e4a07433-35b7-44a6-8db6-62575151488a.text:
Maman,
Je fais mes devoirs de mathématiques chez Louise. Je rentre à 21 heures. Bises et à ce soir.
Patrick
e4a07433-35b7-44a6-8db6-62575151488a.text_en: Mom, I am doing my math homework at Louise's. I will return at 9 PM. Kisses and see you tonight. Patrick
e4a07433-35b7-44a6-8db6-62575151488a.question_fr: Qu’est-ce que Patrick fait chez Louise ?
e4a07433-35b7-44a6-8db6-62575151488a.question_en: What is Patrick doing at Louise's?

options.explanation: He is doing homework, not sleeping.
Doing homework (faire ses devoirs) is considered working (travailler).
Homework is a study task, not play.
There is no mention of eating.

e4a07433-35b7-44a6-8db6-62575151488a.key_line_fr: Je fais mes devoirs de mathématiques chez Louise.
e4a07433-35b7-44a6-8db6-62575151488a.key_line_en: I am doing my math homework at Louise's.
e4a07433-35b7-44a6-8db6-62575151488a.explanation: Patrick explicitly states he is doing his homework, which is a work/study activity.
e4a07433-35b7-44a6-8db6-62575151488a.breakdown: Patrick writes 'Je fais mes devoirs de mathématiques' (I am doing my math homework). In French, doing homework falls under the category of 'travailler' (to work/study), distinct from playing, eating, or sleeping.

e950fc54-da39-453b-afbf-2ddade908a1d.text:
Attention,
Cette semaine, l’accueil de l’université est fermé lundi toute la journée et vendredi après-midi.
e950fc54-da39-453b-afbf-2ddade908a1d.text_en: Attention, This week, the university reception is closed all day Monday and Friday afternoon.
e950fc54-da39-453b-afbf-2ddade908a1d.question_en: What is the purpose of this poster?

options.explanation: The text notifies the public about a temporary closure (Monday and Friday afternoon) for this week, which is a change in schedule.
It mentions the reception but does not describe what the place looks like.
The text is about closure times, not setting up a meeting time with someone.
It is a notification, not an invitation or plan to organize a meeting.

e950fc54-da39-453b-afbf-2ddade908a1d.key_line_fr: Cette semaine, l’accueil de l’université est fermé lundi toute la journée et vendredi après-midi.
e950fc54-da39-453b-afbf-2ddade908a1d.key_line_en: This week, the university reception is closed all day Monday and Friday afternoon.
e950fc54-da39-453b-afbf-2ddade908a1d.explanation: The poster informs students that the reception is closed at specific times this week, which serves to announce a temporary change in hours.
e950fc54-da39-453b-afbf-2ddade908a1d.breakdown:
1. The text begins with 'Attention' and specifies a timeframe: 'Cette semaine' (This week).
2. It states that the university reception ('l’accueil') is 'fermé' (closed) at specific times (Monday all day, Friday afternoon).
3. Informing people about specific closure times for the current week constitutes announcing a change to the normal schedule.

bff41661-7984-4a49-8ceb-878af9ecffee.text:
Alen, bonjour,
C’est d’accord, RV avec les copines chez moi le 30 avril pour déjeuner.
Bisous,
Yvette
bff41661-7984-4a49-8ceb-878af9ecffee.text_en: Alen, hello, It's agreed, meeting with the girlfriends at my place on April 30th for lunch. Kisses, Yvette
bff41661-7984-4a49-8ceb-878af9ecffee.question_fr: Quelles sont les relations entre Aline et Yvette ?
bff41661-7984-4a49-8ceb-878af9ecffee.question_en: What is the relationship between Aline and Yvette?

options.explanation: A professional relationship would not use 'Bisous' or 'copines'.
While family members might use 'Bisous', the text explicitly mentions 'copines' (friends).
The word 'copines' literally means friends, and the tone is casual.
Commercial relationships require formal language, not informal invitations to lunch at home.

bff41661-7984-4a49-8ceb-878af9ecffee.key_line_fr: C’est d’accord, RV avec les copines chez moi le 30 avril pour déjeuner.
bff41661-7984-4a49-8ceb-878af9ecffee.key_line_en: It's agreed, meeting with the girlfriends at my place on April 30th for lunch.
bff41661-7984-4a49-8ceb-878af9ecffee.explanation: The use of the word 'copines' (girlfriends) and the informal closing 'Bisous' indicates a friendly relationship.
bff41661-7984-4a49-8ceb-878af9ecffee.breakdown: The message uses very informal language. 1. The word 'copines' means 'girlfriends' or female friends. 2. The sign-off 'Bisous' (Kisses) is affectionate and used between friends or family, never in business. 3. The invitation is for lunch at home ('chez moi'). The specific mention of 'copines' rules out family or professional ties.

cde474b9-0e41-4989-8978-1b6a982523b5.text:
Nous informons notre aimable clientèle que nous sommes actuellement en vacances jusqu’au dimanche 1er septembre.
Nous aurons le plaisir de vous retrouver à partir du 2. Le magasin ouvrira comme tous les lundis à 11 h.
Bonnes vacances à tous.
cde474b9-0e41-4989-8978-1b6a982523b5.text_en: We inform our kind customers that we are currently on vacation until Sunday, September 1st. We will have the pleasure of seeing you again starting the 2nd. The store will open like every Monday at 11 am. Happy holidays to all.
cde474b9-0e41-4989-8978-1b6a982523b5.question_en: What do we learn about the store?

options.text: Il va avoir de nouveaux horaires
options.text_en: It is going to have new hours
options.explanation: The text states the store will open 'like every Monday' (comme tous les lundis), implying the schedule has not changed.

options.text_en: It is going to change owners
options.explanation: There is no mention of a change in ownership in the text.

options.text_en: It is going to move in September
options.explanation: There is no mention of moving to a new location.

options.text_en: It is going to close during the summer
options.explanation: Being on vacation until September 1st indicates the shop is closed during the summer season.

cde474b9-0e41-4989-8978-1b6a982523b5.key_line_fr: nous sommes actuellement en vacances jusqu’au dimanche 1er septembre.
cde474b9-0e41-4989-8978-1b6a982523b5.key_line_en: we are currently on vacation until Sunday, September 1st.
cde474b9-0e41-4989-8978-1b6a982523b5.explanation: The notice announces a vacation period lasting until September 1st, which corresponds to closing for the summer.
cde474b9-0e41-4989-8978-1b6a982523b5.breakdown: The text is an announcement informing customers that the staff is 'currently on vacation' (actuellement en vacances) and will return on 'Sunday, September 1st'. Since the closure happens before September, it covers the summer period. Therefore, the shop is closed for the summer.

1c4696d9-c0b9-495c-8e5d-e7d6e5078c9e.text:
Salut Paul,
Je t’écris du Canada. J’ai rencontré un étudiant mexicain. Je suis contente de parler ma langue avec lui, car l’Espagne me manque beaucoup.
En juin, nous suivons ensemble une formation en Italie.
Je t’appelle bientôt.
Bisous,
Elsa
1c4696d9-c0b9-495c-8e5d-e7d6e5078c9e.text_en: Hi Paul, I am writing to you from Canada. I met a Mexican student. I am happy to speak my language with him, because I miss Spain a lot. In June, we are taking a training course together in Italy. I will call you soon. Kisses, Elsa

options.explanation: She is writing *from* Canada ('du Canada'), but implies she is a foreigner there.
She says 'I miss Spain a lot' ('l’Espagne me manque'), indicating it is her home country.
Italy is just where she is going for a training course ('formation') in June.
The student she met is Mexican, but she is speaking 'her language' (Spanish) with him.

1c4696d9-c0b9-495c-8e5d-e7d6e5078c9e.key_line_fr: Je suis contente de parler ma langue avec lui, car l’Espagne me manque beaucoup.
1c4696d9-c0b9-495c-8e5d-e7d6e5078c9e.key_line_en: I am happy to speak my language with him, because I miss Spain a lot.
1c4696d9-c0b9-495c-8e5d-e7d6e5078c9e.explanation: Elsa states that she misses Spain and speaks 'her language' with a Mexican student, which identifies her as Spanish.
1c4696d9-c0b9-495c-8e5d-e7d6e5078c9e.breakdown:
1.  Elsa writes 'Je t’écris du Canada' (I write to you from Canada), establishing her current location, not her nationality.
2.  She mentions meeting a 'étudiant mexicain' (Mexican student).
3.  The crucial clue is: 'Je suis contente de parler ma langue avec lui, car l’Espagne me manque beaucoup' (I am happy to speak my language with him, because I miss Spain a lot).
4.  Since she misses Spain and implies Spanish is her language (shared with the Mexican student), her nationality is Spanish.

b049a987-282f-496e-a298-db7e084a1116.text:
Nous avons prévu quelques réparations dans l’appartement à la fin de la semaine.
Veuillez nous excuser pour le bruit.
M. et Mme Garnier 7 avenue du Général Leclerc, Appt. 307

b049a987-282f-496e-a298-db7e084a1116.question_en: What are Mr. and Mrs. Garnier writing to their neighbors?

options.text_en: They are going to move soon
options.explanation: The text says 'réparations' (repairs), not 'déménager' (moving).

options.text_en: They are going to do some work/renovations
options.explanation: 'Faire des travaux' (to do works) is synonymous with doing repairs ('réparations') in this context.

options.text_en: They are going to organize a party
options.explanation: There is no mention of a 'soirée' (party/evening event).

options.text: Ils vont recevoir de la visite
options.text_en: They are going to receive visitors

b049a987-282f-496e-a298-db7e084a1116.key_line_fr: Nous avons prévu quelques réparations dans l’appartement à la fin de la semaine.

c5be1467-4f77-4e83-a740-87a9b843ecd0.text:
Chère Cathy,
Après six mois de travaux, Pierre et moi avons quitté la maison de ses parents et nous sommes enfin installés chez nous !
Nous fêtons l’événement le dimanche 23 juin à partir de 19 h 30.
J’espère que tu pourras venir !
Lésa
c5be1467-4f77-4e83-a740-87a9b843ecd0.text_en: Dear Cathy, After six months of renovations, Pierre and I left his parents' house and we finally moved into our own place! We are celebrating the event on Sunday, June 23rd starting at 7:30 PM. I hope you can come! Lésa
c5be1467-4f77-4e83-a740-87a9b843ecd0.question_en: What is Lésa going to celebrate?

options.explanation: The text mentions the parents' house, but says nothing about their retirement.
There is no mention of a wedding or anniversary in the text.
The phrase 'installés chez nous' (moved into our own place) indicates they have acquired a new home.
The word 'travaux' (works/renovations) refers to the house, not a business creation.

c5be1467-4f77-4e83-a740-87a9b843ecd0.key_line_fr: Pierre et moi avons quitté la maison de ses parents et nous sommes enfin installés chez nous !
c5be1467-4f77-4e83-a740-87a9b843ecd0.key_line_en: Pierre and I left his parents' house and we finally moved into our own place!
c5be1467-4f77-4e83-a740-87a9b843ecd0.explanation: Lésa writes that they have finished renovations and moved into their own place ('chez nous'), so they are celebrating their new home.
c5be1467-4f77-4e83-a740-87a9b843ecd0.breakdown: The text states that Lésa and Pierre have 'left his parents' house' (quitté la maison de ses parents) and 'finally moved into our own place' (enfin installés chez nous). They are celebrating this event. 'Chez nous' refers to their new home, which corresponds to 'un nouveau logement'.

28bbc98c-5e6f-43f2-b3fa-fd668154678b.text:

28bbc98c-5e6f-43f2-b3fa-fd668154678b.question_en: What can associations do on this website?

options.explanation: The text mentions an open position ('poste est libre') and publishing an ad with salary details, which means offering a job.
The text discusses publishing an advertisement, not discussing topics in a forum.
The purpose is specific to filling a vacancy, not generally presenting the association's mission or actions.
The text mentions listing a salary for a new hire, not raising funds for the association.

28bbc98c-5e6f-43f2-b3fa-fd668154678b.key_line_fr: Un poste est libre dans votre association.
28bbc98c-5e6f-43f2-b3fa-fd668154678b.key_line_en: A position is open in your association.
28bbc98c-5e6f-43f2-b3fa-fd668154678b.explanation: The text explicitly invites associations with an open position ('poste est libre') to publish an ad, which is the definition of offering a job.
28bbc98c-5e6f-43f2-b3fa-fd668154678b.breakdown: The text begins by stating 'Un poste est libre dans votre association' (A position is open in your association). 0430ee4a-0eac-4821-90ea-2e3bbba64e3f.text:
Madame,
Nous avons bien reçu votre demande de remboursement pour un billet de train (voyage professionnel).
Vous nous avez envoyé le ticket de carte bancaire, mais nous avons aussi besoin d’une attestation de votre employeur.
Merci de nous l’adresser par courrier postal ou sous format électronique.
Cordialement,
Le service financier.
0430ee4a-0eac-4821-90ea-2e3bbba64e3f.text_en: Madam, We have received your reimbursement request for a train ticket (business trip). You sent us the credit card receipt, but we also need a certificate from your employer. Please send it to us by post or in electronic format. Sincerely, The Financial Department.
0430ee4a-0eac-4821-90ea-2e3bbba64e3f.question_fr: Quel document doit fournir la femme ?
0430ee4a-0eac-4821-90ea-2e3bbba64e3f.question_en: What document must the woman provide?

options.explanation: The requested 'attestation de votre employeur' (employer's certificate) is a type of professional document.
The text mentions the train ticket (billet de train) as the subject of the refund, but the specific document now requested is the employer's certificate.
The text mentions sending by 'courrier postal' (postal mail), but does not ask the user to provide a stamped envelope.
The woman is asking for a reimbursement (receiving money), not providing money.

0430ee4a-0eac-4821-90ea-2e3bbba64e3f.key_line_fr: nous avons aussi besoin d’une attestation de votre employeur.
0430ee4a-0eac-4821-90ea-2e3bbba64e3f.key_line_en: we also need a certificate from your employer.
0430ee4a-0eac-4821-90ea-2e3bbba64e3f.explanation: The financial service specifically asks for an 'attestation de votre employeur', which qualifies as a professional document.
0430ee4a-0eac-4821-90ea-2e3bbba64e3f.breakdown: The text acknowledges receipt of a reimbursement request and a credit card receipt. However, it explicitly states: 'nous avons aussi besoin d’une attestation de votre employeur' (we also need a certificate from your employer). An employer's certificate is a work-related paper, which corresponds to 'Un document professionnel'.

4f5aa150-5895-4dc9-adc3-c2fad5c3ccc3.text:
Semaine du 6 au 10 septembre :
Le restaurant universitaire vous propose des recettes régionales variées au tarif normal.
Rendez-vous de 11 h 15 à 13 h dans la salle du premier étage.
Bon appétit !

4f5aa150-5895-4dc9-adc3-c2fad5c3ccc3.question_fr: Que propose le restaurant du 6 au 10 septembre ?
4f5aa150-5895-4dc9-adc3-c2fad5c3ccc3.question_en: What does the restaurant offer from September 6 to 10?

options.explanation: The text offers 'recipes' to eat (restaurant context), not 'cours' (classes) to learn how to cook.
The text mentions 'recettes régionales variées' (varied regional recipes), which corresponds to offering different menus.
There is no mention of 'à emporter' (takeaway); the text invites people to a room ('salle') to eat.

4f5aa150-5895-4dc9-adc3-c2fad5c3ccc3.explanation: The announcement states that the restaurant is offering 'varied regional recipes,' which means they are providing different types of menus.
4f5aa150-5895-4dc9-adc3-c2fad5c3ccc3.breakdown:
1. Scan the text for the specific dates mentioned in the question (September 6-10).

3. Compare this with the options:
   - Option A suggests cooking classes, but the text says 'recettes' (recipes/dishes) are proposed for eating, not teaching.
   - Option B suggests different menus. The word 'variées' (varied) in the text confirms diversity in the meals.
   - Option C suggests takeaway, which is not mentioned.
   - Option D suggests cheap tickets. The text says 'tarif normal' (standard rate), implying no special discount.
4. Conclusion: 'Recettes variées' best matches 'Menus différents'.

36b81fce-ce2b-4f55-bde9-a7ad27428afe.text:

a4057c7d-22d8-4899-b332-3dfbc3917576.text:
La librairie des Orques à Paris a récolté 9000 euros de ses clients afin de financer son déménagement.
Un résultat inespéré qui a permis à la librairie de s’agrandir.
Lors de l’inauguration, la librairie a offert un verre à ses généreux donateurs.
En fonction du montant de leur participation, ils ont reçu un livre de leur choix ou ont obtenu le statut de client d’or, signifié par une plaque à leur nom sur le mobilier de la librairie.

An unhoped-for result that allowed the bookstore to expand. During the inauguration, the bookstore offered a drink to its generous donors. Depending on the amount of their contribution, they received a book of their choice or obtained the status of 'gold client', signified by a plaque with their name on the bookstore's furniture.

options.text: Pour acheter des meubles de bibliothèque
options.explanation: Furniture ('mobilier') is mentioned only in the context of rewarding donors with a plaque, not as the purpose of the fundraising.

options.text: Pour organiser un concours de lecture
options.explanation: The text does not mention a reading contest.

options.text: Pour ouvrir un salon de thé littéraire
options.text_en: To open a literary tea salon
options.explanation: There is no mention of opening a tea salon.

options.text: Pour s’installer dans un local plus vaste
options.explanation: This option paraphrases the text: 'déménagement' (move) corresponds to 's'installer' (to settle in), and 's'agrandir' (to expand) implies a 'local plus vaste' (larger premises).

a4057c7d-22d8-4899-b332-3dfbc3917576.key_line_fr: financer son déménagement. Un résultat inespéré qui a permis à la librairie de s’agrandir.
a4057c7d-22d8-4899-b332-3dfbc3917576.key_line_en: finance its move. An unhoped-for result that allowed the bookstore to expand.
a4057c7d-22d8-4899-b332-3dfbc3917576.explanation: The text mentions financing a move ('déménagement') to expand ('s'agrandir'), which means moving to a larger location.
a4057c7d-22d8-4899-b332-3dfbc3917576.breakdown: The text explicitly states that the money was collected 'afin de financer son déménagement' (in order to finance its move) and that this allowed the bookstore to 's’agrandir' (to expand). 60e46aa3-4d2e-4b16-9fc7-31179c358ba5.text:
Madame Guilbert,
L’imprimante de mon bureau ne fonctionne pas.
Mes consultations commencent demain à 14 h.
Pourriez-vous commander rapidement du papier et de l’encre, s’il vous plaît ?
Merci,
Docteur Philippe
60e46aa3-4d2e-4b16-9fc7-31179c358ba5.text_en:
Madame Guilbert,
The printer in my office is not working.
My consultations start tomorrow at 2 p.m.
Could you quickly order paper and ink, please?
Thank you,
Doctor Philippe

options.explanation: The doctor explicitly asks her to 'order paper and ink', which is synonymous with buying supplies (matériel).
Although he says the printer 'doesn't work', his specific request is to order ink and paper, implying the lack of supplies is the issue, not a mechanical failure requiring a repairman.
The doctor implies he needs to print things for his consultations, but he is asking her to get the supplies, not to do the printing herself.
He mentions his consultations start tomorrow, but this is context for the urgency, not a request to schedule an appointment.

60e46aa3-4d2e-4b16-9fc7-31179c358ba5.key_line_fr: Pourriez-vous commander rapidement du papier et de l’encre, s’il vous plaît ?
60e46aa3-4d2e-4b16-9fc7-31179c358ba5.key_line_en: Could you quickly order paper and ink, please?
60e46aa3-4d2e-4b16-9fc7-31179c358ba5.explanation: The doctor asks Madame Guilbert to order paper and ink, which matches the option 'Buy supplies'.
60e46aa3-4d2e-4b16-9fc7-31179c358ba5.breakdown:
1. **Analyze the request**: The text is a note from Doctor Philippe to Madame Guilbert.
2. **Identify the problem**: He states the printer is not working ('L’imprimante... ne fonctionne pas').
3. **Locate the specific instruction**: He asks, 'Pourriez-vous commander rapidement du papier et de l’encre' (Could you quickly order paper and ink).
4. **Match with options**: 'Commander' (to order) paper and ink falls under the category of 'Acheter du matériel' (Buying supplies/equipment).
5. **Eliminate distractors**: He mentions the printer isn't working, but asks for supplies, not a repairman (Option B). He mentions consultations, but doesn't ask to schedule them (Option D).

a73ec69c-e9c0-4fbb-9f46-1f9e64196c05.text:
Cher Paul,
Je suis désolée de t’avoir laissé sans nouvelle.
Je pensais t’écrire de Fès, mais notre séjour ne s’est pas déroulé comme nous l’espérions.
Nous avons passé trois nuits supplémentaires à Tanger à cause d’un problème technique sur une de nos lignes touristiques.
Nous avons aussi annulé le rendez-vous prévu aujourd’hui avec notre client de Casablanca, car nous avons dû nous rendre à Marrakech pour régler les frais occasionnés par cet incident.
Nous rentrons demain à Paris.
Bises,
Mathilde
a73ec69c-e9c0-4fbb-9f46-1f9e64196c05.text_en:
Dear Paul,
I am sorry for leaving you without news.
I thought I would write to you from Fes, but our stay did not go as we hoped.
We spent three extra nights in Tangier due to a technical problem on one of our tourist lines.
We also cancelled the appointment scheduled for today with our client from Casablanca, because we had to go to Marrakech to settle the costs caused by this incident.
We are returning to Paris tomorrow.
Kisses,
Mathilde
a73ec69c-e9c0-4fbb-9f46-1f9e64196c05.question_fr: Dans quelle ville se trouve Mathilde d’après cette lettre ?
a73ec69c-e9c0-4fbb-9f46-1f9e64196c05.question_en: In which city is Mathilde according to this letter?

options.explanation: She intended to write from Fès, but plans changed ('Je pensais t’écrire de Fès, mais...').
The client is from Casablanca, but the meeting was cancelled, so she did not go there.
She states they had to travel to Marrakech to handle expenses related to the technical incident.
They spent three nights there previously, but have since moved on ('Nous avons passé...').

a73ec69c-e9c0-4fbb-9f46-1f9e64196c05.key_line_fr: car nous avons dû nous rendre à Marrakech pour régler les frais occasionnés par cet incident.
a73ec69c-e9c0-4fbb-9f46-1f9e64196c05.key_line_en: because we had to go to Marrakech to settle the costs caused by this incident.
a73ec69c-e9c0-4fbb-9f46-1f9e64196c05.explanation: Mathilde mentions that they had to travel to Marrakech to settle costs, making it her current location before returning to Paris tomorrow.
a73ec69c-e9c0-4fbb-9f46-1f9e64196c05.breakdown:
To determine Mathilde's current location, analyze the timeline and locations mentioned: 
1. **Fès**: She planned to write from there, but the trip didn't go as expected ('Je pensais t’écrire de Fès, mais...').
2. **Tanger**: They spent three extra nights there in the past ('Nous avons passé...').
3. **Casablanca**: The client is from Casablanca, but the meeting was cancelled.
4. **Marrakech**: She explains that they cancelled today's meeting because they 'had to go to Marrakech' ('nous avons dû nous rendre à Marrakech') to settle costs. Since they are returning to Paris tomorrow, this implies she is currently writing from Marrakech.

b1c9f6df-eebf-4ff3-a130-062dcfccd5da.text:
Olivier Pollet, co-fondateur d’Escursia, veut développer le tourisme scientifique.
C’est un tourisme permettant de découvrir et d’apprendre sur la nature, la faune et la flore, au cours de treks ou de randonnées guidées par des accompagnateurs scientifiques professionnels désirant faire partager leurs connaissances.
Ces séjours sont ouverts à tous les publics et pour y prendre part, il ne faut pas nécessairement disposer d’une excellente condition physique, il faut juste une pointe de curiosité et le sens de l’observation.
b1c9f6df-eebf-4ff3-a130-062dcfccd5da.text_en: Olivier Pollet, co-founder of Escursia, wants to develop scientific tourism. It is a type of tourism that allows discovering and learning about nature, fauna, and flora, during treks or hikes guided by professional scientific guides wishing to share their knowledge. These stays are open to the general public and to take part, one does not necessarily need to have excellent physical condition, one just needs a touch of curiosity and a sense of observation.
b1c9f6df-eebf-4ff3-a130-062dcfccd5da.question_fr: Quelle est la particularité du tourisme scientifique ?
b1c9f6df-eebf-4ff3-a130-062dcfccd5da.question_en: What is the particularity of scientific tourism?

options.text: Il fait observer la nature de façon différente
options.text_en: It makes one observe nature in a different way.
options.explanation: The involvement of scientific guides and the focus on learning and observation imply a unique, educational perspective on nature.

options.text: Il aide au développement de la recherche
options.text_en: It helps the development of research.
options.explanation: The text mentions sharing existing knowledge, not contributing to the development of new research.

options.text: Il nécessite un bon entrainement sportif
options.explanation: The text explicitly states that excellent physical condition is not necessary.

options.text: Il s’adresse à des spécialistes passionnés
options.text_en: It is addressed to passionate specialists.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states that these stays are 'open to the general public', not just specialists.

b1c9f6df-eebf-4ff3-a130-062dcfccd5da.key_line_fr: C’est un tourisme permettant de découvrir et d’apprendre sur la nature, la faune et la flore, au cours de treks ou de randonnées guidées par des accompagnateurs scientifiques professionnels désirant faire partager leurs connaissances.
b1c9f6df-eebf-4ff3-a130-062dcfccd5da.key_line_en: It is a type of tourism that allows discovering and learning about nature, fauna, and flora, during treks or hikes guided by professional scientific guides wishing to share their knowledge.
b1c9f6df-eebf-4ff3-a130-062dcfccd5da.explanation: Scientific tourism is defined by the presence of scientific guides and an educational approach, offering a different way to observe nature without requiring expertise or high fitness.
b1c9f6df-eebf-4ff3-a130-062dcfccd5da.breakdown:
1. Analyze the definition: Scientific tourism involves 'discovering and learning' about nature with 'professional scientific guides'.
2. Evaluate Option C: The text explicitly states, 'one does not necessarily need to have excellent physical condition' (il ne faut pas nécessairement disposer d’une excellente condition physique), so C is false.
3. Evaluate Option D: The text states it is 'open to the general public' (ouverts à tous les publics), so it is not limited to specialists. D is false.
4. Evaluate Option B: The text says guides want to 'share their knowledge', not that the tourism helps develop new research. B is unsupported.
5. Evaluate Option A: By emphasizing 'learning', 'scientific guides', and 'sense of observation', the text implies a specific, educational way of viewing nature, distinct from ordinary tourism. This aligns with 'observing nature in a different way'.

4529fec3-da31-45a1-8663-be10df371238.text:
Les gardes-chasse d’Orly ont lancé une campagne de capture des lapins vivant sur l’aéroport, afin de les expatrier vers le sud de la France, dont la faune et la flore ont été dévastées par les grands incendies de l’été dernier.
Le lapin élevé au kérosène va donc se refaire une santé auprès des romarins et des thyms de Provence.
On connaît des riverains qui aimeraient bien être des petits lapins !
4529fec3-da31-45a1-8663-be10df371238.text_en: The gamekeepers of Orly launched a campaign to capture the rabbits living at the airport, in order to expatriate them to the south of France, whose flora and fauna were devastated by last summer's major fires. The kerosene-raised rabbit will therefore restore its health among the rosemary and thyme of Provence. We know some local residents who would love to be little rabbits!
4529fec3-da31-45a1-8663-be10df371238.question_fr: Qu’est-il arrivé aux lapins de l’aéroport d’Orly ?
4529fec3-da31-45a1-8663-be10df371238.question_en: What happened to the rabbits at Orly airport?

options.text: On les a tués afin de les manger
options.text_en: They were killed in order to eat them
options.explanation: The text mentions capturing them to move them ('expatrier'), not killing ('tués') or eating them.

options.text: On les a attrapés et emmenés ailleurs
options.text_en: They were caught and taken elsewhere
options.explanation: This aligns with the text: 'capture' corresponds to 'attrapés' and 'expatrier' corresponds to 'emmenés ailleurs'.

options.text: On les a chassés de l’aéroport
options.text_en: They were chased away from the airport
options.explanation: While they are being removed, 'chassés' (chased away) implies simply driving them out. The text specifies they were captured and transported to a specific location.

options.text: On les a soignés et relâchés
options.explanation: They were not treated medically before release; the text says they will 'restore their health' naturally in the new environment.

4529fec3-da31-45a1-8663-be10df371238.key_line_fr: Les gardes-chasse d’Orly ont lancé une campagne de capture des lapins vivant sur l’aéroport, afin de les expatrier vers le sud de la France
4529fec3-da31-45a1-8663-be10df371238.key_line_en: The gamekeepers of Orly launched a campaign to capture the rabbits living at the airport, in order to expatriate them to the south of France
4529fec3-da31-45a1-8663-be10df371238.explanation: The rabbits were captured at the airport to be relocated to the South of France, which matches the option of being caught and taken elsewhere.
4529fec3-da31-45a1-8663-be10df371238.breakdown:
The text explicitly states that the gamekeepers launched a 'campagne de capture' (capture campaign) to 'expatrier' (expatriate/relocate) the rabbits to the south of France. 

1. 'Capture' matches 'attrapés' (caught).
2. 'Expatrier vers le sud' matches 'emmenés ailleurs' (taken elsewhere).

Therefore, option B is the correct summary of the action taken.

5568f508-41f3-4f80-a002-1d95d1d68e3d.text:
Il y a beaucoup d’avantages démontrés par les faits à choisir la Suisse pour y effectuer ses études ou une partie de celles-ci.
La qualité de vie, celle des formations dispensées, même si elles sont souvent chères, la situation géographique et l’ouverture internationale du pays.
Du côté des défauts, mentionnons le fait que toutes les filières et formations ne sont pas représentées, ce qui est le cas dans la plupart des petits pays.
5568f508-41f3-4f80-a002-1d95d1d68e3d.text_en: There are many fact-proven advantages to choosing Switzerland to carry out one's studies or part of them. The quality of life, that of the education provided, even if they are often expensive, the geographical location and the international openness of the country. Regarding the defects, let us mention the fact that not all fields and courses are represented, which is the case in most small countries.
5568f508-41f3-4f80-a002-1d95d1d68e3d.question_fr: Quel avantage présente l’enseignement supérieur dans ce pays ?
5568f508-41f3-4f80-a002-1d95d1d68e3d.question_en: What advantage does higher education present in this country?

options.text: Le choix des matières est vaste

5568f508-41f3-4f80-a002-1d95d1d68e3d.key_line_fr: La qualité de vie, celle des formations dispensées, même si elles sont souvent chères...
5568f508-41f3-4f80-a002-1d95d1d68e3d.key_line_en: The quality of life, that of the education provided, even if they are often expensive...
