67f4fc36-c336-4f4c-aa0d-826e8d5ccd7a.key_line_fr: Adoptées séparément à la naissance, des jumelles indonésiennes se sont retrouvées 29 ans plus tard en Suède.
67f4fc36-c336-4f4c-aa0d-826e8d5ccd7a.key_line_en: Adopted separately at birth, Indonesian twins reunited 29 years later in Sweden.
67f4fc36-c336-4f4c-aa0d-826e8d5ccd7a.explanation: The text explicitly mentions that the twins found each other in Sweden and lived only 40 km apart, confirming they live in the same country.
67f4fc36-c336-4f4c-aa0d-826e8d5ccd7a.breakdown:
1. The text states the twins reunited 'en Suède' (in Sweden) and 'habitaient à 40 km l’une de l’autre' (lived 40 km from each other).
2. Living 40 km apart within Sweden confirms they reside in the same country.
3. Option A is incorrect; only one twin posted on Facebook, and 'loving' it is not mentioned.
4. Option B is incorrect; while they are both teachers ('enseignantes'), the text does not say they work at the same school.
5. Option D is incorrect because the very first sentence says they were 'Adoptées séparément' (Adopted separately).

557cb2c7-1998-4887-a64b-644ee7ddc2e5.text:
« Avec un Master Commerce en poche, je ne pensais pas qu’il serait à ce point difficile de trouver mon premier emploi.
Et pourtant, quel chemin semé d’embûches !
Tout le monde me disait : “Ne t’inquiète pas, dans deux ou trois mois tu auras trouvé !”
Sept mois plus tard, toujours rien en vue.
À 26 ans, je me retrouve sans emploi, toujours chez mes parents.
L’avenir ? Je le vois ailleurs, je prépare activement mon départ pour l’Angleterre. »
Amandine n’est pas une exception chez les jeunes.
Les diplômes ne suffisent plus à assurer une situation stable en France et beaucoup de jeunes décident de partir à l’étranger pour obtenir un emploi.
557cb2c7-1998-4887-a64b-644ee7ddc2e5.text_en:
« With a Master's in Business in my pocket, I didn't think it would be this difficult to find my first job.
And yet, what a path strewn with pitfalls!
Everyone told me: “Don't worry, in two or three months you'll have found something!”
Seven months later, still nothing in sight.
At 26, I find myself unemployed, still living with my parents.
The future? I see it elsewhere, I am actively preparing my departure for England. »
Amandine is not an exception among young people.
Diplomas are no longer enough to ensure a stable situation in France and many young people decide to go abroad to get a job.
557cb2c7-1998-4887-a64b-644ee7ddc2e5.question_fr: De quoi est-il question dans cet article ?

options.text: La difficulté de trouver un stage à travailler
options.text_en: The difficulty of finding an internship to work
options.explanation: The text specifically mentions searching for a 'premier emploi' (first job), not a 'stage' (internship).

options.text: La nécessite de s’exiler pour pouvoir travailler
options.text_en: The necessity to go into exile to be able to work
options.explanation: The text concludes that many young people leave for foreign countries ('partir à l’étranger') to find work, which corresponds to the necessity of exiling oneself ('s'exiler').

options.text: Le manque de formation des jeunes diplômés
options.text_en: The lack of training among young graduates
options.explanation: The text mentions Amandine has a 'Master Commerce', indicating she is well-trained. The issue is the market, not a lack of education.

options.text: Le niveau trop faible des salaires proposés
options.text_en: The level of offered salaries being too low
options.explanation: The text discusses the lack of job offers, not the salary levels ('salaires').

557cb2c7-1998-4887-a64b-644ee7ddc2e5.key_line_fr: Les diplômes ne suffisent plus à assurer une situation stable en France et beaucoup de jeunes décident de partir à l’étranger pour obtenir un emploi.
557cb2c7-1998-4887-a64b-644ee7ddc2e5.key_line_en: Diplomas are no longer enough to ensure a stable situation in France and many young people decide to go abroad to get a job.

vocabulary.gloss: to go into exile / to move abroad

557cb2c7-1998-4887-a64b-644ee7ddc2e5.explanation: The article discusses young graduates who leave France to work abroad because they cannot find jobs locally.
557cb2c7-1998-4887-a64b-644ee7ddc2e5.breakdown:
1. The text describes Amandine, who has a Master's degree but cannot find a job in France after seven months.
2. She states she sees her future elsewhere and is preparing to leave for England.
3. The concluding paragraph generalizes this, stating that many young people decide to 'go abroad' (partir à l'étranger) to find work.
4. Option B uses the synonym 's'exiler' (to go into exile/move abroad) to describe this necessity of leaving the country to find work, which perfectly matches the text's main theme.

3e52afc6-c4c6-4bc3-957e-900280b98e12.text:
Pour ou contre les devoirs ?
Une école donne sa réponse en accueillant chaque lundi, de 17 à 18 heures, les élèves qui peuvent revenir en classe faire leurs devoirs avec leur enseignant… et leurs parents.
Ainsi, un dialogue s’instaure entre enseignants, parents et élèves.
Le directeur relève un autre avantage : les devoirs sont bien faits.
Mais les devoirs alourdissent des journées déjà longues.
Avec six heures de cours, quatre jours par semaine, l’écolier français décroche la première place sur le podium de la fatigue.
3e52afc6-c4c6-4bc3-957e-900280b98e12.text_en: For or against homework? One school gives its answer by welcoming students every Monday, from 5 to 6 pm, who can come back to the classroom to do their homework with their teacher... and their parents. Thus, a dialogue is established between teachers, parents, and students. The principal notes another advantage: homework is done well. But homework weighs down already long days. With six hours of classes, four days a week, the French schoolchild takes first place on the podium of fatigue.

options.text: D’alléger les emplois du temps le lundi pour les professeurs
options.text_en: To lighten the schedules on Mondays for teachers
options.explanation: The text does not mention reducing working hours for teachers; in fact, teachers are present from 17:00 to 18:00.

options.text: De permettre aux enfants de faire leur travail du soir en classe
options.text_en: To allow children to do their evening work in class
options.explanation: The phrase 'revenir en classe faire leurs devoirs' (return to class to do their homework) matches the option 'do their evening work in class'.

options.text: De supprimer totalement le travail à la maison pour les élèves
options.text_en: To totally eliminate homework for students
options.explanation: The school is not eliminating homework; they are providing a specific time and place to do it.

options.text: D’inviter les parents à des visites régulières de l’établissement
options.text_en: To invite parents for regular visits to the establishment
options.explanation: While parents are invited, the specific purpose is to help with homework, not merely for 'regular visits' to the facility.

3e52afc6-c4c6-4bc3-957e-900280b98e12.key_line_fr: Une école donne sa réponse en accueillant chaque lundi, de 17 à 18 heures, les élèves qui peuvent revenir en classe faire leurs devoirs avec leur enseignant… et leurs parents.
3e52afc6-c4c6-4bc3-957e-900280b98e12.key_line_en: One school gives its answer by welcoming students every Monday, from 5 to 6 pm, who can come back to the classroom to do their homework with their teacher... and their parents.
3e52afc6-c4c6-4bc3-957e-900280b98e12.explanation: The text describes a specific initiative where students return to school to complete their homework, matching Option B.
3e52afc6-c4c6-4bc3-957e-900280b98e12.breakdown: The text explicitly states that the school welcomes students on Mondays from 5 PM to 6 PM to 'come back to class to do their homework' (revenir en classe faire leurs devoirs). This directly corresponds to Option B, which rephrases 'homework' as 'evening work' (travail du soir) done in class.

29895499-170a-4811-a263-72cf71085f20.text:
Pour permettre à tous un accès égal au sport, la maison départementale des personnes handicapées offre d’accompagner ceux qui sont en situation de handicap dans leurs projets de loisirs sportifs.
Ce service propose une aide dans le choix d’une activité, une recherche de clubs capables de les accueillir et si besoin, un accompagnement dans le premier contact avec l’association.
Il s’agit de partir des besoins, des envies et des possibilités de la personne, pour construire avec elle son projet sportif adapté.
29895499-170a-4811-a263-72cf71085f20.text_en: To allow everyone equal access to sport, the departmental house for disabled persons offers to accompany those with disabilities in their sports leisure projects. This service proposes help in the choice of an activity, a search for clubs capable of welcoming them and if needed, an accompaniment in the first contact with the association. It involves starting from the needs, desires, and possibilities of the person, to build with them their adapted sports project.
29895499-170a-4811-a263-72cf71085f20.question_en: What does the departmental house propose?

options.text: De faciliter les rencontres avec des sportifs handicapés
options.text_en: To facilitate meetings with disabled athletes
options.explanation: The text mentions finding clubs, not facilitating social meetings between athletes.

options.text: De trouver des entraineurs spécialisés en handisport
options.text_en: To find coaches specialized in disability sports
options.explanation: The service searches for welcoming clubs, not specifically for specialized coaches.

options.text: D’encourager les personnes handicapées à faire du sport
options.text_en: To encourage disabled people to do sport
options.explanation: By offering support, choices, and club access, the house encourages and enables sports participation.

options.text: D’organiser les matches avec des sportifs handicapés
options.text_en: To organize matches with disabled athletes
options.explanation: The text discusses leisure projects and joining clubs, not organizing matches.

29895499-170a-4811-a263-72cf71085f20.key_line_fr: Pour permettre à tous un accès égal au sport, la maison départementale des personnes handicapées offre d’accompagner ceux qui sont en situation de handicap dans leurs projets de loisirs sportifs.
29895499-170a-4811-a263-72cf71085f20.key_line_en: To allow everyone equal access to sport, the departmental house for disabled persons offers to accompany those with disabilities in their sports leisure projects.
29895499-170a-4811-a263-72cf71085f20.explanation: The organization helps disabled individuals choose activities and find clubs, thereby encouraging and supporting them in practicing sports.
29895499-170a-4811-a263-72cf71085f20.breakdown:
The text states that the departmental house wants to 'allow everyone equal access to sport' and 'offers to accompany those with disabilities in their sports leisure projects.' It provides help choosing activities and finding clubs. 

Option A is incorrect because the text mentions finding clubs to join, not organizing social meetings with other athletes.
Option B is incorrect because the text focuses on finding 'clubs capable of welcoming them,' not specifically headhunting individual specialized coaches.
Option C is correct because by offering guidance, club searches, and support to ensure equal access, the organization is actively encouraging and enabling disabled people to participate in sports.
Option D is incorrect because the service helps with joining associations/clubs, not organizing specific matches.

1cf2de74-214f-497c-a5ca-edd56fcd9a92.text:
COMMENT APPRENDRE UNE LANGUE ÉTRANGÈRE
Existe-t-il un âge critique au-delà duquel on ne peut plus jamais atteindre le niveau d’un locuteur natif ?
Ce sujet fait l’objet de nombreux débats.
Plus on est jeune, plus on a d’appétit pour découvrir le monde.
L’apprentissage d’une langue, quelle qu’elle soit, est donc plus simple.
Mais il y a également une composante sociale.
On se comporte avec l’enfant d’une manière bien particulière, que l’on ne peut reproduire avec un adolescent ou un adulte.
1cf2de74-214f-497c-a5ca-edd56fcd9a92.text_en:
HOW TO LEARN A FOREIGN LANGUAGE
Is there a critical age beyond which one can never reach the level of a native speaker?
This subject is the topic of many debates.
The younger one is, the more appetite one has to discover the world.
Learning a language, whatever it may be, is therefore simpler.
But there is also a social component.
We behave with a child in a very specific way, which cannot be reproduced with a teenager or an adult.
1cf2de74-214f-497c-a5ca-edd56fcd9a92.question_fr: D’après cet extrait, qu’est-ce qui favorise chez les enfants l’apprentissage d’une langue étrangère ?
1cf2de74-214f-497c-a5ca-edd56fcd9a92.question_en: According to this extract, what favors foreign language learning in children?

options.explanation: The text states young people have an "appetite to discover the world," which is synonymous with curiosity.
Imagination is not mentioned in the text as a factor for language learning.
While memory is often associated with learning, the text does not explicitly mention it here.
Obedience is not discussed in the text.

1cf2de74-214f-497c-a5ca-edd56fcd9a92.key_line_fr: Plus on est jeune, plus on a d’appétit pour découvrir le monde.
1cf2de74-214f-497c-a5ca-edd56fcd9a92.key_line_en: The younger one is, the more appetite one has to discover the world.
1cf2de74-214f-497c-a5ca-edd56fcd9a92.explanation: The text explicitly links the ease of learning in youth to the "appetite to discover the world," which corresponds directly to curiosity.
1cf2de74-214f-497c-a5ca-edd56fcd9a92.breakdown:
1. The question asks what facilitates language learning in children based on the text.
2. Locate the sentence describing young people: "Plus on est jeune, plus on a d’appétit pour découvrir le monde" (The younger one is, the more appetite one has to discover the world).
3. Compare this description with the options.
4. "Appétit pour découvrir le monde" (appetite to discover the world) is a definition of curiosity.
5. Therefore, Option A is the correct answer.

02d4ea6f-75ec-473e-a4f6-935baea27272.text:
La question de l’orientation est fondamentale et se pose inévitablement au moment de commencer des études universitaires.
Comment faire le bon choix ?
Sur quelles bases ?
Quel parcours sera le mieux adapté à la personnalité scolaire et psychologique, aux capacités de l’étudiant ?
Un livre, édité par le magazine l’Étudiant, propose une démarche progressive qui aide à définir un projet en fonction des goûts et d’un objectif professionnel.
02d4ea6f-75ec-473e-a4f6-935baea27272.text_en: The question of orientation is fundamental and inevitably arises when starting university studies. How to make the right choice? On what grounds? Which path will be best adapted to the student's academic and psychological personality and capabilities? A book, published by the magazine l'Étudiant, proposes a progressive approach that helps define a project based on tastes and a professional goal.
02d4ea6f-75ec-473e-a4f6-935baea27272.question_fr: Que peut-on trouver dans ce livre ?
02d4ea6f-75ec-473e-a4f6-935baea27272.question_en: What can be found in this book?

options.text: Des idées de stages en entreprises
options.explanation: The text discusses choosing a study path, not finding practical work experience or internships ('stages').
The text focuses on the decision-making process ('choisir', 'définir un projet'), not the administrative procedures for enrollment ('inscription').

options.text: Une méthode pour choisir une formation
options.text_en: A method for choosing a training course
options.explanation: The phrase 'une démarche progressive qui aide à définir un projet' (a progressive approach to help define a project) is synonymous with 'une méthode pour choisir une formation' (a method for choosing a training).

options.text_en: A selection of the best universities
options.explanation: The text focuses on the student's suitability ('personnalité', 'capacités') rather than a ranking or selection of the best institutions.

02d4ea6f-75ec-473e-a4f6-935baea27272.key_line_fr: Un livre, édité par le magazine l’Étudiant, propose une démarche progressive qui aide à définir un projet en fonction des goûts et d’un objectif professionnel.
02d4ea6f-75ec-473e-a4f6-935baea27272.key_line_en: A book, published by the magazine l'Étudiant, proposes a progressive approach that helps define a project based on tastes and a professional goal.
02d4ea6f-75ec-473e-a4f6-935baea27272.explanation: The text describes a book that offers a step-by-step approach to help students decide on their future studies, which constitutes a method for choosing a formation.
02d4ea6f-75ec-473e-a4f6-935baea27272.breakdown: The text introduces a problem: choosing a university path ('orientation', 'faire le bon choix'). It then presents a solution: a book published by l'Étudiant. The text explicitly states that this book proposes 'une démarche progressive qui aide à définir un projet' (a progressive approach that helps define a project). This matches Option C, which describes a 'method for choosing a training course'. The other options (internships, registration steps, university rankings) are not mentioned in the text.

ddeaaf52-a27f-4453-97d9-0e7d1506ee51.text:
Madame Mansion,
Suite à notre conversation téléphonique pour le travail de secrétaire, nous aimerions vous rencontrer jeudi prochain à 10 h 00 dans nos bureaux.
Il faudra apporter une photocopie de votre carte d’identité et de vos diplômes.
Merci de nous rappeler pour confirmer.
Cordialement,
Mathieu Leroux
Directeur du service des ressources humaines
ddeaaf52-a27f-4453-97d9-0e7d1506ee51.text_en: Mrs. Mansion, Following our telephone conversation regarding the secretary job, we would like to meet you next Thursday at 10:00 AM in our offices. You will need to bring a photocopy of your ID card and your diplomas. Please call us back to confirm. Sincerely, Mathieu Leroux, Human Resources Director

options.explanation: The text proposes a meeting time, it does not ask to cancel it.
She is asked to 'apporter' (bring) documents to the meeting, not just search for them. The immediate action required is to confirm.
She needs to bring copies of diplomas, not send a CV.
The phrase 'Merci de nous rappeler' explicitly instructs her to phone the company.

ddeaaf52-a27f-4453-97d9-0e7d1506ee51.key_line_fr: Merci de nous rappeler pour confirmer.
ddeaaf52-a27f-4453-97d9-0e7d1506ee51.key_line_en: Please call us back to confirm.
ddeaaf52-a27f-4453-97d9-0e7d1506ee51.explanation: The letter asks the recipient to 'rappeler' (call back) to confirm the meeting, which corresponds to phoning the company.
ddeaaf52-a27f-4453-97d9-0e7d1506ee51.breakdown: The text is an invitation to a job interview. The sender explicitly states, 'Merci de nous rappeler pour confirmer' (Please call us back to confirm). The verb 'rappeler' means to call back. Therefore, the recipient needs to phone the company to confirm the appointment.

3f62e9b1-a98d-45fc-9fa9-1bddc5c93647.text:
Chers Valérie et Serge,
Que vos projets immobiliers voient enfin le jour avec cette année qui débute !
Qu’elle vous apporte la joie de déménager à Nancy comme vous le souhaitez, mais aussi, à tous les niveaux, réussite et beaucoup de bonheur!
J’espère que nous aurons le temps de nous voir plus souvent et de partir à nouveau en vacances ensemble.
Notre séjour en Corse reste un merveilleux souvenir pour moi.
Je vous embrasse,
Elisa
3f62e9b1-a98d-45fc-9fa9-1bddc5c93647.text_en: Dear Valérie and Serge, May your real estate projects finally see the light of day with this year beginning! May it bring you the joy of moving to Nancy as you wish, but also, on all levels, success and lots of happiness! I hope we will have the time to see each other more often and to go on vacation together again. Our stay in Corsica remains a wonderful memory for me. Hugs, Elisa
3f62e9b1-a98d-45fc-9fa9-1bddc5c93647.question_fr: Quel est le but de cette lettre ?
3f62e9b1-a98d-45fc-9fa9-1bddc5c93647.question_en: What is the purpose of this letter?

options.text_en: Announce the purchase of an apartment
options.explanation: The text expresses a wish for the projects to happen ('May they see the light'), implying the purchase has not happened yet.

options.text: Donner des nouvelles à des amis
options.explanation: Elisa is not providing updates about her own life; she is focusing on wishing good things for her friends.

options.text: Envoyer des vœux de nouvel an
options.explanation: The phrases 'cette année qui débute' (this year beginning) and wishes for happiness and success confirm this is a New Year's greeting.
Corsica is mentioned as a past memory ('souvenir'), not as a plan for a future trip.

3f62e9b1-a98d-45fc-9fa9-1bddc5c93647.key_line_fr: Que vos projets immobiliers voient enfin le jour avec cette année qui débute !
3f62e9b1-a98d-45fc-9fa9-1bddc5c93647.key_line_en: May your real estate projects finally see the light of day with this year beginning!

vocabulary.gloss: to come to fruition / see the light of day

3f62e9b1-a98d-45fc-9fa9-1bddc5c93647.explanation: The letter mentions the start of a new year and wishes the recipients success and happiness, which defines New Year's wishes.
3f62e9b1-a98d-45fc-9fa9-1bddc5c93647.breakdown: The text starts with 'cette année qui débute' (this year beginning) and uses the subjunctive structure 'Que...' to express wishes ('May your projects...', 'May it bring you...'). It explicitly wishes for 'réussite' (success) and 'bonheur' (happiness). These elements are characteristic of a New Year's greeting card or letter.

eae2b18b-1dcc-4120-88a9-c3542ef12223.text:
Les bons vieux bancs verts sur les trottoirs parisiens ont de la concurrence.
Depuis le mois de décembre, sur certains boulevards, un nouveau mobilier urbain a fait son apparition, avec 12 modèles de banquettes, chaises et tabourets.
Pour la première fois, la ville de Paris recueille l’avis des usagers et des riverains.
Le traditionnel banc en fonte et bois a-t-il encore de l’avenir au milieu de ce mobilier futuriste ?
eae2b18b-1dcc-4120-88a9-c3542ef12223.text_en: The good old green benches on Parisian sidewalks have competition. Since December, on certain boulevards, new urban furniture has made its appearance, with 12 models of bench seats, chairs, and stools. For the first time, the city of Paris is collecting the opinions of users and local residents. Does the traditional cast iron and wood bench still have a future amidst this futuristic furniture?
eae2b18b-1dcc-4120-88a9-c3542ef12223.question_fr: Quelle est l’originalité de ce projet ?
eae2b18b-1dcc-4120-88a9-c3542ef12223.question_en: What is the originality of this project?

options.text: La priorité donnée à l’aspect écologique.
options.text_en: The priority given to the ecological aspect.
options.explanation: The text mentions new furniture models, but there is no mention of ecology or environmental priority.

options.text: La prise en compte de l’opinion publique.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states that for the first time, the city is gathering opinions from users and residents.

options.text_en: The temporary nature of the installation.
options.explanation: The text says the furniture appeared in December, but does not highlight its temporary nature as the main point of originality.

options.text: Le choix des matériaux de fabrication
options.explanation: While materials (cast iron, wood) are mentioned regarding the old benches, the specific novelty introduced 'for the first time' is the public consultation.

eae2b18b-1dcc-4120-88a9-c3542ef12223.key_line_fr: Pour la première fois, la ville de Paris recueille l’avis des usagers et des riverains.
eae2b18b-1dcc-4120-88a9-c3542ef12223.key_line_en: For the first time, the city of Paris is collecting the opinions of users and local residents.
eae2b18b-1dcc-4120-88a9-c3542ef12223.explanation: The text highlights that 'for the first time', the city is asking for feedback from residents, which matches the option about public opinion.
eae2b18b-1dcc-4120-88a9-c3542ef12223.breakdown: The question asks what makes this project original. The text describes new street furniture in Paris. The phrase 'Pour la première fois' (For the first time) signals a unique or original aspect. This phrase is immediately followed by 'la ville de Paris recueille l’avis des usagers et des riverains' (the city of Paris collects the opinion of users and residents). This corresponds directly to taking public opinion into account.

ed812486-e1df-48d3-a28c-e1c842d70cce.text:
Le smartphone participe à l’entretien d’un lien pathologique de plus en plus répandu : le désir de mainmise des parents sur les adolescents.
La crise d’adolescence confronte les parents au besoin d’autonomie de l’adolescent et les oblige à faire le deuil de leur position de parent.
Cela suppose qu’ils lâchent prise et fassent confiance à leur enfant.
Mais de plus en plus de parents souhaitent que leur ado reste à la maison.
Le smartphone, qui permet de rester en lien avec ses copains, arrange donc les parents.
ed812486-e1df-48d3-a28c-e1c842d70cce.text_en: The smartphone participates in maintaining an increasingly common pathological link: the parents' desire for control over adolescents. The adolescent crisis confronts parents with the teenager's need for autonomy and forces them to mourn their position as a parent. This implies that they let go and trust their child. But more and more parents wish for their teen to stay at home. The smartphone, which allows staying in touch with friends, therefore suits the parents.
ed812486-e1df-48d3-a28c-e1c842d70cce.question_fr: Quel est le constat fait par l’auteur à propos des smartphones ?
ed812486-e1df-48d3-a28c-e1c842d70cce.question_en: What observation does the author make about smartphones?

options.text: Ils éloignent les jeunes du monde des adultes.
options.text_en: They distance young people from the adult world.
options.explanation: The text suggests parents want to keep teens close (at home), not that the phone distances them from adults. The focus is on parental retention.

options.text: Ils entrainent des comportements de type additif.
options.text_en: They lead to addictive type behaviors.
options.explanation: Addiction is a common topic regarding phones, but this specific text focuses on parental psychology, not the user's addiction.

options.text: Ils ont tendance à couper les adolescents du réel.
options.text_en: They tend to cut adolescents off from reality.
options.explanation: The text actually states the phone allows teens to 'remain in touch with their friends,' implying a connection to their social reality, not a disconnection.

options.text: Ils peuvent être utilisés comme outils de contrôle.
options.text_en: They can be used as tools of control.
options.explanation: The word 'mainmise' (stranglehold/grasp) indicates control. The text argues that smartphones suit parents because they help keep teens under their roof/supervision.

ed812486-e1df-48d3-a28c-e1c842d70cce.key_line_fr: Le smartphone participe à l’entretien d’un lien pathologique de plus en plus répandu : le désir de mainmise des parents sur les adolescents.
ed812486-e1df-48d3-a28c-e1c842d70cce.key_line_en: The smartphone participates in maintaining an increasingly common pathological link: the parents' desire for control over adolescents.
ed812486-e1df-48d3-a28c-e1c842d70cce.explanation: The author argues that smartphones serve the parents' desire to keep a 'stranglehold' (mainmise) on their children by allowing them to stay home while socializing, thus acting as tools of control.
ed812486-e1df-48d3-a28c-e1c842d70cce.breakdown:
1. **Analyze the text's opening**: The first sentence explicitly states that smartphones help maintain a 'désir de mainmise' (desire for control/stranglehold) of parents over adolescents.
2. **Understand the context**: The text explains that parents struggle to let go ('lâcher prise') and prefer their teens to stay at home. The smartphone allows this because teens can stay home while still messaging friends.
3. **Evaluate Option D**: 'Tools of control' corresponds directly to 'mainmise' and the description of parents using the phone to keep kids at home.
4. **Eliminate other options**: Options A, B, and C mention common criticisms of phones (alienation, addiction, unreality), but these specific points are not raised in this text.

eda691c4-49d5-49e4-a2c2-666d08dd5047.text:
Les Arts Premiers Au Musée
Si cette reconnaissance sonne comme un cri de victoire, c’est qu’elle marque l’issue d’un combat idéaliste qui n’a fait d’autres victimes que l’arrogance et les préjugés.
Le signal en fut donné par Guillaume Apollinaire en 1909 : « le Louvre devrait recueillir certains chefs-d’œuvre exotiques dont l’aspect n’est pas moins émouvant que celui des beaux spécimens de la statuaire occidentale ».
Près d’un siècle plus tard, le vœu du poète est enfin comblé : plus d’une centaine de sculptures primitives d’Afrique, d’Asie, d’Océanie et des Amériques, jusqu’alors confinées dans des réserves ethnographiques, prennent place dans le temple de l’Art, jusqu’alors réservé à l’Europe et à ses sources.
eda691c4-49d5-49e4-a2c2-666d08dd5047.text_en:
Primitive Arts at the Museum
If this recognition sounds like a cry of victory, it is because it marks the outcome of an idealistic fight which claimed no victims other than arrogance and prejudice.
The signal for this was given by Guillaume Apollinaire in 1909: "the Louvre should collect certain exotic masterpieces whose appearance is no less moving than that of the fine specimens of Western statuary".
Nearly a century later, the poet's wish is finally fulfilled: more than a hundred primitive sculptures from Africa, Asia, Oceania and the Americas, hitherto confined to ethnographic reserves, take their place in the temple of Art, hitherto reserved for Europe and its sources.

options.text: Le résultat d’une lutte menée par des gens orgueilleux et intolérants.
options.text_en: The result of a struggle led by proud and intolerant people.
options.explanation: The text says the fight claimed 'arrogance and prejudice' as victims, meaning it was a fight *against* intolerance, not led by intolerant people.

options.text: Le triomphe d’une opinion émise par Apollinaire mais autrefois combattue.
options.text_en: The triumph of an opinion expressed by Apollinaire but formerly fought against.
options.explanation: The text describes the event as the 'outcome of an idealistic fight' and the fulfillment of Apollinaire's wish from 1909.

options.text: Un miracle dû à la persévérance des archéologues sur plusieurs continents.
options.text_en: A miracle due to the perseverance of archaeologists on several continents.
options.explanation: The text attributes the change to an 'idealistic fight' and Apollinaire's initiative, not specifically to the perseverance of archaeologists.

options.text: La consécration des œuvres européennes jusqu’alors remisées dans les musées.
options.text_en: The consecration of European works previously stored in museums.
options.explanation: The text states that non-European sculptures (Africa, Asia, etc.) are entering the museum, whereas the museum was previously reserved for European sources.

eda691c4-49d5-49e4-a2c2-666d08dd5047.key_line_fr: Près d’un siècle plus tard, le vœu du poète est enfin comblé
eda691c4-49d5-49e4-a2c2-666d08dd5047.key_line_en: Nearly a century later, the poet's wish is finally fulfilled
eda691c4-49d5-49e4-a2c2-666d08dd5047.explanation: The passage describes the acceptance of primitive arts as the fulfillment of Apollinaire's 1909 wish after a long struggle against prejudice.
eda691c4-49d5-49e4-a2c2-666d08dd5047.breakdown:
1. The text describes the entry of primitive arts into the museum as a 'victory' (victoire) marking the end of a 'fight' (combat) against prejudice.
2. It explicitly links this event to a suggestion made by Guillaume Apollinaire in 1909.
3. It states that 'the poet's wish is finally fulfilled' (le vœu du poète est enfin comblé) nearly a century later.
4. This confirms Option B: it is the triumph (victory) of an opinion from Apollinaire that was previously fought against (implied by the century-long delay and the word 'combat').

e00ee352-c9f7-4012-95ef-375a3d37f5fe.text:
Quelles sont les forces dont disposa l’Homme pour conquérir l’hégémonie sur la planète ?
L’Homme est dépourvu de moyens physiques : il n’a ni crocs, ni griffes, ni armure ; il est chétif, fragile et vulnérable.
Mais, d’une part, il prime tous ses autres compagnons de vie par la puissance de son cerveau ; d’autre part, il est attiré par ses semblables, il tend à faire groupe avec les autres individus de son espèce.
Et ce sont ces tendances sociales qui, multipliant l’Homme par lui-même, lui ont donné le moyen d’atteindre à de si prodigieux résultats dans le domaine du savoir comme dans celui du pouvoir.
e00ee352-c9f7-4012-95ef-375a3d37f5fe.text_en:
What are the forces Man disposed of to conquer hegemony over the planet?
Man is devoid of physical means: he has neither fangs, nor claws, nor armor; he is puny, fragile, and vulnerable.
But, on the one hand, he surpasses all his other life companions by the power of his brain; on the other hand, he is attracted to his likes, he tends to form groups with other individuals of his species.
And it is these social tendencies which, multiplying Man by himself, gave him the means to reach such prodigious results in the domain of knowledge as well as in that of power.
e00ee352-c9f7-4012-95ef-375a3d37f5fe.question_fr: Qu’est-ce qui a permis à l’espèce humaine de conquérir le monde, à part son intelligence ?
e00ee352-c9f7-4012-95ef-375a3d37f5fe.question_en: What allowed the human species to conquer the world, apart from its intelligence?

options.text_en: The frequent interaction with his peers
options.explanation: This corresponds to the text's description of 'social tendencies' and being attracted to 'ses semblables' (his peers/likes).

options.text_en: The improvement of his natural habitat
options.explanation: The text does not mention improving the habitat as a cause for hegemony.
The text explicitly describes man as 'chétif' (puny) and 'dépourvu de moyens physiques' (lacking physical means), contradicting the idea of helpful physical mutations.
The text discusses conquering hegemony, but does not cite the active extermination of other species as the method used.

e00ee352-c9f7-4012-95ef-375a3d37f5fe.key_line_fr: d’autre part, il est attiré par ses semblables, il tend à faire groupe avec les autres individus de son espèce.
e00ee352-c9f7-4012-95ef-375a3d37f5fe.key_line_en: on the other hand, he is attracted to his likes, he tends to form groups with other individuals of his species.
e00ee352-c9f7-4012-95ef-375a3d37f5fe.explanation: The text states that besides brain power, humans succeeded because they are social beings who group together with their peers to multiply their strength.
e00ee352-c9f7-4012-95ef-375a3d37f5fe.breakdown:
1. **Identify the core question**: You need to find the factor allowing human dominance *excluding* intelligence ('à part son intelligence').
2. **Analyze the text**: The text lists two main strengths. First, 'puissance de son cerveau' (brain power). Second, 'il est attiré par ses semblables' (attracted to his likes) and 'tend à faire groupe' (tends to form groups).
3. **Eliminate Intelligence**: The question asks for the factor *other* than intelligence, so we focus on the second point: social behavior.
4. **Match with options**: Option A mentions 'congénères' (peers/fellows). While 'fréquence' usually means frequency, in this context (likely a phrasing for 'fréquentation' or frequent interaction), it is the only option describing the relationship with other humans ('ses semblables'). Options B, C, and D are either contradicted by the text (humans are physically weak) or not mentioned.

ea8bc285-dec1-485a-8623-4ddd0c3c6a92.text:
Le témoignage de Maud est très représentatif de la vie étudiante actuelle :
« J’ai cherché un logement près de la fac.
J’ai trouvé un studio à 600 $ par mois.
Mon père me donne 500 $ par mois.
Je dois travailler comme surveillante dans un lycée.
Les fins de mois sont difficiles, mais mon dossier d’allocation logement vient d’être accepté.
Finalement ? J’ai de la chance ! »
ea8bc285-dec1-485a-8623-4ddd0c3c6a92.text_en: Maud's testimony is very representative of current student life: 'I looked for housing near the uni. I found a studio for $600 a month. My father gives me $500 a month. I have to work as a supervisor in a high school. The ends of the month are difficult, but my housing allowance file has just been accepted. Finally? I'm lucky!'
ea8bc285-dec1-485a-8623-4ddd0c3c6a92.question_fr: Pourquoi Maud pense-t-elle avoir de la chance ?
ea8bc285-dec1-485a-8623-4ddd0c3c6a92.question_en: Why does Maud think she is lucky?

options.text: Elle aura un meilleur pouvoir d’achat sous peu.
options.text_en: She will have better purchasing power shortly.
options.explanation: The text states that her housing allowance application was just accepted. Receiving this allowance will alleviate her financial difficulties, effectively increasing her purchasing power soon.

ea8bc285-dec1-485a-8623-4ddd0c3c6a92.key_line_fr: Les fins de mois sont difficiles, mais mon dossier d’allocation logement vient d’être accepté.
ea8bc285-dec1-485a-8623-4ddd0c3c6a92.key_line_en: The ends of the month are difficult, but my housing allowance file has just been accepted.
ea8bc285-dec1-485a-8623-4ddd0c3c6a92.explanation: Maud considers herself lucky because her request for financial housing aid was accepted, which will improve her financial situation.
ea8bc285-dec1-485a-8623-4ddd0c3c6a92.breakdown: To determine why Maud feels lucky, look at the sentence immediately preceding her conclusion ('Finally? I'm lucky!'). She states, 'my housing allowance file has just been accepted.' This implies she will soon receive financial aid, which resolves her problem of 'difficult ends of the month.' Therefore, her purchasing power will improve shortly.

4e06ffb6-f6d8-4e42-84f2-87df199179a1.text:
Le rapport de l'Agence internationale de l'énergie se concentre sur les données de la dernière conférence climatique.
ll contient une information intéressante: d'après lagence, Les réserves mondiales de gaz sont plus importantes que prévues.
Le marché mondial serait même sous la menace d'un excédent massif,enraison de l'essor de la production américaine et d'une chute de la demande liée à la crise.
4e06ffb6-f6d8-4e42-84f2-87df199179a1.text_en: The International Energy Agency report focuses on data from the last climate conference. It contains an interesting piece of information: according to the agency, global gas reserves are larger than expected. The global market might even be under the threat of a massive surplus, due to the boom in American production and a drop in demand linked to the crisis.

4e06ffb6-f6d8-4e42-84f2-87df199179a1.question_en: What did the International Energy Agency report reveal?

options.text: La consommation de gaz dans le monde augmente.

4e06ffb6-f6d8-4e42-84f2-87df199179a1.breakdown:
1. **Analyze the question**: It asks what the International Energy Agency report revealed.
2. **Scan the text for the revelation**: The text states, 'd'après l'agence, Les réserves mondiales de gaz sont plus importantes que prévues' (according to the agency, global gas reserves are larger than expected).

1d060d0e-959b-4f4d-8988-3874afbbb61a.text:
Avez-vous déjà observé des familles en train de remplir des sachets de bonbons sur un stand de confiserie ?
Un chercheur américain a montré qu’elles en achètent plus quand les bonbons sont de couleurs différentes.
De nombreuses observations similaires prouvent que les entreprises agroalimentaires connaissent nos comportements et la manière dont nous prenons certaines de nos décisions.
Par exemple, elles exploitent notre préférence innée pour le sucre, à tous les âges.
Elles savent que l’éducation nutritionnelle des enfants et des jeunes est défaillante dans certaines familles et en profitent.
1d060d0e-959b-4f4d-8988-3874afbbb61a.text_en: Have you ever observed families filling bags of candy at a confectionery stand? An American researcher showed that they buy more when the candies are of different colors. Many similar observations prove that agribusiness companies know our behaviors and the way we make some of our decisions. For example, they exploit our innate preference for sugar, at all ages. They know that the nutritional education of children and young people is failing in some families and take advantage of it.
1d060d0e-959b-4f4d-8988-3874afbbb61a.question_fr: Que dénonce l’auteur de cet article ?
1d060d0e-959b-4f4d-8988-3874afbbb61a.question_en: What does the author of this article denounce?

options.text: La manipulation des clients par les industriels
options.text_en: The manipulation of customers by industrialists
options.explanation: The text explains that companies use knowledge of consumer behavior to influence purchases (e.g., color variety, sugar preference), which constitutes manipulation.
The text suggests the opposite: companies study and know consumer behaviors, implying they are predictable rather than unpredictable.

options.text: L’uniformisation des saveurs et des goûts
options.text_en: The standardization of flavors and tastes
options.explanation: The text mentions different colors and sugar preference, but does not discuss the standardization or uniformity of flavors.

options.text: L’utilisation abusive des produits de synthèse
options.text_en: The abusive use of synthetic products
options.explanation: The text focuses on behavioral psychology and marketing strategies, not the chemical composition or synthetic nature of the products.

1d060d0e-959b-4f4d-8988-3874afbbb61a.key_line_fr: De nombreuses observations similaires prouvent que les entreprises agroalimentaires connaissent nos comportements et la manière dont nous prenons certaines de nos décisions.
1d060d0e-959b-4f4d-8988-3874afbbb61a.key_line_en: Many similar observations prove that agribusiness companies know our behaviors and the way we make some of our decisions.
1d060d0e-959b-4f4d-8988-3874afbbb61a.explanation: The author criticizes food companies for using psychological insights to exploit consumer weaknesses and increase sales, which is a form of manipulation.
1d060d0e-959b-4f4d-8988-3874afbbb61a.breakdown: The text describes how food companies study consumer habits (like buying more colorful candies) and exploit innate preferences (like the love for sugar). The author uses terms like 'exploitent' (exploit) and 'en profitent' (take advantage of), which clearly points to a critique of how companies manipulate consumer decisions based on psychological knowledge. This aligns perfectly with Option A. Option B is incorrect because the text implies consumer behavior is predictable ('connaissent nos comportements'). Options C and D discuss topics (standardization, synthetic products) not mentioned in the text.

d26d8dfc-2044-4181-85ad-9e8493b4623d.text:
L’étendue et la variété des invités reçus par le Parlement Européen ne cessent d’étonner.
Prix Nobel, stars de série télé, grand maître des échecs...
Cette diversité n’a d’égale que l’éclectisme des sujets préparés et débattus au sein de l’hémicycle : la situation dans des pays en guerre, les relations entre pays, les changements climatiques...
Bien évidemment, ces personnalités connues et reconnues ne sont pas choisies pour les paillettes et le strass qu’elles peuvent, parfois, véhiculer, mais parce qu’elles ont une expertise reconnue ou un message à délivrer.
d26d8dfc-2044-4181-85ad-9e8493b4623d.text_en: The extent and variety of the guests received by the European Parliament never cease to amaze. Nobel Prize winners, TV series stars, grand chess masters... This diversity is equaled only by the eclecticism of the subjects prepared and debated within the hemicycle: the situation in countries at war, relations between countries, climate change... Obviously, these known and recognized personalities are not chosen for the glitter and rhinestones they may, at times, convey, but because they have recognized expertise or a message to deliver.
d26d8dfc-2044-4181-85ad-9e8493b4623d.question_fr: À quoi réfère le terme « diversité » dans le texte.
d26d8dfc-2044-4181-85ad-9e8493b4623d.question_en: To what does the term 'diversity' refer in the text?

options.text_en: To the guests of the parliament.
options.explanation: 'Hôtes' is a formal synonym for 'invités' (guests). The text explicitly links 'diversity' to the variety of guests.

The text links 'éclectisme' (eclecticism) to the 'sujets' (subjects/ideas), not 'diversité'. The sentence compares the diversity of guests *to* the eclecticism of ideas, meaning they are two separate groups.
Countries are mentioned as a topic of debate ('situation in countries'), not as the referent for 'this diversity'.
Bills (projets de loi) are not mentioned in the text.

d26d8dfc-2044-4181-85ad-9e8493b4623d.key_line_fr: L’étendue et la variété des invités reçus par le Parlement Européen ne cessent d’étonner. ... Cette diversité n’a d’égale que l’éclectisme des sujets...
d26d8dfc-2044-4181-85ad-9e8493b4623d.key_line_en: The extent and variety of the guests received by the European Parliament never cease to amaze. ... This diversity is equaled only by the eclecticism of the subjects...
d26d8dfc-2044-4181-85ad-9e8493b4623d.explanation: The phrase 'Cette diversité' refers back to the 'variété des invités' mentioned in the previous sentence, and 'hôtes' is a synonym for guests.
d26d8dfc-2044-4181-85ad-9e8493b4623d.breakdown: The text mentions 'L’étendue et la variété des invités' (The extent and variety of the guests) in the first sentence. The next sentence begins with 'Cette diversité' (This diversity). The demonstrative adjective 'Cette' indicates that the word 'diversité' refers back to the 'variété des invités' mentioned immediately before. Therefore, 'diversité' refers to the guests. In French, 'hôtes' is a synonym for 'invités' (guests), making Option A the correct choice. Note: The text compares this diversity of guests to the 'éclectisme des sujets' (eclecticism of subjects/ideas), so 'diversité' does not refer to the ideas (Option B).

c3d4cd59-49a3-419f-a428-dcac47516c15.text:
Parcourir les routes d’Europe l’été, beaucoup de touristes le font sans forcément connaître les règles en vigueur dans chacun des pays.
Ce qu’il faut savoir, c’est qu’il existe des différences qui peuvent être notables selon les législations.
Alors que la vitesse maximale sur autoroute est de 130 km/h en France, elle n’est que de 120 km/h en Belgique, en Espagne ou au Portugal.
Quant au taux d’alcoolémie toléré, il varie de 0.8 g/l en Irlande à zéro en République tchèque.
c3d4cd59-49a3-419f-a428-dcac47516c15.text_en: Traveling Europe's roads in summer, many tourists do so without necessarily knowing the rules in force in each country. What you need to know is that there are differences that can be notable depending on the legislation. While the maximum speed on highways is 130 km/h in France, it is only 120 km/h in Belgium, Spain, or Portugal. As for the tolerated blood alcohol limit, it varies from 0.8 g/l in Ireland to zero in the Czech Republic.
c3d4cd59-49a3-419f-a428-dcac47516c15.question_fr: Que fait l’auteur de cet article ?
c3d4cd59-49a3-419f-a428-dcac47516c15.question_en: What is the author of this article doing?

options.explanation: The author mentions legislation differences but does not offer a commentary or opinion on a specific law.
By stating 'What you need to know' and listing differences, the author advises readers to be informed and careful.
The tone is informative and neutral, not expressing dissatisfaction or a complaint.
The text presents general facts and rules, not a personal story or specific past event.

c3d4cd59-49a3-419f-a428-dcac47516c15.key_line_fr: Ce qu’il faut savoir, c’est qu’il existe des différences qui peuvent être notables selon les législations.
c3d4cd59-49a3-419f-a428-dcac47516c15.key_line_en: What you need to know is that there are differences that can be notable depending on the legislation.
c3d4cd59-49a3-419f-a428-dcac47516c15.explanation: The author uses the phrase 'Ce qu’il faut savoir' to alert tourists to differing driving laws, which constitutes advice to be informed.
c3d4cd59-49a3-419f-a428-dcac47516c15.breakdown: The text begins by observing that many tourists travel without knowing local traffic rules. The phrase 'Ce qu’il faut savoir' (What you need to know) signals the author's intent to inform and warn the reader. By highlighting specific differences in speed limits and alcohol tolerance across countries, the author is advising tourists to be aware of these variations to avoid problems.

557dc502-6407-4098-a009-afc31ca0dfad.text:
On s’est habitué depuis belle lurette à ne plus rencontrer de poinçonneurs dans le métro ni de pompistes dans les stations-service.
Mais la liste des professions en voie de disparition ne cesse de s’allonger.
Caissières dans les supermarchés, guichetiers dans les banques, hôtesses dans les cinémas…
Tous remplacés par des machines.
Pas si simple.
Comme l’analyse Thibaut Carpentier, directeur du cabinet de conseil Obstand, la tentation industrielle de réduire les frais de personnel est grande mais cette logique se heurte à celle des consommateurs qui ont du mal à se passer d’une personne humaine.
D’ailleurs, toutes les entreprises concernées l’ont bien compris : pas de suppression de postes mais des redéploiements avec élargissement des compétences.
557dc502-6407-4098-a009-afc31ca0dfad.text_en: We have been used for ages to no longer meeting ticket punchers in the metro nor gas station attendants. But the list of disappearing professions keeps growing. Cashiers in supermarkets, tellers in banks, hostesses in cinemas... All replaced by machines. Not so simple. As Thibaut Carpentier, director of the consulting firm Obstand, analyzes, the industrial temptation to reduce personnel costs is great but this logic runs up against that of consumers who find it hard to do without a human person. Moreover, all the companies concerned have understood this well: no job cuts but redeployments with expansion of skills.
557dc502-6407-4098-a009-afc31ca0dfad.question_fr: Quel obstacle rencontre l’automatisation des services ?
557dc502-6407-4098-a009-afc31ca0dfad.question_en: What obstacle does service automation encounter?

options.explanation: The text mentions the temptation to 'reduce personnel costs', but does not cite high investment costs as an obstacle.
Employee qualifications are mentioned later regarding redeployment ('élargissement des compétences'), but not as an obstacle to automation itself.

options.text: Les réticences émises par la clientèle.
options.explanation: The text states consumers struggle to do without humans ('ont du mal à se passer d’une personne humaine'), representing client reluctance.
The specific nature of the jobs is not mentioned as the hindrance; consumer preference is.

557dc502-6407-4098-a009-afc31ca0dfad.key_line_fr: cette logique se heurte à celle des consommateurs qui ont du mal à se passer d’une personne humaine.

a63856c0-9599-450b-a0b2-697ec07bc797.text:
Théâtre
Joël Pommerat nous offre un très court spectacle dont à la fois la pureté formelle et le sens nous ont conquis.
Le matériau en est constitué par une série de rencontres, auxquelles lui-même et son équipe assistèrent, entre des travailleurs sociaux et des femmes d'origine simple, vivant en cité, et en proie à des problèmes familiaux.
De ces confidences relatives aux tensions qu'elles connaissent dans leurs rapports, soit avec leurs parents, soit avec leurs enfants, Pommerat a tiré une suite de brèves séquences qui composent une tragédie intense de la souffrance familiale, et particulièrement de la souffrance de la femme.
Son regard sur la détresse humaine est d'une bienveillance et d'une tendresse infinies.
Il ne nous livre aucun message moral et à peine un message social ; il fait simplement appel à notre sensibilité.
a63856c0-9599-450b-a0b2-697ec07bc797.text_en:
Theater
Joël Pommerat offers us a very short show whose formal purity and meaning have both conquered us.
The material consists of a series of meetings, which he and his team attended, between social workers and women of simple origins, living in housing projects, and prey to family problems.
From these confidences relating to the tensions they experience in their relationships, either with their parents or with their children, Pommerat has drawn a suite of brief sequences that compose an intense tragedy of family suffering, and particularly of the woman's suffering.
His look upon human distress is of infinite benevolence and tenderness.
He delivers no moral message to us and barely a social message; he simply appeals to our sensibility.
a63856c0-9599-450b-a0b2-697ec07bc797.question_fr: Dans quel objectif Joël Pommerat a-t-il créé son spectacle ?
a63856c0-9599-450b-a0b2-697ec07bc797.question_en: For what objective did Joël Pommerat create his show?

options.text: Aider les femmes à se battre pour améliorer leur situation familiale.
options.text_en: To help women to fight to improve their family situation.
options.explanation: The text states there is 'no moral message,' and the play is an artistic representation ('tragedy'), not an intervention program to help the characters fight.

options.text: Amener les spectateurs à s’émouvoir d’un quotidien douloureux.
options.text_en: To lead the spectators to be moved by a painful daily life.
options.explanation: The text concludes that the director 'simply appeals to our sensibility' regarding 'human distress' and 'family suffering,' which means moving the audience emotionally.

options.text: Démontrer que la condition de la femme dans les cités est désastreuse.
options.text_en: To demonstrate that the condition of the woman in the housing projects is disastrous.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states there is 'barely a social message,' meaning the primary goal is not to make a sociological demonstration about living conditions.

options.text: Informer des difficultés que peuvent rencontrer les enfants des cités.
options.text_en: To inform about the difficulties that children of the housing projects can encounter.
options.explanation: While children are mentioned as a source of tension, the focus is on the women's suffering and the emotional impact on the audience, not merely providing information about children.

a63856c0-9599-450b-a0b2-697ec07bc797.key_line_fr: Il ne nous livre aucun message moral et à peine un message social ; il fait simplement appel à notre sensibilité.
a63856c0-9599-450b-a0b2-697ec07bc797.key_line_en: He delivers no moral message to us and barely a social message; he simply appeals to our sensibility.
a63856c0-9599-450b-a0b2-697ec07bc797.explanation: The text explicitly states the director's goal is not to send a moral or social message, but to appeal to the audience's emotions ('sensibilité') regarding the suffering depicted.
a63856c0-9599-450b-a0b2-697ec07bc797.breakdown:
The text describes a play based on the suffering of women living in housing projects. 8ac5b455-17de-4068-8df9-037529d6fc7c.text:
Plancher sur la réforme des rythmes scolaires, comme le fera la « Conférence » installée aujourd’hui par le ministre de l’Éducation, c’est prendre en compte toute une série de paramètres qui n’ont rien à voir, ou si peu, avec l’école primaire.
C’est s’intéresser aux évolutions de la famille et à la multiplication des horaires de travail dits « atypiques ».
C’est examiner, du point de vue des collectivités locales, les conséquences financières et pratiques (transport scolaire, cantine, centres de loisirs) de tout changement éventuel dans l’organisation de la semaine.
C’est encore recueillir l’avis des experts de la circulation routière et entendre les préoccupations des professionnels du tourisme...
Autant dire que l’intérêt de l’enfant se trouve plus ou moins sacrifié sur l’autel du compromis.
8ac5b455-17de-4068-8df9-037529d6fc7c.text_en: To work on the reform of school rhythms, as the 'Conference' set up today by the Minister of Education will do, is to take into account a whole series of parameters that have nothing to do, or very little, with primary school. It is to take an interest in the changes in the family and the increase in so-called 'atypical' working hours. It is to examine, from the point of view of local authorities, the financial and practical consequences (school transport, canteen, leisure centers) of any potential change in the organization of the week. It is also to gather the opinion of road traffic experts and hear the concerns of tourism professionals... Suffice to say that the child's interest is more or less sacrificed on the altar of compromise.
8ac5b455-17de-4068-8df9-037529d6fc7c.question_fr: Quel constat dresse le journaliste à propos de la réforme des rythmes scolaires ?
8ac5b455-17de-4068-8df9-037529d6fc7c.question_en: What observation does the journalist make regarding the reform of school rhythms?

options.text: Les familles dont opposées à toute modification.
options.text_en: Families are opposed to any modification.
options.explanation: The text discusses 'evolutions of the family' regarding work schedules, but it never states that families are opposed to the reform itself.
Financial consequences are listed as a parameter to be examined by local authorities, but the text does not describe them as 'insurmountable' (impossible to overcome).

options.text: Les intérêts en jeu sont difficilement compatibles.
options.text_en: The interests at stake are difficult to reconcile.
options.explanation: The passage shows that the reform is pulled in different directions by tourism, traffic, budget, and parents' work hours. The final mention of a 'sacrifice' for the sake of 'compromise' confirms that these interests clash and are hard to make compatible.

options.text: Les opinions des experts sont en tout désaccord.
options.text_en: Expert opinions are in total disagreement.
options.explanation: The text mentions the need to 'gather the opinion' of experts, but implies nothing about a disagreement among the experts themselves.

8ac5b455-17de-4068-8df9-037529d6fc7c.key_line_fr: Autant dire que l’intérêt de l’enfant se trouve plus ou moins sacrifié sur l’autel du compromis.
8ac5b455-17de-4068-8df9-037529d6fc7c.key_line_en: Suffice to say that the child's interest is more or less sacrificed on the altar of compromise.
8ac5b455-17de-4068-8df9-037529d6fc7c.explanation: The journalist highlights that the reform depends on many external factors (tourism, traffic, budgets) that conflict with the child's well-being, making the interests involved hard to reconcile.
8ac5b455-17de-4068-8df9-037529d6fc7c.breakdown: The text enumerates a long list of external factors influencing the reform: family work schedules, local authority budgets (transport, canteens), road traffic experts, and tourism professionals. The journalist concludes that the child's specific interest is 'sacrificed on the altar of compromise'. This metaphor implies that satisfying all these disparate parties requires a trade-off where the child loses out, proving that the various interests involved (economic, social, educational) are competing and difficult to align successfully.

f4b45382-352f-4fb4-8c2b-516c8b396062.text:
L’éclairage événementiel est une discipline artistique récente qui consiste à créer des décors et des ambiances par un jeu de lumières projetées sur des monuments et des sites remarquables.
L’intérêt de cet art est double : il permet, sans toucher au site qui accueille l’événement, de modifier littéralement l’aspect d’une façade ou d’un intérieur et de personnaliser un lieu en rapport avec le thème abordé.
Ainsi, une grande ville comme Paris peut façonner ses monuments et ses bâtiments publics grâce aux éclairages conçus et réalisés par de véritables artistes.
f4b45382-352f-4fb4-8c2b-516c8b396062.text_en: Event lighting is a recent artistic discipline which consists of creating scenery and atmospheres through a play of lights projected onto monuments and remarkable sites. The interest of this art is twofold: it allows, without touching the site hosting the event, to literally modify the appearance of a facade or an interior and to personalize a place in relation to the theme addressed. Thus, a large city like Paris can shape its monuments and public buildings thanks to lighting designed and produced by true artists.
f4b45382-352f-4fb4-8c2b-516c8b396062.question_fr: Quel est l’atout principal de cette discipline artistique ?
f4b45382-352f-4fb4-8c2b-516c8b396062.question_en: What is the main asset of this artistic discipline?

options.text: Donner une dimension nouvelle aux lieux mis en scène.
options.text_en: Give a new dimension to the staged places.
options.explanation: The text states the art allows modifying the appearance and personalizing the place, which is synonymous with giving it a new dimension.

options.text: Permettre la réhabilitation des monuments historiques.
options.text_en: Allow the rehabilitation of historical monuments.
options.explanation: The text specifies 'without touching the site', whereas rehabilitation implies physical work or restoration.

options.text: Transformer de manière durable les bâtiments illumines.
options.text_en: Transform illuminated buildings in a lasting way.
options.explanation: The text describes 'event' lighting (temporary), while this option suggests a 'lasting' (durable) transformation.

options.text: Valoriser culturellement des zones urbaines délaissées.
options.explanation: The text focuses on 'remarkable sites' and monuments, not 'neglected' (délaissées) areas.

f4b45382-352f-4fb4-8c2b-516c8b396062.key_line_fr: L’intérêt de cet art est double : il permet, sans toucher au site qui accueille l’événement, de modifier littéralement l’aspect d’une façade ou d’un intérieur et de personnaliser un lieu en rapport avec le thème abordé.
f4b45382-352f-4fb4-8c2b-516c8b396062.key_line_en: The interest of this art is twofold: it allows, without touching the site hosting the event, to literally modify the appearance of a facade or an interior and to personalize a place in relation to the theme addressed.
f4b45382-352f-4fb4-8c2b-516c8b396062.explanation: The text highlights that this lighting technique modifies the visual appearance and atmosphere of a place without physically changing it, effectively giving it a new dimension.

1.  **Analyze the Question**: You need to find the 'main asset' (atout principal) of 'event lighting' (l'éclairage événementiel).
2.  **Scan the Text**: Look for keywords like 'intérêt' (interest/asset) or positive descriptions. The text states: 'L’intérêt de cet art est double : il permet... de modifier littéralement l’aspect... et de personnaliser un lieu'.
3.  **Match Option A**: 'Modifier littéralement l’aspect' (literally modify the appearance) aligns perfectly with 'Donner une dimension nouvelle' (Give a new dimension).

5.  **Eliminate Option C**: The text is about 'événementiel' (event-based), which implies temporary setups. Option C suggests 'durable' (lasting/permanent) transformation.
6.  **Eliminate Option D**: The text mentions 'monuments et des sites remarquables' (remarkable sites), whereas Option D talks about 'zones urbaines délaissées' (neglected urban zones).

c36c8867-4818-4b7f-9d3a-8be325a62f70.text:
Plutôt que de multiplier les tests et les mises en situation, certaines entreprises choisissent de déléguer la responsabilité du recrutement à leurs salariés.
« Personnellement, je suis très favorable à la cooptation, affirme ce responsable.
Si vous avez un bon élément dans votre équipe, vous avez une excellente chance qu’il vous amène un autre bon élément, ça permet de limiter les risques. »
Signe des temps : la « cooptation » est aujourd’hui acceptée et revendiquée par tous.
Dans certaines entreprises, elle est même encouragée par une prime : 4000 euros sont versés à tout employé ayant recommandé un candidat recruté à son tour.
c36c8867-4818-4b7f-9d3a-8be325a62f70.text_en: Rather than multiplying tests and role-playing scenarios, some companies choose to delegate recruitment responsibility to their employees. « Personally, I am very favorable to cooptation, asserts this manager. If you have a good element in your team, you have an excellent chance that he brings you another good element, it allows limiting risks. » Sign of the times: « cooptation » is today accepted and claimed by everyone. In some companies, it is even encouraged by a bonus: 4000 euros are paid to any employee having recommended a candidate recruited in their turn.
c36c8867-4818-4b7f-9d3a-8be325a62f70.question_fr: En adoptant la cooptation pour le recrutement, que recherchent les entreprises ?
c36c8867-4818-4b7f-9d3a-8be325a62f70.question_en: By adopting cooptation for recruitment, what are companies looking for?

options.explanation: While skipping tests might save time, the text explicitly cites risk reduction as the benefit, not speed.
The text states cooptation allows one to 'limiter les risques' (limit risks), which corresponds to 'minimiser les aléas' (minimize uncertainties/hazards).
The text mentions a €4000 bonus for referrals, suggesting cost reduction is not the primary motive.
Simplification might be a byproduct, but the stated objective is ensuring candidate quality to lower risk.

c36c8867-4818-4b7f-9d3a-8be325a62f70.key_line_fr: Si vous avez un bon élément dans votre équipe, vous avez une excellente chance qu’il vous amène un autre bon élément, ça permet de limiter les risques.
c36c8867-4818-4b7f-9d3a-8be325a62f70.key_line_en: If you have a good element in your team, you have an excellent chance that he brings you another good element, it allows limiting risks.
c36c8867-4818-4b7f-9d3a-8be325a62f70.explanation: The text explicitly states that cooptation allows companies to 'limit risks' because good employees tend to recommend other good employees. This matches option B.
c36c8867-4818-4b7f-9d3a-8be325a62f70.breakdown:
1. The question asks for the primary goal of companies using 'cooptation' (referral recruitment).
2. Scanning the text for the manager's explanation, we find the sentence: '...ça permet de limiter les risques' (it allows limiting risks).
3. We compare this with the options.
4. Option B, 'minimiser les aléas' (minimize hazards/uncertainties), is a synonym for 'limiter les risques'.
5. Other options like saving time or money are not explicitly stated as the primary goal in the provided text (in fact, a bonus is mentioned, implying a cost).

d5e062e1-f3e8-4df3-8527-1e211a31f474.text:
Le discours écologique actuel est très factuel, « pratico-pratique », comme si on n’osait pas parler de cette beauté dont nous avons pourtant besoin pour nous épanouir.
C’est peut-être l’une des raisons pour lesquelles l’écologie politique ne rallie pas tant que ça.
Si on n’est pas sensible à la terre, aux végétaux, on devient un technicien de l’écologie, on emploie un langage neutre et rassurant, fait « d’environnement » et de « développement durable ».
Mais il faut pouvoir parler de la beauté spécifique de la nature qui nous enchante, qui nous fait vibrer.
Nous avons besoin de nous nourrir de sa splendeur, de son mystère, et pas seulement de ses aspects matériels, pratiques, biologiques.
d5e062e1-f3e8-4df3-8527-1e211a31f474.text_en: The current ecological discourse is very factual, 'down-to-earth', as if we didn't dare speak of this beauty that we nevertheless need to flourish. This is perhaps one of the reasons why political ecology does not rally people that much. If one is not sensitive to the earth, to plants, one becomes a technician of ecology, one employs a neutral and reassuring language, made of 'environment' and 'sustainable development'. But we must be able to speak of the specific beauty of nature that enchants us, that makes us vibrate. We need to nourish ourselves with its splendor, its mystery, and not only its material, practical, biological aspects.
d5e062e1-f3e8-4df3-8527-1e211a31f474.question_fr: Selon l’intervenant, qu’est-ce qui caractérise le discours écologique actuel ?
d5e062e1-f3e8-4df3-8527-1e211a31f474.question_en: According to the speaker, what characterizes current ecological discourse?

options.text: Il apaise les tensions de la société
options.explanation: The text mentions a 'reassuring' language, but this describes the tone of a 'technician', not a successful soothing of societal tensions.

options.text: Il insiste sur le point de vue matériel
options.text_en: It insists on the material point of view
options.explanation: The text explicitly defines the discourse as factual, practical ('pratico-pratique'), and focused on material aspects.
The text describes the discourse as practical and technical, which is the opposite of 'utopian'.

options.text: Il traite les problèmes liés aux sols
options.explanation: The text mentions being sensitive to 'the earth' (la terre), but implies the current discourse fails to do this emotionally, rather than technically focusing on soil problems.

d5e062e1-f3e8-4df3-8527-1e211a31f474.key_line_fr: Le discours écologique actuel est très factuel, « pratico-pratique »
d5e062e1-f3e8-4df3-8527-1e211a31f474.key_line_en: The current ecological discourse is very factual, 'down-to-earth'
d5e062e1-f3e8-4df3-8527-1e211a31f474.explanation: The text complains that current ecology is too dry, factual, and 'practical', lacking emotion or beauty. This aligns perfectly with the option stating it insists on the 'material point of view'.
d5e062e1-f3e8-4df3-8527-1e211a31f474.breakdown:
1. **Identify the subject**: The question asks about the characteristics of the 'current ecological discourse' (discours écologique actuel).
2. **Scan the text**: The very first sentence states: 'Le discours écologique actuel est très factuel, « pratico-pratique »' (The current ecological discourse is very factual, 'down-to-earth').
3. **Analyze the context**: The text contrasts this factual approach with 'beauty' and 'mystery'. The final sentence reinforces this by listing what we currently focus on: 'aspects matériels, pratiques, biologiques' (material, practical, biological aspects).
4. **Evaluate Option B**: 'Insists on the material point of view' directly aligns with 'factuel', 'pratico-pratique', and 'aspects matériels'.

1f86475b-ac1f-4f9c-861b-3a6ba64e1321.text:
Le Bon Usage est un gros livre, parce que son auteur n’a voulu éluder aucune des chausse-trapes de cette langue française dont Colette disait : « C’est une langue bien difficile que le français. À peine écrit-on depuis quarante-cinq ans qu’on commence à s’en apercevoir ».
J’avais craint, jadis, que la masse même du volume n’en rebutât plus d’un.
Appréhension vaine : l’ouvrage s’est étoffé à chaque réédition, la typographie (tout en restant d’une parfaite lisibilité) se présente dans une composition beaucoup plus serrée, et le succès du livre va croissant.
À mesure que le lecteur a davantage le sentiment qu’il est aimablement conduit par la main grâce surtout à un index infiniment précieux, et que les explications qu’on lui propose ne sont pas de sommaires ukases, mais le reflet patient, probe jusqu’à l’aveu d’incertitudes, d’une actualité aussi mouvante que la vie.
1f86475b-ac1f-4f9c-861b-3a6ba64e1321.text_en:
Le Bon Usage is a big book because its author did not want to evade any of the pitfalls of this French language, of which Colette said: "French is a very difficult language. One has barely been writing for forty-five years when one begins to perceive it."
I had feared, formerly, that the very mass of the volume might repel more than one person.
Vain apprehension: the work has fleshed out with each reissue, the typography (while remaining perfectly readable) appears in a much tighter composition, and the success of the book keeps growing.
As the reader feels more and more that he is kindly led by the hand thanks especially to an infinitely precious index, and that the explanations offered to him are not summary decrees, but the patient reflection, honest even to the admission of uncertainties, of a reality as shifting as life.
1f86475b-ac1f-4f9c-861b-3a6ba64e1321.question_fr: D’après cet extrait, quelle est la plus grande qualité du Bon Usage ?
1f86475b-ac1f-4f9c-861b-3a6ba64e1321.question_en: According to this extract, what is the greatest quality of Le Bon Usage?

options.explanation: The text states the author refused to skip any difficulties ('pitfalls') of the language, resulting in a 'big book' that covers everything.
The text describes it as a 'gros livre' (big book) that has 's'est étoffé' (expanded), which is the opposite of concise.
The text focuses on the book's thoroughness and reliability, not on it being innovative.
The text mentions the book contains an 'aveu d'incertitudes' (admission of uncertainties), meaning it does not claim to be absolute or irrefutable.

1f86475b-ac1f-4f9c-861b-3a6ba64e1321.key_line_fr: Le Bon Usage est un gros livre, parce que son auteur n’a voulu éluder aucune des chausse-trapes de cette langue française
1f86475b-ac1f-4f9c-861b-3a6ba64e1321.key_line_en: Le Bon Usage is a big book because its author did not want to evade any of the pitfalls of this French language
1f86475b-ac1f-4f9c-861b-3a6ba64e1321.explanation: The book is described as large and detailed because the author covers every difficulty of the language without skipping anything, making it complete.
1f86475b-ac1f-4f9c-861b-3a6ba64e1321.breakdown: The text immediately characterizes the book as a 'gros livre' (big book) because the author did not want to 'éluder' (evade/skip) any of the 'chausse-trapes' (pitfalls/traps) of the language. Furthermore, it states the work has 's'est étoffé' (fleshed out/expanded) with every edition. This emphasis on covering every difficulty and the increasing volume points directly to the quality of being comprehensive or complete. Option B is contradicted by the size of the book. Option D is contradicted by the mention of 'l’aveu d’incertitudes' (admission of uncertainties). Therefore, 'complet' is the best fit.

7933ce26-eb20-455b-8e70-2449ba4c1116.text:
Il est incroyable que la perspective d’avoir à lire son propre livre en public n’ait jamais fait renoncer un écrivain à l’écrire.
Rien n’est extravagant comme ces émissions littéraires où ils sont régulièrement requis de sacrifier à ce rituel qui suppose tout de même une habitude, une habileté, pour ne pas dire une technique, qui ne sont pas données à tous les romanciers.
La plupart n’osent pas refuser, en quoi ils ont tort.
Pour les convaincre de renoncer à ce dernier avatar de leur vanité, il suffirait de les emmener, un soir, écouter des comédiens lire leur livre.
En principe, si l’on est lucide et de bonne foi, on ne se remet pas d’une telle épreuve.
7933ce26-eb20-455b-8e70-2449ba4c1116.text_en: It is incredible that the prospect of having to read one's own book in public has never made a writer give up writing it. Nothing is as extravagant as those literary shows where they are regularly required to sacrifice themselves to this ritual which implies, all the same, a habit, a skill, not to say a technique, which are not given to all novelists. Most do not dare to refuse, in which they are wrong. To convince them to give up this last avatar of their vanity, it would suffice to take them, one evening, to listen to actors read their book. In principle, if one is lucid and in good faith, one does not recover from such an ordeal.
7933ce26-eb20-455b-8e70-2449ba4c1116.question_fr: Que pense cet écrivain de la lecture publique d’un roman par son auteur ?
7933ce26-eb20-455b-8e70-2449ba4c1116.question_en: What does this writer think of the public reading of a novel by its author?

options.text: Elle dessert le travail d’écriture du romancier.

options.explanation: The author mentions that the prospect of reading might discourage someone from writing, but does not suggest that the act of reading negatively impacts the actual work of writing.

options.text: Elle est particulièrement adaptée au petit écran.
options.text_en: It is particularly adapted to the small screen.
options.explanation: The author describes literary programs featuring these readings as 'extravagant' (meaning absurd or excessive) and criticizes the practice, rather than finding it well-suited for television.

options.text: Elle rend les émissions littéraires prétentieuses.
options.explanation: While the author mentions the 'vanity' of the writers who agree to read, the text focuses on their lack of technical skill for the performance rather than the pretentiousness of the programs.

7933ce26-eb20-455b-8e70-2449ba4c1116.key_line_fr: Rien n’est extravagant comme ces émissions littéraires où ils sont régulièrement requis de sacrifier à ce rituel qui suppose tout de même une habitude, une habileté, pour ne pas dire une technique, qui ne sont pas données à tous les romanciers.
7933ce26-eb20-455b-8e70-2449ba4c1116.key_line_en: Nothing is as extravagant as these literary programs where they are regularly required to sacrifice to this ritual which nevertheless requires a habit, a skill, not to say a technique, which are not given to all novelists.
7933ce26-eb20-455b-8e70-2449ba4c1116.explanation: The author argues that reading a novel in public requires specific skills and techniques that most writers do not possess, implying that it is a task better suited for professional performers.
7933ce26-eb20-455b-8e70-2449ba4c1116.breakdown: The author emphasizes that public reading is a 'ritual' requiring a specific 'technique' and 'skill' that novelists typically lack. By suggesting that writers should listen to professional actors to realize their own inadequacy, the author confirms that public reading requires the talents of a performer (acting skills). Option B is wrong because the text doesn't say the reading harms the writing process itself. Option C is wrong because the author is critical of these TV shows, not praising their suitability. Option D is wrong because while the author mentions the 'vanity' of the writers, he does not state that the shows themselves become pretentious because of the readings.

817574ad-7e02-4983-9000-e0cab118e805.text:
Le trois-mâts d’exploration La Boudeuse va reprendre le large pour une nouvelle mission à caractère scientifique.
Le voilier va mettre le cap en septembre prochain sur l’Amérique du Sud et ses grands fleuves.
Il se consacrera « aux études scientifiques et humaines concernant la biosphère, le réchauffement climatique et le développement durable », selon la « lettre de mission » adressée à son commandant, signée du ministre d’État aux Transports et à l’Écologie.
Cette « lettre de mission » de la République assigne à l’équipage un audacieux programme concernant la protection de l’environnement.
817574ad-7e02-4983-9000-e0cab118e805.text_en: The exploration three-masted ship La Boudeuse is about to set sail again for a new mission of a scientific nature. The sailboat will head next September for South America and its great rivers. It will devote itself to 'scientific and human studies concerning the biosphere, global warming, and sustainable development', according to the 'mission letter' addressed to its commander, signed by the Minister of State for Transport and Ecology. This 'mission letter' from the Republic assigns the crew a bold program concerning environmental protection.
817574ad-7e02-4983-9000-e0cab118e805.question_fr: Selon l’article, que va faire l’équipage du voilier La Boudeuse ?
817574ad-7e02-4983-9000-e0cab118e805.question_en: According to the article, what will the crew of the sailboat La Boudeuse do?
