4. Option A is incorrect because you should not interrupt a consultation. Options B and D are not mentioned.

8bcd45b5-b23a-4c63-aa52-d2d8c7f427a8.text: Du 10 avril au 15 septembre, les ascenseurs de votre station de métro sont en réparation. Pour faciliter vosdéplacements, les installations changent. Pendant les travaux, prenez l'escalier à droite des guichets
8bcd45b5-b23a-4c63-aa52-d2d8c7f427a8.text_en: From April 10 to September 15, the elevators at your metro station are under repair. To facilitate your travel, the facilities are changing. During the work, take the stairs to the right of the ticket counters.
8bcd45b5-b23a-4c63-aa52-d2d8c7f427a8.question_fr: Qu'est-ce qui est fermé du 10 avril au 15septembre?
8bcd45b5-b23a-4c63-aa52-d2d8c7f427a8.question_en: What is closed from April 10 to September 15?

options.explanation: The text instructs you to 'take the stairs' (prenez l'escalier), which means they are open.
The station itself is not closed; only specific equipment inside it is being repaired.
The text states the elevators are 'en réparation' (under repair), making them unavailable.
The ticket counters are used as a landmark ('to the right of the ticket counters'), implying they are not the object being closed.

8bcd45b5-b23a-4c63-aa52-d2d8c7f427a8.key_line_fr: Du 10 avril au 15 septembre, les ascenseurs de votre station de métro sont en réparation.

cad3ec2e-f079-41ab-8c5a-8e511f8f0e3b.text:
Bonne idée
Numéro 1 français de badminton ，Brice Leverdez lancé lundi une opération de « financement participatif » pour préparation aux jeux Olympiques.
Une manière de récolter de l'argent supplémentaire dans un sport peu sponsorisé.
« C'est un moyen pour les gens de faire partie du projet.
Si je rapporte une médaille des prochains JO, ils pourront dire qu'ils ont aidé Brice Leverdez à y arriver », explique-t-il.
cad3ec2e-f079-41ab-8c5a-8e511f8f0e3b.text_en: French number 1 in badminton, Brice Leverdez launched a 'crowdfunding' operation on Monday for his preparation for the Olympic Games. A way to raise extra money in a sport that is little sponsored. 'It is a way for people to be part of the project. If I bring back a medal from the next Olympics, they will be able to say that they helped Brice Leverdez achieve it,' he explains.
cad3ec2e-f079-41ab-8c5a-8e511f8f0e3b.question_fr: Qu'est-ce que les donateurs peuvent espérer ?
cad3ec2e-f079-41ab-8c5a-8e511f8f0e3b.question_en: What can the donors hope for?

options.explanation: The text does not mention a meeting or date with the athlete as a reward.

options.text: Une place offerte pour les JO

options.explanation: Offering tickets to the Olympic Games is not mentioned in the text.
There is no mention of playing a session of badminton with him.
The text mentions bringing back a 'medal' (médaille), which corresponds to a victory.

cad3ec2e-f079-41ab-8c5a-8e511f8f0e3b.key_line_fr: Si je rapporte une médaille des prochains JO, ils pourront dire qu'ils ont aidé Brice Leverdez à y arriver
cad3ec2e-f079-41ab-8c5a-8e511f8f0e3b.key_line_en: If I bring back a medal from the next Olympics, they will be able to say that they helped Brice Leverdez achieve it
cad3ec2e-f079-41ab-8c5a-8e511f8f0e3b.explanation: The athlete states that donors can claim they helped him if he wins a medal; thus, they are hoping for his victory.
cad3ec2e-f079-41ab-8c5a-8e511f8f0e3b.breakdown: The question asks what donors can hope for. The text explains that Brice Leverdez is launching a crowdfunding campaign for the Olympics. In the quote, he states: 'Si je rapporte une médaille... ils pourront dire qu'ils ont aidé...' (If I bring back a medal... they can say they helped...). Bringing back a medal is synonymous with achieving a victory. Options A, B, and C involve specific rewards (meeting, ticket, session) that are not mentioned in the text. Therefore, the only supported outcome is his success (victory/medal).

25033197-01ba-49be-8ea3-71b360a4da3a.text:
Le Marché des saveurs est ouvert : venez y découvrir le savoir-faire de notre région : Poulets rôtis. viandes grillées, charcuteries fromages frais, miel, confitures, tartes, gâteaux.
Vous composerez votre menu et dégusterez nos petits plats sous le chapiteau de la buvette.
Vous vous laisserez également séduire par nos artisans avec des peintres, des créateurs de bijoux, des couturiers, des botanistes, tous du pays et vous serez peut-être tentés par des jouets en bois, un tableau romantique ou un bouquet de fleurs séchées.
25033197-01ba-49be-8ea3-71b360a4da3a.text_en: The Flavors Market is open: come discover the know-how of our region: Roasted chickens, grilled meats, deli meats, fresh cheeses, honey, jams, pies, cakes. You will compose your menu and taste our small dishes under the refreshment tent. You will also be seduced by our artisans with painters, jewelry creators, dressmakers, botanists, all from the country and you may be tempted by wooden toys, a romantic painting or a bouquet of dried flowers.
25033197-01ba-49be-8ea3-71b360a4da3a.question_fr: Que peut-on acheter au marché des saveurs ?
25033197-01ba-49be-8ea3-71b360a4da3a.question_en: What can one buy at the flavors market?

options.explanation: Too specific. While painters are present, the market also sells food, so it is not limited to art objects.
The text emphasizes products 'of our region' and artisans 'from the country', which corresponds to local specialties.
The text does not mention that the products are ecological or organic.
This contradicts the text, which states the products and artisans are from the region/country, not exotic.

25033197-01ba-49be-8ea3-71b360a4da3a.key_line_fr: venez y découvrir le savoir-faire de notre région
25033197-01ba-49be-8ea3-71b360a4da3a.key_line_en: come discover the know-how of our region
25033197-01ba-49be-8ea3-71b360a4da3a.explanation: The text explicitly focuses on the 'know-how of our region' and artisans 'from the country', defining the goods as local specialties.
25033197-01ba-49be-8ea3-71b360a4da3a.breakdown:
1. The text invites visitors to discover 'le savoir-faire de notre région' (the know-how of our region).
2. It lists food items (chicken, cheese, honey) and mentions artisans 'tous du pays' (all from the country/region).
3. While art is mentioned (painters), the market is primarily about 'saveurs' (flavors) and regional products.
4. Therefore, 'Local specialties' is the only category that accurately describes the regional nature of all items sold (both food and crafts), whereas 'Art objects' ignores the food.

5e4d0d36-2f8d-4e87-861e-49d6f3424efc.text:
Les repas servis dans les avions de ligne ont toujours été tristement réputés pour leur fadeur.
Mais il semblerait que les chefs n'y soient pour rien.
D'après une étude, les nuisance sonores importantes peuvent en effet réduire lasensibilité des palais, rendant la nourriture peusavoureuse.
Le vrombissement des réacteurs expliqueraitle peu d'enthousiasme des passagers pour les plateaux servis à bord.
Les chercheurs ont aussi découvert que dessons agréables pouvaient faire mieux apprécier les mets.
5e4d0d36-2f8d-4e87-861e-49d6f3424efc.text_en: Meals served on airliners have always been sadly notorious for their blandness. But it seems that the chefs are not to blame. According to a study, significant noise pollution can indeed reduce the sensitivity of palates, making the food unpalatable. The roar of the engines would explain the lack of enthusiasm of passengers for the trays served on board. Researchers also discovered that pleasant sounds could make dishes better appreciated.
5e4d0d36-2f8d-4e87-861e-49d6f3424efc.question_fr: Quelle est la conclusion de cette étude ?
5e4d0d36-2f8d-4e87-861e-49d6f3424efc.question_en: What is the conclusion of this study?

options.text: L’anxiété en avion diminue la sensation de faim
options.text_en: Anxiety on planes decreases the sensation of hunger.
options.explanation: The text discusses noise, not anxiety.

options.text: La qualité de la nourriture se détériore en altitude
options.text_en: The quality of food deteriorates at altitude.
options.explanation: The text attributes the problem to the passenger's perception (palate sensitivity) affected by noise, not the physical deterioration of food quality due to altitude.

options.text: Le bruit altère le sens du goût des passagers
options.text_en: Noise alters passengers' sense of taste.
options.explanation: This option summarizes the core finding: loud noise ('nuisances sonores') reduces the sensitivity of the palate ('sens du goût').

options.text: Les plats proposés en vol manquent de saveur
options.text_en: Dishes offered in flight lack flavor.
options.explanation: This is the initial observation (premise) mentioned in the first sentence, not the specific conclusion of the scientific study explaining the cause.

5e4d0d36-2f8d-4e87-861e-49d6f3424efc.key_line_fr: D'après une étude, les nuisance sonores importantes peuvent en effet réduire la sensibilité des palais, rendant la nourriture peu savoureuse.
5e4d0d36-2f8d-4e87-861e-49d6f3424efc.key_line_en: According to a study, significant noise pollution can indeed reduce the sensitivity of palates, making the food unpalatable.
5e4d0d36-2f8d-4e87-861e-49d6f3424efc.explanation: The text explicitly links 'noise pollution' (nuisances sonores) to a reduction in 'palate sensitivity' (sensibilité des palais), which means noise alters the sense of taste.
5e4d0d36-2f8d-4e87-861e-49d6f3424efc.breakdown:
1. The text begins by stating a common observation: airline food is considered bland.
2. It introduces a study that investigates the cause ('D'après une étude...').
3. The study finds that 'nuisances sonores importantes' (significant noise pollution) reduce 'la sensibilité des palais' (palate sensitivity).
4. Option C states that noise alters the sense of taste, which is a direct paraphrase of the study's finding.

c6658f49-fd94-4e13-a9d8-2b3d7b46153d.text:
Paris, le 13 mars
Madame, Monsieur,
Ce courrier fait suite à mon achat d'un téléphone le 5 mars dernier. Après réflexion, je souhaiterais le rendre, car j'ai finalement décidé d'acheter un appareil avec messagerie intégrée.
Ainsi, je vous prie de bien vouloir me restituer la somme de 80 euros, correspondant à la somme versée le 5 mars par chèque.
Dans l'attente de votre réponse, je vous transmets, Madame, Monsieur, mes meilleures salutations.
André Cellier
c6658f49-fd94-4e13-a9d8-2b3d7b46153d.text_en:
Paris, March 13th
Madame, Monsieur,
This letter follows my purchase of a telephone on March 5th. Upon reflection, I would like to return it, because I have finally decided to buy a device with integrated messaging.
Thus, I ask you to please return the sum of 80 euros to me, corresponding to the sum paid on March 5th by check.
Awaiting your response, I send you, Madame, Monsieur, my best regards.
André Cellier
c6658f49-fd94-4e13-a9d8-2b3d7b46153d.question_fr: Quel est l'objet de la lettre de Monsieur Cellier ?
c6658f49-fd94-4e13-a9d8-2b3d7b46153d.question_en: What is the subject of Mr. Cellier's letter?

options.explanation: The text explicitly asks for the return of the money paid ('restituer la somme'), which defines a refund ('remboursement').
He mentions deciding to buy a different device, but he asks for his money back, not for a direct exchange of the product.

options.text: L’envoi de son téléphone par la poste.
options.explanation: Sending the phone is implied as part of the process, but the *objective* of the letter is financial restitution.

While this is a customer service issue, 'réclamation' (complaint) usually implies a defect or dissatisfaction. Here, he simply changed his mind ('Après réflexion') and specifically requests a refund, making A the more precise answer.

c6658f49-fd94-4e13-a9d8-2b3d7b46153d.key_line_fr: Ainsi, je vous prie de bien vouloir me restituer la somme de 80 euros, correspondant à la somme versée le 5 mars par chèque.
c6658f49-fd94-4e13-a9d8-2b3d7b46153d.key_line_en: Thus, I ask you to please return the sum of 80 euros to me, corresponding to the sum paid on March 5th by check.
c6658f49-fd94-4e13-a9d8-2b3d7b46153d.explanation: Mr. Cellier asks for the 80 euros he paid to be returned to him, which is a request for a refund.
c6658f49-fd94-4e13-a9d8-2b3d7b46153d.breakdown: The author states in the letter: 'je souhaiterais le rendre' (I would like to return it) and explicitly asks: 'je vous prie de bien vouloir me restituer la somme de 80 euros' (I ask you to please return the sum of 80 euros). The phrase 'restituer la somme' (return the sum) is synonymous with 'remboursement' (refund). Therefore, the specific purpose is to get his money back.

5749e6df-8b10-4cee-b2c3-1a21baa95e18.text:
Pendant un an, la journaliste allemande Greta Taubert a décidé de quitter la société de consommation sans quitter son appartement berlinois. Pendant cette expérience, elle a bu, mangé, s’est habillée sans payer : elle a échangé jupes et pantalons avec ses voisines, planté des légumes dans un jardin collectif. Pour ses vacances, elle est allée chez des amis en faisant de l’auto-stop. « Aujourd’hui, je suis contente de ne plus vivre aussi radicalement, c’était difficile, mais je cherche à intégrer dans mon quotidien ce que j’ai appris », explique-t-elle ?
D'après linternaute.com
5749e6df-8b10-4cee-b2c3-1a21baa95e18.text_en: For a year, the German journalist Greta Taubert decided to leave consumer society without leaving her Berlin apartment. During this experience, she drank, ate, and dressed without paying: she swapped skirts and trousers with her neighbors, planted vegetables in a community garden. For her holidays, she went to friends' houses by hitchhiking. "Today, I am happy not to live so radically anymore, it was difficult, but I seek to integrate what I learned into my daily life," she explains?
5749e6df-8b10-4cee-b2c3-1a21baa95e18.question_fr: Quel est le constat de Greta Taubert après cette expérience ?
5749e6df-8b10-4cee-b2c3-1a21baa95e18.question_en: What is Greta Taubert's observation after this experience?

options.text_en: It is possible in the countryside.
options.explanation: The text states she stayed in her "Berlin apartment," meaning she was in the city, not the countryside.
The text does not mention that time was the enabling factor for this experience.
She completed the experience (so it is possible), but she explicitly stated "c'était difficile" (it was difficult), which is synonymous with "pénible".
She speaks only of her own personal experience; the text does not suggest this lifestyle is viable for everyone.

5749e6df-8b10-4cee-b2c3-1a21baa95e18.key_line_fr: « Aujourd’hui, je suis contente de ne plus vivre aussi radicalement, c’était difficile, mais je cherche à intégrer dans mon quotidien ce que j’ai appris », explique-t-elle ?
5749e6df-8b10-4cee-b2c3-1a21baa95e18.key_line_en: "Today, I am happy not to live so radically anymore, it was difficult, but I seek to integrate what I learned into my daily life," she explains?
5749e6df-8b10-4cee-b2c3-1a21baa95e18.explanation: Greta explicitly describes the experience as "difficile" (difficult), which corresponds to the adjective "pénible" in option C.
5749e6df-8b10-4cee-b2c3-1a21baa95e18.breakdown:
1. **Identify the core question**: We need to find Greta's conclusion or feeling about the experience.
2. **Locate the answer in the text**: The text describes her actions (living without paying), but her evaluation comes at the end in quotes: "c’était difficile" (it was difficult).
3. **Compare with options**:
   - Option A mentions the countryside, but the text says "appartement berlinois" (city).
   - Option B mentions time, which isn't the focus.
   - Option C mentions it is "pénible" (arduous/hard). "Pénible" is a close synonym for "difficile". Since she completed the year, it is "possible", but the difficulty is the key takeaway.
   - Option D claims it's for everyone, which is not stated.
4. **Conclusion**: Option C accurately reflects that she managed to do it (possible) but found it hard (pénible/difficile).

5eb58422-213e-419e-8deb-78fd93eda726.text:
L'année dernière, une étude publiée par la revue Nature faisait grand bruit menée par une équipe de l'université de Zurich, l'étude montrait qu'une odeur d'ocytocine diffusée lors d'un entretien avec un banquier pousse les gens à lui confier leur argent !
L'expérience portait sur 56 personnes qui acceptaient de jouer à un jeu d'argent. On leur donnait une somme et ils devaient dire s'ils acceptaient ou non de la confier à un banquier après un entretien avec lui. Avant la discussion, la moitié des personnes avaient respiré un spray d'ocytocine, hormone connue pour jouer un rôle dans l'établissement des relations interpersonnelles.
5eb58422-213e-419e-8deb-78fd93eda726.text_en: Last year, a study published by the journal Nature caused a stir. Led by a team from the University of Zurich, the study showed that a scent of oxytocin released during an interview with a banker drives people to entrust their money to him! The experiment involved 56 people who agreed to play a money game. They were given a sum and had to say whether or not they agreed to entrust it to a banker after an interview with him. Before the discussion, half of the people had breathed in an oxytocin spray, a hormone known to play a role in establishing interpersonal relationships.
5eb58422-213e-419e-8deb-78fd93eda726.question_fr: Quel est le but de cette expérience ?
5eb58422-213e-419e-8deb-78fd93eda726.question_en: What is the goal of this experiment?

options.text: Apprendre à gérer une entrevue importante avec un banquier
options.text_en: To learn how to handle an important interview with a banker
options.explanation: The text describes a scientific observation of behavior, not a guide or lesson on how to conduct an interview.

options.text: Déterminer le lien, positif ou non, que les gens ont avec l’argent
options.text_en: To determine the connection, positive or otherwise, that people have with money
options.explanation: The focus is on the influence of the hormone on trust towards a person (the banker), not on the general psychological relationship people have with money itself.

options.text: Identifier les conditions et facteurs d’addiction aux jeux de hasard
options.text_en: To identify the conditions and factors of addiction to games of chance
options.explanation: Although a 'money game' was used as the testing method, the goal was to study trust and biological influence, not gambling addiction.

options.text: Montrer l’importance de la chimie dans les rapports humains
options.text_en: To show the importance of chemistry in human relationships
options.explanation: Oxytocin represents the 'chemistry', and the study proves it influences 'human relationships' (specifically trust).

5eb58422-213e-419e-8deb-78fd93eda726.key_line_fr: Avant la discussion, la moitié des personnes avaient respiré un spray d'ocytocine, hormone connue pour jouer un rôle dans l'établissement des relations interpersonnelles.
5eb58422-213e-419e-8deb-78fd93eda726.key_line_en: Before the discussion, half of the people had breathed in an oxytocin spray, a hormone known to play a role in establishing interpersonal relationships.
5eb58422-213e-419e-8deb-78fd93eda726.explanation: The experiment proves that a chemical substance (oxytocin) directly influences social behavior and trust, supporting the idea that chemistry plays a role in human relationships.
5eb58422-213e-419e-8deb-78fd93eda726.breakdown:
1. The text describes an experiment where participants inhaled oxytocin (a hormone) before meeting a banker.
2. The result showed that this hormone made people more likely to entrust their money to the banker.
3. The text concludes by defining oxytocin as a hormone involved in 'establishing interpersonal relationships'.
4. Option D summarizes this finding by linking the biological agent (oxytocin/chemistry) to its effect on social interaction (human relationships).

9e482395-d016-4d09-be06-c34b0b802e9a.text:
Éducation numérique
Il n'y a presque plus aujourd'hui de manuel scolaire qui paraisse sans avoir une double traduction, numérique et en ligne. C'est devenu le standard de la production au terme d'une mutation très rapide. Mais cependant, nous restons en proximité forte avec le manuel classique. De nouvelles applications qui seraient déconnectées du livre papier ne nous paraissent pas encore à ce stade conformes à notre mission, ni répondre aux attentes de la majorité des enseignants. En outre, cela ne correspond pas à l'équipement de la très grande majorité des établissements. Autrement dit, les conditions d'un changement d'ensemble ne sont pas réunies.
M. Huet, éditeur de manuels scolaires
9e482395-d016-4d09-be06-c34b0b802e9a.text_en: There is almost no textbook published today without having a double translation, digital and online. This has become the production standard after a very rapid transformation. But nevertheless, we remain in close proximity to the classic textbook. New applications that would be disconnected from the paper book do not yet appear to us at this stage to conform to our mission, nor to meet the expectations of the majority of teachers. Furthermore, this corresponds not to the equipment of the vast majority of institutions. In other words, the conditions for a comprehensive change are not met.
9e482395-d016-4d09-be06-c34b0b802e9a.question_fr: Quelle est la position de cet éditeur de manuels sur la croissance du support numérique ?
9e482395-d016-4d09-be06-c34b0b802e9a.question_en: What is the position of this textbook editor regarding the growth of digital media?

options.text: Il considère que l’ère du support papier est définitivement terminée
options.text_en: He considers that the era of paper media is definitely over.
options.explanation: The text states the opposite: 'we remain in close proximity to the classic textbook,' meaning paper is still very relevant.

options.text: Il estime qu’il reste du travail à faire pour mieux préparer cette évolution
options.text_en: He estimates that work remains to be done to better prepare for this evolution.
options.explanation: The editor concludes that the conditions for a total change (equipment, expectations) are not yet met, implying that further preparation is required for this evolution.

options.text: Il juge indispensable de n’utiliser que les supports électroniques
options.text_en: He judges it essential to use only electronic supports.
options.explanation: The text rejects applications 'disconnected from the paper book' as they do not yet conform to the mission or teacher expectations.

options.text: Il pense qu’il faut privilégier le contact des élèves avec l’outil internet
options.text_en: He thinks that student contact with internet tools should be prioritized.
options.explanation: The text does not advocate prioritizing the internet over paper; it emphasizes the continued importance of the classic textbook.

9e482395-d016-4d09-be06-c34b0b802e9a.key_line_fr: Autrement dit, les conditions d'un changement d'ensemble ne sont pas réunies.
9e482395-d016-4d09-be06-c34b0b802e9a.key_line_en: In other words, the conditions for a comprehensive change are not met.
9e482395-d016-4d09-be06-c34b0b802e9a.explanation: The editor argues that while digital formats exist, schools and teachers are not ready for a full switch from paper, meaning the necessary conditions are not yet met.
9e482395-d016-4d09-be06-c34b0b802e9a.breakdown: The text begins by acknowledging that digital versions are now standard ('double traduction, numérique et en ligne'). However, the editor explicitly states that they remain close to the 'classic textbook' (paper). He lists obstacles preventing a full switch: it does not fit the publisher's mission, it does not meet teacher expectations ('attentes de la majorité des enseignants'), and schools lack the necessary equipment ('équipement'). The final sentence summarizes the situation: 'the conditions for a comprehensive change are not met.' This implies that more preparation (equipment, teacher readiness) is needed before a full digital evolution can occur, which aligns with Option B.

40c28e05-a6e3-4488-bb79-8a980749b1df.text:
On réserve trop facilement le covoiturage aux étudiants sans un sou.
Les clichés sont tenaces.
Pourtant, le temps de la petite annonce papier accrochée près de la machine à café est bel et bien terminé.
Les nouveaux moyens de communication ont changé les choses.
L’organisation d’un trajet entre plusieurs personnes qui se rendent dans la même direction est devenue si simple et si efficace avec les sites spécialisés que le covoiturage est en train d’élargir son public et de gagner son statut de mode de transport à part entière.
40c28e05-a6e3-4488-bb79-8a980749b1df.text_en: We too easily reserve carpooling for penniless students. Clichés are stubborn. However, the time of the small paper ad stuck near the coffee machine is well and truly over. New means of communication have changed things. Organizing a trip between several people going in the same direction has become so simple and efficient with specialized sites that carpooling is widening its audience and earning its status as a full-fledged mode of transport.

options.text: Il devient la solution idéale des voyages organisés à la dernière minute.
options.text_en: It is becoming the ideal solution for trips organized at the last minute.
options.explanation: The text mentions efficiency and specialized sites, but does not specifically focus on 'last minute' organization.

options.text: Il est accessible à un nombre croissant d’utilisateurs grâce à internet.
options.text_en: It is accessible to a growing number of users thanks to the internet.

aea0ebbe-fee5-4b42-a33f-c8528f604b51.text:
Le temps des cerises
Pièce de théâtre de Niels Arestrup
Un vieil homme, dérangé dans sa vieille maison par unejeune femme : dispute, goût de la vie retrouvé, momentsde tendresse. La comédienne Cécile de France joue avecautant de talent qu'au cinéma. Le comédien EddyMitchell, dans le rôle du vieux peintre, manque denoirceur. Dommage que le metteur en scène n'interprètepas lui-même le personnage principal. On passe un bonmoment mais pas un grand moment.
aea0ebbe-fee5-4b42-a33f-c8528f604b51.text_en:
The Time of Cherries
Play by Niels Arestrup
An old man, disturbed in his old house by a young woman: argument, rediscovered taste for life, moments of tenderness. The actress Cécile de France plays with as much talent as in the cinema. The actor Eddy Mitchell, in the role of the old painter, lacks darkness. Pity that the director does not play the main character himself. We have a good time but not a great time.
aea0ebbe-fee5-4b42-a33f-c8528f604b51.question_fr: Sur quel aspect de la pièce porte la critique ?
aea0ebbe-fee5-4b42-a33f-c8528f604b51.question_en: On which aspect of the play does the critique focus?

options.explanation: The text mentions the director (metteur en scène), but refers to his potential acting capability, not his directing style or staging.
There is no mention of the scenery, sets, or decorations (décors) in the text.
The review explicitly discusses the acting skills of Cécile de France (praised) and Eddy Mitchell (criticized), focusing on how they interpreted their roles.
The plot is briefly summarized (old man, young woman, argument), but the actual critique (evaluation of quality) focuses on the actors, not the story itself.

aea0ebbe-fee5-4b42-a33f-c8528f604b51.explanation: The passage specifically evaluates the acting skills of Cécile de France and Eddy Mitchell, focusing on the performance rather than the plot or sets.

It also expresses regret that the director did not perform the main role himself. Therefore, the critique centers on the actors' performance (le jeu des interprètes).

a52a3601-4582-4e16-a70b-a39ea2ee860e.text: Les auteurs européens ont persuadé la maison d'éditionLivresque d'aller plus loin que la simple numérisation des livresuniversitaire : au lieu de ne scanner des livres qu'à des fins derecherche, les écrivains ont demandé à ce qu'ils soient remisdans le circuit commercial. Grâce à cet accord, ces millions delivres épuisés vont reprendre vie. Les bénéfices générés par lapublicité et les droits de licence iront en partie à Livresque. maisla grande majorité de l'argent gagné par cette mise à dispositiondes ouvrages sera directement remise aux auteurs puisqu'ilstoucheront leurs droits.
a52a3601-4582-4e16-a70b-a39ea2ee860e.text_en: European authors persuaded the publishing house Livresque to go further than the simple digitization of academic books: instead of only scanning books for research purposes, the writers asked that they be put back into the commercial circuit. Thanks to this agreement, these millions of out-of-print books will come back to life. The profits generated by advertising and licensing rights will go partly to Livresque, but the vast majority of the money earned by this availability of the works will be directly given to the authors since they will receive their royalties.
a52a3601-4582-4e16-a70b-a39ea2ee860e.question_fr: D'après le texte, quel avantage les auteurstireront-ils de la numération des livres ?
a52a3601-4582-4e16-a70b-a39ea2ee860e.question_en: According to the text, what benefit will the authors derive from the digitization of the books?

options.explanation: Visibility is implied by the books 'coming back to life', but the text explicitly highlights the monetary return (royalties) as the direct advantage for authors.

options.text_en: It will decrease the cost of the works
options.explanation: The text does not mention anything about reducing the price or cost of the books.

options.text_en: It will lead to a financial gain
options.explanation: The text states that authors will receive the majority of the money earned and their royalties ('toucheront leurs droits'), which is a direct financial gain.

a52a3601-4582-4e16-a70b-a39ea2ee860e.key_line_fr: mais la grande majorité de l'argent gagné par cette mise à disposition des ouvrages sera directement remise aux auteurs puisqu'ils toucheront leurs droits.

a52a3601-4582-4e16-a70b-a39ea2ee860e.breakdown: The text discusses a deal between European authors and a publisher regarding the digitization of books. It explains that books will return to the commercial circuit. The crucial part is the final sentence, which details the distribution of revenue: while the publisher gets some profit, 'the vast majority of the money earned... will be directly given to the authors since they will receive their royalties.' 70b89f7d-bc28-47f9-9ce8-9a7688debb8b.text: Depuis plusieurs années, Thierry Marx, un grand cheffrançais, intervient pour donner des cours de cuisine enprison. Faire découvrir à ce public, contraint de vivre enmilieu fermé, qu'une profession, quelle qu'elle soit, peutêtre épanouissante, est une tâche qui le passionne etnécessite très naturellement une grande énergie. Le désirde rallumer cette lueur d'espoir, de montrer « qu'après »,il peut y avoir une réinsertion réussie et que chacun laporte en lui, c'est un moteur pour relever ce défi.
70b89f7d-bc28-47f9-9ce8-9a7688debb8b.text_en: For several years, Thierry Marx, a great French chef, has been intervening to give cooking classes in prison. To help this audience, forced to live in a closed environment, discover that a profession, whatever it may be, can be fulfilling, is a task that fascinates him and quite naturally requires great energy. The desire to rekindle this glimmer of hope, to show that "afterwards", there can be a successful reintegration and that everyone carries it within themselves, is a driving force to take up this challenge.
70b89f7d-bc28-47f9-9ce8-9a7688debb8b.question_fr: Pourquoi Thierry Marx intervient-il dans lesprisons?
70b89f7d-bc28-47f9-9ce8-9a7688debb8b.question_en: Why does Thierry Marx intervene in prisons?

options.text: Pour encourager la création de formations professionnelles
options.text_en: To encourage the creation of professional training courses
options.explanation: While he provides training, the specific goal mentioned is to change the inmates' perspective on work and hope, rather than advocating for the administrative creation of training programs.

options.text: Pour faire naître l’envie de s’investir dans un métier
options.text_en: To spark the desire to invest in a trade
options.explanation: The text explicitly states his goal is to show that a profession can be fulfilling ('épanouissante') and to rekindle hope, which means motivating them to engage in a job.

options.text: Pour sensibiliser le grand public à la réalité de la vie carcérale
options.text_en: To raise public awareness about the reality of prison life
options.explanation: The intervention is directed at the inmates ('ce public, contraint de vivre en milieu fermé'), not at raising awareness among the general public outside.

70b89f7d-bc28-47f9-9ce8-9a7688debb8b.key_line_fr: Faire découvrir à ce public [...] qu'une profession, quelle qu'elle soit, peut être épanouissante, est une tâche qui le passionne

70b89f7d-bc28-47f9-9ce8-9a7688debb8b.explanation: Thierry Marx wants to show inmates that work can be fulfilling and lead to successful reintegration, which corresponds to sparking the desire to invest in a trade.
70b89f7d-bc28-47f9-9ce8-9a7688debb8b.breakdown: The text states that Thierry Marx gives cooking classes to show inmates ('ce public') that a profession can be fulfilling ('peut être épanouissante') and to rekindle hope for reintegration. This aligns perfectly with Option C, which speaks of sparking the desire ('faire naître l’envie') to invest in a trade. Option A is incorrect as the text mentions cooking classes, not canteen logistics. Option B is too broad; he is teaching, not lobbying for the creation of programs. Option D is incorrect because his target audience is the inmates, not the general public.

Avoir accès par latoile aux mêmes informations ne compense absolument pasI'absence d'apprentissage.
d3b9bf5e-4a79-428e-ab10-8cd9be29db47.text_en: By making a multitude of information accessible at any time, the internet profoundly modifies our relationship with knowledge. It would nevertheless be completely illusory to imagine that what is accessible on the web does not need to be learned simply because of its permanent availability, for possessing all the books in the world, like being able to access all the sites in the world, does not substitute for knowledge. Having access via the web to the same information absolutely does not compensate for the lack of learning.

d32ba1cc-336f-46b0-88de-23abb6217b3d.text: Aux débuts d'internet, je me souviens d'avoir lu, éberluée, dans un magazine féminin « Mon mari était absent, il passait tout sontemps sur le chat » et j'en étais à tenter de visualiser ce triste état de fait lorsque je compris ma méprise : avoir confondu le chat, le félidé, avec le chat, la discussion sur internet. Depuis ce jour,aucun progrès sur cette équivoque terrible de la langue, alors que l'usage informatique du mot souris démultiplie les sources deconfusions. Le bon sens voudrait que la phonétique l'emporte et que l'on écrive « tchat ». Au lieu de cette solution évidente, lePetit Larousse laissé entrer en 2003 dans le dictionnaire lemonstrueux mot-valise « clavardage ».
d32ba1cc-336f-46b0-88de-23abb6217b3d.text_en: In the early days of the internet, I remember reading, flabbergasted, in a women's magazine 'My husband was absent, he spent all his time on the chat' and I was trying to visualize this sad state of affairs when I realized my mistake: having confused the cat, the feline, with the chat, the discussion on the internet. Since that day, no progress on this terrible ambiguity of the language, while the computer usage of the word mouse multiplies the sources of confusion. Common sense would dictate that phonetics prevail and that one writes 'tchat'. Instead of this obvious solution, the Petit Larousse let the monstrous portmanteau word 'clavardage' enter the dictionary in 2003.

   - Option C is irrelevant to the text.
   - Option D refers to the end of the text where she dislikes 'clavardage', but the root problem discussed throughout is the confusion regarding 'chat'.

83418762-effd-4bfa-aa1e-18a10180e6ad.text:
Elle s'appelait Sarah
Le cinéaste n'arrive pas à éviter - mais le pouvait-il ? - l'artifice du scénario : ping-pong incessant et artificiel entre le passé et le présent. Néanmoins, chaque fois qu'il change d'époque, le cinéaste repart à la recherche de l'émotion perdue qu'il retrouve, d'ailleurs, à force de pudeur et de retenue. Aucun débordement lacrymal. Les acteurs restent jusqu'au bout étonnamment sobres. Le film est un mélo, un vrai, puisqu'il repose sur une faute dont chacun ne peut ou ne veut se défaire. C'est aussi « un film du samedi soir », avec ses drames, ses sacrifices, parfois même ses outrances... Bref, on est dans le cinéma humaniste à l'ancienne (et, peut-être, éternel). À la frontière exacte, en tout cas, entre bons et grands sentiments.
83418762-effd-4bfa-aa1e-18a10180e6ad.text_en: The filmmaker fails to avoid - but could he? - the artifice of the screenplay: incessant and artificial ping-pong between the past and the present. Nevertheless, each time he changes eras, the filmmaker sets out again in search of lost emotion which he finds, moreover, through modesty and restraint. No tearful overflow. The actors remain surprisingly sober until the end. The film is a melodrama, a real one, since it rests on a fault that no one can or wants to undo. It is also 'a Saturday night movie', with its dramas, its sacrifices, sometimes even its excesses... In short, we are in old-fashioned humanist cinema (and, perhaps, eternal). On the exact border, in any case, between good and great feelings.
83418762-effd-4bfa-aa1e-18a10180e6ad.question_fr: Sur quel élément du film porte la réserve du critique?
83418762-effd-4bfa-aa1e-18a10180e6ad.question_en: On which element of the film does the critic's reservation focus?

options.explanation: The text explicitly states there is 'no tearful overflow' and the actors are 'restrained,' refuting the idea of a heavy, pathetic atmosphere.
The critic describes the switching between past and present as 'incessant' and 'artificial,' which corresponds to an abusive use of flashbacks.

options.text: La caricature du film de genre
options.text_en: The caricature of the genre film
options.explanation: The text acknowledges the film's genre traits ('real melodrama,' 'Saturday night movie') as characteristic, not as a negative caricature.

options.text_en: The conviction of the actors' performance
options.explanation: The critic praises the actors for being 'surprisingly sober' (restrained), so the reservation is not about their acting.

83418762-effd-4bfa-aa1e-18a10180e6ad.key_line_fr: Le cinéaste n'arrive pas à éviter - mais le pouvait-il ? - l'artifice du scénario : ping-pong incessant et artificiel entre le passé et le présent.
83418762-effd-4bfa-aa1e-18a10180e6ad.key_line_en: The filmmaker fails to avoid - but could he? - the artifice of the screenplay: incessant and artificial ping-pong between the past and the present.
83418762-effd-4bfa-aa1e-18a10180e6ad.explanation: The critic explicitly complains about the 'incessant and artificial ping-pong between the past and the present,' which refers to the overuse of flashbacks.
83418762-effd-4bfa-aa1e-18a10180e6ad.breakdown:
1.  **Identify the criticism (réserve):** Look for negative language or limitations mentioned by the author. The very first sentence states: 'Le cinéaste n'arrive pas à éviter... l'artifice du scénario : ping-pong incessant et artificiel entre le passé et le présent' (The filmmaker fails to avoid the artifice of the screenplay: incessant and artificial ping-pong between past and present).
2.  **Analyze Option A (Heavy/pathetic atmosphere):** The text says 'Aucun débordement lacrymal' (No tearful overflow) and describes the actors as 'sobres' (restrained). This contradicts the idea of a pathetic atmosphere.
3.  **Analyze Option B (Abusive use of flashbacks):** The phrase 'ping-pong incessant... entre le passé et le présent' describes the narrative structure of jumping back and forth in time (flashbacks). The words 'incessant' and 'artificiel' indicate the critic's reservation about this technique.
4.  **Analyze Option C (Caricature of genre):** While the author admits it is a 'mélo' and has 'outrances' (excesses), the overall tone defines it as 'cinéma humaniste' and 'un vrai' mélo, accepting the genre rather than rejecting it as a caricature.
5.  **Analyze Option D (Acting):** The text praises the actors: 'Les acteurs restent jusqu'au bout étonnamment sobres.'
6.  **Conclusion:** The only clear criticism refers to the structural back-and-forth in time, which matches Option B.

0e34013a-8ff6-4f2b-b1b1-f729086f3105.text: La première difficulté, qu'il avait en réalité sous-estimée, fut deréussir à atteindre l'extrémité du trottoir, c'est-à-dire de franchir la masse mouvante et compacte des hommes et des femmes qui marchaient devant lui, frange large de deux ou trois mètres mais dont la texture était dense, mobile, paisiblement hostile. ll eut beau dans un premier temps prononcer à haute voix de nombreuses paroles d'excuse, expliquant avec des gestes modestes qu'il voulait passer, se montrer on ne peut plus poli et plus encore, personne ne s'arrêta, ni ne se poussa afin de lui permettre de se faufiler entre les corps. Les hommes et les femmes qui marchaient ne le regardaient pas et beaucoup avaient sur les oreilles des écouteurs.
0e34013a-8ff6-4f2b-b1b1-f729086f3105.text_en: The first difficulty, which he had in reality underestimated, was succeeding in reaching the edge of the sidewalk, that is to say, crossing the moving and compact mass of men and women walking in front of him, a fringe two or three meters wide but whose texture was dense, mobile, peacefully hostile. In vain did he initially utter numerous words of apology aloud, explaining with modest gestures that he wanted to pass, showing himself to be as polite as could be and even more so, no one stopped, nor moved over to allow him to slip between the bodies. The men and women walking did not look at him and many had headphones on their ears.
0e34013a-8ff6-4f2b-b1b1-f729086f3105.question_fr: Dans quelle situation se trouve le personnage principal?
0e34013a-8ff6-4f2b-b1b1-f729086f3105.question_en: What situation is the main character in?

8a81c7fc-9ebd-4757-a44f-3923a23a3823.text:
Mais qu'est-ce qu'être autonome ?
L'autonomie été un idéal de la fin des années 70 et depuis, c'est devenue une norme. Mais qu'est-ce qu'être autonome ? Est-ce rechercher en soi les forces pour agir ? Cette représentation d'un sujet en relation avec lui-même est contestée par certains penseurs pour qui agir par soi-même, ce n'est pas s'inventer mais être capable de se diriger seul. Autrement dit, on peut être autonome en appliquant des règles que l'on apprises et dont l'origine ne se trouve donc pas au fonde nous mais dans le contexte social où nous existons. Ces règles apparaissent alors comme des capacités et non plus comme une limitation des possibilités de l'action.
8a81c7fc-9ebd-4757-a44f-3923a23a3823.text_en: Autonomy was an ideal of the late 70s and since then, it has become a norm. But what is being autonomous? Is it looking inside oneself for the strength to act? This representation of a subject in relation with himself is contested by certain thinkers for whom acting by oneself is not inventing oneself but being able to steer oneself alone. In other words, one can be autonomous by applying rules that one has learned and whose origin is therefore not deep inside us but in the social context where we exist. These rules then appear as capabilities and no longer as a limitation of action possibilities.
8a81c7fc-9ebd-4757-a44f-3923a23a3823.question_fr: Qu'est-ce qu'être autonome, selon ce texte ?
8a81c7fc-9ebd-4757-a44f-3923a23a3823.question_en: What is being autonomous, according to this text?

options.explanation: The text mentions that rules come from the 'social context', implying a connection to society rather than indifference to others.
The text explicitly contests the view that autonomy is about finding forces 'in oneself' (en soi) or 'deep inside us' (au fond de nous).
The text states autonomy is achieved by applying 'rules that one has learned' (règles que l'on a apprises), which corresponds to using acquired skills.

options.text: S’éloigner de la vie en société
options.text_en: Moving away from life in society
options.explanation: The text locates the origin of autonomy in the 'social context', suggesting engagement with society rather than distancing from it.

8a81c7fc-9ebd-4757-a44f-3923a23a3823.key_line_fr: Autrement dit, on peut être autonome en appliquant des règles que l'on a apprises et dont l'origine ne se trouve donc pas au fond de nous mais dans le contexte social où nous existons.
8a81c7fc-9ebd-4757-a44f-3923a23a3823.key_line_en: In other words, one can be autonomous by applying rules that one has learned and whose origin is therefore not deep inside us but in the social context where we exist.
8a81c7fc-9ebd-4757-a44f-3923a23a3823.explanation: The text defines autonomy not as relying on internal instinct, but as the ability to apply rules learned from the social environment (acquired skills).
8a81c7fc-9ebd-4757-a44f-3923a23a3823.breakdown:
1. The text questions the definition of autonomy: is it finding strength inside oneself ('en soi')? 
2. It states this internal view is contested. 
3. It introduces an alternative definition: autonomy is applying learned rules ('règles que l'on a apprises'). 
4. These rules come from the social context ('contexte social'), not from deep inside us. 
5. Option C ('Exploiting acquired skills') matches the concept of applying learned rules ('règles apprises'), which the text defines as capabilities ('capacités').

8c52675f-2c01-4925-a1d2-a03705104a98.text: Ceux qui l'ont vu cet été aux Francofolies n'en sont pas revenus. Trente ans après ses débuts, le chanteur Joseph Many subjugué l'assistance. Il lui fallut du temps pour se convaincre que monter sur scène pour y pousser la chansonnette était encore de son âge. Les ritournelles des années 1970 l'avaient propulsé à son époque sur le devant de la scène, avec l'image d'un artiste terriblement proche de la jeunesse d'alors. Puis sa brillante carrière d'écrivain l'avait convaincu de se consacrer à l'écriture, jusqu'à ce que l'inspiration musicale revienne. Preuve en est son nouvel album. Une ode à la vie, à l'amour, aux femmes. Les atmosphères sont délicieuses. Au fil des ballades, on redevient, pour quelques minutes, adolescent.
8c52675f-2c01-4925-a1d2-a03705104a98.text_en: Those who saw him this summer at the Francofolies haven't gotten over it. Thirty years after his debut, the singer Joseph Many captivated the audience. It took him time to convince himself that getting on stage to sing a tune was still appropriate for his age. The catchy tunes of the 1970s had propelled him to the forefront of the scene in his time, with the image of an artist terribly close to the youth of then. Then his brilliant career as a writer had convinced him to dedicate himself to writing, until musical inspiration returned. Proof of this is his new album. An ode to life, to love, to women. The atmospheres are delicious. Throughout the ballads, one becomes, for a few minutes, an adolescent again.
8c52675f-2c01-4925-a1d2-a03705104a98.question_fr: Pourquoi Joseph Many a-t-il tardé à revenir sur scène ?
8c52675f-2c01-4925-a1d2-a03705104a98.question_en: Why did Joseph Many delay his return to the stage?

options.explanation: The text mentions his image was close to the youth, but not that he wanted to flee ('fuir') it.

options.text_en: The public preferred the writer to the singer
options.explanation: The text mentions a 'brilliant career' as a writer, but does not state the public preferred it or that this caused the delay.

8c52675f-2c01-4925-a1d2-a03705104a98.key_line_fr: Il lui fallut du temps pour se convaincre que monter sur scène pour y pousser la chansonnette était encore de son âge.

3fba1492-65d4-4988-928c-8c968a9fe00f.text:
La bioéthique fait l'objet d'une polémique qui confronte deux écoles
Pour la première, composée de chercheurs et de rationaliste, le progrès scientifique ne saurait être limité. La recherche entraîner l'éradication des maladies génétiques et permettre même de les prévoir. On en viendra à un eugénisme contrôlé qui améliorer l'espèce humaine et les dépenses de santé publique seront allégées. La seconde école, de philosophes ou des ecclésiastiques, affirme ses craintes en ce qui concerne la pratique d'un eugénisme scientifique : il permettra la sélection efficace des embryons et ouvrira de plus en plus largement ses critères de choix à des exigences non pathologique. Pour eux, il est impossible de déterminer les tares inconciliables avec I'humain, puisque certains individus en ont fait l'origine même de leur génie.
3fba1492-65d4-4988-928c-8c968a9fe00f.text_en: Bioethics is the subject of a controversy confronting two schools. For the first, composed of researchers and rationalists, scientific progress cannot be limited. Research will lead to the eradication of genetic diseases and even allow them to be predicted. We will arrive at a controlled eugenics that will improve the human species and public health expenses will be lightened. The second school, of philosophers or ecclesiastics, asserts its fears regarding the practice of scientific eugenics: it will allow the efficient selection of embryos and will open its selection criteria more and more widely to non-pathological requirements. For them, it is impossible to determine the defects irreconcilable with being human, since some individuals have made them the very origin of their genius.
3fba1492-65d4-4988-928c-8c968a9fe00f.question_fr: Sur quoi portent les réserves des partisans de la seconde école ?
3fba1492-65d4-4988-928c-8c968a9fe00f.question_en: What do the reservations of the partisans of the second school relate to?

options.text: Le coût social élevé de prise en charge des maladies gins
options.text_en: The high social cost of managing genetic diseases
options.explanation: The first school argues that costs will be reduced; the second school does not discuss the cost of care.

options.text: Le développement de traitements curatifs de pathologies génétiques
options.text_en: The development of curative treatments for genetic pathologies
options.explanation: The second school's concern is not about curing diseases, but about the ethical implications of selection and eugenics.

options.text: Le mode de financement de la recherche génétique fondamentale
options.text_en: The mode of financing fundamental genetic research
options.explanation: The financing of research is not mentioned in the text.

options.text: Les dérives induites par l’amélioration du patrimoine génétique
options.text_en: The drifts induced by the improvement of the genetic heritage
options.explanation: The text explicitly states the second school fears 'scientific eugenics' and selection based on 'non-pathological requirements,' which constitutes a drift/excess in improving the genetic heritage.

3fba1492-65d4-4988-928c-8c968a9fe00f.key_line_fr: La seconde école [...] affirme ses craintes en ce qui concerne la pratique d'un eugénisme scientifique : il permettra la sélection efficace des embryons et ouvrira de plus en plus largement ses critères de choix à des exigences non pathologique.
3fba1492-65d4-4988-928c-8c968a9fe00f.key_line_en: The second school [...] asserts its fears regarding the practice of scientific eugenics: it will allow the efficient selection of embryos and will open its selection criteria more and more widely to non-pathological requirements.
3fba1492-65d4-4988-928c-8c968a9fe00f.explanation: The second school worries that scientific eugenics will go too far, selecting embryos based on non-medical criteria (drifts), rather than just curing diseases.
3fba1492-65d4-4988-928c-8c968a9fe00f.breakdown:
1. Identify the 'second school' in the text: 'La seconde école... affirme ses craintes...' (The second school... asserts its fears...).
2. Locate their specific concern: They worry about 'eugénisme scientifique' (scientific eugenics) and that it will open criteria to 'exigences non pathologique' (non-pathological requirements).
3. Analyze Option A: The text mentions costs in the context of the *first* school (rationalists) claiming they will be reduced ('dépenses... seront allégées'). This is not the second school's reservation.
4. Analyze Option B: While the topic is genetic pathologies, the second school specifically fears the 'selection' and 'eugenics' aspect, not the curative treatments themselves.
5. Analyze Option C: There is no mention of financing or funding in the text.
6. Analyze Option D: 'Dérives' (drifts/excesses) corresponds to the fear of moving from medical needs to 'non-pathological requirements' (enhancing the species/eugenics). This matches the second school's argument perfectly.

87ca05ef-6e34-4790-9c91-7fc64c62d3ee.text: Mozart est le compositeur le plus joué. Le plus aimé et le plus exploité. Ainsi, en 1993, la psychologue américaine Francs Rausher annonçait que l'écoute de la sonate pour deux pianos en ré majeur développait l'intelligence. En effet, après avoir écouté ce morceau, 36 étudiants avaient obtenu de meilleurs résultats à un test de localisation spatiale. L'étude eut un retentissement fracassant, on examina la teneur en haute fréquence de la sonate. On la fit écouter à des rats de laboratoire avant de les perdre dans un labyrinthe. On évoqua l'influence des gènes. En 1999, une nouvelle étude venait contredire les conclusions de Frances Rauscher.
87ca05ef-6e34-4790-9c91-7fc64c62d3ee.text_en: Mozart is the most played composer. The most loved and the most exploited. Thus, in 1993, American psychologist Frances Rauscher announced that listening to the sonata for two pianos in D major developed intelligence. Indeed, after listening to this piece, 36 students obtained better results on a spatial localization test. The study had a shattering impact; the high-frequency content of the sonata was examined. It was played to laboratory rats before losing them in a maze. The influence of genes was evoked. In 1999, a new study came to contradict Frances Rauscher's conclusions.
87ca05ef-6e34-4790-9c91-7fc64c62d3ee.question_fr: À quelle conclusion est arrivée Frances Raucher concernant l'écoute de la Sonate de Mozart ?
87ca05ef-6e34-4790-9c91-7fc64c62d3ee.question_en: What conclusion did Frances Rauscher reach regarding listening to Mozart's Sonata?

options.text: Elle a un effet négligeable sur l’intellect

options.explanation: Rauscher claimed the music 'developed intelligence,' which implies a significant positive effect, not a negligible one.

options.text: Elle accroît la capacité de concentration
options.text_en: It increases the capacity for concentration
options.explanation: The text specifically mentions a 'spatial localization test,' not a general test of concentration capacity.

options.text: Elle facilite le repérage dans l’espace
options.explanation: The text states students had better results in 'spatial localization,' which is synonymous with 'spatial orientation' (repérage dans l'espace).
The students obtained 'better results' (positive), whereas this option suggests a negative disturbance of reasoning.

87ca05ef-6e34-4790-9c91-7fc64c62d3ee.key_line_fr: En effet, après avoir écouté ce morceau, 36 étudiants avaient obtenu de meilleurs résultats à un test de localisation spatiale.
87ca05ef-6e34-4790-9c91-7fc64c62d3ee.key_line_en: Indeed, after listening to this piece, 36 students obtained better results on a spatial localization test.
87ca05ef-6e34-4790-9c91-7fc64c62d3ee.explanation: The text explicitly links listening to the sonata with better results on a 'spatial localization test,' which corresponds directly to facilitating spatial orientation (Option C).
87ca05ef-6e34-4790-9c91-7fc64c62d3ee.breakdown:
1.  **Locate the specific finding**: The text mentions that Frances Rauscher announced listening to the sonata developed intelligence.
2.  **Find the specific evidence**: The text clarifies this by stating, '36 students obtained better results on a spatial localization test' (test de localisation spatiale).
3.  **Match with options**: Option C, 'facilite le repérage dans l’espace' (facilitates spatial orientation), uses synonyms ('repérage' for 'localisation') to describe exactly what was tested.

7071eb15-ff42-4870-b0f5-221afddf7a8b.text:
Prévoir le Temps
L'énorme masse de données météorologiques collectées tous les jours par les satellites est traitée par les plus gros ordinateurs du monde. Le résultat de ces calculs est fourni sous forme de cartes des vents, des pluies ou des températures. Ces cartes peuvent être animées par l'ordinateur, ce qui donne l'impression de voir se dérouler en accéléré les mouvements de l'atmosphère. Les ordinateurs font des calculs que le météorologue doit compléter. Au vu des informations, il prépare un scénario sur le temps le plus probable dans un, deux ou trois, voire dix jours dans certains centres.
7071eb15-ff42-4870-b0f5-221afddf7a8b.text_en: The huge mass of meteorological data collected every day by satellites is processed by the world's largest computers. The result of these calculations is provided in the form of wind, rain, or temperature maps. These maps can be animated by the computer, giving the impression of seeing atmospheric movements unfold in fast motion. The computers perform calculations that the meteorologist must complete. Based on the information, he prepares a scenario on the most probable weather in one, two, or three, or even ten days in some centers.
7071eb15-ff42-4870-b0f5-221afddf7a8b.question_fr: En quoi consiste la profession décrite ?
7071eb15-ff42-4870-b0f5-221afddf7a8b.question_en: What does the described profession consist of?

options.text: Concevoir des prévisions à court terme
options.explanation: The text explicitly states the meteorologist prepares a scenario on the 'most probable weather' for the coming days, which defines making a weather forecast.
The text states that 'computers do calculations' (Les ordinateurs font des calculs), not that the meteorologist writes the programs for them.
The text mentions that maps 'can be animated by the computer' (animées par l'ordinateur). The meteorologist uses these visuals but is not described as the one finalizing the animation files.

While the meteorologist analyzes the data ('Au vu des informations'), the massive synthesis of raw satellite data is done by the computers ('traitée par les plus gros ordinateurs'). The human role focuses on the prediction (forecast).

7071eb15-ff42-4870-b0f5-221afddf7a8b.key_line_fr: Au vu des informations, il prépare un scénario sur le temps le plus probable dans un, deux ou trois, voire dix jours dans certains centres.
7071eb15-ff42-4870-b0f5-221afddf7a8b.key_line_en: Based on the information, he prepares a scenario on the most probable weather in one, two, or three, or even ten days in some centers.
7071eb15-ff42-4870-b0f5-221afddf7a8b.explanation: The passage concludes by saying the meteorologist uses the computer data to predict the probable weather for the coming days, which corresponds to designing forecasts.
7071eb15-ff42-4870-b0f5-221afddf7a8b.breakdown: The text describes a workflow where computers process raw data and create maps. The specific role of the meteorologist is introduced in the last two sentences. The text states that the meteorologist 'completes' the computer's calculations and, crucially, 'prepares a scenario on the most probable weather' for the next few days (1, 2, 3, or 10). Preparing a scenario about future weather is synonymous with creating (conceiving) weather forecasts.

83b74b62-9323-44ff-b133-5ff18b45229c.text: Panache et arrogance, élégance et futilité, galanterie et gauloiserie: S'il existe, et à condition que cette notion ait encore un sens à l'ère de la mondialisation, l'esprit français tire son essence particulière du fragile équilibre entre ces oppositions. Amateur de grands principe, du coup de sang et de bons mots, c'est l'esprit français. Quoi que nous en disions, il nous obsède. Que nous exaltions le génie national ou l'exception culturelle, les racines ou l'universel, le particularisme local ou l'intérêt général, il ne s'agit toujours, au fond, que de lui. La mondialisation va-t-elle le dissoudre, et nous renvoyer au triste rang de pays ordinaire ?
83b74b62-9323-44ff-b133-5ff18b45229c.text_en: Panache and arrogance, elegance and frivolity, gallantry and bawdy humor: If it exists, and provided that this notion still has meaning in the era of globalization, the French spirit draws its particular essence from the fragile balance between these oppositions. Lover of great principles, of sudden outbursts and of witty remarks, that is the French spirit. Whatever we say about it, it obsesses us. Whether we exalt national genius or cultural exception, roots or the universal, local particularism or the general interest, essentially, it is always about it. Will globalization dissolve it, and send us back to the sad rank of an ordinary country?
83b74b62-9323-44ff-b133-5ff18b45229c.question_fr: Selon l'auteur, qu'est-ce que l'esprit français ?
83b74b62-9323-44ff-b133-5ff18b45229c.question_en: According to the author, what is the French spirit?

options.text: Des attitudes contradictoires forgeant une identité
options.explanation: The text explicitly defines the French spirit as a 'fragile balance between these oppositions' (panache/arrogance, etc.), which equates to contradictory attitudes forming an identity.

options.text: Un égocentrisme désuet au temps de la mondialisation
options.text_en: An obsolete egocentrism in the time of globalization
options.explanation: The text questions if globalization will dissolve the spirit, but does not define the spirit itself as obsolete egocentrism.

options.text: Un ensemble de valeurs partagées par une élite
options.text_en: A set of values shared by an elite
options.explanation: The text mentions 'national genius' and 'cultural exception,' but never suggests these values are limited to or shared only by an 'elite'.

options.text: Une aptitude à l’ouverture qui tend à disparaître
options.text_en: An aptitude for openness that tends to disappear
options.explanation: The text does not define the French spirit as an 'aptitude for openness'; it actually lists specific, somewhat inward-looking traits like 'particularisme local'.

83b74b62-9323-44ff-b133-5ff18b45229c.key_line_fr: l'esprit français tire son essence particulière du fragile équilibre entre ces oppositions.
83b74b62-9323-44ff-b133-5ff18b45229c.key_line_en: the French spirit draws its particular essence from the fragile balance between these oppositions.
83b74b62-9323-44ff-b133-5ff18b45229c.explanation: The author defines the French spirit as a mix of opposing traits (like elegance vs. frivolity), which matches the idea of 'contradictory attitudes' in Option A.
83b74b62-9323-44ff-b133-5ff18b45229c.breakdown:
1. Analyze the question: It asks for the definition of 'l'esprit français' (the French spirit) according to the author.
2. Scan the text for the definition: The first sentence lists opposing pairs ('Panache et arrogance', 'élégance et futilité', etc.).
3. Locate the key claim: The text states, 'l'esprit français tire son essence particulière du fragile équilibre entre ces oppositions' (the French spirit draws its particular essence from the fragile balance between these oppositions).
4. Compare with options: Option A mentions 'attitudes contradictoires' (contradictory attitudes), which directly paraphrases 'oppositions' and 'équilibre' (balance). The other options discuss globalization or elites, which are secondary themes or not mentioned.

96b1812b-bdee-444e-a097-ae9bf7017e0f.text:
Je suis dans le métro J’arrive dans 20 minutes au bureau.
Commencez la réunion de travail.
Sans moi. Merci
Jean
96b1812b-bdee-444e-a097-ae9bf7017e0f.text_en: I am in the subway. I arrive at the office in 20 minutes. Start the work meeting. Without me. Thank you, Jean.
96b1812b-bdee-444e-a097-ae9bf7017e0f.question_fr: Pour qui est ce message de Jean ?

Tapas, duck hearts, Serrano ham, and foie gras meet there in a warm atmosphere, making us travel between the south-west of France and Spain.

options.text: D’apprendre à cuisiner des plats étrangers
options.text_en: To learn how to cook foreign dishes

The text mentions a 'warm atmosphere', but does not mention any shows or performances ('spectacles').

options.text: De gagner un voyage à la fin du repas
options.text_en: To win a trip at the end of the meal
options.explanation: The word 'voyager' (travel) refers to the culinary journey experienced through tasting the food, not winning an actual trip.
The menu items listed include both Spanish (tapas, serrano ham) and French (duck hearts, foie gras) specialties, linking the two regions.

0e502717-92b4-4527-8f27-2655ac5a3dc9.key_line_fr: Tapas, cœurs de canard, jambon serrano et foie gras s’y rencontrent dans une ambiance chaleureuse, nous faisant voyager entre le sud-ouest de la France et l’Espagne.

0e502717-92b4-4527-8f27-2655ac5a3dc9.breakdown: The text describes a restaurant that combines Spanish elements (Tapas, jambon serrano) with French ones (cœurs de canard, foie gras). It explicitly states that the food makes customers 'travel between the south-west of France and Spain.' Therefore, it offers specialties from both regions (Franco-Spanish). Option A is incorrect because the text is about eating ('goûter'), not cooking. Option B is incorrect as there is no mention of a show ('spectacle'). Option C is incorrect because 'voyager' is used metaphorically for the culinary experience, not a contest prize.

0b61f991-d5fa-40cf-b9a7-4e9449bd2e90.text:
Coup de cœur
LE DIRIGEABLE : La carte varie mais la qualité et le raffinement des plats se maintiennent.
Les sauces sont merveilleusement travaillées, les produits de qualité, et les nappes toujours impeccablement blanches.
C’est très étonnant de trouver une table si délicieuse dans un quartier aussi éloigné du centre-ville ; malgré cela, la réservation pour le soir est à conseiller.
Y aller et y retourner, même en jeans et baskets.
0b61f991-d5fa-40cf-b9a7-4e9449bd2e90.text_en:
FAVORITE PICK
LE DIRIGEABLE: The menu varies but the quality and refinement of the dishes are maintained.
The sauces are wonderfully crafted, the products of quality, and the tablecloths always impeccably white.
It is very surprising to find such a delicious table in a neighborhood so far from the city center; despite that, reservation for the evening is advisable.
Go there and return, even in jeans and sneakers.

A 'nuanced' review implies a mix of pros and cons, but this text is entirely positive.
The title 'Coup de cœur' and words like 'wonderfully' and 'delicious' demonstrate clear enthusiasm.
While the review describes facts, the heavy use of subjective praise ('merveilleusement', 'délicieuse') makes 'enthusiastic' the primary characteristic.

0b61f991-d5fa-40cf-b9a7-4e9449bd2e90.key_line_fr: Les sauces sont merveilleusement travaillées, les produits de qualité, et les nappes toujours impeccablement blanches.

2. The text uses strong adverbs and adjectives like 'merveilleusement' (wonderfully), 'impeccablement' (impeccably), and 'délicieuse' (delicious).

31333e9f-254c-4dd3-879b-1c4fe89fb87d.text:
Partez à la découverte d’un Paris méconnu, celui des passages secrets, des curiosités historiques, des panoramas étonnants, et même des beautés naturelles en pleine ville.
Redressez le dos, levez la tête, admirez le ciel, les toits et l’horizon !
Petits et grands, femmes et hommes, sportifs et paresseux, bébés en poussette, handicapés en fauteuil... venez nous rejoindre !
Vous êtes tous invités ce dimanche à une matinée en famille, entre amis, ou même seuls aux côtés d’inconnus qui ne demandent qu’à faire connaissance.
Rendez-vous place de la Bastille à 7 h 30 min.
31333e9f-254c-4dd3-879b-1c4fe89fb87d.text_en: Set off to discover an unknown Paris, that of secret passages, historical curiosities, astonishing panoramas, and even natural beauties right in the city. Straighten your back, look up, admire the sky, the roofs, and the horizon! Young and old, women and men, athletic and lazy, babies in strollers, disabled in wheelchairs... come join us! You are all invited this Sunday to a morning with family, friends, or even alone alongside strangers who just want to get to know each other. Meeting point Place de la Bastille at 7:30 AM.

options.explanation: The text explicitly welcomes 'paresseux' (lazy people), indicating this is not a competition.
The text proposes discovering 'unknown Paris', 'secret passages', and 'historical curiosities', which constitutes an original guided tour.
While the text says 'straighten your back', it is to 'admire the sky', not to exercise. The inclusion of strollers and wheelchairs suggests a walk, not gymnastics.

options.text: Une fête familiale en plein air
options.explanation: Families are invited, but so are strangers and friends; the primary activity is discovery ('découverte'), not a party ('fête').

31333e9f-254c-4dd3-879b-1c4fe89fb87d.explanation: The announcement invites people to discover hidden spots in Paris, fitting the description of an original guided tour rather than a sport or party.
31333e9f-254c-4dd3-879b-1c4fe89fb87d.breakdown: The text invites readers to 'set off to discover an unknown Paris' ('Partez à la découverte d’un Paris méconnu') involving secret passages and historical curiosities. This clearly describes a sightseeing activity. The invitation includes everyone, even 'lazy' people ('paresseux') and babies in strollers, which eliminates the possibility of a sports competition (Option A) or a gymnastics session (Option C). 43a9e71b-6800-4ee5-bd83-ed6fb92183d5.text:
Dora Bruder, publié en 1997, est considéré comme l’un des meilleurs romans de Patrick Modiano.
L’écrivain aime fouiller l’histoire de la capitale et fréquente de nombreuses bibliothèques.
Un jour, il tombe sur une annonce parue le 31 décembre 1941 dans Paris-soir :
« On recherche une jeune fille, Dora Bruder, 15 ans, 1m55, visage ovale, yeux gris marron, manteau sport gris. Adresse toute indication à M. et Mme Bruder, 41, boulevard Ornano, Paris. »
Modiano va alors s’attacher à lever le mystère de cette disparition en entraînant le lecteur dans les rues du 18e arrondissement.
43a9e71b-6800-4ee5-bd83-ed6fb92183d5.text_en: Dora Bruder, published in 1997, is considered one of Patrick Modiano's best novels. The writer likes to dig into the capital's history and frequents many libraries. One day, he comes across an ad published on December 31, 1941 in Paris-Soir: 'Wanted, a young girl, Dora Bruder, 15 years old, 1m55, oval face, gray-brown eyes, gray sports coat. Send any information to Mr. and Mrs. Bruder, 41 Boulevard Ornano, Paris.' Modiano then sets out to solve the mystery of this disappearance by dragging the reader into the streets of the 18th arrondissement.
43a9e71b-6800-4ee5-bd83-ed6fb92183d5.question_fr: Que fait le journaliste dans cet extrait ?
43a9e71b-6800-4ee5-bd83-ed6fb92183d5.question_en: What is the journalist doing in this excerpt?

options.text: Il cite un extrait d’une œuvre de Modiano.
options.text_en: He cites an excerpt from a work by Modiano.
options.explanation: The text quotes a classified ad from a 1941 newspaper ('Paris-Soir'), not an excerpt from Modiano's actual novel.

options.text: Il explique l’idée de départ d’un livre de Modiano.
options.text_en: He explains the starting idea of a book by Modiano.
options.explanation: The passage describes the specific event (finding the ad) that inspired Modiano to write the book and solve the mystery.

options.text: Il présente le métier de Modiano à ses débuts.
options.text_en: He presents Modiano's job at his beginnings.
options.explanation: The text discusses a book published in 1997 (mid-career), not the author's beginnings or early profession.

options.text: Il raconte la rencontre entre Modiano et sa femme.
options.text_en: He tells the story of the meeting between Modiano and his wife.
options.explanation: Dora Bruder is a missing girl from 1941 whom the author investigates; she is not his wife.

43a9e71b-6800-4ee5-bd83-ed6fb92183d5.key_line_fr: Un jour, il tombe sur une annonce parue le 31 décembre 1941 dans Paris-soir... Modiano va alors s’attacher à lever le mystère de cette disparition
43a9e71b-6800-4ee5-bd83-ed6fb92183d5.key_line_en: One day, he comes across an ad published on December 31, 1941 in Paris-Soir... Modiano then sets out to solve the mystery of this disappearance
43a9e71b-6800-4ee5-bd83-ed6fb92183d5.explanation: The text explains how Patrick Modiano found an old missing person ad which became the inspiration for his novel *Dora Bruder*.
43a9e71b-6800-4ee5-bd83-ed6fb92183d5.breakdown:
1. **Analyze the text structure**: The text starts by introducing a book (*Dora Bruder*). It then describes the author's research habits and a specific event: finding a missing person ad from 1941.
2. **Identify the cause-and-effect**: The finding of the ad ('tombe sur une annonce') leads the author to investigate and write the book ('Modiano va alors s’attacher à lever le mystère').
3. **Evaluate the options**: The text is describing the inspiration or the origin story of the novel. This matches 'explaining the starting idea'. Option A is incorrect because the quote provided is from a newspaper, not Modiano's book. Option C is unrelated to his debut. Option D is factually wrong regarding the content.

d3a93a3d-9860-4468-864d-f631c851d234.text:
VOUS CHERCHEZ UN CONTRAT À DURÉE INDÉTERMINÉE AVEC UN SALAIRE MOTIVANT ET FIXE ?
Dans le cadre du lancement d’une cellule de télévente, la société ADEM recrute 12 télévendeurs confirmés.
Si vous êtes un commercial, si vous êtes dynamique et motivé, contactez-nous : recrutement@ademtel.fr
d3a93a3d-9860-4468-864d-f631c851d234.text_en: ARE YOU LOOKING FOR A PERMANENT CONTRACT WITH A MOTIVATING AND FIXED SALARY? As part of the launch of a telesales unit, the company ADEM is recruiting 12 experienced telemarketers. If you are a salesperson, if you are dynamic and motivated, contact us: recruitment@ademtel.fr
d3a93a3d-9860-4468-864d-f631c851d234.question_fr: La société ADEM recherche des télévendeurs...
d3a93a3d-9860-4468-864d-f631c851d234.question_en: The company ADEM is looking for telemarketers...

options.text: Qui débutent dans le métier de la télévente
options.text_en: Who are starting out in the telesales profession

options.text: Qui ont de l’expérience dans la télévente
options.explanation: The adjective 'confirmés' means established or experienced, matching 'ont de l’expérience'.

options.text: Qui sont intéressés par un salaire modulable
options.text_en: Who are interested in a variable salary
options.explanation: The text explicitly promises a salary that is 'FIXE' (fixed), not modulable.

options.text: Qui recherchent un contrat de courte durée
options.text_en: Who are looking for a short-term contract
options.explanation: The text offers a 'Contrat à Durée Indéterminée' (Permanent Contract), not a short-term one.

d3a93a3d-9860-4468-864d-f631c851d234.key_line_fr: Dans le cadre du lancement d’une cellule de télévente, la société ADEM recrute 12 télévendeurs confirmés.
d3a93a3d-9860-4468-864d-f631c851d234.key_line_en: As part of the launch of a telesales unit, the company ADEM is recruiting 12 experienced telemarketers.
d3a93a3d-9860-4468-864d-f631c851d234.explanation: The advertisement explicitly seeks 'télévendeurs confirmés', which corresponds to candidates who have experience in the field.
d3a93a3d-9860-4468-864d-f631c851d234.breakdown:
