f526a8b1-d3b4-4598-9aea-46a140673f7e.text:
Internet est entré dans les habitudes de consommation et aucun secteur ne semble pouvoir échapper à cette pratique sauf peut-être le milieu pharmaceutique.
Aujourd’hui, les trois quarts des Français déclarent ne pas être prêts à acheter un médicament sur Internet.
Car le médicament n’est pas une simple marchandise, et la personne qui entre dans une pharmacie n’y cherche pas seulement un remède, mais un accompagnement et une assurance à la fois de sécurité et de santé.
f526a8b1-d3b4-4598-9aea-46a140673f7e.text_en: The Internet has entered consumption habits and no sector seems able to escape this practice except perhaps the pharmaceutical environment. Today, three-quarters of French people declare they are not ready to buy medicine on the Internet. Because medicine is not a simple commodity, and the person who enters a pharmacy is not looking only for a remedy there, but guidance and an assurance of both safety and health.
f526a8b1-d3b4-4598-9aea-46a140673f7e.question_fr: Qu’apprend-on sur l’achat de médicaments en ligne ?
f526a8b1-d3b4-4598-9aea-46a140673f7e.question_en: What do we learn about buying medicines online?

options.explanation: The text says the pharmaceutical sector might 'escape' this common practice, meaning it is not common for medicines.
The text discusses the attitude of consumers (French people), not the opinion of pharmacists.
Payment security is not mentioned; the text refers to 'safety and health' assurance.

options.text_en: People are wary of it in France.
options.explanation: Since 75% of the population is 'not ready' to buy online, it confirms that there is significant wariness or mistrust in France.

f526a8b1-d3b4-4598-9aea-46a140673f7e.key_line_fr: Aujourd’hui, les trois quarts des Français déclarent ne pas être prêts à acheter un médicament sur Internet.
f526a8b1-d3b4-4598-9aea-46a140673f7e.key_line_en: Today, three-quarters of French people declare they are not ready to buy medicine on the Internet.
f526a8b1-d3b4-4598-9aea-46a140673f7e.explanation: The text states that 75% of French people are not ready to buy medicine online because they want the safety and guidance of a physical pharmacy, which corresponds to being wary (se méfier).
f526a8b1-d3b4-4598-9aea-46a140673f7e.breakdown:
1. The text states that the Internet affects all sectors 'except perhaps the pharmaceutical environment'.
2. It explicitly provides a statistic: 'three-quarters of French people declare they are not ready to buy medicine on the Internet'.
3. It explains this reluctance by noting that people seek 'guidance' and 'assurance' in physical pharmacies, which implies they do not feel secure buying online.
4. Option D ('People are wary of it') accurately summarizes the statistic that most people are not ready to do it.

4738553d-7f01-4f32-91af-4207355b27bc.text:
Sur la bouteille de sa boisson de jus de fruits bio, un fabricant utilise une belle image d’ananas et de noix de coco.
À lire de plus près, vous apprendrez que « des oranges gorgées de soleil et de bananes » viennent s’associer à l’ananas et à la noix de coco.
Une jolie manière d’expliquer qu’ananas et noix de coco ne représentent que 30% des fruits de la boisson avec d’autres jus plus communs (et moins coûteux).
4738553d-7f01-4f32-91af-4207355b27bc.text_en: On the bottle of his organic fruit juice drink, a manufacturer uses a beautiful image of pineapple and coconut. Reading closer, you will learn that 'sun-drenched oranges and bananas' come to associate themselves with the pineapple and coconut. A pretty way to explain that pineapple and coconut represent only 30% of the fruits in the drink along with other more common (and less expensive) juices.

options.explanation: The added ingredients are oranges and bananas, which are not 'unhealthy' (malsains).
While the text mentions the manufacturer chooses 'less expensive' juices, it does not denounce the price of exotic products itself.
The text focuses specifically on the bottle's packaging, not general advertisements (annonces publicitaires).
The article highlights that the images on the bottle (pineapple/coconut) do not accurately reflect the main ingredients (orange/banana), which constitutes a deceptive label.

4738553d-7f01-4f32-91af-4207355b27bc.key_line_fr: Une jolie manière d’expliquer qu’ananas et noix de coco ne représentent que 30% des fruits de la boisson avec d’autres jus plus communs (et moins coûteux).
4738553d-7f01-4f32-91af-4207355b27bc.key_line_en: A pretty way to explain that pineapple and coconut represent only 30% of the fruits in the drink along with other more common (and less expensive) juices.
4738553d-7f01-4f32-91af-4207355b27bc.explanation: The article criticizes the fact that the manufacturer highlights expensive fruits on the packaging while the product actually consists mostly of cheaper, common fruits.
4738553d-7f01-4f32-91af-4207355b27bc.breakdown:
1. The text describes a fruit juice bottle featuring images of pineapples and coconuts.
2. However, upon reading the label closely ('À lire de plus près'), one discovers the drink actually contains mostly oranges and bananas.
3. It states that the highlighted exotic fruits only make up 30% of the content, while the rest are 'common' and 'less expensive' juices.
4. The text criticizes the discrepancy between the visual presentation on the bottle and the actual contents.
5. Therefore, it denounces 'deceptive labels' (étiquettes trompeuses) rather than health issues, prices, or general advertising.

10b3d902-820b-4e6d-9457-be28c41a257e.text:
Quelle est la principale ressource qui manque aux chercheurs. Le temps ?
« Informatiser les données de l'herbier du Muséum d'histoire naturelle aurait pris cinq cents ans un chercheur »,
explique Marc Pignal, botaniste au Muséum. Le Muséum a donc trouvé une alternative : une plate-forme sur laquelle les internautes sont invités à retranscrire les informations répertoriées sur les étiquettes des plantes et que l'apprenti botaniste, après avoir ouvert un compte, retrouve sur une photo d'une page de l'herbier national.
10b3d902-820b-4e6d-9457-be28c41a257e.text_en: What is the main resource lacking for researchers. Time? "Computerizing the data from the Natural History Museum's herbarium would have taken a researcher five hundred years," explains Marc Pignal, a botanist at the Museum. The Museum therefore found an alternative: a platform on which internet users are invited to transcribe the information listed on plant labels and which the apprentice botanist, after opening an account, finds on a photo of a page from the national herbarium.
10b3d902-820b-4e6d-9457-be28c41a257e.question_fr: Qu'a décidé de faire en ligne le Muséum d'histoire naturelle ?
10b3d902-820b-4e6d-9457-be28c41a257e.question_en: What has the Natural History Museum decided to do online?

options.text: Créer un site collaboratif de données.
options.explanation: The text describes a platform where internet users transcribe data, which constitutes a collaborative data site.

options.text: Mener une enquête sur les plantes.
options.explanation: The text mentions transcribing existing labels, not conducting a survey ('enquête') on plants.
The platform is for data entry, not for organizing physical or virtual visits to the herbarium.
While users act as 'apprentice botanists', the primary goal is data transcription, not providing educational courses.

10b3d902-820b-4e6d-9457-be28c41a257e.key_line_fr: Le Muséum a donc trouvé une alternative : une plate-forme sur laquelle les internautes sont invités à retranscrire les informations répertoriées sur les étiquettes des plantes
10b3d902-820b-4e6d-9457-be28c41a257e.key_line_en: The Museum therefore found an alternative: a platform on which internet users are invited to transcribe the information listed on plant labels
10b3d902-820b-4e6d-9457-be28c41a257e.explanation: The Museum invites internet users to help transcribe plant label data on a platform, which is a collaborative data project.
10b3d902-820b-4e6d-9457-be28c41a257e.breakdown: The text explains that digitizing the herbarium data would take too long for a single researcher. To solve this, the Museum created a platform where internet users ('internautes') are invited to transcribe information from plant labels. This process describes a collaborative effort to manage data online, which matches Option A.

a9804a42-b3f7-4412-a3b6-b7bc7de88f27.text:
Il y a quelque chose de rare dans « Normandie nue » : ce film est résolument léger, tout en ayant du fond.
À travers une histoire qui sert de fil conducteur cocasse et insolite - celle d’un artiste américain qui veut photographier des paysans dévêtus -, « Normandie nue » aborde la crise des éleveurs avec beaucoup d’humanité, notamment grâce au maire du village qui voit dans la venue du photographe l’occasion de faire valoir sa cause aux yeux de la planète.
Parfois un peu maladroite, cette comédie amuse en caricaturant gentiment les médias, les artistes et les bobos parisiens en mal de verdure.
a9804a42-b3f7-4412-a3b6-b7bc7de88f27.text_en: There is something rare in 'Normandie nue': this film is resolutely light, while having substance. Through a story that serves as a comical and unusual common thread - that of an American artist who wants to photograph undressed peasants -, 'Normandie nue' approaches the livestock farmers' crisis with a lot of humanity, notably thanks to the village mayor who sees in the photographer's arrival the opportunity to promote his cause in the eyes of the planet. Sometimes a bit clumsy, this comedy amuses by gently caricaturing the media, artists, and Parisian bobos in need of greenery.
a9804a42-b3f7-4412-a3b6-b7bc7de88f27.question_fr: Quelle est l’opinion du journaliste sur le film « Normandie nue » ?
a9804a42-b3f7-4412-a3b6-b7bc7de88f27.question_en: What is the journalist's opinion on the film 'Normandie nue'?

options.text: Il est facile de s’identifier aux personnages.
options.text_en: It is easy to identify with the characters.
options.explanation: The text mentions the film treats characters with 'humanity', but does not explicitly claim that the audience easily identifies with them.

options.text: Les lieux de tournage sont authentiques.
options.explanation: The text describes the setting and plot, but does not evaluate the authenticity of the filming locations.

options.text: On y dresse un portrait juste de la société.
options.text_en: A fair portrait of society is drawn there.
options.explanation: The text states the film uses 'caricature' (exaggeration) for certain groups, which contradicts the idea of a strictly 'fair' or accurate portrait of society.

options.text: Son humour fait passer un message sérieux.
options.text_en: Its humor conveys a serious message.
options.explanation: This paraphrases the core critique: the film is 'light' (humor) yet addresses the 'farmers' crisis' (serious message).

a9804a42-b3f7-4412-a3b6-b7bc7de88f27.key_line_fr: ce film est résolument léger, tout en ayant du fond.
a9804a42-b3f7-4412-a3b6-b7bc7de88f27.key_line_en: this film is resolutely light, while having substance.
a9804a42-b3f7-4412-a3b6-b7bc7de88f27.explanation: The review explicitly states the film is lighthearted yet possesses depth, using a funny storyline to address the serious crisis of livestock farmers.
a9804a42-b3f7-4412-a3b6-b7bc7de88f27.breakdown:
1. The text begins by describing the film as 'résolument léger' (resolutely light) but 'ayant du fond' (having depth/substance).
2. It explains that the plot is 'cocasse' (comical) but addresses a serious issue: 'la crise des éleveurs' (the livestock farmers' crisis).
3. This combination of comedy and a serious societal issue aligns with the idea that the film uses humor to deliver a meaningful message.
4. Option D perfectly summarizes this duality (Humor conveys a serious message).

2316d60d-3fb5-4bec-9989-06579e0020ef.text:
Le PDG de la société SEB a avoué « ne plus espérer avoir une croissance importante » sur les marchés occidentaux, arrivés à saturation.
Lui qui a toujours défendu la valeur ajoutée et le savoir-faire des usines tricolores n’a pas pu faire face à l’arrivée des pays émergents dans le petit électroménager : 80% des grille-pains vendus en France coûtent désormais moins de 30 €.
Résultat, les ventes de l’inventeur de la cocotte-minute ont reculé de 5.6% en France et de 2.6% dans les autres pays de l’Union européenne.
2316d60d-3fb5-4bec-9989-06579e0020ef.text_en: The CEO of the SEB company admitted 'no longer hoping for significant growth' in Western markets, which have reached saturation. He, who has always defended the added value and know-how of French factories, could not cope with the arrival of emerging countries in the small appliance sector: 80% of toasters sold in France now cost less than €30. As a result, sales for the inventor of the pressure cooker fell by 5.6% in France and 2.6% in other European Union countries.
2316d60d-3fb5-4bec-9989-06579e0020ef.question_fr: Que regrette le PDG de la société SEB ?
2316d60d-3fb5-4bec-9989-06579e0020ef.question_en: What does the CEO of the SEB company regret?

options.text: La faible qualité de la production française.
options.text_en: The low quality of French production.
options.explanation: The text states the CEO defends the 'know-how of French factories' (savoir-faire des usines tricolores), implying he believes the quality is high, not low.

options.text: Le manque d’innovation dans son entreprise.
options.text_en: The lack of innovation in his company.
options.explanation: The text attributes the problem to 'market saturation' and 'emerging countries,' not a lack of internal innovation.
There is no mention of financial controls or audits in the passage.
The phrase 'arrival of emerging countries' (arrivée des pays émergents) directly refers to the expansion of international competition, which is cited as the cause for sales declining.

2316d60d-3fb5-4bec-9989-06579e0020ef.key_line_fr: Lui qui a toujours défendu la valeur ajoutée et le savoir-faire des usines tricolores n’a pas pu faire face à l’arrivée des pays émergents dans le petit électroménager
2316d60d-3fb5-4bec-9989-06579e0020ef.key_line_en: He, who has always defended the added value and know-how of French factories, could not cope with the arrival of emerging countries in the small appliance sector
2316d60d-3fb5-4bec-9989-06579e0020ef.explanation: The CEO is concerned about competitors from emerging countries entering the market with cheaper products, which corresponds to the expansion of international competition.
2316d60d-3fb5-4bec-9989-06579e0020ef.breakdown:
1.  **Analyze the text**: The text states that the CEO defended French expertise ('savoir-faire des usines tricolores') but 'could not cope with the arrival of emerging countries' ('n’a pas pu faire face à l’arrivée des pays émergents').
2.  **Analyze the options**: 
    *   Option A claims he regrets low French quality, but the text says he defends French expertise.
    *   Option B suggests a lack of innovation, but the text focuses on market conditions and competitors.
    *   Option C mentions financial controls, which are not discussed.
    *   Option D mentions international competition. 'Pays émergents' (emerging countries) entering the market corresponds directly to international competition.
3.  **Conclusion**: The CEO regrets the impact of new competitors from emerging countries.

6686526b-1c99-45e6-91dd-342a320207d6.text:
Lors de l’inscription à la faculté de médecine de Boston, les professeurs privilégient les candidats… ayant déjà connu des échecs.
Ils considèrent en effet que ces erreurs d’orientation permettent de grandir plus vite, de se rapprocher plus rapidement de sa vocation – bref, de mieux se connaître.
Plus simplement, ils réduisent aussi le risque de recruter des élèves qui vont se rendre compte au bout de quelques mois qu’ils ne veulent plus devenir médecins : ils ont déjà changé de voie une fois, il est moins probable qu’ils en changent une seconde fois.
6686526b-1c99-45e6-91dd-342a320207d6.text_en: When enrolling at the Boston medical faculty, professors favor candidates... who have already experienced failures. They consider that these orientation errors allow one to grow faster, to get closer to one's vocation more quickly – in short, to know oneself better. More simply, they also reduce the risk of recruiting students who will realize after a few months that they no longer want to become doctors: they have already changed paths once, it is less likely that they will change a second time.
6686526b-1c99-45e6-91dd-342a320207d6.question_fr: Pourquoi les candidates qui se réorientent sont-ils privilégiés dans cette faculté ?
6686526b-1c99-45e6-91dd-342a320207d6.question_en: Why are candidates who reorient themselves favored in this faculty?

options.text: Ils ont plus de facilités d’apprentissage.
options.explanation: The text mentions they 'grow faster' or 'know themselves better,' but does not mention that they learn academic material more easily.

options.text: Ils ont une idée claire de leur futur métier.
options.text_en: They have a clear idea of their future job.
options.explanation: While the text mentions getting closer to their 'vocation,' the primary practical reason given for the preference is the reduced risk of changing paths again, which points more strongly to the certainty of the choice (Option D) rather than just having a clear idea of the job itself.

options.text: Ils sont déterminés à travailler beaucoup.
options.text_en: They are determined to work a lot.
options.explanation: Hard work or determination to work a lot is not mentioned in the text.

options.text: Ils sont plus sûrs de leur nouveau choix.
options.text_en: They are more sure of their new choice.
options.explanation: The text states that since they have already changed paths once, they are less likely to do so again. This implies they are more certain about their decision to become doctors compared to others who might quit after a few months.

6686526b-1c99-45e6-91dd-342a320207d6.key_line_fr: ils ont déjà changé de voie une fois, il est moins probable qu’ils en changent une seconde fois.
6686526b-1c99-45e6-91dd-342a320207d6.key_line_en: they have already changed paths once, it is less likely that they will change a second time.
6686526b-1c99-45e6-91dd-342a320207d6.explanation: The text argues that students who have already reoriented are less of a recruitment risk because they are unlikely to change their minds a second time, making them more sure of their current choice.
6686526b-1c99-45e6-91dd-342a320207d6.breakdown:
1. **Analyze the text**: The text explains that professors at Boston's medical school prefer candidates who have already experienced failure or changed paths.
2. **Identify the reasons**: The text offers two main reasons. First, these students know themselves better. Second, and more practically ('Plus simplement'), they reduce the risk of dropping out.
3. **Focus on the key argument**: The text explicitly states, 'they have already changed paths once, it is less likely that they will change a second time' ('il est moins probable qu’ils en changent une seconde fois').
4. **Evaluate Option D**: Being 'less likely to change' implies a higher degree of certainty and stability regarding their current decision. Therefore, they are 'more sure of their new choice.'

4b5db826-391d-40e0-80b6-4fa1e04d780b.text:
La rétrospective Mali Twist montre comment, par sa diversité et son éclat, l'œuvre de Malick Sidibé s’inscrit dans le champ contemporain de la photographie.
Tour à tour reporter et portraitiste, Malick Sidibé a construit, depuis l’ouverture de son studio à Bamako en 1962, un ensemble photographique en noir et blanc exceptionnel.
Mali Twist révèle son regard attentif et son talent pour mettre en lumière le meilleur de chacun, sa singularité. Malick Sidibé a fait de la photographie un art de l’échange. S’il a eu pour règle d’or d’embellir ses modèles, il témoigne aussi de la joie de vivre de la jeunesse bamakoise, peu après l’indépendance du Mali.
Entre visages anonymes et corps en mouvement, poseurs élégants et flâneurs, Mali Twist offre plus de 250 photographies.
4b5db826-391d-40e0-80b6-4fa1e04d780b.text_en: The Mali Twist retrospective shows how, through its diversity and brilliance, Malick Sidibé's work fits into the contemporary field of photography. Alternately reporter and portraitist, Malick Sidibé has built, since opening his studio in Bamako in 1962, an exceptional collection of black and white photography. Mali Twist reveals his attentive gaze and his talent for highlighting the best in everyone, their uniqueness. Malick Sidibé made photography an art of exchange. While his golden rule was to beautify his models, he also testifies to the joy of living of Bamako's youth, shortly after Mali's independence. Between anonymous faces and bodies in motion, elegant posers and strollers, Mali Twist offers more than 250 photographs.
4b5db826-391d-40e0-80b6-4fa1e04d780b.question_fr: Sur quoi repose le travail photographique de Malick Sidibé ?
4b5db826-391d-40e0-80b6-4fa1e04d780b.question_en: What is Malick Sidibé's photographic work based on?

options.explanation: The text mentions the historical context of independence, but the focus of the work is on the 'joy of living' and portraits, not political activism.
The work focuses on portraits, faces, and bodies in motion, which are concrete subjects, not abstract contemplation.

options.text: Une mise en valeur de l’autre.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states he had a talent for 'highlighting the best in everyone' and a rule to 'beautify his models,' which corresponds to valuing/highlighting the other.
The 'beautification' mentioned refers to his artistic perspective and the 'art of exchange,' not specifically to a technical method of photo retouching.

4b5db826-391d-40e0-80b6-4fa1e04d780b.key_line_fr: Mali Twist révèle son regard attentif et son talent pour mettre en lumière le meilleur de chacun, sa singularité.
4b5db826-391d-40e0-80b6-4fa1e04d780b.key_line_en: Mali Twist reveals his attentive gaze and his talent for highlighting the best in everyone, their uniqueness.
4b5db826-391d-40e0-80b6-4fa1e04d780b.explanation: The text emphasizes Sidibé's talent for highlighting the best in people and beautifying his models, which aligns with the concept of valuing the other (Option C).
4b5db826-391d-40e0-80b6-4fa1e04d780b.breakdown:
1. Scan the text for Malick Sidibé's artistic approach or philosophy.
2. The text states: 'son talent pour mettre en lumière le meilleur de chacun' (his talent for highlighting the best in everyone) and 'embellir ses modèles' (beautifying his models).
3. It also calls photography 'un art de l’échange' (an art of exchange).
4. Compare this with the options:
   - Option A mentions politics. Although 'independence' is mentioned as a timeline, the work itself focuses on 'joy of living', not political action.
   - Option B suggests abstraction, but the work involves 'faces', 'bodies', and 'portraits', which are concrete.
   - Option D suggests technical retouching. While he 'beautifies', the text attributes this to his 'gaze' and 'talent', not technical editing.
   - Option C ('mise en valeur de l’autre') perfectly paraphrases 'highlighting the best in everyone'.

913257a6-b881-4d6d-89a4-a7b2ea598919.text:
Dixième anniversaire du musée de l’Europe
Il y a maintenant près de dix ans, le musée de l’Europe n’était encore qu’un projet lancé par un petit groupe d’historiens et de promoteurs culturels issus de la société civile. Avec pour ambition de faire découvrir aux Européens les racines de leur civilisation commune.
Installé dans la ville de Bruxelles, siège des institutions européennes, celui-ci sera le « lieu de mémoire » dont l’Europe a besoin. C’est là que le parcours permanent et les expositions temporaires offriront à tous les Européens (et à leurs hôtes) une histoire raisonnée de l’union, entendue comme une civilisation diverse mais unique.
913257a6-b881-4d6d-89a4-a7b2ea598919.text_en: Nearly ten years ago now, the Museum of Europe was still only a project launched by a small group of historians and cultural promoters from civil society. With the ambition of revealing to Europeans the roots of their common civilization. Located in the city of Brussels, seat of European institutions, this will be the 'place of memory' that Europe needs. It is there that the permanent tour and temporary exhibitions will offer all Europeans (and their guests) a reasoned history of the union, understood as a diverse but unique civilization.
913257a6-b881-4d6d-89a4-a7b2ea598919.question_fr: Quelles sont les personnes à l’origine de ce projet ?
913257a6-b881-4d6d-89a4-a7b2ea598919.question_en: Who are the people behind this project?

options.explanation: The text mentions historians and cultural promoters, but does not specifically identify them as professional museum curators (conservateurs).
The text specifies they are from 'civil society,' which generally excludes elected officials (élus) or government representatives.
The phrase 'issus de la société civile' refers to private individuals or ordinary citizens acting independently of the state.
While they are 'promoters,' the term 'militants' (activists) implies a political struggle or activism that is not explicitly supported by the text.

913257a6-b881-4d6d-89a4-a7b2ea598919.key_line_fr: ...un petit groupe d’historiens et de promoteurs culturels issus de la société civile.
913257a6-b881-4d6d-89a4-a7b2ea598919.key_line_en: ...a small group of historians and cultural promoters from civil society.
913257a6-b881-4d6d-89a4-a7b2ea598919.explanation: The text specifies the project was launched by people from 'civil society,' which corresponds to ordinary private citizens rather than officials or specific professionals.
913257a6-b881-4d6d-89a4-a7b2ea598919.breakdown:
1. The question asks who started the project (Quelles sont les personnes à l’origine de ce projet ?).
2. Scan the text for keywords like 'projet lancé par' (project launched by).
3. The text states: '...projet lancé par un petit groupe d’historiens et de promoteurs culturels issus de la société civile' (project launched by a small group of historians and cultural promoters from civil society).
4. The phrase 'issus de la société civile' (from civil society) indicates they are private individuals, distinct from government officials or state institutions.
5. Option C, 'De simples citoyens' (Simple/Ordinary citizens), is the synonym used in TCF contexts for people from civil society.

c280bfaf-5c75-4bcf-9329-48153b413cde.text:
La désillusion de la jeunesse française d’aujourd’hui est un fait préoccupant. Elle est surtout due à la crise internationale, qui réduit les offres d’emploi, fait pression sur les salaires et raréfie les possibilités de promotion.
Mais on peut également l’attribuer à un conflit de génération larvé : il oppose la classe d’âge des « baby-boomers », devenus aujourd’hui « papy-boomers » triomphants tout au long de leurs parcours, à celle de leurs enfants et maintenant de leurs petits-enfants.
c280bfaf-5c75-4bcf-9329-48153b413cde.text_en: The disillusionment of today's French youth is a worrying fact. It is mainly due to the international crisis, which reduces job offers, puts pressure on employees, and makes promotion opportunities scarce. But it can also be attributed to a latent generational conflict: it opposes the age group of 'baby boomers,' who have become today's triumphant 'grandpa boomers' throughout their careers, to that of their children and now their grandchildren.
c280bfaf-5c75-4bcf-9329-48153b413cde.question_fr: D’où vient la désillusion des jeunes en France ?
c280bfaf-5c75-4bcf-9329-48153b413cde.question_en: Where does the disillusionment of young people in France come from?

options.text: De la concurrence des autres générations.
options.explanation: The text mentions a 'generational conflict' (conflit de génération), but this is cited as a secondary reason ('également'), whereas the economic crisis is the main reason ('surtout'). Furthermore, 'concurrence' (competition) is not exactly the same as the 'conflit' described.

options.text: De la course à la compétitive.
options.explanation: The text mentions pressure on employees, but does not attribute the disillusionment specifically to a 'race for competitiveness'.
This option summarizes the phrase 'crise internationale' (international crisis) found in the text, which is identified as the main cause of the disillusionment.

options.text: Des critiques émanant de leurs parents.
options.text_en: From criticisms coming from their parents.
options.explanation: The text describes a conflict between age groups ('baby-boomers' vs their children), but does not mention specific 'criticisms' (critiques) coming from parents.

c280bfaf-5c75-4bcf-9329-48153b413cde.key_line_fr: Elle est surtout due à la crise internationale, qui réduit les offres d’emploi, fait pression sur les salariés et raréfie les possibilités de promotion.
c280bfaf-5c75-4bcf-9329-48153b413cde.key_line_en: It is mainly due to the international crisis, which reduces job offers, puts pressure on employees, and makes promotion opportunities scarce.
c280bfaf-5c75-4bcf-9329-48153b413cde.explanation: The text explicitly states that the disillusionment is 'mainly due to the international crisis,' which corresponds to a tense economic situation.
c280bfaf-5c75-4bcf-9329-48153b413cde.breakdown:
1. The text identifies the subject: 'La désillusion de la jeunesse française' (The disillusionment of French youth).
2. It explicitly states the primary cause: 'Elle est surtout due à la crise internationale' (It is mainly due to the international crisis).
3. It details the effects of this crisis: 'réduit les offres d’emploi' (reduces job offers), 'pression sur les salariés' (pressure on employees).
4. Compare with Option C: 'Situation économique tendue' (Tense economic situation) is a direct paraphrase of 'crise internationale'.
5. While a generational conflict is mentioned later ('également' - also), the economic crisis is cited as the main reason ('surtout').

5a47f5f5-c12b-487b-90f0-58e25c6661e0.text:
Les implants médicaux (prothèses mammaires, de hanche, etc.) sont censés vous améliorer la vie. Mais des lacunes dans leur contrôle seraient à l’origine d’incidents en nombre croissant. C’est ce que révèle la dernière enquête du Consortium international des journalistes d’investigation.
On y apprend que, en France, le nombre d’incidents liés à ces implants aurait doublé en dix ans. Le problème, souligne l’enquête, c’est que les informations sur les patients restent globalement très incomplètes et leurs données sont souvent confidentielles. Il est donc difficile de dénombrer avec précision le modèle des implants posés, et de retrouver les patients en cas de problème.
5a47f5f5-c12b-487b-90f0-58e25c6661e0.text_en: Medical implants (breast prostheses, hip replacements, etc.) are supposed to improve your life. But gaps in their control are reportedly the cause of an increasing number of incidents. This is what the latest investigation by the International Consortium of Investigative Journalists reveals. We learn therein that, in France, the number of incidents linked to these implants has reportedly doubled in ten years. The problem, emphasizes the investigation, is that information on patients remains globally very incomplete and their data is often confidential. It is therefore difficult to precisely count the model of implants installed, and to find the patients in case of a problem.
5a47f5f5-c12b-487b-90f0-58e25c6661e0.question_fr: Quel problème révèle cet article à propos des implants médicaux ?
5a47f5f5-c12b-487b-90f0-58e25c6661e0.question_en: What problem does this article reveal regarding medical implants?

options.text: Les données des malades sont transmises aux fabricants.
options.text_en: Patient data is transmitted to manufacturers.
options.explanation: The text states data is 'confidential' and 'incomplete', not that it is sent to manufacturers.

options.text: Les incidents dus aux erreurs de diagnostic augmentent.
options.text_en: Incidents due to diagnostic errors are increasing.
options.explanation: The text mentions incidents due to 'gaps in control' of implants, not 'diagnostic errors'.

options.text: Les patients se méfient des innovations technologiques.
options.text_en: Patients are wary of technological innovations.
options.explanation: There is no mention of patients' feelings or mistrust toward innovation in the text.

options.text: Les recherches sont limitées par le manque d’informations.
options.text_en: Research is limited by the lack of information.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states that incomplete and confidential data makes it difficult to track models or find patients (limiting investigation/research).

5a47f5f5-c12b-487b-90f0-58e25c6661e0.key_line_fr: Le problème, souligne l’enquête, c’est que les informations sur les patients restent globalement très incomplètes et leurs données sont souvent confidentielles.
5a47f5f5-c12b-487b-90f0-58e25c6661e0.key_line_en: The problem, emphasizes the investigation, is that information on patients remains globally very incomplete and their data is often confidential.
5a47f5f5-c12b-487b-90f0-58e25c6661e0.explanation: The article highlights that patient data is incomplete and confidential, which prevents accurate tracking and investigation of implant issues.
5a47f5f5-c12b-487b-90f0-58e25c6661e0.breakdown:
1. The text discusses rising incidents related to medical implants.
2. It identifies the core issue: 'information on patients remains globally very incomplete'.
3. It states the consequence: 'It is therefore difficult to precisely count... and to find the patients'.
4. Option D paraphrases this by stating that research (tracking/investigation) is limited by the lack of information.

1c46a1a4-6ab6-4f4b-acc4-5ba89974201e.text:
Quarante terrains de football.
C’est la superficie que les forêts perdent chaque minute à travers le monde.
La destruction de la forêt tropicale provoque chaque année plus de rejets dans l’atmosphère que l’ensemble du secteur des transports.
L’imaginaire collectif rendrait volontiers le commerce du bois principal responsable de la déforestation, alors qu’il n’en est rien.
L’acteur majeur de ce phénomène est l’agriculture, responsable à 80% des déboisements dans les zones tropicales.
Le marché illégal du bois a aussi sa part de responsabilité.
Il est un facteur déclenchant et s’alimente des autres activités.
Quelque 1.6 milliard d’habitants dépendent directement des forêts, et contribuent pourtant à leur raréfaction, voire à leur disparition.
1c46a1a4-6ab6-4f4b-acc4-5ba89974201e.text_en: Forty football fields. That is the surface area that forests lose every minute across the world. The destruction of the tropical forest causes more emissions into the atmosphere each year than the entire transport sector. The collective imagination would willingly make the timber trade the main culprit of deforestation, whereas this is not the case. The major actor in this phenomenon is agriculture, responsible for 80% of deforestation in tropical zones. The illegal timber market also shares some responsibility. It is a triggering factor and feeds on other activities. Some 1.6 billion inhabitants depend directly on forests, yet contribute to their scarcity, or even their disappearance.
1c46a1a4-6ab6-4f4b-acc4-5ba89974201e.question_fr: Selon cet article, sur quoi la déforestation a-t-elle un impact ?
1c46a1a4-6ab6-4f4b-acc4-5ba89974201e.question_en: According to this article, what does deforestation impact?

options.explanation: The text mentions the timber trade as a perceived cause, not as an industry impacted by deforestation.

options.text: Sur la démographie dans ces zones.
options.text_en: On the demography in these areas.
options.explanation: While the text mentions that 1.6 billion people depend on forests, it does not discuss the impact on demography (population statistics) itself.
The text explicitly states that forest destruction causes massive emissions ('rejets') into the atmosphere, linking it directly to atmospheric pollution.

options.text: Sur la progression des cultures tropicales.
options.text_en: On the progression of tropical crops.
options.explanation: Agriculture is identified as the *cause* (80%) of deforestation, not as the result or impact of it described in the text.

1c46a1a4-6ab6-4f4b-acc4-5ba89974201e.key_line_fr: La destruction de la forêt tropicale provoque chaque année plus de rejets dans l’atmosphère que l’ensemble du secteur des transports.
1c46a1a4-6ab6-4f4b-acc4-5ba89974201e.key_line_en: The destruction of the tropical forest causes more emissions into the atmosphere each year than the entire transport sector.
1c46a1a4-6ab6-4f4b-acc4-5ba89974201e.explanation: The article explicitly compares the emissions caused by forest destruction to those of the transport sector, highlighting its impact on the atmosphere.
1c46a1a4-6ab6-4f4b-acc4-5ba89974201e.breakdown: The text discusses the consequences of deforestation. Specifically, the third sentence states: 'La destruction de la forêt tropicale provoque chaque année plus de rejets dans l’atmosphère que l’ensemble du secteur des transports' (The destruction of the tropical forest causes more emissions into the atmosphere each year than the entire transport sector). The phrase 'rejets dans l’atmosphère' (emissions into the atmosphere) directly refers to atmospheric pollution. Therefore, the text indicates that deforestation has a significant impact on pollution.

36da3092-a57f-4ff0-b12b-c87e03c4ceec.text:
Salé, sucré, acide, amer : quatre termes - tels les points cardinaux - qui définissent le territoire d’expression du goût.
Nous serions en droit de penser que c’est un peu court pour dépeindre toutes les nuances de la palette aromatique et les émotions qu’elle suscite.
Les Japonais y ont d’ailleurs ajouté la notion d’umami, cette saveur qui littéralement signifie « goût délicieux », enrobante, qui tapisse le palais, très addictive.
Dans l’imaginaire collectif, le sucre évoque douceur, gourmandise, réconfort.
L’on peut cependant imaginer une douceur à la lecture moins immédiate que celle apportée par le sucre, une douceur qui soit synonyme de complexité aromatique, qui joue sur les notes amères, piquantes ou acidulées.
36da3092-a57f-4ff0-b12b-c87e03c4ceec.text_en: Salty, sweet, acidic, bitter: four terms - like the cardinal points - that define the territory of taste expression. We would be right to think that it is a bit short to depict all the nuances of the aromatic palette and the emotions it arouses. The Japanese have also added the notion of umami, this flavor which literally means 'delicious taste', coating, which lines the palate, very addictive. In the collective imagination, sugar evokes sweetness, indulgence, comfort. However, one can imagine a sweetness that is less immediately readable than that brought by sugar, a sweetness that is synonymous with aromatic complexity, which plays on bitter, spicy, or tangy notes.
36da3092-a57f-4ff0-b12b-c87e03c4ceec.question_en: What problem does this article raise?

options.text_en: The addiction related to certain foods.
options.explanation: The word 'addictive' is used to describe umami, but addiction itself is not the central problem discussed in the article.
The article discusses the complexity and variety of tastes, not their standardization or uniformity.

options.text: La difficulté à décrire les saveurs.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states that the four standard terms are insufficient ('un peu court') to describe ('dépeindre') the full range of flavors.
The text implies there are too few terms (only four initially), rather than a problem of there being too many.

36da3092-a57f-4ff0-b12b-c87e03c4ceec.key_line_fr: Nous serions en droit de penser que c’est un peu court pour dépeindre toutes les nuances de la palette aromatique et les émotions qu’elle suscite.
36da3092-a57f-4ff0-b12b-c87e03c4ceec.key_line_en: We would be right to think that it is a bit short to depict all the nuances of the aromatic palette and the emotions it arouses.
36da3092-a57f-4ff0-b12b-c87e03c4ceec.explanation: The article argues that the four basic words used to define taste are insufficient to capture the full complexity and nuances of flavors.
36da3092-a57f-4ff0-b12b-c87e03c4ceec.breakdown: The text begins by listing the four traditional terms for taste (salty, sweet, acidic, bitter). Immediately after, it challenges this classification by stating that it is 'a bit short' (insufficient) to 'depict all the nuances' of the aromatic palette. While it mentions 'umami' and the addictive nature of certain flavors, the central argument is about the limitation of language and categories to fully capture the complexity of taste experiences.

032a01c9-f8a2-4953-bab4-4635e94fef7e.text:
Dans le monde de l’entreprise, les jeunes et les seniors éprouvent des sentiments analogues d’éviction et de dévalorisation.
Pourtant, des actions de mentorat, menées par des seniors pour guider les jeunes sur le marché du travail ou lors de la création de leur entreprise, existent depuis de nombreuses années.
Plus étonnant, est apparu récemment le mentorat renversé, où les jeunes habitués aux outils numériques initient les seniors à leur usage.
Les seniors y gagnent de nouvelles compétences, et les jeunes élargissent leur réseau.
En période de crise, cette coopération peut constituer un moyen de désamorcer les tensions sociales.
Favoriser les échanges intergénérationnels, c’est contribuer à établir des relations où chacun prend conscience qu’il peut apporter quelque chose à l’autre.
032a01c9-f8a2-4953-bab4-4635e94fef7e.text_en: In the corporate world, young people and seniors experience similar feelings of exclusion and devaluation. However, mentoring actions, led by seniors to guide young people in the labor market or during the creation of their business, have existed for many years. More surprisingly, reverse mentoring has recently appeared, where young people accustomed to digital tools introduce seniors to their use. Seniors gain new skills, and young people expand their network. In times of crisis, this cooperation can constitute a means of defusing social tensions. Encouraging intergenerational exchanges means contributing to establishing relationships where everyone realizes that they can contribute something to the other.
032a01c9-f8a2-4953-bab4-4635e94fef7e.question_fr: Quel est l’intérêt des mentorats décrits ?
032a01c9-f8a2-4953-bab4-4635e94fef7e.question_en: What is the interest of the described mentorships?

options.explanation: The text mentions guiding youth in the job market, but creating 'new sources of employment' is not the primary goal described, nor does it cover the benefit for seniors.

options.text: Éviter la solitude des personnes âgées.
options.text_en: Avoid the loneliness of the elderly.
options.explanation: Loneliness is not mentioned in the text; the focus is on professional exclusion and skills.
The text describes a mutual exchange (experience vs. digital skills) and concludes that everyone contributes to the other, which defines reciprocity.

options.text: Répondre à l’allongement de la durée de vie.
options.text_en: Respond to the lengthening of life expectancy.
options.explanation: Life expectancy is not discussed in the passage.

032a01c9-f8a2-4953-bab4-4635e94fef7e.key_line_fr: Favoriser les échanges intergénérationnels, c’est contribuer à établir des relations où chacun prend conscience qu’il peut apporter quelque chose à l’autre.
032a01c9-f8a2-4953-bab4-4635e94fef7e.key_line_en: Encouraging intergenerational exchanges means contributing to establishing relationships where everyone realizes that they can contribute something to the other.
032a01c9-f8a2-4953-bab4-4635e94fef7e.explanation: The text describes a two-way exchange where both seniors and youth help each other, creating a reciprocal relationship.
032a01c9-f8a2-4953-bab4-4635e94fef7e.breakdown:
1. The text introduces two types of mentorship: traditional (seniors guiding youth) and 'reverse mentorship' (youth teaching seniors digital tools).
2. It highlights the benefits for both sides: seniors gain new skills, and youth expand their networks.
3. The concluding sentence explicitly states that these exchanges establish relationships where 'everyone realizes that they can contribute something to the other'.
4. This mutual contribution perfectly matches the definition of 'reciprocity' found in option C.

76c99651-249b-4bf3-ae8a-60a76e0231bf.text:
Planter sur la réforme des rythmes scolaires, comme le fera la « conférence » installée aujourd’hui par le ministre de l’Éducation, c’est prendre en compte toute une série de paramètres qui n’ont rien à voir, ou si peu, avec l’école primaire.
C’est s’intéresser aux évolutions de la famille et à la multiplication des horaires de travail dits « atypiques ».
C’est examiner, du point de vue des collectivités locales, les conséquences financières et pratiques (transport scolaire, cantine, centres de loisirs) de tout changement éventuel dans l’organisation de la semaine.
C’est encore recueillir l’avis des experts de la circulation routière et entendre les préoccupations des professionnels du tourisme.
Autant dire que l’intérêt de l’enfant se trouve plus ou moins sacrifié sur l’autel du compromis.
76c99651-249b-4bf3-ae8a-60a76e0231bf.text_en:
To work on the reform of school rhythms, as the 'conference' set up today by the Minister of Education will do, is to take into account a whole series of parameters that have nothing, or very little, to do with primary school.
It means looking at changes in the family and the increase in so-called 'atypical' working hours.
It means examining, from the point of view of local authorities, the financial and practical consequences (school transport, canteen, leisure centers) of any possible change in the organization of the week.
It means also gathering the opinion of road traffic experts and hearing the concerns of tourism professionals.
Suffice it to say that the child's interest is more or less sacrificed on the altar of compromise.
76c99651-249b-4bf3-ae8a-60a76e0231bf.question_fr: Quel constat dresse le journaliste à propos de la réforme des rythmes scolaires ?
76c99651-249b-4bf3-ae8a-60a76e0231bf.question_en: What observation does the journalist make regarding the reform of school rhythms?

options.text: Les familles sont opposées à toute modification.
options.text_en: Families are opposed to any modification.
options.explanation: The text mentions the 'evolution of the family' and working hours, but does not state that families oppose the changes.
The text mentions that financial consequences must be examined, but does not claim they are insurmountable (impossible to overcome).

options.text: Les intérêts en jeu sont difficilement compatibles.
options.text_en: The interests at stake are difficult to make compatible.
options.explanation: The text lists multiple diverging constraints (work schedules, tourism, local budgets) and concludes that a 'compromise' sacrifices the child's interest, implying these interests clash.

options.text: Les opinions des experts sont en total désaccord.
options.text_en: The opinions of experts are in total disagreement.
options.explanation: The text mentions gathering opinions from experts (traffic), but does not say the experts disagree with one another.

76c99651-249b-4bf3-ae8a-60a76e0231bf.key_line_fr: Autant dire que l’intérêt de l’enfant se trouve plus ou moins sacrifié sur l’autel du compromis.
76c99651-249b-4bf3-ae8a-60a76e0231bf.key_line_en: Suffice it to say that the child's interest is more or less sacrificed on the altar of compromise.
76c99651-249b-4bf3-ae8a-60a76e0231bf.explanation: The journalist argues that because the reform must satisfy so many different groups (tourism, local government, parents' work), the interests clash, resulting in a compromise that neglects the child.
76c99651-249b-4bf3-ae8a-60a76e0231bf.breakdown:
The text describes the school rhythm reform as a complex issue involving many factors unrelated to education itself. cbde88bb-3f2d-4567-b761-c8781afcaccd.text:
Une exposition de l’Institut d’Art Contemporain de Villeurbanne est consacrée à l’Américain Jimmie Durham et à la Brésilienne Marie Thereza Alves.
Depuis vingt ans, ils parcourent, au fil de leurs déplacements, le territoire méditerranéen et sont réunis au sein de cette exposition à la forme inédite.
Le parcours se veut éloigné de tout didactisme, laissant assez d’espace au spectateur pour construire son propre récit autour d’une mer connue pour être le berceau fertile des civilisations.
Dans un jeu de matières, de couleurs et d’objets, tous tangibles. Durham et Alves tentent de décrypter une certaine pensée historique et mythologique, notamment en déjouant les codes classiques utilisés dans les musées.
cbde88bb-3f2d-4567-b761-c8781afcaccd.text_en: An exhibition at the Institute of Contemporary Art in Villeurbanne is dedicated to the American Jimmie Durham and the Brazilian Marie Thereza Alves. For twenty years, they have traveled across the Mediterranean territory during their trips and are reunited in this exhibition with an unprecedented form. The path aims to be far from any didacticism, leaving enough space for the spectator to construct their own narrative around a sea known to be the fertile cradle of civilizations. In a play of materials, colors, and tangible objects, Durham and Alves attempt to decipher a certain historical and mythological thought, notably by thwarting the classic codes used in museums.
cbde88bb-3f2d-4567-b761-c8781afcaccd.question_fr: Qu’est-ce qui fait la singularité de cette exposition ?

options.explanation: The text states the exhibition leaves 'enough space for the spectator to construct their own narrative,' which corresponds to giving freedom to the visitors.
The text mentions a 'play of materials, colors, and objects,' but does not describe the means as 'simple'.
The text explicitly states the artists are 'déjouant les codes classiques' (thwarting/bypassing classic codes), meaning it is not classic in presentation.

options.text_en: The political discourse of the visual artists.
options.explanation: The text mentions deciphering 'historical and mythological thought,' not political discourse.

cbde88bb-3f2d-4567-b761-c8781afcaccd.key_line_fr: Le parcours se veut éloigné de tout didactisme, laissant assez d’espace au spectateur pour construire son propre récit autour d’une mer connue pour être le berceau fertile des civilisations.
cbde88bb-3f2d-4567-b761-c8781afcaccd.key_line_en: The path aims to be far from any didacticism, leaving enough space for the spectator to construct their own narrative around a sea known to be the fertile cradle of civilizations.
cbde88bb-3f2d-4567-b761-c8781afcaccd.explanation: The exhibition is unique because it avoids being didactic (instructive), instead allowing visitors the freedom to interpret and create their own stories.

Scanning the text for descriptions of the exhibition's style, we find: 'Le parcours se veut éloigné de tout didactisme' (The path aims to be far from any didacticism) and 'laissant assez d’espace au spectateur pour construire son propre récit' (leaving enough space for the spectator to construct their own narrative).
3.  This indicates that the viewer is active and free to interpret, rather than being taught a specific lesson.
4.  Option A ('The freedom granted to visitors') perfectly matches the idea of the spectator constructing their own narrative.
5.  Option C is explicitly contradicted by the text ('déjouant les codes classiques').

5c13058b-5c82-4ef9-83ba-f1760cf0daa5.text:
Je suis persuadée que tous les enfants possèdent en eux la volonté de mettre en route leur imaginaire qui les pousse naturellement vers la littérature.
Mais si elle n’est pas stimulée, cette force peut s’éteindre.
C’est la mission de l’école que de sensibiliser les élèves aux grands textes classiques.
Malheureusement, elle y a renoncé.
Trop souvent, les enseignants ont tendance à penser qu’ils sont réservés à l’élite.
Alors qu’au contraire, l’école devrait donner un accès à la haute culture aux élèves qui arrivent avec un bagage moins fourni que les autres.
5c13058b-5c82-4ef9-83ba-f1760cf0daa5.text_en: I am convinced that all children possess within themselves the will to activate their imagination which naturally pushes them towards literature. But if it is not stimulated, this force can die out. It is the school's mission to raise students' awareness of great classic texts. Unfortunately, it has given up on this. Too often, teachers tend to think that they are reserved for the elite. Whereas on the contrary, the school should give access to high culture to students who arrive with a less extensive background than others.
5c13058b-5c82-4ef9-83ba-f1760cf0daa5.question_fr: Selon l’auteur de ce texte, quelle ambition devraient avoir les enseignants ?
5c13058b-5c82-4ef9-83ba-f1760cf0daa5.question_en: According to the author of this text, what ambition should teachers have?

options.text: Aborder des œuvres réputées difficiles avec leurs élèves.
options.text_en: Tackle works deemed difficult with their students.
options.explanation: The text argues that schools should introduce students to 'great classic texts' and 'high culture,' despite teachers often thinking they are too difficult or reserved for the elite.

options.text: Encourager leurs élèves à écrire des textes littéraires.
options.text_en: Encourage their students to write literary texts.
options.explanation: The text focuses on reading and accessing existing literature ('classic texts'), not on students creating their own literary works.

options.text: Inviter régulièrement des écrivains célèbres dans leur classe.
options.text_en: Regularly invite famous writers to their class.
options.explanation: There is no mention of inviting authors or external guests in the passage.

options.text: Monter des pièces de théâtre d’auteurs classiques.
options.explanation: While 'classic authors' are mentioned, the text discusses reading their texts in general, not specifically staging theatrical performances.

5c13058b-5c82-4ef9-83ba-f1760cf0daa5.key_line_fr: C’est la mission de l’école que de sensibiliser les élèves aux grands textes classiques.
5c13058b-5c82-4ef9-83ba-f1760cf0daa5.key_line_en: It is the school's mission to raise students' awareness of great classic texts.
5c13058b-5c82-4ef9-83ba-f1760cf0daa5.explanation: The author believes schools must introduce students to great classic literature and high culture, rejecting the idea that these works are too difficult or only for the elite.
5c13058b-5c82-4ef9-83ba-f1760cf0daa5.breakdown:
1. The text defines the school's mission as raising awareness of 'great classic texts' (grands textes classiques).
2. It notes that teachers often avoid this because they believe these texts are 'reserved for the elite' (réservés à l'élite), implying they are viewed as too difficult or exclusive.
3. The author argues the opposite: school should provide access to 'high culture' (haute culture).
4. Therefore, the goal is to introduce students to these classic, prestigious works, which aligns with Option A.
5. Options B (writing), C (inviting writers), and D (theater) mention specific activities not found in the text.

64ea7f39-1386-40f5-b0d4-56f832edc610.text:
Défenseurs et détracteurs de l’écriture inclusive, qui consiste à féminiser les mots en plaçant entre des points la terminaison du féminin, s’écharpent sur cet épineux sujet.
Pour Éliane Viennot, il est important de défendre l’écriture inclusive qui, en remaniant l’orthographe, vise à combattre les stéréotypes sexistes.
Selon elle, la langue structure notre représentation du monde.
Apprendre aux plus jeunes que le masculin l’emporte sur le féminin ne peut guère contribuer à forger des consciences égalitaristes.
Elle rappelle de surcroît que la langue française a longtemps été plus égalitaire qu’elle ne l’est aujourd’hui : il y a eu une masculinisation délibérée du langage à partir du XVIIe siècle.
Ceux qui se piquaient alors de définir le bon usage en ont profité pour renforcer l’ordre masculin.
64ea7f39-1386-40f5-b0d4-56f832edc610.text_en: Defenders and detractors of inclusive writing, which consists of feminizing words by placing the feminine ending between dots, are tearing each other apart over this thorny subject. For Éliane Viennot, it is important to defend inclusive writing which, by reshaping spelling, aims to combat sexist stereotypes. According to her, language structures our representation of the world. Teaching the youngest that the masculine prevails over the feminine can hardly contribute to forging egalitarian consciences. She specifically recalls that the French language has long been more egalitarian than it is today: there was a deliberate masculinization of language starting from the 17th century. Those who prided themselves then on defining proper usage took the opportunity to reinforce the masculine order.
64ea7f39-1386-40f5-b0d4-56f832edc610.question_fr: Que pense Éliane Viennot de l’écriture inclusive ?
64ea7f39-1386-40f5-b0d4-56f832edc610.question_en: What does Éliane Viennot think of inclusive writing?

options.text_en: It favors the evolution of mentalities.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states that inclusive writing aims to "combat sexist stereotypes" and forge "egalitarian consciences." This equates to fostering an evolution in mentalities.

The text mentions that the French language was "longtemps été plus égalitaire" (long more egalitarian) before the 17th century, implying this is not a historical first but a return to a previous state.

options.text: Elle permet de moderniser le lexique.
options.explanation: While it involves reshaping spelling ("remaniant l’orthographe"), the stated goal is social (fighting sexism), not merely modernizing the lexicon for the sake of modernity.

options.text: Elle reflète les clivages de la société.
options.text_en: It reflects the divisions of society.
options.explanation: The introductory sentence mentions that people clash over the subject, reflecting a divide. However, the question asks for Viennot's opinion on the *writing itself*, not on the state of the debate.

64ea7f39-1386-40f5-b0d4-56f832edc610.key_line_fr: Pour Éliane Viennot, il est important de défendre l’écriture inclusive qui, en remaniant l’orthographe, vise à combattre les stéréotypes sexistes.
64ea7f39-1386-40f5-b0d4-56f832edc610.key_line_en: For Éliane Viennot, it is important to defend inclusive writing which, by reshaping spelling, aims to combat sexist stereotypes.
64ea7f39-1386-40f5-b0d4-56f832edc610.explanation: Éliane Viennot supports inclusive writing because she believes language shapes our worldview; thus, changing it helps fight stereotypes and evolves mentalities toward equality.
64ea7f39-1386-40f5-b0d4-56f832edc610.breakdown:
1.  **Identify the core question**: What is Éliane Viennot's opinion on inclusive writing?
2.  **Scan for the name**: The text states, "Pour Éliane Viennot... vise à combattre les stéréotypes sexistes" (For Éliane Viennot... aims to combat sexist stereotypes).
3.  **Analyze the logic**: She believes language structures our representation of the world. Therefore, changing the language (inclusive writing) helps forge "consciences égalitaristes" (egalitarian consciences).
4.  **Match with options**: Option A ("It favors the evolution of mentalities") perfectly summarizes the idea of combating stereotypes and forging egalitarian consciences. Option B is contradicted by the text (which says French used to be egalitarian). Option C is not the primary goal stated. Option D describes the context (the debate), not her specific opinion on the tool itself.

6c9e30ee-174d-4583-bbf4-d02f8cd60c40.text:
Non, tous les salariés ne sont pas faits pour le télétravailleur.
Le rapport Obergo le prouve à travers soixante-quinze entretiens approfondis avec des télétravailleurs.
Les résultats tordent le cou à une idée reçue : le télétravail serait l’organisation de demain car elle est bonne pour la productivité des entreprises et la qualité de vie des salariés.
En effet, tous les métiers et les personnalités ne sont pas adaptés au télétravail.
La réussite du télétravail exige des profils de salariés très spécifiques.
Parmi les conditions sine qua non : vouloir et aimer travailler seul, disposer d’une grande autonomie et posséder un logement pouvant accueillir un bureau isolé.
« Autant de conditions difficiles à rassembler », constate Jean-Paul Boucher, commanditaire du rapport.
6c9e30ee-174d-4583-bbf4-d02f8cd60c40.text_en: No, not all employees are made for telework. The Obergo report proves this through seventy-five in-depth interviews with teleworkers. The results dispel a preconceived notion: that telework is the organization of tomorrow because it is good for company productivity and employees' quality of life. Indeed, not all professions and personalities are adapted to telework. The success of telework requires very specific employee profiles. Among the sine qua non conditions: wanting and liking to work alone, possessing great autonomy, and having housing that can accommodate an isolated office. "So many conditions difficult to bring together," notes Jean-Paul Boucher, sponsor of the report.
6c9e30ee-174d-4583-bbf4-d02f8cd60c40.question_fr: Qu’est-ce qui ressort du rapport Obergo concernant le télétravail ?
6c9e30ee-174d-4583-bbf4-d02f8cd60c40.question_en: What emerges from the Obergo report regarding telework?

options.text: Il donne satisfaction aux employés interrogés.
options.text_en: It gives satisfaction to the employees interviewed.
options.explanation: The text disputes the idea that telework automatically improves quality of life and does not state that the interviewees were satisfied; it focuses on the constraints.

options.text: Il est délicat à mettre en œuvre.
options.explanation: The text lists strict prerequisites (autonomy, space, personality) and explicitly calls them "conditions difficult to bring together," meaning implementation is not simple.

options.text: Il impose une restructuration des services.
options.text_en: It imposes a restructuring of services.
options.explanation: The text mentions organizational changes regarding the individual (profiles, housing), but does not mention a structural reorganization of company services.

options.text: Il nuit à la performance des cadres.
options.text_en: It harms the performance of executives.
options.explanation: The text challenges the general idea that telework always aids productivity, but does not specifically claim it harms the performance of executives (cadres).

6c9e30ee-174d-4583-bbf4-d02f8cd60c40.key_line_fr: « Autant de conditions difficiles à rassembler », constate Jean-Paul Boucher, commanditaire du rapport.
6c9e30ee-174d-4583-bbf4-d02f8cd60c40.key_line_en: "So many conditions difficult to bring together," notes Jean-Paul Boucher, sponsor of the report.

vocabulary.term: tordent le cou à une idée reçue

6c9e30ee-174d-4583-bbf4-d02f8cd60c40.explanation: The report concludes that telework requires specific conditions regarding personality and housing that are hard to find, making it tricky to implement successfully.
6c9e30ee-174d-4583-bbf4-d02f8cd60c40.breakdown: The text argues that teleworking is not suitable for everyone. It lists specific, strict requirements for success: liking solitude, having autonomy, and having a home with a separate office space. The text concludes by stating these conditions are 'difficult to bring together' (difficiles à rassembler). This difficulty in meeting all the necessary conditions aligns with the idea that telework is 'delicate to implement' (délicat à mettre en œuvre).

124909d9-3dbe-49b0-9b34-df7cb13f0a3a.text:
La France est le pays d’Europe où il y a le plus d’animaux par habitant.
Chien, chat, poisson, cheval ou même serpent, les Français adorent s’occuper d’eux, les nourrir, les sortir et vivre à leurs côtés.
124909d9-3dbe-49b0-9b34-df7cb13f0a3a.text_en: France is the European country where there are the most animals per inhabitant. Dog, cat, fish, horse, or even snake, the French love taking care of them, feeding them, taking them out, and living alongside them.
124909d9-3dbe-49b0-9b34-df7cb13f0a3a.question_fr: Qu’apprend-on sur les Français et les animaux ?
124909d9-3dbe-49b0-9b34-df7cb13f0a3a.question_en: What do we learn about the French and animals?

options.explanation: The text discusses domestic pets (dogs, cats, etc.) and caring for them, not observing wildlife in nature.

options.text: Ils les regardent à la télévision.
options.explanation: There is no mention of television or media in the text.

options.explanation: The phrase 'le plus d’animaux par habitant' implies a high rate of ownership among the population.

options.text: Ils vont les voir dans les zoos.

124909d9-3dbe-49b0-9b34-df7cb13f0a3a.key_line_en: France is the European country where there are the most animals per inhabitant.
124909d9-3dbe-49b0-9b34-df7cb13f0a3a.explanation: The passage states France has the highest number of animals per person in Europe, indicating that many French people own pets.
124909d9-3dbe-49b0-9b34-df7cb13f0a3a.breakdown: The text explicitly states that France is the European country with 'le plus d’animaux par habitant' (the most animals per inhabitant). It further describes how French people love to take care of them and 'vivre à leurs côtés' (live alongside them). This confirms that a large number of French people own animals.

Dominique
PS : Mon téléphone est cassé !
d91c601d-a86f-4c4a-984a-dd884ad8b4c5.text_en: Pierre, I went out for an emergency, you can wait for me at the café around the corner, it's the nicest in the neighborhood. I will be back home around 7 PM. Sorry. Dominique PS: My phone is broken!

He asks Pierre to 'attendre' (wait) for him, implying the meeting will still happen, not that it is cancelled.
