d91c601d-a86f-4c4a-984a-dd884ad8b4c5.breakdown: The text is a note from Dominique to Pierre. Dominique states he had to leave for an 'urgence' (emergency) and asks Pierre to wait at a café. Crucially, he specifies 'Je serai de retour à la maison vers 19h' (I will be back home around 7 PM). The apology ('Désolé') and the instruction to wait imply that he is not there now and will arrive later than Pierre might expect, supporting the idea that he will arrive late at home.

9f1b2ffe-0753-4ed5-bc9c-9ce80a1a6a58.text: Inauguré en décembre 2012 dans le nord de la France, le musée du Louvre-Lens célèbre ses 5 ans avec une programmation spéciale. L’ambition initiale était d’attirer un public différent de celui du célèbre musée du Louvre à Paris. L’objectif est atteint : 65% des visiteurs sont originaires de la région du Nord, 18% sont ouvriers ou employés, et plus de la moitié d’entre eux déclarent aller rarement au musée. À l’occasion de cet anniversaire, une quarantaine de nouveaux chefs-d’œuvre du Louvre-Paris y seront exposés.
9f1b2ffe-0753-4ed5-bc9c-9ce80a1a6a58.text_en: Inaugurated in December 2012 in the north of France, the Louvre-Lens museum celebrates its 5 years with special programming. The initial ambition was to attract an audience different from that of the famous Louvre museum in Paris. The goal has been reached: 65% of visitors originate from the North region, 18% are manual workers or employees, and more than half of them declare rarely going to a museum. On the occasion of this anniversary, around forty new masterpieces from the Louvre-Paris will be exhibited there.
9f1b2ffe-0753-4ed5-bc9c-9ce80a1a6a58.question_en: What do we learn about the Louvre-Lens?

options.text_en: It is a rarely visited museum.
options.explanation: The text states that half the visitors rarely go to museums, but it does not claim the museum itself has low attendance.

options.text: Il a réussi à séduire un public local.
options.text_en: It has succeeded in attracting a local audience.
options.explanation: The text confirms that 65% of visitors come from the local North region, fulfilling the museum's goal.

options.text: On y découvrir l’histoire de la région.
options.text_en: One can discover the history of the region there.
options.explanation: The text mentions exhibiting masterpieces from the Louvre, not the history of the local region.

options.text: Sa collection sera présentée à Paris.
options.text_en: Its collection will be presented in Paris.
options.explanation: The text says masterpieces from Paris will be exhibited in Lens, not that the Lens collection is going to Paris.

9f1b2ffe-0753-4ed5-bc9c-9ce80a1a6a58.key_line_fr: L’objectif est atteint : 65% des visiteurs sont originaires de la région du Nord
9f1b2ffe-0753-4ed5-bc9c-9ce80a1a6a58.key_line_en: The goal has been reached: 65% of visitors originate from the North region
9f1b2ffe-0753-4ed5-bc9c-9ce80a1a6a58.explanation: The passage states that 65% of the visitors are from the local region (the North), confirming it successfully attracted a local audience.
9f1b2ffe-0753-4ed5-bc9c-9ce80a1a6a58.breakdown: The text explicitly states that the initial ambition was to attract a different audience and that this goal was reached. It specifies that '65% des visiteurs sont originaires de la région du Nord' (65% of visitors originate from the North region). This directly confirms that the museum has succeeded in attracting a local public. Option A is incorrect as the text discusses the profile of visitors (people who rarely go to museums), not low attendance numbers. Option C is not mentioned; the text talks about Louvre masterpieces, not regional history. Option D contradicts the text, which says works from Paris are coming to Lens ('y seront exposés'), not the other way around.

1e7f1106-a221-48a9-904c-6f12caf87876.text: Dans les quartiers populaires de Kinshasa, il crée des tableaux en relief à partir des déchets trouvés dans la ville. Certains le prennent pour un fou, d’autres pour un génie. Yeux perçants, mains agiles, jambes déformées par la polio, Emmanuel Botalatala est appelé le « ministre des poubelles » ce poste n’est pas officiel, c’est son nom d’artiste. Le documentaire qui lui est consacré présente le rôle qu’un artiste et sa vision peuvent jouer dans une capitale en pleine mutation.
1e7f1106-a221-48a9-904c-6f12caf87876.text_en: In the working-class neighborhoods of Kinshasa, he creates relief paintings from waste found in the city. Some take him for a madman, others for a genius. Piercing eyes, agile hands, legs deformed by polio, Emmanuel Botalatala is called the 'Minister of Garbage'; this position is not official, it is his artist name. The documentary dedicated to him presents the role that an artist and his vision can play in a capital in full transformation.
1e7f1106-a221-48a9-904c-6f12caf87876.question_fr: De quoi est-il question dans cet article ?

options.text: D’un comédien qui tourne dans des bidonvilles.
options.text_en: Of a comedian filming in shanty towns.
options.explanation: The text describes a visual artist making paintings, not a comedian or actor filming.

options.text: D’un homme qui produit des œuvres originales.
options.text_en: Of a man who produces original works.
options.explanation: The passage describes him creating relief paintings from waste, which corresponds to producing original works.

options.text: De la santé d’un membre du gouvernement.
options.text_en: Of the health of a government member.
options.explanation: The title 'Minister' is explicitly described as an artist name ('nom d’artiste'), not a real government position.

options.text: De mesure écologique prise par une mairie.
options.text_en: Of an ecological measure taken by a town hall.
options.explanation: The text focuses on an artist's personal vision and work, not an official ecological policy implemented by the city hall.

1e7f1106-a221-48a9-904c-6f12caf87876.key_line_fr: il crée des tableaux en relief à partir des déchets trouvés dans la ville.
1e7f1106-a221-48a9-904c-6f12caf87876.key_line_en: he creates relief paintings from waste found in the city.
1e7f1106-a221-48a9-904c-6f12caf87876.explanation: The article is about an artist who creates art from trash; therefore, it concerns a man producing original works.
1e7f1106-a221-48a9-904c-6f12caf87876.breakdown: The text introduces Emmanuel Botalatala, who creates 'tableaux en relief' (relief paintings) from 'déchets' (waste). While he is nicknamed the 'Minister of Garbage,' the text explicitly states this is an artist name, not an official post. Option A is incorrect because he creates paintings, not acts in films. Option C is incorrect because he is not a government member. Option D is incorrect because this is an individual artistic initiative, not a city measure. Option B is the correct summary as he produces unique art pieces.

ec9be88c-55b7-4960-9981-ced881e61e3c.text:
Des études de marché récentes montrent que les frites signent leur grand retour. Leur côte de popularité ne se dément pas, mais elles doivent être préparées dans les règles de l’art : pour des frites dorées, moelleuses dedans, croquantes dehors, il faut les cuire puis les frire en deux temps.
Si la Belgique et la France se disputent la paternité, on n’en a toujours pas trouvé l’origine, avec le bond spectaculaire du burger dont elles sont l’accompagnement idéal, les frites sont fortement consommées au restaurant.
ec9be88c-55b7-4960-9981-ced881e61e3c.text_en: Recent market studies show that fries are making a big comeback. Their popularity is undeniable, but they must be prepared according to the rules of the art: for golden fries, soft inside, crunchy outside, they must be cooked then fried in two stages. While Belgium and France dispute the paternity, the origin has still not been found; with the spectacular leap of the burger of which they are the ideal accompaniment, fries are heavily consumed in restaurants.
ec9be88c-55b7-4960-9981-ced881e61e3c.question_fr: Que révèle cet article sur les frites ?
ec9be88c-55b7-4960-9981-ced881e61e3c.question_en: What does this article reveal about fries?

options.text_en: The historical origin of the recipe.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states that the origin has still not been found.

options.text_en: The secret of a good preparation.
options.explanation: The text explains exactly how to cook them (two stages) to get the best result.

options.text_en: The addresses where to consume them.
options.explanation: No specific locations or addresses are mentioned.
While the burger is mentioned as a factor, the core specific information provided is technical (how to cook them), making B the stronger 'revelation'.

ec9be88c-55b7-4960-9981-ced881e61e3c.key_line_fr: pour des frites dorées, moelleuses dedans, croquantes dehors, il faut les cuire puis les frire en deux temps.
ec9be88c-55b7-4960-9981-ced881e61e3c.key_line_en: for golden fries, soft inside, crunchy outside, they must be cooked then fried in two stages.

vocabulary.gloss: according to the rules of the art (perfectly)

ec9be88c-55b7-4960-9981-ced881e61e3c.explanation: The article explicitly describes the specific cooking method (two stages) required to make perfect fries, which is the secret to their preparation.
ec9be88c-55b7-4960-9981-ced881e61e3c.breakdown:
1.  **Analyze the text**: The text discusses the popularity of fries but emphasizes that they must be prepared 'dans les règles de l’art' (according to the rules of the art). It explicitly states the method: 'il faut les cuire puis les frire en deux temps' (cook then fry in two stages).
2.  **Evaluate Option A (Origin)**: The text states 'on n’en a toujours pas trouvé l’origine' (we still haven't found the origin). The article does not reveal it.
3.  **Evaluate Option B (Preparation)**: The text gives a specific instruction for the perfect fry (two-stage cooking). This constitutes the 'secret' of preparation.
4.  **Evaluate Option C (Addresses)**: The text mentions 'restaurant' generally, but lists no specific addresses.
5.  **Evaluate Option D (Reasons for popularity)**: While it mentions the burger connection, the most specific, instructional information 'revealed' by the text is the cooking method. The prompt specifically flags B as the correct answer.

e59e04bc-0645-4690-a5cb-533b775056f1.text:
À l'ère des réseaux sociaux, il n'y a pas une table où les convives ne dégainent leur smartphone pour « poster » immédiatement leur assiette. Peu importe qu'elle refroidisse, que ce soit bon ou pas.
Sur la toile, la cuisine est devenue « l'univers le plus plébiscité avec le voyage ». Et même si la vue des mets est un avant-goût du plaisir, réduire la cuisine à une galerie de natures mortes, aussi belles soient-elles, n'est pas sans interroger.
« Pour moi, la bonne cuisine, c'est quand on soulève le couvercle, que ça fume, que ça sent bon et qu'on peut se resservir », disait le grand cuisinier Paul Bocuse.
Pour les réseaux sociaux, c'est un plat qui en met plein la vue et qu'on vous sert sur écran plat.
D'après Le Figaro.fr
e59e04bc-0645-4690-a5cb-533b775056f1.text_en: In the era of social networks, there is not a table where guests do not draw their smartphone to immediately 'post' their plate. It matters little whether it cools down, whether it is good or not. On the web, cuisine has become the most acclaimed universe along with travel. And even if the sight of dishes is a foretaste of pleasure, reducing cooking to a gallery of still lifes, however beautiful they may be, raises questions. 'For me, good cooking is when you lift the lid, it smokes, it smells good and you can have seconds,' said the great cook Paul Bocuse. For social networks, it is a dish that is dazzling and served to you on a flat screen.
e59e04bc-0645-4690-a5cb-533b775056f1.question_en: What do we learn in this article?

options.text: La réputation de restaurants touristiques est menacée par internet.
options.text_en: The reputation of tourist restaurants is threatened by the internet.
options.explanation: The text mentions cuisine and travel are popular online, but does not mention any threat to the reputation of tourist restaurants.

options.text: La technologie modifie la relation à la gastronomie.
options.text_en: Technology modifies the relationship with gastronomy.
options.explanation: The text describes how people prioritize photographing food over eating it hot, illustrating a change in the relationship with food due to technology.

options.text: Les grands chefs livrent leurs secrets sur des sites.
options.text_en: Great chefs deliver their secrets on sites.
options.explanation: Paul Bocuse is quoted to define 'good cuisine' in a traditional sense, not because chefs are sharing secrets online.

options.text: Les traditions culinaires peuvent se perpétuer grâce au numérique.
options.text_en: Culinary traditions can be perpetuated thanks to digital technology.
options.explanation: The text implies the digital world reduces cuisine to just visuals ('still lifes'), rather than helping preserve the full traditional experience.

e59e04bc-0645-4690-a5cb-533b775056f1.key_line_fr: À l’ère des réseaux sociaux, il n’y a pas une table où les convives ne dégainent leur smartphone pour « poster » immédiatement leur assiette.
e59e04bc-0645-4690-a5cb-533b775056f1.key_line_en: In the era of social networks, there is not a table where guests do not draw their smartphone to immediately 'post' their plate.
e59e04bc-0645-4690-a5cb-533b775056f1.explanation: The text highlights how smartphones and social media cause diners to focus on the visual aspect of food rather than the taste or temperature, shifting the traditional relationship with food.
e59e04bc-0645-4690-a5cb-533b775056f1.breakdown:
1. The text begins by describing a behavioral change: diners use smartphones to take photos before eating, ignoring whether the food gets cold or tastes good. 
2. It mentions that cuisine is very popular online but questions if reducing food to visual 'still lifes' is a good thing. 
3. It contrasts a traditional chef's view (smell, heat, seconds) with the social media view (visuals on a screen). 
4. This contrast and the change in behavior (posting vs. eating) support the idea that technology is changing how people relate to gastronomy.

c750127c-d52b-4a6a-9455-688fa6324986.text:
Dans cette belle institution qu’est l’Éducation nationale, ce sont les profs qui font tourner la boutique. Ce sont eux qui, chaque jour, nourrissent intellectuellement ceux qui feront la France de demain. Sans eux et leur amour du métier, l’école française se serait effondrée depuis belle lurette et ferait encore moins bien que ses résultats actuels. Notre journal veut donc leur dire merci en publiant quelques portraits et en vous demandant de nous signaler d’autres « héros de l’école ».
ENVOYEZ-NOUS VOS MESSAGES, NOUS LES PUBLIERONS.
c750127c-d52b-4a6a-9455-688fa6324986.text_en: In this beautiful institution that is the National Education system, it is the teachers who keep the shop running. It is they who, every day, intellectually nourish those who will make the France of tomorrow. Without them and their love for the profession, the French school system would have collapsed ages ago and would perform even worse than its current results. Our newspaper therefore wants to say thank you by publishing a few portraits and asking you to point out other 'school heroes' to us. SEND US YOUR MESSAGES, WE WILL PUBLISH THEM.
c750127c-d52b-4a6a-9455-688fa6324986.question_fr: D’après le texte, quel rôle jouent les enseignants dans l’institution scolaire ?
c750127c-d52b-4a6a-9455-688fa6324986.question_en: According to the text, what role do teachers play in the school institution?

options.explanation: While the text mentions they nourish those who will make the future France, the focus is on the survival of the institution, not specifically on influence outside the classroom.

options.text: Ils instillent le goût du travail en équipe.
options.text_en: They instill a taste for teamwork.
options.explanation: The text does not mention teamwork or collaborative skills.

options.text: Ils permettent au système de se maintenir.
options.text_en: They allow the system to maintain itself.
options.explanation: The phrase 'se serait effondrée' (would have collapsed) without them confirms that their role is to prevent collapse, i.e., to allow the system to maintain itself.
The text discusses teachers' love for their job, but does not mention that they inspire students to become teachers (vocations).

c750127c-d52b-4a6a-9455-688fa6324986.key_line_fr: Sans eux et leur amour du métier, l’école française se serait effondrée depuis belle lurette
c750127c-d52b-4a6a-9455-688fa6324986.key_line_en: Without them and their love for the profession, the French school system would have collapsed ages ago

c750127c-d52b-4a6a-9455-688fa6324986.explanation: The text states that the school system would have collapsed without teachers, meaning they are responsible for keeping the system running.
c750127c-d52b-4a6a-9455-688fa6324986.breakdown: 1. The text begins by stating that teachers are the ones who 'font tourner la boutique' (keep the shop running/keep things going). 2. It explicitly mentions that without them, the French school system 'se serait effondrée depuis belle lurette' (would have collapsed ages ago). 3. This implies that their primary role described here is ensuring the survival and continuity of the institution. 4. Therefore, they allow the system to maintain itself.

824770dd-5963-4f63-88ca-e9a35b97d6cc.text:
Plus de 40 % des espèces d’insectes sont en déclin et un tiers sont menacés. Leur taux de mortalité est huit fois plus rapide que celui des mammifères. À ce rythme, s’inquiètent les scientifiques, les insectes pourraient disparaître d’ici un siècle. Cette prévision est préoccupante, car ils sont essentiels au bon fonctionnement de tous les écosystèmes. Ils pollinisent les plantes, recyclent les nutriments, et servent de nourriture aux autres animaux. Leur disparition « aura des conséquences catastrophiques à la fois pour les écosystèmes de la planète et pour la survie de l’humanité ».
« Si les modes de production alimentaire ne changent pas, les insectes dans leur ensemble s’engageront sur la voie de l’extinction dans quelques décennies », écrivent les chercheurs.
824770dd-5963-4f63-88ca-e9a35b97d6cc.text_en: More than 40% of insect species are in decline and a third are threatened. Their mortality rate is eight times faster than that of mammals. At this rate, scientists worry, insects could disappear within a century. This forecast is worrying, because they are essential to the proper functioning of all ecosystems. They pollinate plants, recycle nutrients, and serve as food for other animals. Their disappearance 'will have catastrophic consequences both for the planet's ecosystems and for the survival of humanity'. 'If food production methods do not change, insects as a whole will go down the path of extinction in a few decades', write the researchers.
824770dd-5963-4f63-88ca-e9a35b97d6cc.question_fr: D’après l’article, qu’est-ce qui est à l’origine de la disparition des insectes ?
824770dd-5963-4f63-88ca-e9a35b97d6cc.question_en: According to the article, what is the origin of the disappearance of insects?

options.explanation: Climate change is not mentioned in this text as the specific cause.
The text links the extinction to 'food production methods', which is synonymous with farming/culture methods.
The text mentions insects serve as food for animals, not that predators are the cause of their mass decline.
Public policies are not explicitly mentioned in the text.

824770dd-5963-4f63-88ca-e9a35b97d6cc.key_line_fr: Si les modes de production alimentaire ne changent pas, les insectes dans leur ensemble s’engageront sur la voie de l’extinction dans quelques décennies
824770dd-5963-4f63-88ca-e9a35b97d6cc.key_line_en: If food production methods do not change, insects as a whole will go down the path of extinction in a few decades
824770dd-5963-4f63-88ca-e9a35b97d6cc.explanation: The researchers explicitly state that insects will face extinction if 'food production methods' do not change, which refers to farming methods.
824770dd-5963-4f63-88ca-e9a35b97d6cc.breakdown:
1. The question asks for the cause ('l'origine') of insect disappearance according to the text.
2. Scan the text for reasons or conditions regarding their extinction.
3. The text states: 'Si les modes de production alimentaire ne changent pas...' ('If food production methods do not change...').
4. Compare 'modes de production alimentaire' (food production methods) with the options.
5. Option B, 'Les méthodes de culture' (Farming methods), is synonymous with food production methods.

639caf6e-b4ae-4c81-9af7-da5998d52eec.text:
Ma chère Amélie,
Merci pour la lettre. Je suis contente que tu te plaises dans la nouvelle résidence. Il faut dire que le soleil et la proximité de la mer rendent la vie plus agréable. Ta proposition me fait plaisir et je pense pouvoir te rejoindre bientôt. Cela ne me gêne pas que les travaux ne soient pas terminés dans la maison et je me réjouis de pouvoir profiter de la plage et de ton jardin.
Encore mille mercis.
Florence
639caf6e-b4ae-4c81-9af7-da5998d52eec.text_en: My dear Amélie, Thanks for the letter. I am glad that you like the new residence. It must be said that the sun and the proximity of the sea make life more pleasant. Your proposal pleases me and I think I can join you soon. It does not bother me that the renovation work is not finished in the house and I look forward to being able to enjoy the beach and your garden. A thousand thanks again. Florence
639caf6e-b4ae-4c81-9af7-da5998d52eec.question_fr: Quelle information est absente de la lettre ?
639caf6e-b4ae-4c81-9af7-da5998d52eec.question_en: Which information is absent from the letter?

options.explanation: The text mentions 'nouvelle résidence' (new residence), confirming she moved.
Florence refers to a 'proposition' and plans to join Amélie, confirming an invitation.

options.text_en: Florence has a lot of work.
options.explanation: The text uses the word 'travaux' to refer to house renovations, not professional work/employment.

options.text: Florence aime le bord de mer.
options.explanation: Florence expresses joy about enjoying the beach ('profiter de la plage'), confirming she likes the seaside.

639caf6e-b4ae-4c81-9af7-da5998d52eec.key_line_fr: Cela ne me gêne pas que les travaux ne soient pas terminés dans la maison
639caf6e-b4ae-4c81-9af7-da5998d52eec.key_line_en: It does not bother me that the renovation work is not finished in the house

2. Option B: Florence mentions 'Ta proposition' (your proposal) and plans to 'te rejoindre' (join you), implying an invitation. This information is present.

417c3d61-ec44-464c-af5e-30d32411e5e4.text:
Dans le monde de la littérature jeunesse, Michèle Moreau est une référence. Les bénévoles de l’association Lire et faire lire l’ont écoutée raconter son parcours et son engagement au service de cette littérature, au cours d’un « atelier comptines ». Michèle Moreau a montré les constantes, l’universalité des comptines et histoires qu’elle a éditées. Elle a aussi défendu l’idée que la littérature jeunesse n’était pas « une sous-culture » :
« L’idée qu’il existerait un répertoire réservé aux enfants m’est inconnue. Si l’on n’est pas d’abord ému en tant qu’adulte, les enfants ne le seront pas non plus. Un livre ou un livre-disque doit savoir parler autant aux enfants qu’aux adultes, c’est pour cela que musiques, textes et illustrations sont particulièrement soignés. »
417c3d61-ec44-464c-af5e-30d32411e5e4.text_en: In the world of children's literature, Michèle Moreau is a reference. Volunteers from the 'Lire et faire lire' association listened to her recount her career and her commitment to this literature during a 'nursery rhyme workshop'. Michèle Moreau showed the constants and universality of the nursery rhymes and stories she has published. She also defended the idea that children's literature was not a 'sub-culture': 'The idea that there exists a repertoire reserved for children is unknown to me. If one is not first moved as an adult, children will not be either. A book or a book-record must be able to speak as much to children as to adults, that is why the music, texts, and illustrations are particularly well-crafted.'
417c3d61-ec44-464c-af5e-30d32411e5e4.question_fr: Selon Michèle Moreau, à quoi reconnaît-on un bon livre jeunesse ?
417c3d61-ec44-464c-af5e-30d32411e5e4.question_en: According to Michèle Moreau, how do we recognize a good children's book?

options.text: Il a plus d’illustrations que d’écrit.
options.text_en: It has more illustrations than writing.
options.explanation: The text mentions that illustrations are 'soignés' (carefully done), but never claims they should outnumber the text.
While likely true for the genre, the text does not mention preserving imagination as the specific criterion Michèle Moreau uses to define a good book here.
This matches the text's statement that a book must move adults ('ému en tant qu’adulte') and speak to them as much as to children.
She mentions the universality of nursery rhymes, which implies heritage, but her specific measure of a *good* book in the quote is its ability to appeal to adults.

417c3d61-ec44-464c-af5e-30d32411e5e4.key_line_fr: Un livre ou un livre-disque doit savoir parler autant aux enfants qu’aux adultes
417c3d61-ec44-464c-af5e-30d32411e5e4.key_line_en: A book or a book-record must be able to speak as much to children as to adults
417c3d61-ec44-464c-af5e-30d32411e5e4.explanation: Michèle Moreau explicitly states that for a children's book to be good, it must move adults just as much as it moves children.
417c3d61-ec44-464c-af5e-30d32411e5e4.breakdown:
The question asks how to recognize a good children's book according to Michèle Moreau. 

1.  Scan the text for her criteria regarding the quality of books. 
2.  In the quote at the end, she states: 'Si l’on n’est pas d’abord ému en tant qu’adulte, les enfants ne le seront pas non plus' (If one is not first moved as an adult, children won't be either).
3.  She clarifies further: 'Un livre... doit savoir parler autant aux enfants qu’aux adultes' (A book... must know how to speak as much to children as to adults).
4.  Compare this with the options. Option C states 'It touches adults also,' which directly paraphrases her requirement that a book must move adults to be good for children.

a28f72df-0655-4cd3-8c67-0a2ccd87b06a.text: Sur la côte de la Tanzanie, la petite bourgade de Pangani s’organise autour de son fleuve éponyme dont l’eau est de plus en plus viciée. Même s’il participe à lui donner des allures d’éden, le fleuve a pourtant été depuis des décennies la principale raison de vivre dans la région, fournissant eau fraîche et travail aux pêcheurs. Dans son reportage, Federico Romano dévoile son ambivalence. Alors que Pangani est paradisiaque, calme et bordée de palmiers, il y a comme un ennemi invisible : les gens y boivent tous l’eau du fleuve, parce qu’ils n’ont tout simplement pas d’autre solution, alors que celle-ci n’a plus rien à voir avec de l’eau douce.
a28f72df-0655-4cd3-8c67-0a2ccd87b06a.text_en: On the coast of Tanzania, the small town of Pangani is organized around its eponymous river, whose water is increasingly tainted. Even if it helps give it the look of an Eden, the river has nevertheless been the main reason for living in the region for decades, providing fresh water and work to fishermen. In his report, Federico Romano reveals its ambivalence. While Pangani is paradisiacal, calm, and lined with palm trees, there is something like an invisible enemy: people all drink the river water there, because they simply have no other solution, even though it no longer has anything to do with fresh water.
a28f72df-0655-4cd3-8c67-0a2ccd87b06a.question_en: What is revealed about this river?

options.text: Il constitue un bienfait autant qu’un problème.
options.text_en: It constitutes a benefit as much as a problem.
options.explanation: The text explicitly mentions the 'ambivalence' of the river: it provides work and life (benefit) but its water is tainted and dangerous to drink (problem).

options.text_en: It is threatened with drying up.
options.explanation: The text says the water is 'tainted' (viciée) and no longer 'fresh' (douce), likely implying salinity or pollution, but does not mention it is drying up.
The text mentions the water is tainted and harmful to humans who drink it, but does not specifically state that it pollutes the surrounding land.

options.text: Il représente un attrait touristique essentiel.
options.text_en: It represents an essential tourist attraction.
options.explanation: While the place is described as 'paradisiacal', the river is primarily presented as a source of livelihood for locals ('travail aux pêcheurs') and a health risk, rather than just a tourist attraction.

a28f72df-0655-4cd3-8c67-0a2ccd87b06a.key_line_fr: Dans son reportage, Federico Romano dévoile son ambivalence.
a28f72df-0655-4cd3-8c67-0a2ccd87b06a.key_line_en: In his report, Federico Romano reveals its ambivalence.
a28f72df-0655-4cd3-8c67-0a2ccd87b06a.explanation: The river is described as having 'ambivalence' because it is vital for the fishermen's work but simultaneously dangerous due to its tainted water.
a28f72df-0655-4cd3-8c67-0a2ccd87b06a.breakdown: The text presents a contrast regarding the river. On one hand, it describes the river as the 'principale raison de vivre' (main reason for living) and a provider of 'travail' (work) and water for decades. On the other hand, it states the water is 'viciée' (tainted), represents an 'ennemi invisible' (invisible enemy), and is no longer 'eau douce' (fresh water). The text explicitly summarizes this duality with the phrase 'dévoile son ambivalence' (reveals its ambivalence), which directly aligns with option A (benefit as much as a problem).

2fcab0f2-8868-4bd9-b88c-c5462bc5b222.text: L’homme est de noir vêtu. Son crâne, nu, joue avec la lumière. Tout est dit, tout est là, dans ce jeu d’ombre et de clarté qui fait d’un bâtisseur un poète. Jean Nouvel façonne le mystère pour insuffler du vivant aux édifices au cœur de pierre et bâtit sans dénaturer. Cet architecte éclairé n’érige rien, il convie cette émotion, suscite une apparition pour sa dernière création, il découvre une ville-musée aux formes douces, un dôme qui semble né des mains d’une dentellière. Le dôme repose sur quatre piliers pour gagner en légèreté et s’allier au paysage, trait d’union avec les nuages.
2fcab0f2-8868-4bd9-b88c-c5462bc5b222.text_en: The man is dressed in black. His bare skull plays with the light. Everything is said, everything is there, in this play of shadow and clarity that turns a builder into a poet. Jean Nouvel shapes mystery to breathe life into stone-hearted edifices and builds without distorting. This enlightened architect erects nothing, he invites this emotion, sparks an apparition for his latest creation, he discovers a museum-city with soft shapes, a dome that seems born from the hands of a lacemaker. The dome rests on four pillars to gain lightness and ally with the landscape, a hyphen with the clouds.
2fcab0f2-8868-4bd9-b88c-c5462bc5b222.question_fr: Quelle particularité de Jean Nouvel est louée dans cet article ?
2fcab0f2-8868-4bd9-b88c-c5462bc5b222.question_en: Which particularity of Jean Nouvel is praised in this article?

options.text: Sa technique puise dans divers mouvements artistiques.
options.text_en: His technique draws from various artistic movements.
options.explanation: The text mentions he is a 'poet' and 'builder', but does not discuss specific artistic movements influencing his technique.

options.text: Ses œuvres se fondent dans leur environnement.
options.text_en: His works blend into their environment.
options.explanation: The phrase 's’allier au paysage' (ally with the landscape) and 'bâtit sans dénaturer' (builds without distorting) confirm that his works blend into the environment.

options.text: Son inspiration provient de ses nombreuses lectures.
options.text_en: His inspiration comes from his numerous readings.
options.explanation: There is no mention of books, reading, or literary inspiration in the passage.

options.text: Son savoir-faire met en valeur des procédés connus.
options.explanation: The text focuses on creating 'mystery' and 'emotion' rather than highlighting standard or known technical processes.

2fcab0f2-8868-4bd9-b88c-c5462bc5b222.key_line_fr: Le dôme repose sur quatre piliers pour gagner en légèreté et s’allier au paysage, trait d’union avec les nuages.
2fcab0f2-8868-4bd9-b88c-c5462bc5b222.key_line_en: The dome rests on four pillars to gain lightness and ally with the landscape, a hyphen with the clouds.
2fcab0f2-8868-4bd9-b88c-c5462bc5b222.explanation: The article explicitly states that his architecture seeks to 'ally with the landscape' and build without distorting nature, meaning it blends into the environment.
2fcab0f2-8868-4bd9-b88c-c5462bc5b222.breakdown: The text describes Jean Nouvel's architectural style with phrases like 'bâtit sans dénaturer' (builds without distorting) and states that the dome is designed to 's’allier au paysage' (ally/blend with the landscape). This directly supports the idea that his works integrate well with their surroundings. Other options regarding specific artistic movements, reading habits, or known technical processes are not mentioned in the text.

f3f464d2-d18b-4dc1-b5c7-ed0308f76a3a.text: Inexorablement, la cravate perd de sa superbe. Un abandon progressif constaté par Serge Carreira, maître de conférences à Sciences Po Paris et spécialiste du luxe et de la mode : on l’impose de moins en moins de manière systématique à tout le monde au sein d’une entreprise. Toutefois, il existe des secteurs qui résistent à la tendance. Dans le monde de la finance, dans la haute administration, la cravate reste quelque chose de statutaire, estime Serge Carreira. C’est un symbole d’autorité et de respect vis-à-vis de ses interlocuteurs, de ses clients… Un formalisme qui n’est pas toujours très bien compris par les principaux intéressés : Josselin travaille pour une banque d’entreprise, il n’est pas en contact avec les clients et pourtant il doit se plier à la règle.
f3f464d2-d18b-4dc1-b5c7-ed0308f76a3a.text_en: Inexorably, the tie is losing its splendor. A progressive abandonment noted by Serge Carreira, lecturer at Sciences Po Paris and specialist in luxury and fashion: it is imposed less and less systematically on everyone within a company. However, there are sectors that resist the trend. In the world of finance, in high administration, the tie remains something statutory, estimates Serge Carreira. It is a symbol of authority and respect towards one's interlocutors, one's clients... A formalism that is not always very well understood by the principal interested parties: Josselin works for a corporate bank, he is not in contact with clients and yet he must comply with the rule.
f3f464d2-d18b-4dc1-b5c7-ed0308f76a3a.question_fr: Pourquoi certains continuent-ils à porter la cravate au travail ?
f3f464d2-d18b-4dc1-b5c7-ed0308f76a3a.question_en: Why do some continue to wear the tie at work?

options.text_en: It is an accessory of masculine elegance.
options.explanation: While a tie is a fashion accessory, the text specifically explains its persistence as a tool for authority and respect, not just elegance.

options.text: C’est un signe de reconnaissance entre pairs.
options.text_en: It is a sign of recognition between peers.
options.explanation: The text mentions it is 'statutaire' (related to status), but it emphasizes the relationship with clients and interlocutors rather than recognition among peers.

options.text_en: It is a custom in meetings.
options.explanation: The text does not restrict the custom to meetings; it applies generally in specific sectors like finance.

options.text_en: It is a mark of courtesy.
options.explanation: The text explicitly defines the tie as a symbol of 'respect towards one's interlocutors,' which matches the definition of courtesy.

f3f464d2-d18b-4dc1-b5c7-ed0308f76a3a.key_line_fr: C’est un symbole d’autorité et de respect vis-à-vis de ses interlocuteurs, de ses clients…
f3f464d2-d18b-4dc1-b5c7-ed0308f76a3a.key_line_en: It is a symbol of authority and respect towards one's interlocutors, one's clients...

vocabulary.gloss: To comply with / To bow to

f3f464d2-d18b-4dc1-b5c7-ed0308f76a3a.explanation: The text describes the tie as a symbol of respect towards others (clients/interlocutors), which corresponds to being a mark of courtesy.
f3f464d2-d18b-4dc1-b5c7-ed0308f76a3a.breakdown: The question asks why some people still wear ties. The text states that in certain sectors (finance, high administration), the tie remains 'statutaire' (status-related). Crucially, the text explains that it is a symbol of 'autorité' (authority) and 'respect vis-à-vis de ses interlocuteurs' (respect towards one's interlocutors). The concept of showing respect towards people you speak with is synonymous with courtesy ('courtoisie'). Therefore, option D is the correct paraphrase of the text.

07feae4d-a5cb-449b-8746-e99a8c2cb37e.text: J’ai la naïveté de penser qu’un peu d’imagination n’est pas totalement absurde lorsqu’on écrit des romans. Or, à mon sens, l’imagination est le but de deux choses fondamentales : l’ennui, à qui on donne trop souvent un mauvais rôle, et l’observation, qui n’est pas seulement un terme médical. Il s’avère que le téléphone intelligent, ce charmant objet, si nécessaire, si vital, fait peu à peu disparaître ces deux activités de fainéants du cerveau humain que sont l’ennui et l’observation. Pourquoi s’ennuyer quand on peut regarder des vidéos de chatons ou des notifications Facebook de la plus haute importance dans une salle d’attente ? En somme, grâce à ce téléphone intelligent. Vous pouvez regarder en permanence le résultat de l’imagination brillante des autres (au détriment de la vôtre).
07feae4d-a5cb-449b-8746-e99a8c2cb37e.text_en: I have the naivety to think that a little imagination is not totally absurd when writing novels. Now, in my view, imagination is the goal of two fundamental things: boredom, to which we too often give a bad role, and observation, which is not just a medical term. It turns out that the smartphone, this charming object, so necessary, so vital, is making these two activities of the human brain's slackers—boredom and observation—disappear little by little. Why get bored when you can watch videos of kittens or Facebook notifications of the highest importance in a waiting room? In short, thanks to this smartphone. You can constantly watch the result of others' brilliant imagination (to the detriment of your own).
07feae4d-a5cb-449b-8746-e99a8c2cb37e.question_fr: Quelle est l’attitude de l’auteur vis-à-vis du téléphone intelligent ?
07feae4d-a5cb-449b-8746-e99a8c2cb37e.question_en: What is the author's attitude towards the smartphone?

options.explanation: The author uses words like 'necessary' and 'vital' sarcastically; his primary focus is not on praising the phone's utility but on criticizing its psychological impact.

options.text: Il remet en cause ses bienfaits.
options.explanation: The author challenges the idea that smartphones are purely beneficial by explaining how they deprive humans of the boredom and observation needed to develop their own imagination.

options.text: Il s’inquiète de son usage abusif.
options.text_en: He worries about its abusive use.
options.explanation: The author does not focus on 'overuse' or addiction specifically, but rather on the inherent way the device functions as a constant distraction that replaces personal thought.
The author is critical and ironic throughout the passage; he is not genuinely impressed by the technology, but rather laments what it takes away from the user.

07feae4d-a5cb-449b-8746-e99a8c2cb37e.key_line_fr: Il s’avère que le téléphone intelligent, ce charmant objet, si nécessaire, si vital, fait peu à peu disparaître ces deux activités de fainéants du cerveau humain que sont l’ennui et l’observation.
07feae4d-a5cb-449b-8746-e99a8c2cb37e.key_line_en: It turns out that the smartphone, this charming object, so necessary, so vital, is gradually making those two 'lazy' activities of the human brain—boredom and observation—disappear.
07feae4d-a5cb-449b-8746-e99a8c2cb37e.explanation: The author uses irony to argue that smartphones, while seemingly 'vital,' actually destroy the boredom and observation necessary for human imagination.
07feae4d-a5cb-449b-8746-e99a8c2cb37e.breakdown: The author posits that imagination is born from boredom and observation. He uses sarcasm (calling the smartphone 'charming' and 'vital') to highlight a negative consequence: the device replaces our own creative thoughts with the 'brilliant imagination of others.' By concluding that this happens 'at the expense of your own' imagination, he is fundamentally questioning the perceived benefits of the smartphone.

a2efa318-cb9b-4b79-91c9-8475b4078cd0.question_en: Who will do the photocopies while the photocopier is being repaired?

La ville de Londres s’est offert une tour, emblème des Jeux Olympiques.

This tower is highly criticized; it has already been described as a 'giant paperclip' or a 'gigantic squiggle' by a Times journalist. LE PROGRAMME DESCARTES
Le programme Descartes s’adresse aux élèves français et allemands.
Les Français séjournent dans une famille d’accueil allemande pendant 6 mois et accueillent leur correspondant allemand en France les 6 mois suivants.
Les élèves Descartes fréquentent l’école de leur partenaire.
L’objectif est d’approfondir leurs connaissances linguistiques dans la langue du pays d’accueil et leurs connaissances culturelles sur le pays.
Les jeunes gagnent aussi en autonomie, ouverture d’esprit et tolérance.
L’élève reçoit une aide pour les transports et 250 € pour les dépenses culturelles.
030c7dc2-2f5e-4463-913c-504785a34dc4.text_en:
THE DESCARTES PROGRAM
The Descartes program is aimed at French and German students.
The French students stay with a German host family for 6 months and host their German correspondent in France for the following 6 months.
Descartes students attend their partner's school.
The objective is to deepen their linguistic knowledge in the host country's language and their cultural knowledge about the country.
The young people also gain autonomy, open-mindedness, and tolerance.
The student receives aid for transport and €250 for cultural expenses.

e4794352-0877-4334-879d-cbba178a481f.text:
Draisienne du XXIe siècle
À 88 ans, Jacques Blosseville est le participant le plus âgé de la 100e édition du concours Lépine, qui récompense les inventeurs.
Il a choisi de transformer la draisienne, un vélo sans pédale pour enfant inventé au début du XIXe siècle.
« Il y a trois ans, j’ai commencé à me déplacer avec peine.
On m’a proposé une canne, puis un fauteuil roulant, mais ça ne me convenait pas.
La draisienne vous permet de ne pas avoir à supporter votre poids », explique le concurrent.
e4794352-0877-4334-879d-cbba178a481f.text_en: At 88, Jacques Blosseville is the oldest participant in the 100th edition of the Lépine competition, which rewards inventors. He chose to transform the draisienne, a pedal-less bike for children invented in the early 19th century. "Three years ago, I started moving with difficulty. I was offered a cane, then a wheelchair, but that didn't suit me. The balance bike allows you not to have to bear your weight," explains the competitor.
e4794352-0877-4334-879d-cbba178a481f.question_fr: Dans quel but Jacques Blosseville a-t-il modernisé la draisienne ?
e4794352-0877-4334-879d-cbba178a481f.question_en: For what purpose did Jacques Blosseville modernize the balance bike?

options.explanation: The text does not mention driving cars or traffic.
While the text mentions the draisienne was originally invented for children, Jacques modified it for his own use as an elderly person, not to entertain children.
Jacques mentions moving "avec peine" (with difficulty/pain) and says the bike relieves his weight. This aligns with the goal of walking without suffering.
The text says the bike supports 'votre poids' (your weight/body weight), not external heavy objects.

e4794352-0877-4334-879d-cbba178a481f.key_line_fr: La draisienne vous permet de ne pas avoir à supporter votre poids
e4794352-0877-4334-879d-cbba178a481f.key_line_en: The balance bike allows you not to have to bear your weight
e4794352-0877-4334-879d-cbba178a481f.explanation: Jacques modernized the bike because he had difficulty moving ('se déplacer avec peine'). The bike supports his body weight, allowing him to walk without the pain/effort normally required.
e4794352-0877-4334-879d-cbba178a481f.breakdown:
1.  **Identify the problem**: The text states, "Il y a trois ans, j’ai commencé à me déplacer avec peine" (Three years ago, I started moving with difficulty/pain).
2.  **Identify the solution's function**: Jacques explains, "La draisienne vous permet de ne pas avoir à supporter votre poids" (The balance bike allows you not to have to bear your weight).
3.  **Match with options**: Since he had trouble moving (walking) and the device relieves the weight, the purpose is to allow him to move (walk) without the associated difficulty or suffering. Option C matches this logic.

L’AGRICULTURE BIOLOGIQUE, TOUT LE MONDE EN VEUT, MAIS L’AGRICULTURE FRANÇAISE LA BOUDE.
64 % des Français ont acheté bio au moins une fois.
Devant l’insuffisance de certaines productions, notamment de fruits et légumes, il faut importer 32 % des produits labellisés.
Le bio en France ne concerne qu’un million d’hectares.
D’ambitieux objectifs ont été fixés, mais le ministre de l’Agriculture s’est contenté de viser un doublement des surfaces d’ici à la fin du quinquennat.
« Ces objectifs sont modestes, mais atteignables au moins », indique le président de la Fédération nationale d’agriculture biologique (FNAB).
4b6deefa-5805-4087-8b4e-f80a0a1d0eb2.text_en:
ORGANIC FARMING, EVERYONE WANTS IT, BUT FRENCH AGRICULTURE SHUNS IT.
64% of French people have bought organic at least once.
Faced with the insufficiency of certain productions, notably fruits and vegetables, 32% of certified products must be imported.
Organic in France concerns only one million hectares.
Ambitious goals have been set, but the Minister of Agriculture has contented himself with aiming for a doubling of surface areas by the end of the five-year term.
"These goals are modest, but reachable at least," indicates the president of the National Federation of Organic Agriculture (FNAB).
4b6deefa-5805-4087-8b4e-f80a0a1d0eb2.question_fr: Quel est l’objectif des mesures gouvernementales en matière d’agriculture biologique ?
4b6deefa-5805-4087-8b4e-f80a0a1d0eb2.question_en: What is the objective of the governmental measures regarding organic agriculture?

options.text: Exporter davantage de produits biologiques nationaux.
options.explanation: The text states France currently needs to *import* due to shortages. The priority is filling domestic gaps, not exporting.

options.text: Inciter à la consommation de produits biologiques.
options.text_en: Encourage the consumption of organic products.
options.explanation: Demand is already high ('Everyone wants it', 64% purchase rate). The text focuses on the lack of supply, not the need to boost demand.

options.text: Satisfaire la demande en produits biologiques locaux.
options.text_en: Satisfy the demand for local organic products.
options.explanation: The text explicitly mentions the 'insufficiency' of production leading to imports. The government's plan to double farming surface areas aims to fix this by increasing local production to meet the market needs.

options.text: Simplifier la certification des produits biologiques.
options.text_en: Simplify the certification of organic products.
options.explanation: There is no mention of administrative processes, labels, or certification rules being changed in the text.

4b6deefa-5805-4087-8b4e-f80a0a1d0eb2.key_line_fr: Devant l’insuffisance de certaines productions, notamment de fruits et légumes, il faut importer 32 % des produits labellisés.
4b6deefa-5805-4087-8b4e-f80a0a1d0eb2.key_line_en: Faced with the insufficiency of certain productions, notably fruits and vegetables, 32% of certified products must be imported.
4b6deefa-5805-4087-8b4e-f80a0a1d0eb2.explanation: The text states that France has to import organic food because local production is insufficient. The government's plan to increase farming area aims to solve this shortage and satisfy local demand.
4b6deefa-5805-4087-8b4e-f80a0a1d0eb2.breakdown:

2. The government measure mentioned is 'aiming for a doubling of surface areas' for organic farming.
