99a1331a-a080-4689-8b08-e5497533283c.text:
Le sport arrive largement en tête des nombreuses activités extrascolaires proposées aux 12-16 ans.
Les parents se font une obligation sociale d’inscrire leurs enfants à ces activités et de montrer aux autres qu’ils sont de « bons parents » qui veillent à l’épanouissement global de leurs enfants.
Ils leur permettent ainsi de se divertir, de se dépenser, et de s’initier à un sport individuel ou collectif.
C’est également l’occasion pour les enfants de découvrir et d’accepter leurs propres limites.
99a1331a-a080-4689-8b08-e5497533283c.text_en: Sport comes largely at the top of the many extracurricular activities proposed to 12-16 year olds. Parents make it a social obligation to enroll their children in these activities and to show others that they are "good parents" who look after the overall fulfillment of their children. They thus allow them to have fun, to burn off energy, and to be introduced to an individual or team sport. It is also the opportunity for children to discover and accept their own limits.
99a1331a-a080-4689-8b08-e5497533283c.question_fr: Qu’est-ce qui incite les parents à inscrire leurs enfants à des activités sportives ?
99a1331a-a080-4689-8b08-e5497533283c.question_en: What motivates parents to enroll their children in sports activities?

options.explanation: The text mentions a 'social obligation' and the need to 'show others' they are good parents, which is the definition of social pressure.
The text does not mention the reputation of the clubs.
While 'burning energy' is mentioned as a result, the explicit motivation for the parents described is social appearance ('obligation sociale'), not health per se.
The text focuses on the parents' decision-making and social image, not the requests or desires of the teenagers.

99a1331a-a080-4689-8b08-e5497533283c.key_line_fr: Les parents se font une obligation sociale d’inscrire leurs enfants à ces activités et de montrer aux autres qu’ils sont de « bons parents » qui veillent à l’épanouissement global de leurs enfants.
99a1331a-a080-4689-8b08-e5497533283c.key_line_en: Parents make it a social obligation to enroll their children in these activities and to show others that they are "good parents" who look after the overall fulfillment of their children.

vocabulary.gloss: to burn off energy / exert oneself

99a1331a-a080-4689-8b08-e5497533283c.explanation: The text states parents feel a 'social obligation' to enroll their kids to prove to others they are 'good parents,' which aligns with societal pressure.
99a1331a-a080-4689-8b08-e5497533283c.breakdown: The question asks what motivates parents. The text explicitly states that parents consider it a 'social obligation' ('se font une obligation sociale') and want to 'show others' ('montrer aux autres') that they are good parents. This desire to conform to social expectations and prove one's parenting quality to others corresponds directly to 'social pressure'. While the text mentions children having fun or burning energy, these are the results, not the primary motivation ascribed to the parents in the second sentence.

4e9097e5-828c-4b6f-b692-a5e868e68128.text:
Parcourir un roman n’est pas qu’une distraction.
Votre cerveau a besoin de stimulation pour garder ses pleines capacités.
Certaines études montrent d’ailleurs que cela diminue le risque de déclenchement de la maladie d’Alzheimer.
Ce passe-temps offre aussi un remède au stress, car lire vous éloigne de vos soucis et détend.
C’est d’ailleurs souvent un agréable prélude au sommeil.
Évidemment, lire accroît aussi votre vocabulaire, votre orthographe et votre culture générale : des atouts qui font la différence dans votre vie professionnelle.
Cela permet aussi de renforcer vos capacités d’analyse, de mémorisation et de concentration tout comme votre capacité à reconnaître les émotions des autres.
4e9097e5-828c-4b6f-b692-a5e868e68128.text_en: Reading a novel is not just a distraction. Your brain needs stimulation to keep its full capabilities. Some studies show that this decreases the risk of triggering Alzheimer's disease. This hobby also offers a remedy for stress, because reading takes you away from your worries and relaxes. It is also often a pleasant prelude to sleep. Obviously, reading also increases your vocabulary, your spelling and your general culture: assets that make the difference in your professional life. It also allows reinforcing your capacities for analysis, memorization and concentration as well as your capacity to recognize the emotions of others.
4e9097e5-828c-4b6f-b692-a5e868e68128.question_fr: Que démontre l’auteur de cet article à propos de la lecture ?
4e9097e5-828c-4b6f-b692-a5e868e68128.question_en: What does the author of this article demonstrate about reading?

options.text: C’est une activité qui enrichit l’imagination.
options.text_en: It is an activity that enriches imagination.
options.explanation: While often true in general, the text does not explicitly state that reading enriches imagination.
The text lists benefits like improved professional assets and reinforced cognitive capacities (analysis, memory), which equates to improved performance.

options.text: Il est difficile de s’y livrer si on est angoissé.
options.text_en: It is difficult to engage in it if one is anxious.
options.explanation: The text contradicts this by stating reading is a 'remedy for stress' and 'takes you away from your worries'.

options.text: Sa pratique exige des connaissances variées.
options.explanation: The text states reading 'increases' general culture, not that it requires varied knowledge beforehand.

4e9097e5-828c-4b6f-b692-a5e868e68128.key_line_fr: Cela permet aussi de renforcer vos capacités d’analyse, de mémorisation et de concentration tout comme votre capacité à reconnaître les émotions des autres.
4e9097e5-828c-4b6f-b692-a5e868e68128.key_line_en: It also allows reinforcing your capacities for analysis, memorization and concentration as well as your capacity to recognize the emotions of others.
4e9097e5-828c-4b6f-b692-a5e868e68128.explanation: The text focuses on how reading strengthens cognitive skills and professional assets, which translates to improving one's performance.
4e9097e5-828c-4b6f-b692-a5e868e68128.breakdown: The text enumerates various benefits of reading. It mentions that reading provides 'assets that make the difference in your professional life' (vocabulary, spelling) and 'reinforces your capacities for analysis, memorization, and concentration'. These points directly support the idea that reading improves one's capabilities and performance. The other options are either not mentioned (imagination), contradicted (anxiety), or reversed (knowledge requirement).

169562e4-2750-464f-9ca2-45adca207494.text:
Envie de faire le clown ?
Pendant les vacances de Pâques, l’équipe d’animateurs du centre de loisirs dessinera chaque jour sur les joues des enfants des animaux marins : hippocampes, phoques, manchots, poissons-clowns…
169562e4-2750-464f-9ca2-45adca207494.text_en: Want to clown around? During the Easter holidays, the recreation center's team of animators will draw marine animals on the children's cheeks every day: seahorses, seals, penguins, clownfish...
169562e4-2750-464f-9ca2-45adca207494.question_fr: Quelle activité proposera-t-on aux enfants pendant les vacances de Pâques ?
169562e4-2750-464f-9ca2-45adca207494.question_en: What activity will be proposed to the children during the Easter holidays?

options.explanation: The title uses 'faire le clown' idiomatically, but there is no mention of a circus performance.
The text describes drawing on children's cheeks ('dessinera... sur les joues'), which constitutes a face painting activity.
'Poissons-clowns' refers to clownfish, not an actual clown person.
Animals (seals, penguins) are mentioned only as drawings, not as live animals to visit.

169562e4-2750-464f-9ca2-45adca207494.key_line_fr: l’équipe d’animateurs du centre de loisirs dessinera chaque jour sur les joues des enfants des animaux marins
169562e4-2750-464f-9ca2-45adca207494.key_line_en: the recreation center's team of animators will draw marine animals on the children's cheeks every day
169562e4-2750-464f-9ca2-45adca207494.explanation: The text explicitly states that animators will draw on children's cheeks, which corresponds to face painting (maquillage).
169562e4-2750-464f-9ca2-45adca207494.breakdown:
1. Analyze the core action in the text: 'dessinera chaque jour sur les joues des enfants' (will draw every day on the children's cheeks).
2. Relate the action to the options: Drawing on cheeks is the definition of face painting ('maquillage').
3. Eliminate distractors: The title mentions 'clown' (Option C) and the text lists animals (Option D), but the activity itself is the act of drawing/painting on the face. 'Cirque' (Option A) is not mentioned.

3165faf0-e6eb-4b78-ba04-5ebabdec9df9.text:
Outre-Manche, une jeune députée a attiré l’attention des médias et des photographes en proposant un décret qui imposerait la mention « retouchée numériquement » sur toutes les photos corrigées.
Le parti libéral démocratique a d’ailleurs approuvé cette proposition.
« Je ne veux pas interdire aux publicitaires de recourir à des mannequins plus beaux que la femme de tous les jours, mais il y a une différence entre choisir la beauté et retoucher cette beauté pour atteindre des proportions impossibles en ce qui concerne, par exemple, la taille des jambes », s’insurge la députée.
3165faf0-e6eb-4b78-ba04-5ebabdec9df9.text_en: Across the Channel, a young MP has attracted the attention of the media and photographers by proposing a decree that would impose the mention 'digitally retouched' on all corrected photos. The Liberal Democrat party has incidentally approved this proposal. 'I do not want to forbid advertisers from resorting to models more beautiful than the everyday woman, but there is a difference between choosing beauty and retouching that beauty to reach impossible proportions regarding, for example, the length of the legs,' insists the MP.
3165faf0-e6eb-4b78-ba04-5ebabdec9df9.question_fr: Que propose cette députée à propos des publicités mettant en scène des femmes ?
3165faf0-e6eb-4b78-ba04-5ebabdec9df9.question_en: What does this MP propose regarding advertisements featuring women?

options.text: D’interdire les photos portant atteinte à leur dignité.
options.text_en: To ban photos infringing on their dignity.
options.explanation: The text focuses on technical retouching and impossible proportions, but the specific proposal is about labeling, not a legal ban based on dignity.

options.text: De diversifier le type de femmes prises pour modèles.
options.text_en: To diversify the type of women used as models.
options.explanation: The MP explicitly states she does *not* want to forbid advertisers from using models who are 'more beautiful than the everyday woman'.

options.text: De mentionner les références précises des produits.
options.text_en: To mention precise references of the products.
options.explanation: The text does not mention anything about listing product references.

options.text: De signaler sur les photos les modifications effectuées.
options.text_en: To indicate on the photos the modifications made.
options.explanation: The proposal specifically calls for a label ('mention') on photos that have been 'corrected' or 'retouched', which is exactly what signaling modifications means.

3165faf0-e6eb-4b78-ba04-5ebabdec9df9.key_line_fr: imposerait la mention « retouchée numériquement » sur toutes les photos corrigées
3165faf0-e6eb-4b78-ba04-5ebabdec9df9.key_line_en: would impose the mention 'digitally retouched' on all corrected photos

vocabulary.gloss: Across the Channel (referring to the UK)

3165faf0-e6eb-4b78-ba04-5ebabdec9df9.explanation: The MP wants a mandatory label on photos that have been digitally altered, which corresponds to signaling the modifications made.
3165faf0-e6eb-4b78-ba04-5ebabdec9df9.breakdown:
1.  **Identify the main action**: The text states the MP is proposing a decree ('proposant un décret').
2.  **Find the specific detail of the proposal**: The text says the decree would impose the mention 'digitally retouched' on all corrected photos ('imposerait la mention « retouchée numériquement » sur toutes les photos corrigées').
3.  **Match with options**: Option D suggests 'signaling on the photos the modifications made'.
4.  **Verify synonyms**: 'Signaler' (to signal/indicate) matches 'imposer la mention' (impose the label), and 'modifications effectuées' (modifications made) matches 'retouchée numériquement' (digitally retouched).

0d02e1ab-198a-4a88-a109-dcbe6e0f144f.text:
En quelques années, le camping est devenu le premier mode d’hébergement touristique, devant les hôtels, les résidences et les villages de vacances.
« Les familles qui louaient des villas ou partaient à l’hôtel choisissent de plus en plus ce type de séjour en plein air et tout compris », déclare un expert.
Ces nouveaux adeptes du camping, souvent plus fortunés, se tournent vers les tentes meublées, chalets et mobil-homes classés 3 à 5 étoiles qui existaient peu auparavant.
Il y a quelques années, certains avaient honte de dire : « Je suis allé au camping. » Aujourd’hui, ce n’est plus vrai.
0d02e1ab-198a-4a88-a109-dcbe6e0f144f.text_en: In a few years, camping has become the leading mode of tourist accommodation, ahead of hotels, residences, and holiday villages. "Families who used to rent villas or go to hotels are increasingly choosing this type of open-air, all-inclusive stay," declares an expert. These new camping enthusiasts, often wealthier, are turning to furnished tents, chalets, and mobile homes rated 3 to 5 stars, which rarely existed before. A few years ago, some people were ashamed to say: "I went camping." Today, that is no longer true.
0d02e1ab-198a-4a88-a109-dcbe6e0f144f.question_fr: Que constate l’expert à propos du camping ?
0d02e1ab-198a-4a88-a109-dcbe6e0f144f.question_en: What does the expert observe about camping?

options.text: Le confort a été très nettement amélioré.
options.explanation: The text describes a shift towards 'furnished tents', 'chalets', and '3 to 5 star' ratings, attracting people who usually go to hotels. This indicates a clear upgrade in comfort.
The text mentions 'open air' (plein air), but does not explicitly claim the accommodation is ecological or that ecology is the expert's main point.
While these luxury options 'rarely existed before', the focus is on the upgrade in standards (stars/furniture) enticing wealthy clients, rather than the services simply being novel/unprecedented.

options.text: Les prix deviennent de plus en plus attractifs.
options.text_en: Prices are becoming more and more attractive.
options.explanation: The text states the new campers are often 'wealthier' (plus fortunés), suggesting they are not necessarily driven by low prices.

0d02e1ab-198a-4a88-a109-dcbe6e0f144f.key_line_fr: Ces nouveaux adeptes du camping, souvent plus fortunés, se tournent vers les tentes meublées, chalets et mobil-homes classés 3 à 5 étoiles qui existaient peu auparavant.
0d02e1ab-198a-4a88-a109-dcbe6e0f144f.key_line_en: These new camping enthusiasts, often wealthier, are turning to furnished tents, chalets, and mobile homes rated 3 to 5 stars, which rarely existed before.
0d02e1ab-198a-4a88-a109-dcbe6e0f144f.explanation: The text highlights that camping now offers 3 to 5-star accommodations (chalets, furnished tents) attracting wealthy clients who used to stay in hotels, which signifies a major improvement in comfort.
0d02e1ab-198a-4a88-a109-dcbe6e0f144f.breakdown:
1. The expert notes that families who previously chose **villas** or **hotels** are now choosing camping.
2. The text explains that these new campers are **wealthier** ('plus fortunés') and choose accommodations rated **3 to 5 stars** ('classés 3 à 5 étoiles') like furnished tents and chalets.
3. Comparing camping to hotels and mentioning 3-5 star ratings directly implies a significant increase in **comfort** and quality standards.
4. Therefore, the observation is that comfort has been improved to attract this new demographic.

c5c776ce-95eb-4f06-96d4-12fa33fee1e7.text:
Certaines grandes surfaces ont désigné un coach antigaspi au sein du personnel, ont cassé les prix des produits à date de péremption proche, ont réduit le nombre d’articles en rayon et ont proposé les fruits et légumes en vrac.
Ces mesures ont permis de réduire les pertes alimentaires de 22 % en trois mois !
Les solutions pour lutter contre le gaspillage en grande distribution existent donc bel et bien.
Des initiatives similaires, dont les résultats devraient paraître prochainement, sont en cours dans d’autres secteurs (industries agroalimentaires, producteurs, etc.).
c5c776ce-95eb-4f06-96d4-12fa33fee1e7.text_en: Some supermarkets have designated an anti-waste coach among the staff, slashed prices on products nearing their expiration date, reduced the number of items on shelves, and offered fruits and vegetables in bulk. These measures allowed for a 22% reduction in food losses in three months! Solutions to fight against waste in large-scale distribution therefore clearly exist. Similar initiatives, the results of which should appear soon, are underway in other sectors (agri-food industries, producers, etc.).
c5c776ce-95eb-4f06-96d4-12fa33fee1e7.question_fr: Selon cet article, quel type d’action faudrait-il poursuivre ?
c5c776ce-95eb-4f06-96d4-12fa33fee1e7.question_en: According to this article, what type of action should be pursued?

options.explanation: The passage lists specific strategies used by stores (bulk selling, discounting expiring goods), which are definitionally sales practices.
The text focuses on the initiatives taken by the distributors/stores, not the behavioral changes of the customers.
The text addresses 'waste' (gaspillage), not the healthiness or nutritional value of the food.
The measures mentioned are about preventing waste during the sales process (anti-waste), not recycling waste after it occurs.

c5c776ce-95eb-4f06-96d4-12fa33fee1e7.key_line_fr: Certaines grandes surfaces ont désigné un coach antigaspi au sein du personnel, ont cassé les prix des produits à date de péremption proche, ont réduit le nombre d’articles en rayon et ont proposé les fruits et légumes en vrac.
c5c776ce-95eb-4f06-96d4-12fa33fee1e7.key_line_en: Some supermarkets have designated an anti-waste coach among the staff, slashed prices on products nearing their expiration date, reduced the number of items on shelves, and offered fruits and vegetables in bulk.
c5c776ce-95eb-4f06-96d4-12fa33fee1e7.explanation: The article describes supermarkets implementing new methods like bulk selling and discounts to cut waste, which are new sales practices.
c5c776ce-95eb-4f06-96d4-12fa33fee1e7.breakdown: The text lists specific measures taken by supermarkets ('grandes surfaces') to reduce waste: lowering prices on near-expiry items, reducing shelf inventory, and selling produce in bulk. These are changes in how products are sold to customers. Therefore, the actions described are 'sales practices' (pratiques de vente). The text highlights the success of these retailer-led operational changes.

b467def4-fa47-4a55-85be-51f6c00487b8.text:
MARCO LENO
139 avenue d’Italie
75013 Paris
Société immobilière
30 boulevard Raspail
75007 Paris
Paris, le 26 janvier
Monsieur,
Je vous écris pour vous faire part des nuisances sonores provoquées par les locataires du 7ème étage.
Ils écoutent de la musique jusque tard dans la nuit à un volume qui ne permet pas de dormir dans de bonnes conditions. Je leur ai demandé plusieurs fois de baisser le son et de faire attention à l’heure, mais ils ne m’ont pas écouté.
Je vous demande de bien vouloir agir afin qu’ils changent de comportement au plus vite.
Cordialement,
Marco Leno
b467def4-fa47-4a55-85be-51f6c00487b8.text_en:
MARCO LENO
139 avenue d’Italie, 75013 Paris

Real Estate Company
30 boulevard Raspail, 75007 Paris

Paris, January 26th

Sir,
I am writing to inform you of the noise nuisance caused by the tenants on the 7th floor.
They listen to music until late at night at a volume that does not allow for sleeping in good conditions. I have asked them several times to lower the sound and watch the time, but they did not listen to me.
I ask you to please take action so that they change their behavior as soon as possible.

Sincerely,
Marco Leno
b467def4-fa47-4a55-85be-51f6c00487b8.question_fr: Quel est l’objet de ce courrier ?
b467def4-fa47-4a55-85be-51f6c00487b8.question_en: What is the purpose of this letter?

options.text: C’est un dépôt de plainte destiné aux services de police.
options.text_en: It is a complaint filed with the police services.
options.explanation: The letter is addressed to a 'Société immobilière' (Real Estate Company), not the police services.

options.text: C’est une lettre de menace destinée à des voisins bruyants.
options.text_en: It is a threat letter intended for noisy neighbors.
options.explanation: The letter is about the neighbors, but it is addressed to the management company, not sent to the neighbors themselves.

options.text: C’est une mise en demeure destinée à un propriétaire.
options.text_en: It is a formal notice intended for a landlord.
options.explanation: A 'mise en demeure' is a specific legal formal notice. This is a standard complaint letter. Furthermore, the recipient is a company (manager), not necessarily the individual owner.

options.text: C’est une réclamation destinée au gérant d’un immeuble.
options.text_en: It is a complaint intended for a building manager.
options.explanation: The sender is writing to the real estate company ('gérant' or manager) to report a problem ('réclamation') regarding noise.

b467def4-fa47-4a55-85be-51f6c00487b8.key_line_fr: Je vous écris pour vous faire part des nuisances sonores provoquées par les locataires du 7ème étage.
b467def4-fa47-4a55-85be-51f6c00487b8.key_line_en: I am writing to inform you of the noise nuisance caused by the tenants on the 7th floor.
b467def4-fa47-4a55-85be-51f6c00487b8.explanation: The letter is addressed to a real estate company (building manager) to complain about noise from other tenants.
b467def4-fa47-4a55-85be-51f6c00487b8.breakdown:
1. **Identify the recipient**: The letter is addressed to 'Société immobilière' (Real Estate Company), not the police or a specific individual owner.
2. **Identify the content**: The writer complains about 'nuisances sonores' (noise pollution) from neighbors ('locataires du 7ème étage').
3. **Identify the intent**: The writer asks the company to intervene ('agir').
4. **Match with options**: This is not a police report (A), not a letter sent directly to the neighbors (B), and 'réclamation' (complaint/claim) to a manager fits better than a legal 'mise en demeure' (formal notice) to an owner (C). Ideally, a 'Société immobilière' acts as the building manager ('gérant').

4785d99c-0573-4e3a-b5ce-a3ab9568041e.text:
DIRECTION L’ITALIE POUR DÉCOUVRIR LA BRIGADE DES FROMAGES
Un département entier de policiers situé à Rome traque les imitations alimentaires et notamment celle du plus célèbre des fromages italiens, le parmesan.
Ils ont, en effet, fort à faire avec des meules de parmesan AOP (Appellation d’Origine Protégée) qui peuvent valoir plusieurs milliers d’euros.
Le parmesan représente 900 ans de tradition concentrés entre les mains de 350 fabricants dans le nord de la péninsule, un savoir fièrement défendu par cette brigade.
4785d99c-0573-4e3a-b5ce-a3ab9568041e.text_en:
Heading to Italy to discover the Cheese Brigade
A whole police department located in Rome tracks food imitations and notably that of the most famous of Italian cheeses, Parmesan. They have, in fact, a lot to do with AOP (Protected Designation of Origin) Parmesan wheels which can be worth several thousand euros. Parmesan represents 900 years of tradition concentrated in the hands of 350 manufacturers in the north of the peninsula, a know-how proudly defended by this brigade.
4785d99c-0573-4e3a-b5ce-a3ab9568041e.question_fr: Quel est l’objectif de cette brigade spéciale ?
4785d99c-0573-4e3a-b5ce-a3ab9568041e.question_en: What is the objective of this special brigade?

options.text: Contrôler la qualité sanitaire des fromages.
options.text_en: To control the sanitary quality of cheeses.
options.explanation: The text focuses on authenticity and fraud ("imitations"), not on health or sanitary inspections.

options.text: Empêcher le trafic des fromages de contrebande.
options.text_en: To prevent the trafficking of contraband cheeses.
options.explanation: The brigade tracks "food imitations." Fighting against counterfeit products equates to stopping the traffic of illegal/contraband goods.

options.text: Enquêter sur les vols de fromages de luxe.
options.text_en: To investigate thefts of luxury cheeses.
options.explanation: The text mentions the high monetary value to explain why fakes are profitable, not to indicate they are investigating theft (burglary).

options.text: Protéger les secrets d’élaboration des fromages.
options.text_en: To protect the secrets of cheese making.
options.explanation: The brigade defends the "know-how" by stopping fakes, but their objective is law enforcement against imitations, not guarding the manufacturing secrets themselves.

4785d99c-0573-4e3a-b5ce-a3ab9568041e.key_line_fr: Un département entier de policiers situé à Rome traque les imitations alimentaires et notamment celle du plus célèbre des fromages italiens, le parmesan.
4785d99c-0573-4e3a-b5ce-a3ab9568041e.key_line_en: A whole police department located in Rome tracks food imitations and notably that of the most famous of Italian cheeses, Parmesan.
4785d99c-0573-4e3a-b5ce-a3ab9568041e.explanation: The text explicitly states that the police department tracks "food imitations." This aligns with preventing the illegal traffic (contraband) of fake products.
4785d99c-0573-4e3a-b5ce-a3ab9568041e.breakdown:
1.  **Analyze the specific mission**: The first sentence states the police department "traque les imitations alimentaires" (tracks food imitations). 
2.  **Analyze the context**: It mentions Parmesan AOP (Protected Designation of Origin), implying a legal protection of the brand/origin against fakes.
3.  **Evaluate Option A**: The text mentions nothing about hygiene or sanitary quality.
4.  **Evaluate Option B**: "Contrebande" (contraband) and "trafic" refer to the illegal trade of goods. Since the police are fighting "imitations" (counterfeits) of high-value goods, this falls under the category of illicit traffic/contraband.
5.  **Evaluate Option C**: While the text mentions the high value (thousands of euros), the explicit action is tracking "imitations," not investigating "vols" (thefts).
6.  **Evaluate Option D**: While "savoir" (know-how) is mentioned, the police's active role is law enforcement against fakes, not the intellectual preservation of the recipe secrets.

e1cc29a2-c0d6-4133-bbc9-661eef82b695.text:
La sonorité naturelle qui berce l’océan depuis des millions d’années a presque disparu, éclipsée par les bruits artificiels générés depuis l’ère industrielle.
Le bioacousticien Michel André alerte sur cette nuisance invisible qui menace la vie marine : la cacophonie engendrée par les activités humaines.
À la différence de la lumière qui ne pénètre qu’à quelques mètres sous l’eau et n’est d’aucune utilité pour transmettre des informations sur de longues distances, le son, lui, se propage à des centaines de kilomètres.
Heureusement, le bruit, dès qu’on le coupe, n’a plus aucun effet. Si nous travaillons sur des méthodes pour éliminer ces sons produits par les êtres humains, la nuisance pourrait être diminuée.
e1cc29a2-c0d6-4133-bbc9-661eef82b695.text_en: The natural sound that has rocked the ocean for millions of years has almost disappeared, eclipsed by artificial noises generated since the industrial era. Bioacoustician Michel André warns about this invisible nuisance threatening marine life: the cacophony generated by human activities. Unlike light, which only penetrates a few meters underwater and is useless for transmitting information over long distances, sound propagates for hundreds of kilometers. Fortunately, noise, as soon as it is cut, has no further effect. If we work on methods to eliminate these sounds produced by humans, the nuisance could be diminished.
e1cc29a2-c0d6-4133-bbc9-661eef82b695.question_fr: De quoi est-il question dans cet article ?

options.explanation: The text mentions sound transmits information, but the article focuses on noise as a threat/pollution, not on a new way to communicate.

options.text: D’un système de guidage par ondes.
options.explanation: The text does not mention a guidance system.
The text mentions potential future methods to reduce noise, but the main topic is the noise itself, not a specific technological innovation.
The text describes the noise as a "nuisance invisible" (invisible nuisance) caused by humans, which matches the definition of imperceptible (invisible) pollution.

e1cc29a2-c0d6-4133-bbc9-661eef82b695.key_line_fr: Le bioacousticien Michel André alerte sur cette nuisance invisible qui menace la vie marine : la cacophonie engendrée par les activités humaines.
e1cc29a2-c0d6-4133-bbc9-661eef82b695.key_line_en: Bioacoustician Michel André warns about this invisible nuisance threatening marine life: the cacophony generated by human activities.
e1cc29a2-c0d6-4133-bbc9-661eef82b695.explanation: The article describes human-made ocean noise as an "invisible nuisance" threatening marine life, which corresponds directly to the concept of imperceptible pollution.
e1cc29a2-c0d6-4133-bbc9-661eef82b695.breakdown:
1.  **Identify the core subject**: The text discusses "bruits artificiels" (artificial noises) and "cacophonie" (cacophony) caused by human activity in the ocean.
2.  **Locate key descriptions**: The text explicitly calls this a "nuisance invisible" (invisible nuisance) that threatens marine life.
3.  **Match with options**: 
    *   Option A focuses on communication, which is mentioned only to contrast light vs. sound physics, not as the main topic.
    *   Option B is irrelevant.
    *   Option C mentions innovation, but the text focuses on the problem, not a specific new tech.
    *   Option D uses "pollution imperceptible" (imperceptible pollution). This is a synonym for the text's "nuisance invisible" (invisible nuisance/harm).

6d2edde7-3112-43d2-9a3c-8e6ffe306e44.text:
Deux petites saisons et puis s’en vont.
Sur les plates-formes de streaming vidéo par abonnement, les séries ont beau être reines, elles n’en sont pas moins soumises à rude concurrence.
Et leur durée de vie peut se révéler bien plus courte que sur les chaînes traditionnelles.
Cette stratégie ne doit rien au hasard.
Dans leur objectif de conquête de nouveaux abonnés, les plates-formes accordent en effet plus de vertus à la nouveauté qu’à la longévité.
Quitte à décevoir certains fans qui payent un service de streaming spécialisé dont le baromètre de satisfaction devrait en théorie être plus important que celui de l’audimat.
6d2edde7-3112-43d2-9a3c-8e6ffe306e44.text_en: Two short seasons and then they're gone. On subscription video streaming platforms, even though series are kings, they are nonetheless subject to tough competition. And their lifespan can turn out to be much shorter than on traditional channels. This strategy owes nothing to chance. In their goal of conquering new subscribers, platforms indeed accord more virtues to novelty than to longevity. Even if it means disappointing certain fans who pay for a specialized streaming service whose satisfaction barometer should in theory be more important than that of audience ratings.
6d2edde7-3112-43d2-9a3c-8e6ffe306e44.question_fr: D’après l’article, que privilégient les plates-formes de streaming ?
6d2edde7-3112-43d2-9a3c-8e6ffe306e44.question_en: According to the article, what do streaming platforms favor?

options.explanation: The text explicitly states the opposite: platforms value novelty more than longevity ('plus de vertus à la nouveauté qu’à la longévité').
While quality might be important generally, the text focuses on the strategic preference for 'novelty' and new content turnover, not service quality itself.
The text highlights that platforms prefer 'novelty' and that series often have short lifespans ('durée de vie... bien plus courte'). This strategy necessitates frequently changing series.

The text notes that this strategy is pursued 'Quitte à décevoir certains fans' (Even if it means disappointing some fans), indicating subscriber contentment is not the primary driver compared to acquiring new ones.

6d2edde7-3112-43d2-9a3c-8e6ffe306e44.key_line_fr: Dans leur objectif de conquête de nouveaux abonnés, les plates-formes accordent en effet plus de vertus à la nouveauté qu’à la longévité.
6d2edde7-3112-43d2-9a3c-8e6ffe306e44.key_line_en: In their goal of conquering new subscribers, platforms indeed accord more virtues to novelty than to longevity.
6d2edde7-3112-43d2-9a3c-8e6ffe306e44.explanation: The article explains that streaming platforms prioritize novelty (new content) over keeping shows running for a long time to attract new subscribers, which aligns with regularly changing series.
6d2edde7-3112-43d2-9a3c-8e6ffe306e44.breakdown: The text discusses the strategy of streaming platforms regarding their series. Specifically, it mentions that their goal is to acquire new subscribers ('conquête de nouveaux abonnés'). The pivotal sentence states: 'les plates-formes accordent en effet plus de vertus à la nouveauté qu’à la longévité' (platforms indeed accord more virtues to novelty than to longevity). Valuing novelty over longevity implies constantly introducing new shows and ending old ones (short lifespan), which corresponds to 'Le changement régulier des séries' (The regular changing of series).

896a9a6a-1fc2-436c-bb5f-73d7e5305841.text:
Le numérique bouleverse profondément l’enseignement, mais, d’après le philosophe Marcel Gauchet, on aura plus que jamais besoin de professeurs et d’écoles.
Excellent moyen de stimuler la curiosité, le numérique pousse à chercher, à creuser encore.
Surtout, il enseigne une chose essentielle : personne ne sait et, nulle part, il n’existe de détenteur ultime du savoir.
Ainsi, les élèves sont de plus en plus en contact avec des sources hétéroclites et cela constitue un changement majeur en termes pédagogiques.
L’enseignant est alors celui qui va expliquer qu’il existe plusieurs versions d’une même chose et que savoir, c’est se confronter à l’incertitude et non réciter bêtement des connaissances.
896a9a6a-1fc2-436c-bb5f-73d7e5305841.text_en: Digital technology is profoundly disrupting education, but according to philosopher Marcel Gauchet, we will need teachers and schools more than ever. An excellent way to stimulate curiosity, digital technology pushes one to search, to dig deeper. Above all, it teaches one essential thing: no one knows, and nowhere does an ultimate holder of knowledge exist. Thus, students are increasingly in contact with heterogeneous sources and this constitutes a major change in pedagogical terms. The teacher is then the one who will explain that there exist several versions of the same thing and that knowing means confronting uncertainty and not stupidly reciting knowledge.
896a9a6a-1fc2-436c-bb5f-73d7e5305841.question_fr: Selon Marcel Gauchet, quel va être le rôle de l’enseignant auprès des élèves ?
896a9a6a-1fc2-436c-bb5f-73d7e5305841.question_en: According to Marcel Gauchet, what will be the teacher's role with the students?

options.explanation: The text states the teacher helps students confront uncertainty and understand that multiple versions of facts exist, which defines critical thinking.
While the text mentions confronting uncertainty, it does not explicitly mention facilitating debates between students.
The text explicitly opposes this by stating the goal is 'not stupidly reciting knowledge'.
There is no mention of exams, grades, or regular evaluation in the text.

896a9a6a-1fc2-436c-bb5f-73d7e5305841.key_line_fr: L’enseignant est alors celui qui va expliquer qu’il existe plusieurs versions d’une même chose et que savoir, c’est se confronter à l’incertitude et non réciter bêtement des connaissances.
896a9a6a-1fc2-436c-bb5f-73d7e5305841.key_line_en: The teacher is then the one who will explain that there exist several versions of the same thing and that knowing means confronting uncertainty and not stupidly reciting knowledge.
896a9a6a-1fc2-436c-bb5f-73d7e5305841.explanation: The teacher guides students to handle uncertain information and multiple viewpoints, which equates to developing critical thinking skills.
896a9a6a-1fc2-436c-bb5f-73d7e5305841.breakdown: The text describes the changing landscape of education due to digital technology. It specifically states in the final sentence that the teacher's role is to explain that there are multiple versions of the same thing and that 'knowing' means confronting uncertainty rather than rote recitation. Teaching students to navigate uncertainty and analyze different sources corresponds to developing their critical thinking (esprit critique), rather than memory or simple evaluation.

0300f492-f215-4bba-987e-60beff965d2a.text:
Les néo-nomades ont souvent moins de 30 ans et vivent dans leur camion ou d’anciens cars scolaires transformés en caravane ou camping-car.
Ces nouveaux voyageurs intermittents vont d’un lieu à l’autre, au gré des impératifs de leur travail, souvent saisonnier, et forment une population hétérogène.
Ils résolvent la difficulté d’accéder à un logement lorsque l’on n’a pas de travail permanent en se posant en marge de notre paysage contemporain : aux abords des routes secondaires, dans la périphérie des villes, le long des rails, sur des friches ou des terrains privés.
Les néo-nomades forment de fait une entité structurée au cœur de notre société individualiste.
0300f492-f215-4bba-987e-60beff965d2a.text_en: Neo-nomads are often under 30 and live in their trucks or old school buses converted into caravans or campers. These new intermittent travelers go from one place to another, according to the imperatives of their work, often seasonal, and form a heterogeneous population. They solve the difficulty of accessing housing when one does not have permanent work by settling on the margins of our contemporary landscape: on the sides of secondary roads, in the outskirts of cities, along rails, on wastelands or private lands. Neo-nomads essentially form a structured entity in the heart of our individualistic society.
0300f492-f215-4bba-987e-60beff965d2a.question_fr: Selon le journaliste, quelle est l’origine du néo-nomadisme ?
0300f492-f215-4bba-987e-60beff965d2a.question_en: According to the journalist, what is the origin of neo-nomadism?

options.explanation: The text mentions they park on roadsides or outskirts, but does not state that an attraction to nature is the reason for their lifestyle.
There is no mention of safety issues or insecurity in urban areas as a motivating factor.

options.text_en: The precariousness of the professional world.
options.explanation: The text links their lifestyle to seasonal jobs and the inability to get housing due to a lack of permanent work, which defines professional precariousness.

options.text: Le désir de vivre en communauté.
options.text_en: The desire to live in a community.
options.explanation: While the text says they form a 'structured entity,' this is a description of the group, not cited as the origin or cause of why they adopted this lifestyle.

0300f492-f215-4bba-987e-60beff965d2a.key_line_fr: Ils résolvent la difficulté d’accéder à un logement lorsque l’on n’a pas de travail permanent en se posant en marge de notre paysage contemporain
0300f492-f215-4bba-987e-60beff965d2a.key_line_en: They solve the difficulty of accessing housing when one does not have permanent work by settling on the margins of our contemporary landscape

vocabulary.gloss: depending on / at the will of

0300f492-f215-4bba-987e-60beff965d2a.explanation: The text attributes the neo-nomadic lifestyle to the necessities of seasonal work and the difficulty of finding housing without a permanent job.
0300f492-f215-4bba-987e-60beff965d2a.breakdown:
1. The question asks for the 'origin' or cause of neo-nomadism.
2. The text states that these travelers move 'au gré des impératifs de leur travail' (according to the imperatives of their work).
3. It explicitly states they adopt this lifestyle to 'résolvent la difficulté d’accéder à un logement lorsque l’on n’a pas de travail permanent' (solve the difficulty of accessing housing when one does not have permanent work).
4. 'Pas de travail permanent' (no permanent work) and 'travail saisonnier' (seasonal work) correspond directly to the concept of 'précarité du monde professionnel' (precariousness of the professional world).

36203f74-de71-4143-84ec-1fd5cebcd4fc.text:
Que pensent les Français de la mobilité territoriale ?
Si la mobilité n’est ni bonne, ni mauvaise en soi, elle peut être perçue de manière radicalement différente en fonction des circonstances dans lesquelles elle se réalise et surtout du fait d’être choisie ou non.
Des mobilités personnelles, professionnelles et spatiales, voulues et recherchées, peuvent être un facteur d’épanouissement individuel et professionnel pour certains groupes favorisés, alors qu’elles peuvent être un facteur de précarité pour les groupes défavorisés, notamment si elles sont subies.
36203f74-de71-4143-84ec-1fd5cebcd4fc.text_en: While mobility is neither good nor bad in itself, it can be perceived in radically different ways depending on the circumstances in which it occurs and, above all, on the fact of being chosen or not. Personal, professional, and spatial mobilities, wanted and sought after, can be a factor of individual and professional fulfillment for certain privileged groups, whereas they can be a factor of precariousness for disadvantaged groups, especially if they are endured.
36203f74-de71-4143-84ec-1fd5cebcd4fc.question_fr: Quand une mobilité territoriale est-elle bien vécue ?

259f118c-56d9-4c07-9d5a-ebccd79c989e.text:
Instaurer un grand oral pour réformer le baccalauréat est un nouveau défi à relever pour le système éducatif français.
L’oral a autant d’importance que l’écrit. Il a ses règles propres et ses méthodes d’apprentissage : selon moi, une quinzaine d’heures suffit avec douze élèves pour arriver à parler debout devant les autres de façon argumentée.
Bien loin d’être un discriminant social, l’oral peut être une formidable opportunité de réussite pour tous les élèves, à condition qu’il s’agisse bien d’une épreuve orale et non d’un écrit transposé à l’oral.
Contrairement aux idées reçues, je ne pense pas que l’oral demande quasiment pas de prérequis ni un quelconque talent de naissance venu d’une fée - y compris sociale - qui se serait penchée sur le bureau.
259f118c-56d9-4c07-9d5a-ebccd79c989e.text_en: Establishing a 'grand oral' to reform the baccalaureate is a new challenge for the French educational system. Oral skills are as important as written ones. It has its own rules and learning methods: in my opinion, about fifteen hours with twelve students is enough to learn to stand up and speak in front of others in an argued manner. Far from being a social discriminator, the oral exam can be a tremendous opportunity for success for all students, provided it is truly an oral test and not a written one transposed to speech. Contrary to popular belief, I do not think that oral skills require almost no prerequisites nor any talent from birth given by a fairy - including a social one - leaning over the cradle.

dd2de530-030d-4eff-a62d-4d20ae0142dc.text:
Le stress, la fatigue, les troubles du sommeil : voilà ce qui menace notre organisme à la suite d’une exposition excessive à une lumière artificielle.
Au contraire, la lumière naturelle influence notre comportement et régit nos processus physiologiques, notre efficacité au quotidien, nos humeurs, jouant donc un rôle fondamental sur notre métabolisme.
Ainsi, par une diminution des effets de fatigue, de stress et par un accroissement de la concentration, nous sommes alors plus réceptifs et attentifs aux différents stimuli que notre organisme pourra plus facilement assimiler.
En entreprise, un aménagement adéquat des bureaux, de préférence dans un environnement préservant au maximum la lumière naturelle, est donc un atout pour nos performances journalières.
dd2de530-030d-4eff-a62d-4d20ae0142dc.text_en: Stress, fatigue, sleep disorders: this is what threatens our organism following excessive exposure to artificial light. On the contrary, natural light influences our behavior and governs our physiological processes, our daily efficiency, our moods, thus playing a fundamental role in our metabolism. Thus, through a reduction in the effects of fatigue and stress and an increase in concentration, we are then more receptive and attentive to the different stimuli that our organism can assimilate more easily. In companies, an adequate layout of offices, preferably in an environment preserving natural light as much as possible, is therefore an asset for our daily performance.
