c7200265-cefd-424c-a4fd-ca156f2519a0.text:
Information importante :
À cause de l’augmentation du nombre de vols de téléphones portables, vous ne pouvez plus les utiliser à l’intérieur du lycée.
Merci de votre compréhension.
Le directeur de l’établissement.
c7200265-cefd-424c-a4fd-ca156f2519a0.text_en: Important information: Due to the increase in the number of mobile phone thefts, you can no longer use them inside the high school. Thank you for your understanding. The school principal.
c7200265-cefd-424c-a4fd-ca156f2519a0.question_fr: Que dit ce texte sur l’utilisation des téléphones portables ?
c7200265-cefd-424c-a4fd-ca156f2519a0.question_en: What does this text say about the use of mobile phones?

options.explanation: 'Autorisée' means authorized. The text says 'ne... plus' (no longer), which indicates the opposite.
'Dangereuse' means dangerous. While 'vols' (thefts) are mentioned as the cause, the text describes a new rule banning usage, not the danger of usage itself.
'Interdite' means forbidden. The phrase 'vous ne pouvez plus' (you can no longer) confirms that usage is now prohibited.
'Limitée' means limited. The text implies a total restriction inside the premises ('à l’intérieur'), not just a limitation.

c7200265-cefd-424c-a4fd-ca156f2519a0.key_line_fr: vous ne pouvez plus les utiliser à l’intérieur du lycée.
c7200265-cefd-424c-a4fd-ca156f2519a0.key_line_en: you can no longer use them inside the high school.
c7200265-cefd-424c-a4fd-ca156f2519a0.explanation: The phrase 'ne pouvez plus' indicates that permission has been revoked, meaning the use of phones is now forbidden.
c7200265-cefd-424c-a4fd-ca156f2519a0.breakdown: The text states 'vous ne pouvez plus les utiliser' (you can no longer use them) inside the high school. The phrase 'ne... plus' combined with 'pouvoir' indicates a cessation of permission, effectively making the action forbidden (interdite). Option C matches this meaning perfectly.

8cc4f757-c457-4364-853e-732487c1fcdb.question_fr: Que faut-il faire pour joindre un conseiller ?
8cc4f757-c457-4364-853e-732487c1fcdb.question_en: What must one do to reach an advisor?

8cc4f757-c457-4364-853e-732487c1fcdb.key_line_fr: parler avec des conseillers du lundi au vendredi de 8 h à 22 h, le samedi de 8 h à 18 h
8cc4f757-c457-4364-853e-732487c1fcdb.key_line_en: speak with advisors from Monday to Friday from 8 am to 10 pm, Saturday from 8 am to 6 pm
8cc4f757-c457-4364-853e-732487c1fcdb.explanation: The text states that advisors are available only during specific days and times, so you must call within those indicated schedules.
8cc4f757-c457-4364-853e-732487c1fcdb.breakdown: The text distinguishes between two services accessible via the phone number: speaking with 'conseillers' (advisors) and accessing a 'serveur vocal' (automated voice server). 7e0a3357-eac0-4d35-9d40-bc134a9b82a0.text:
Chère Marie,
Je t’écris rapidement ce mot pour te prévenir que je ne pourrai, hélas, pas être parmi vous pour l’anniversaire de Théo. Je suis vraiment déçu !
Je pars pour des raisons professionnelles au Japon, à des milliers de kilomètres de toi ! Je serai de retour dans trois semaines et j’espère sincèrement que l’on pourra se voir alors, avec Théo.
Nous pourrions également inviter Fred.
Tu me manques.
Je t’embrasse,
Pierre.
7e0a3357-eac0-4d35-9d40-bc134a9b82a0.text_en: Dear Marie, I am writing this note quickly to let you know that I will not be able, alas, to be with you for Théo's birthday. I am really disappointed! I am leaving for professional reasons to Japan, thousands of kilometers away from you! I will be back in three weeks and I sincerely hope that we can see each other then, with Théo. We could also invite Fred. I miss you. Kisses, Pierre.
7e0a3357-eac0-4d35-9d40-bc134a9b82a0.question_fr: Qu’est-ce que Pierre envoie à Marie ?
7e0a3357-eac0-4d35-9d40-bc134a9b82a0.question_en: What is Pierre sending to Marie?

options.explanation: Pierre explains he cannot attend the birthday party ('je ne pourrai... pas être parmi vous'). This is an apology/excuse for his absence.
Although he says 'Tu me manques' (I miss you), the primary purpose of the letter is to explain his absence, not just to declare love.
He is declining to attend an event, not inviting someone to one.
He mentions leaving for 'raisons professionnelles' (professional reasons), so it is a business trip, not a holiday.

7e0a3357-eac0-4d35-9d40-bc134a9b82a0.key_line_fr: Je t’écris rapidement ce mot pour te prévenir que je ne pourrai, hélas, pas être parmi vous pour l’anniversaire de Théo.
7e0a3357-eac0-4d35-9d40-bc134a9b82a0.key_line_en: I am writing this note quickly to let you know that I will not be able, alas, to be with you for Théo's birthday.
7e0a3357-eac0-4d35-9d40-bc134a9b82a0.explanation: Pierre is writing to inform Marie that he cannot attend Théo's birthday party due to a business trip, effectively making an excuse for his absence.
7e0a3357-eac0-4d35-9d40-bc134a9b82a0.breakdown: The text is a short note from Pierre to Marie. In the very first sentence, Pierre states the purpose of his message: 'pour te prévenir que je ne pourrai... pas être parmi vous' (to let you know that I cannot be with you) for a specific event (Théo's birthday). Since he is explaining why he cannot attend, this constitutes a message of excuse/apology for his absence. He further explains the reason is a business trip ('raisons professionnelles').

d2524f4b-fbd3-4d4f-af3f-3667c1011637.text:
Message:
Monsieur le Directeur,
Conformément au devis (en pièce jointe) qui a reçu votre accord, notre équipe interviendra le 20 juin prochain pour effectuer les opérations nécessaires dans l’aile droite du bâtiment principal de votre société.
Le chantier nécessite l'utilisation de produits à risque et d’un appareillage bruyant. Pour la sécurité et le confort de votre personnel, il serait préférable que les services du bâtiment concerné soient suspendus la journée du 20.
Merci par avance de me faire part de votre avis sur ce point.
Cordialement,
Jacques Legendre
Chef du service d'entretien
d2524f4b-fbd3-4d4f-af3f-3667c1011637.text_en: Mr. Director, In accordance with the estimate (attached) which received your agreement, our team will intervene on June 20th to carry out the necessary operations in the right wing of your company's main building. The work site requires the use of high-risk products and noisy equipment. For the safety and comfort of your staff, it would be preferable for the services in the building concerned to be suspended on the 20th. Thank you in advance for letting me know your opinion on this point. Sincerely, Jacques Legendre, Head of Maintenance Service.
d2524f4b-fbd3-4d4f-af3f-3667c1011637.question_en: What does Jacques Legendre ask the director?

options.text_en: To send the estimate very quickly.
options.explanation: The text states the estimate has already been agreed upon ('qui a reçu votre accord'). He is not asking for it.

options.text_en: To prohibit the use of toxic products.
options.explanation: The text states the work 'necessitates' (nécessite) the use of risky products, implying they must be used. He is not asking to ban them.

options.text: De libérer les lieux pendant les travaux.
options.text_en: To vacate the premises during the work.
options.explanation: The author requests that services be suspended due to noise and danger, which is equivalent to asking to vacate the premises ('libérer les lieux').

options.text: De préciser la nature de l’intervention.
options.text_en: To specify the nature of the intervention.
options.explanation: The nature of the intervention is already established in the attached estimate; he is not asking for clarification.

d2524f4b-fbd3-4d4f-af3f-3667c1011637.key_line_fr: Pour la sécurité et le confort de votre personnel, il serait préférable que les services du bâtiment concerné soient suspendus la journée du 20.
d2524f4b-fbd3-4d4f-af3f-3667c1011637.key_line_en: For the safety and comfort of your staff, it would be preferable for the services in the building concerned to be suspended on the 20th.
d2524f4b-fbd3-4d4f-af3f-3667c1011637.explanation: Because the work involves dangerous products and noise, the author asks to suspend activities in the building, meaning the premises should be vacated.
d2524f4b-fbd3-4d4f-af3f-3667c1011637.breakdown:
1. The email confirms that maintenance work will take place on June 20th.
2. The author notes that the work involves 'produits à risque' (risky products) and 'appareillage bruyant' (noisy equipment).
3. Consequently, he suggests: 'il serait préférable que les services du bâtiment concerné soient suspendus' (it would be preferable for the services... to be suspended).
4. Suspending services implies that staff should not be present or working there.
5. This matches option C: 'libérer les lieux' (vacate the premises).

d8588e09-5434-4295-aea7-f0b68ce18f5c.text:
Le Festival Sourd Métrage est accessible à tous : traduction en langue des signes et films sous-titrés.
Ce festival de courts métrages présente des réalisateurs sourds. Tous les regards sont permis : fictions, documentaires, films d’animation…
Tous les publics sont accueillis.
Pendant trois jours, un espace « rencontre » est créé entre des écoles européennes accueillant de jeunes sourds, entre un public sourd et non-sourd ainsi qu’entre le regard du jeune sourd derrière la caméra et des professionnels de l’image.
d8588e09-5434-4295-aea7-f0b68ce18f5c.text_en: The Sourd Métrage Festival is accessible to all: sign language translation and subtitled films. This short film festival presents deaf directors. All perspectives are allowed: fictions, documentaries, animated films... All audiences are welcomed. For three days, a 'meeting' space is created between European schools welcoming young deaf people, between a deaf and non-deaf audience as well as between the perspective of the young deaf person behind the camera and image professionals.
d8588e09-5434-4295-aea7-f0b68ce18f5c.question_fr: Quelle est la particularité de ce festival de cinéma ?
d8588e09-5434-4295-aea7-f0b68ce18f5c.question_en: What is the particularity of this film festival?

options.text: Il montre des documentaires sur les conditions de vie des sourds.
options.text_en: It shows documentaries on the living conditions of the deaf.
options.explanation: The text mentions documentaries as a genre, but does not limit the content to 'living conditions of the deaf'.

options.text: Il organise des conférences sur la langue utilisée par les sourds.
options.text_en: It organizes conferences on the language used by the deaf.
options.explanation: The text mentions sign language translation for accessibility, not conferences about the language itself.

options.text: Il présente des films réalisés par des personnes sourdes.
options.text_en: It presents films made by deaf people.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states that the festival presents 'deaf directors' (réalisateurs sourds), which means films made by deaf people.

options.text: Il programme des spectacles destinés à un jeune public sourd.
options.text_en: It schedules shows intended for a young deaf audience.
options.explanation: The festival is open to 'all audiences' (tous les publics), not just a young deaf audience.

d8588e09-5434-4295-aea7-f0b68ce18f5c.key_line_fr: Ce festival de courts métrages présente des réalisateurs sourds.
d8588e09-5434-4295-aea7-f0b68ce18f5c.key_line_en: This short film festival presents deaf directors.
d8588e09-5434-4295-aea7-f0b68ce18f5c.explanation: The text explicitly states that the festival features 'deaf directors,' which directly corresponds to the option about films made by deaf people.
d8588e09-5434-4295-aea7-f0b68ce18f5c.breakdown:
1. Scan the text for the main characteristic of the festival.
2. The second sentence states: 'Ce festival de courts métrages présente des réalisateurs sourds' (This short film festival presents deaf directors).
3. Compare this with the options:
   - Option A focuses on the *topic* (living conditions), but the text lists various genres (fiction, documentary, animation) without limiting the topic.
   - Option B mentions conferences about language, whereas the text mentions sign language only as a means of accessibility (translation).
   - Option C states it presents films made by deaf people. This matches 'réalisateurs sourds'.
   - Option D suggests it is for a 'young deaf audience', but the text says 'accessible à tous' (accessible to all) and 'Tous les publics sont accueillis' (All audiences are welcomed).
4. Conclusion: Option C is the only one that accurately reflects the text.

fcbf4546-ee01-47c1-9f28-a2e94ab929b1.text:
Chère Andréa,
Hier, j’ai déjeuné avec des célibataires de mon quartier.
C’était à 12h30 au restaurant corse près de l’église.
On était 7 : on a bien mangé et bien ri.
C’est vraiment une bonne idée pour se faire des amis : tu t’inscris sur le site MIAMI et tu consultes les propositions de rendez-vous dans ton quartier.
Tu devrais essayer, c’est génial.
Léa.
fcbf4546-ee01-47c1-9f28-a2e94ab929b1.text_en: Dear Andréa, Yesterday, I had lunch with some singles from my neighborhood. It was at 12:30 at the Corsican restaurant near the church. There were 7 of us: we ate well and laughed a lot. It's really a good idea for making friends: you sign up on the MIAMI site and check the meeting proposals in your neighborhood. You should try it, it's great. Léa.
fcbf4546-ee01-47c1-9f28-a2e94ab929b1.question_fr: Qu’est-ce que Léa souhaite faire découvrir à son amie ?
fcbf4546-ee01-47c1-9f28-a2e94ab929b1.question_en: What does Léa wish to introduce her friend to?

options.text: Un centre de loisirs pour les habitants de son quartier.
options.text_en: A leisure center for the inhabitants of her neighborhood.
options.explanation: The text mentions a website ('site MIAMI') and a restaurant, not a physical 'leisure center' (centre de loisirs).

options.text: Un restaurant qui sert des spécialités de sa région.
options.text_en: A restaurant serving specialties from her region.
options.explanation: Although they ate at a Corsican restaurant, the restaurant was merely the venue. The recommendation is about the concept of meeting people, not the food establishment itself.

options.text: Un service municipal d’aide sociale aux jeunes célibataires.
options.text_en: A municipal social aid service for young singles.
options.explanation: There is no mention of government services ('service municipal') or social welfare ('aide sociale'). It is a voluntary social activity.

options.text: Une manière originale de rencontrer des gens près de chez elle.
options.text_en: An original way to meet people near her home.
options.explanation: Léa recommends using a website to find meetups in the neighborhood to make friends. This fits perfectly with 'an original way to meet people near her home'.

fcbf4546-ee01-47c1-9f28-a2e94ab929b1.key_line_fr: C’est vraiment une bonne idée pour se faire des amis : tu t’inscris sur le site MIAMI et tu consultes les propositions de rendez-vous dans ton quartier.
fcbf4546-ee01-47c1-9f28-a2e94ab929b1.key_line_en: It's really a good idea for making friends: you sign up on the MIAMI site and check the meeting proposals in your neighborhood.
fcbf4546-ee01-47c1-9f28-a2e94ab929b1.explanation: Léa recommends a website ('site MIAMI') specifically designed for finding meetups and making friends in the neighborhood, which constitutes an original way to meet people.
fcbf4546-ee01-47c1-9f28-a2e94ab929b1.breakdown: Léa writes to Andréa describing a lunch she attended with other singles in her neighborhood. She explains that she found this event through a website called 'MIAMI' and states that it is a 'good idea for making friends' ('bonne idée pour se faire des amis'). She encourages Andréa to try it ('Tu devrais essayer'). While she mentions a restaurant, the main recommendation is the method of finding people to meet (the website), making Option D the correct choice.

d19a2d44-6d90-4b5d-ae18-6c25a7b9861d.text: « Beaucoup d'aliments pour enfants sont testés par des adultes », explique le délégué régional du projet « DisMoiGoût ». Leur avis intéresse pourtant ceux qui cherchent à développer des gammes de produits dédiés aux petits. L'école agroalimentaire nantaise, a ainsi entrepris de sonder les goûts des bambins et leur perception des aliments. Objectif : cerner plus subtilement leur profil alimentaire. Les résultats de cette étude devraient permettre, à terme, d’élaborer des produits bons pour leur santé, c’est-à-dire conformes aux recommandations du Programme national de nutrition, mais aussi bons pour leur goût.
d19a2d44-6d90-4b5d-ae18-6c25a7b9861d.text_en: « Many foods for children are tested by adults, » explains the regional delegate of the « DisMoiGoût » project. However, their opinion is of interest to those seeking to develop product ranges dedicated to little ones. The Nantes agri-food school has thus undertaken to probe the tastes of toddlers and their perception of foods. Goal: to define their food profile more subtly. The results of this study should eventually allow for the development of products that are good for their health, meaning compliant with the National Nutrition Program recommendations, but also good for their taste.
d19a2d44-6d90-4b5d-ae18-6c25a7b9861d.question_fr: Quelle est la vocation du projet« DisMoiGoút » ?
d19a2d44-6d90-4b5d-ae18-6c25a7b9861d.question_en: What is the vocation of the « DisMoiGoût » project?

options.text: Corriger les mauvaises habitudes alimentaires des enfants.
options.text_en: To correct children's bad eating habits.
options.explanation: The text talks about developing products that taste good to children and are healthy, not about actively correcting their existing bad habits.

options.text: Faire respecter la législation sur l’alimentation des enfants.
options.text_en: To enforce legislation on children's nutrition.
options.explanation: The text mentions products should be 'compliant with recommendations,' but the project's vocation is research and development, not legal enforcement.

options.text: Mieux comprendre les préférences alimentaires des enfants.
options.text_en: To better understand children's food preferences.
options.explanation: The phrase 'cerner plus subtilement leur profil alimentaire' (define their food profile more subtly) is a direct paraphrase of 'mieux comprendre les préférences alimentaires'.

options.text: Permettre aux enfants de découvrir de nouveaux aliments.
options.text_en: To allow children to discover new foods.
options.explanation: The objective is for the researchers to learn about the children's tastes, not for the children to discover new foods themselves.

d19a2d44-6d90-4b5d-ae18-6c25a7b9861d.key_line_fr: Objectif : cerner plus subtilement leur profil alimentaire.
d19a2d44-6d90-4b5d-ae18-6c25a7b9861d.key_line_en: Goal: to define their food profile more subtly.
d19a2d44-6d90-4b5d-ae18-6c25a7b9861d.explanation: The text explicitly states that the goal is to 'probe the tastes of toddlers' and 'define their food profile,' which means understanding what they like.
d19a2d44-6d90-4b5d-ae18-6c25a7b9861d.breakdown:
The text introduces a project called 'DisMoiGoût' which aims to address the issue that children's food is often tested by adults. The text states that the Nantes agri-food school has undertaken to 'sonder les goûts des bambins' (probe the tastes of toddlers). 

The crucial sentence is: 'Objectif : cerner plus subtilement leur profil alimentaire' (Goal: to define their food profile more subtly). 

This clearly indicates a desire to investigate and understand what children like and how they perceive food, which corresponds exactly to Option C (Better understand food preferences). Options A and B are unrelated to the stated goal (correction or legislation), and D suggests an educational goal for the children, whereas the text describes a study *about* the children.

10d11ff4-cb4d-4548-871f-cdc26fc3b305.text:
L’action du film se situe en Nouvelle-Angleterre, à la fin du XVIIIᵉ siècle.
Un jeune inspecteur de police ne jure que par la science et la logique et ne rate jamais une occasion de le faire savoir.
Pour le mettre à l’épreuve, ses supérieurs l’envoient dans un petit village de fermiers d’origine hollandaise, théâtre de plusieurs meurtres étranges.
10d11ff4-cb4d-4548-871f-cdc26fc3b305.text_en: The film's action takes place in New England, at the end of the 18th century. A young police inspector swears only by science and logic and never misses an opportunity to let it be known. To put him to the test, his superiors send him to a small village of farmers of Dutch origin, the scene of several strange murders.
10d11ff4-cb4d-4548-871f-cdc26fc3b305.question_fr: Quel est le sujet du film présenté ?
10d11ff4-cb4d-4548-871f-cdc26fc3b305.question_en: What is the subject of the presented film?

options.text: L’arrivée d’une troupe de comédiens à la campagne.
options.text_en: The arrival of a troupe of actors in the countryside.
options.explanation: The word 'théâtre' in the text means 'scene' (of a crime), not a literal theater with actors/comedians.

options.text: L’enquête policière d’une personne très rationnelle.
options.text_en: The police investigation of a very rational person.
options.explanation: The text describes a police inspector (investigation) who relies strictly on science and logic (very rational).

options.text: La vie des paysans néerlandais au XVIIIE siècle.
options.text_en: The life of Dutch peasants in the 18th century.
options.explanation: The Dutch farmers provide the setting/background, but the main subject is the inspector's mission regarding the murders.

options.text: Les expériences originales d’un scientifique anglais.
options.text_en: The original experiments of an English scientist.
options.explanation: The protagonist is a police inspector, not a scientist, though he uses scientific methods.

10d11ff4-cb4d-4548-871f-cdc26fc3b305.key_line_fr: Un jeune inspecteur de police ne jure que par la science et la logique [...] ses supérieurs l’envoient dans un petit village [...] théâtre de plusieurs meurtres étranges.
10d11ff4-cb4d-4548-871f-cdc26fc3b305.key_line_en: A young police inspector swears only by science and logic [...] his superiors send him to a small village [...] the scene of several strange murders.
10d11ff4-cb4d-4548-871f-cdc26fc3b305.explanation: The text describes a logical police inspector sent to solve murders, which matches the description of a police investigation by a rational person.
10d11ff4-cb4d-4548-871f-cdc26fc3b305.breakdown:
1. The text introduces a 'jeune inspecteur de police' (young police inspector).
2. It describes his personality: he 'ne jure que par la science et la logique' (swears only by science and logic), which aligns with being 'très rationnelle' (very rational).
3. It describes the plot: he is sent to a village that is the 'théâtre de plusieurs meurtres' (scene of several murders), implying an investigation.
4. Combining these elements leads directly to Option B: A police investigation by a very rational person.

9fc3012e-8bfb-4f86-9c18-99e5cb0dcc72.text:
L’enfant fréquente le musée par obligation, avec ses parents ou son instituteur.
L’adulte le vit par plaisir.
Entre les deux, rien.
Chez l’ado, la perspective de franchir ses portes, même gratuitement, provoque la nausée.
Il préfère le spectacle d’une toile de cinéma ou le plongeon dans la toile du cyberspace.
Les jeunes deviennent aujourd’hui pour les musées une cible prioritaire.
Mais les inciter à venir n’est pas facile.
La culture internet a bouleversé leur relation au savoir.
Les musées ne peuvent plus s’accrocher aux réseaux traditionnels de la transmission des connaissances.
Le temps est venu de réfléchir à de nouvelles approches adaptées à ce public.
9fc3012e-8bfb-4f86-9c18-99e5cb0dcc72.text_en: The child visits the museum by obligation, with parents or a teacher. The adult experiences it for pleasure. Between the two, nothing. For the adolescent, the prospect of crossing its doors, even for free, provokes nausea. He prefers the spectacle of a cinema screen or diving into the web of cyberspace. Young people are becoming a priority target for museums today. But inciting them to come is not easy. Internet culture has disrupted their relationship to knowledge. Museums can no longer cling to traditional networks of knowledge transmission. The time has come to reflect on new approaches adapted to this audience.
9fc3012e-8bfb-4f86-9c18-99e5cb0dcc72.question_fr: Que suggère l’auteur pour attirer le jeune public au musée ?
9fc3012e-8bfb-4f86-9c18-99e5cb0dcc72.question_en: What does the author suggest to attract the young audience to the museum?

options.text: D’analyser les moyens de séduire les jeunes.
options.text_en: To analyze ways to seduce young people.
options.explanation: This summarizes the final sentence. 'Reflecting on new approaches' is equivalent to analyzing means to attract ('seduce') them.

options.text: De moderniser le contenu des expositions.
options.text_en: To modernize the content of exhibitions.
options.explanation: The text discusses changing the 'approach' and relationship with knowledge, not necessarily modifying the historical or artistic 'content' of the exhibitions.

options.text: De s’inspirer des approches pédagogiques scolaires.
options.text_en: To draw inspiration from school pedagogical approaches.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states museums can *no longer* cling to 'traditional networks of knowledge transmission' (which implies school-like methods).

options.text: De systématiser l’accès gratuit pour les adolescents.
options.text_en: To systematize free access for adolescents.
options.explanation: The text mentions that the prospect of entering a museum causes nausea 'even for free,' meaning free access alone is not a sufficient solution.

9fc3012e-8bfb-4f86-9c18-99e5cb0dcc72.key_line_fr: Le temps est venu de réfléchir à de nouvelles approches adaptées à ce public.
9fc3012e-8bfb-4f86-9c18-99e5cb0dcc72.key_line_en: The time has come to reflect on new approaches adapted to this audience.
9fc3012e-8bfb-4f86-9c18-99e5cb0dcc72.explanation: The author concludes that since traditional methods fail, museums must think about new strategies specifically designed to interest young people.
9fc3012e-8bfb-4f86-9c18-99e5cb0dcc72.breakdown:
1. The text identifies a problem: adolescents dislike museums and prefer cinema or the internet.
2. It explains that traditional methods of knowledge transmission are no longer effective due to internet culture.
3. The final sentence states: 'The time has come to reflect on new approaches adapted to this audience.'
4. Option A ('To analyze ways to seduce young people') is a direct paraphrase of reflecting on new approaches to attract this specific demographic.

0524039e-2356-4610-a946-adad0f9eda26.text:
Réparer un véhicule endommagé avec des pièces d’occasion recyclées, c’est désormais possible.
Depuis le printemps dernier, l’expert d’une compagnie d’assurances peut en effet proposer à un assuré des pièces de réemploi.
Ces pièces issues de véhicules hors d’usage, accidentés ou arrivés en fin de vie, sont démontées, contrôlées et revendues à des réparateurs par des recycleurs agréés.
Cette disposition est une alternative au neuf et répond à de nouvelles attentes.
La récupération de pièces valides permet ainsi de prolonger leur longévité ainsi que celle d’autres véhicules avec un bénéfice économique, environnemental et social.
0524039e-2356-4610-a946-adad0f9eda26.text_en: Repairing a damaged vehicle with recycled second-hand parts is now possible. Since last spring, an insurance company expert can indeed propose reused parts to a policyholder. These parts, coming from end-of-life vehicles, damaged ones, or those that have reached the end of their life, are dismantled, checked, and resold to repairers by approved recyclers. This provision is an alternative to new parts and meets new expectations. The recovery of valid parts thus allows prolonging their longevity as well as that of other vehicles with an economic, environmental, and social benefit.
0524039e-2356-4610-a946-adad0f9eda26.question_fr: D’après cet article, quel avantage présente l’utilisation de pièces recyclées ?
0524039e-2356-4610-a946-adad0f9eda26.question_en: According to this article, what advantage does the use of recycled parts present?

options.text: Elle donne l’assurance d’un dépannage rapide.
options.text_en: It gives the assurance of a quick repair.
options.explanation: The text does not mention the speed of the repair service.

options.text: Elle donne lieu à une réduction sur l’assurance.
options.text_en: It leads to a reduction on the insurance.
options.explanation: The text states that insurance experts can propose these parts, but it never mentions a discount on the insurance policy itself.

options.text: Elle offre la possibilité d’une garantie de qualité.
options.text_en: It offers the possibility of a quality guarantee.
options.explanation: While the text says parts are 'controlled', it does not highlight a 'quality guarantee' as a specific advantage over new parts.

options.text: Elle permet de dépenser moins d’argent.
options.explanation: The text explicitly mentions a 'bénéfice économique' (economic benefit), which is synonymous with spending less money.

0524039e-2356-4610-a946-adad0f9eda26.key_line_fr: La récupération de pièces valides permet ainsi de prolonger leur longévité ainsi que celle d’autres véhicules avec un bénéfice économique, environnemental et social.
0524039e-2356-4610-a946-adad0f9eda26.key_line_en: The recovery of valid parts thus allows prolonging their longevity as well as that of other vehicles with an economic, environmental, and social benefit.
0524039e-2356-4610-a946-adad0f9eda26.explanation: The text states that using recycled parts offers an 'economic benefit,' which directly implies cost savings (spending less money).
0524039e-2356-4610-a946-adad0f9eda26.breakdown:
1.  **Analyze the text**: The text discusses the use of recycled parts for vehicle repairs. The final sentence lists the benefits: 'un bénéfice économique, environnemental et social' (an economic, environmental, and social benefit).
2.  **Analyze the question**: We need to identify a specific advantage mentioned in the text.
3.  **Evaluate Option A**: Does the text mention speed? No.
4.  **Evaluate Option B**: Does it mention insurance discounts? No, only that insurance experts can propose the parts.
5.  **Evaluate Option C**: Does it focus on a warranty? No, it mentions parts are checked, but 'economic benefit' is the explicit advantage listed.
6.  **Evaluate Option D**: 'Spending less money' is the definition of an 'economic benefit'. This matches the text perfectly.

29a17d7b-301e-48c3-a785-7658f5c6f6bb.text:
Monsieur,
Le règlement de votre facture du mois dernier ne nous est pas encore parvenu.
Peut-être avez-vous effectué ce paiement très récemment ?
Dans ce cas, nous vous en remercions et nous vous prions de ne pas tenir compte de ce courrier.
S’il s’agit d’un simple oubli, adressez-nous votre règlement à l’aide du coupon-réponse.
Pour toute autre raison, contactez rapidement votre conseiller clientèle.
Il vous renseignera sur votre facture ainsi que sur les moyens de paiement.
Nous vous prions d’agréer, Monsieur, nos sincères salutations.
Le responsable clientèle.
29a17d7b-301e-48c3-a785-7658f5c6f6bb.text_en: Sir, The payment for your invoice from last month has not yet reached us. Perhaps you made this payment very recently? In that case, we thank you and ask you to disregard this letter. If it is a simple oversight, please send us your payment using the reply coupon. For any other reason, please contact your customer advisor quickly. He will provide you with information on your invoice as well as on payment methods. Yours sincerely, The Customer Service Manager.

options.text: Un rappel d’un impayé en cours.
options.text_en: A reminder of an outstanding unpaid balance.
options.explanation: The text is a notification that a previous bill remains unpaid. This corresponds exactly to a 'rappel' (reminder) of an 'impayé' (unpaid balance).

options.text_en: An invoice to be paid quickly.
options.explanation: While the topic is an invoice ('facture'), the document itself is a follow-up letter regarding non-payment, not the initial bill itself.
The text asks for immediate payment ('adressez-nous votre règlement'), not offering a way to pay later or in installments.
The text mentions a possible 'oubli' (oversight) by the customer, but does not discuss a processing error regarding a specific payment made.

29a17d7b-301e-48c3-a785-7658f5c6f6bb.key_line_fr: Le règlement de votre facture du mois dernier ne nous est pas encore parvenu.
29a17d7b-301e-48c3-a785-7658f5c6f6bb.key_line_en: The payment for your invoice from last month has not yet reached us.
29a17d7b-301e-48c3-a785-7658f5c6f6bb.explanation: The letter informs the recipient that their payment has not arrived and asks them to settle the debt, which defines a payment reminder.
29a17d7b-301e-48c3-a785-7658f5c6f6bb.breakdown: The letter begins by stating that the payment for the previous month's invoice has not yet been received ('Le règlement... ne nous est pas encore parvenu'). It advises the customer to ignore the letter if they have already paid, or to send payment if they forgot ('S’il s’agit d’un simple oubli'). A letter sent to notify a customer of a missing payment is essentially a reminder ('un rappel') of an unpaid debt ('impayé').

0a05fdf5-6187-4007-9b14-43ef78ed5c84.text:
L’éthique, nouveau critère d’attractivité.
Diversité, handicap, éthique, développement durable.
Autant de grands enjeux sociétaux englobés sous le terme de « responsabilité sociale de l’entreprise » (RSE).
Suivant sa définition, la RSE repose sur trois piliers : les problématiques sociales, environnementales et économiques.
En amont du marché du travail, les écoles n’échappent pas à ces obligations.
La RSE couvre les actions en faveur des lycéens issus de zones défavorisées, grâce à un tutorat proposé en classe de première et de terminale.
Elle couvre aussi le champ humanitaire.
Ses enjeux sont finalement proches des questions chères à la jeunesse.
On comprend pourquoi les écoles, bien conscientes de l’attractivité exercée par la RSE, multiplient les initiatives dans le domaine.
0a05fdf5-6187-4007-9b14-43ef78ed5c84.text_en:
Ethics, a new criterion of attractiveness.
Diversity, disability, ethics, sustainable development.
So many major societal stakes included under the term 'Corporate Social Responsibility' (CSR).
According to its definition, CSR rests on three pillars: social, environmental, and economic issues.
Upstream of the labor market, schools do not escape these obligations.
CSR covers actions in favor of high school students from disadvantaged areas, thanks to tutoring offered in the first and final years.
It also covers the humanitarian field.
Its stakes are ultimately close to the issues dear to youth.
We understand why schools, well aware of the attractiveness exercised by CSR, are multiplying initiatives in this domain.
0a05fdf5-6187-4007-9b14-43ef78ed5c84.question_fr: Comment le texte justifie-t-il l’attrait qu’exerce la RSE auprès des écoles ?
0a05fdf5-6187-4007-9b14-43ef78ed5c84.question_en: How does the text justify the attraction that CSR exercises on schools?

options.text: Elle favorise l’orientation des élèves après l’obtention du baccalauréat.
options.text_en: It promotes student orientation after obtaining the baccalaureate.
options.explanation: The text mentions tutoring for disadvantaged students, but does not limit the goal solely to post-baccalaureate orientation.

options.text: Elle permet de renforcer les liens éducatifs entre adultes et élèves.
options.text_en: It allows for strengthening educational ties between adults and students.
options.explanation: While tutoring involves adults, the text does not highlight the strengthening of educational bonds as the primary reason for RSE's attractiveness.

options.text: Elle répond de manière pertinente aux difficultés et aux aspirations des élèves.
options.text_en: It responds pertinently to the difficulties and aspirations of students.
options.explanation: This summarizes the text perfectly: it addresses 'difficulties' (students from disadvantaged areas) and 'aspirations' (issues dear to youth).

options.text: Elle veille à la concrétisation des projets professionnels des élèves.
options.text_en: It ensures the concretization of students' professional projects.
options.explanation: The text discusses social and humanitarian values, not the specific concretization of professional career plans.

0a05fdf5-6187-4007-9b14-43ef78ed5c84.key_line_fr: Ses enjeux sont finalement proches des questions chères à la jeunesse.
0a05fdf5-6187-4007-9b14-43ef78ed5c84.key_line_en: Its stakes are ultimately close to the issues dear to youth.
0a05fdf5-6187-4007-9b14-43ef78ed5c84.explanation: The text argues that RSE attracts schools because it aligns with the values young people care about and addresses social inequalities.
0a05fdf5-6187-4007-9b14-43ef78ed5c84.breakdown:
1.  **Identify the core subject**: The text discusses 'RSE' (Corporate Social Responsibility) and its adoption by schools.
2.  **Analyze the specific reasons given**: The text mentions two main applications of RSE in schools: helping students from 'disadvantaged areas' (addressing difficulties) and addressing 'humanitarian' fields or issues 'dear to youth' (addressing aspirations).
3.  **Connect to the question**: The question asks why RSE is attractive to schools. The text concludes that schools use it because RSE issues are 'close to questions dear to youth'.
4.  **Evaluate options**:
    *   Option A focuses only on post-bac orientation, which is too narrow.
    *   Option B focuses on adult-student bonds, which is a side effect of tutoring but not the main point of 'attractiveness'.
    *   Option C mentions responding to 'difficulties' (disadvantaged zones) and 'aspirations' (questions dear to youth). This covers the entire scope of the text's argument.
    *   Option D mentions professional projects, which is not the focus.

2e7685f5-26e8-4b98-b12b-32c103ad3722.text:
Écologique par nature, les solutions que nous proposons représentent un atout certain pour lutter contre les émissions de gaz à effet de serre.
Audioconférence, visioconférence et messagerie vous évitent des déplacements inutiles, tout en vous permettant de contribuer à la préservation de la planète.
En effet, une étude environnementale a calculé qu’en remplaçant 20 % des voyages d’affaires par des visioconférences, on économiserait 22 millions de tonnes de CO2 par an.
Ensemble, agissons pour un monde plus vert !
2e7685f5-26e8-4b98-b12b-32c103ad3722.text_en: Ecological by nature, the solutions we propose represent a definite asset for fighting against greenhouse gas emissions. Audioconferencing, videoconferencing, and messaging save you unnecessary trips, while allowing you to contribute to the preservation of the planet. Indeed, an environmental study calculated that by replacing 20% of business trips with videoconferences, 22 million tons of CO2 would be saved per year. Together, let's act for a greener world!

options.explanation: The text lists audioconferencing, videoconferencing, and messaging, which are definitionally communication tools.
The text mentions 'voyages d’affaires' (business trips) only to say they should be replaced, not sold.
While the text speaks about ecology, the product offered is a technical solution (tools) to help the environment, not an educational course or training.

While these tools are part of IT, 'Communication tools' is the precise category for the examples given (conferencing, messaging), whereas 'Information system' usually refers to data management infrastructure.

2e7685f5-26e8-4b98-b12b-32c103ad3722.key_line_fr: Audioconférence, visioconférence et messagerie vous évitent des déplacements inutiles, tout en vous permettant de contribuer à la préservation de la planète.
2e7685f5-26e8-4b98-b12b-32c103ad3722.key_line_en: Audioconferencing, videoconferencing, and messaging save you unnecessary trips, while allowing you to contribute to the preservation of the planet.
2e7685f5-26e8-4b98-b12b-32c103ad3722.explanation: The passage lists videoconferencing and messaging as the company's solutions, which categorizes them as communication tools.
2e7685f5-26e8-4b98-b12b-32c103ad3722.breakdown: The text explicitly lists the services provided: 'Audioconférence, visioconférence et messagerie' (Audioconferencing, videoconferencing, and messaging). These are specifically tools designed to facilitate remote communication between people. The text argues that using these tools helps avoid unnecessary travel ('vous évitent des déplacements inutiles'). Therefore, the company is selling communication tools that serve as an ecological alternative to physical travel.

3333d6ee-ef8b-4572-81cb-81a3b05520bc.text:
Aux débuts d’Internet, je me souviens d’avoir lu, éberluée, dans un magazine féminin : « Mon mari était absent, il passait tout son temps sur le chat », et j’en étais à tenter de visualiser ce triste état de fait lorsque je compris ma méprise : avoir confondu le chat, le félidé, avec le chat, la discussion sur Internet.
Depuis ce jour, aucun progrès sur cette équivoque terrible de la langue, alors que l’usage informatique du mot souris démultiplie les sources de confusions.
Le bon sens voudrait que la phonétique l’emporte et que l’on écrive « tchat ».
Au lieu de cette solution évidente, le Petit Larousse a laissé entrer en 2004 dans le dictionnaire le monstrueux mot-valise « clavardage ».
3333d6ee-ef8b-4572-81cb-81a3b05520bc.text_en: In the early days of the Internet, I remember reading, flabbergasted, in a women's magazine: "My husband was absent, he spent all his time on the chat," and I was there attempting to visualize this sad state of affairs when I understood my mistake: having confused the chat, the feline, with the chat, the discussion on the Internet. Since that day, no progress has been made on this terrible ambiguity of the language, while the computer usage of the word mouse multiplies the sources of confusion. Common sense would dictate that phonetics prevail and that we write "tchat". Instead of this obvious solution, the Petit Larousse allowed the monstrous portmanteau word "clavardage" to enter the dictionary in 2004.
3333d6ee-ef8b-4572-81cb-81a3b05520bc.question_fr: Qu’est-ce qui dérange l’auteur de ce texte ?
3333d6ee-ef8b-4572-81cb-81a3b05520bc.question_en: What bothers the author of this text?

options.text_en: The abuse of anglicisms in computer language.
options.explanation: The author does not criticize the use of English terms generally; she even suggests spelling it "tchat" (phonetic adaptation) rather than using the French replacement "clavardage".

options.text: L’ambiguïté du néologisme « chat » à l’écrit.
options.text_en: The ambiguity of the neologism "chat" in writing.
options.explanation: The entire first paragraph recounts a misunderstanding caused by the word "chat" looking like the animal, and the second paragraph explicitly calls this an "équivoque terrible" (terrible ambiguity).

options.text: Le laxisme orthographique dans les forums.
options.explanation: The text discusses a magazine article and dictionary entries, not the spelling habits of users in online forums.

options.text_en: The lack of imagination of lexicologists.
options.explanation: While she dislikes the word "clavardage", this is a secondary point. Her main frustration is the confusion (ambiguity) caused by the word "chat" not being spelled "tchat".

3333d6ee-ef8b-4572-81cb-81a3b05520bc.key_line_fr: Depuis ce jour, aucun progrès sur cette équivoque terrible de la langue
3333d6ee-ef8b-4572-81cb-81a3b05520bc.key_line_en: Since that day, no progress has been made on this terrible ambiguity of the language
3333d6ee-ef8b-4572-81cb-81a3b05520bc.explanation: The author recounts a personal misunderstanding where she confused the internet term "chat" with the animal because they are spelled the same, calling this ambiguity a terrible linguistic issue.
3333d6ee-ef8b-4572-81cb-81a3b05520bc.breakdown:
1. **Identify the core anecdote**: The author starts by describing a moment where she read the word "chat" in a magazine and was confused ("éberluée", "méprise") because she thought it referred to the animal (cat), not the internet activity.
2. **Analyze the author's reaction**: She describes this situation as an "équivoque terrible de la langue" (terrible ambiguity of the language).
3. **Evaluate the author's suggestion**: She wishes the word was spelled "tchat" to match the pronunciation and differentiate it from the animal.
4. **Compare with options**: 
   - Option A is incorrect; she uses "mouse" and suggests "tchat" (an anglicism adapted phonetically), so she isn't against anglicisms per se.
   - Option B is correct; the text focuses entirely on the confusion caused by the written form of "chat".
   - Option C is irrelevant; the text discusses a magazine and dictionaries, not forum users' spelling.
   - Option D focuses on the last sentence about "clavardage", but the primary annoyance driving the text is the initial ambiguity (Option B).

8d8c76fe-16a4-4690-9d79-01eb8acd1d32.text:
Les additifs et conservateurs, ces poudres de perlimpinpin, rendent appétissant un produit médiocre afin de mieux le vendre.
C’est le cas des colorants si la préparation est terne, des exhausteurs de goût de type glutamate si elle est fade, des agents de texture si elle est sans consistance, ou des arômes si elle est insipide ou a carrément mauvais goût.
On vous dit que les conservateurs ou antioxydants (sorbates, nitrites, sulfites…) servent à vous protéger de possibles intoxications bactériennes, mais ils servent surtout à prolonger les dates limites de consommation, afin de laisser plus de temps aux industriels et aux supermarchés pour commercialiser leur marchandise.
8d8c76fe-16a4-4690-9d79-01eb8acd1d32.text_en: Additives and preservatives, these magic powders, make a mediocre product appetizing in order to sell it better. This is the case with colorants if the preparation is dull, flavor enhancers like glutamate if it is bland, texturizing agents if it lacks consistency, or aromas if it is tasteless or simply tastes bad. You are told that preservatives or antioxidants (sorbates, nitrites, sulfites…) serve to protect you from possible bacterial poisoning, but they mainly serve to extend expiration dates, in order to leave more time for industrialists and supermarkets to market their merchandise.

options.text: Le dosage des produits chimiques dans les aliments.
options.text_en: The dosage of chemical products in food.
options.explanation: The text discusses the purpose and deceptive nature of additives, not whether the specific amount (dosage) used is too high or low.

options.text: Le manque de lisibilité des étiquettes.
options.text_en: The lack of readability of labels.
options.explanation: The text does not mention labels or how difficult they are to read.

options.text: Les arguments hypocrites avancés par les fabricants.
options.text_en: The hypocritical arguments put forward by manufacturers.
options.explanation: The author contrasts the manufacturers' public claim (protecting consumers) with their actual goal (extending sales time), exposing the arguments as hypocritical.
While the text mentions health safety as a pretext, the main criticism is not focused on the negative health impacts of eating the additives, but rather on the false reasons given for their use.

8d8c76fe-16a4-4690-9d79-01eb8acd1d32.key_line_fr: On vous dit que les conservateurs ou antioxydants (sorbates, nitrites, sulfites…) servent à vous protéger de possibles intoxications bactériennes, mais ils servent surtout à prolonger les dates limites de consommation
8d8c76fe-16a4-4690-9d79-01eb8acd1d32.key_line_en: You are told that preservatives or antioxidants (sorbates, nitrites, sulfites…) serve to protect you from possible bacterial poisoning, but they mainly serve to extend expiration dates
8d8c76fe-16a4-4690-9d79-01eb8acd1d32.explanation: The text claims manufacturers lie about why they use preservatives—saying it's for safety when it's really for profit—making their arguments hypocritical.
8d8c76fe-16a4-4690-9d79-01eb8acd1d32.breakdown:
1. The text starts by calling additives 'magic powders' used to disguise mediocre products.
2. It lists specific examples of how additives hide flaws (colorants for dull food, flavor enhancers for bland food).
3. The crucial argument appears in the final sentence: 'You are told' (On vous dit que) preservatives are for safety, 'but' (mais) they are actually used to extend shelf life for commercial benefit.
4. This structure highlights a discrepancy between the stated reason (health/safety) and the real reason (profit/logistics), which defines hypocrisy.

db6d98ea-ce1f-4752-bbe2-f4b7ceceeba2.text:
Si la télévision est souvent critiquée pour sa distribution d’informations un peu floues, elle est aussi un remarquable éveilleur d’intérêt, quand, en plus d’un embryon de connaissances, elle donne le goût de le développer.
Il en est ainsi par exemple de la lecture, dont elle est la plupart du temps un incomparable promoteur.
Contrairement à trop d’idées reçues, la concurrence est très rare entre le petit écran et le livre, ne serait-ce que parce que leurs clientèles respectives sont différentes.
Ceux qui aiment lire ne sacrifient pas ce vice impuni à l’uniformité des habituels spectacles télévisés.
Au contraire, après chaque émission littéraire, les chiffres de la vente des livres évoqués ou ayant inspiré le spectacle comblent toujours d’aise les éditeurs.
db6d98ea-ce1f-4752-bbe2-f4b7ceceeba2.text_en: While television is often criticized for its distribution of somewhat fuzzy information, it is also a remarkable awakener of interest, when, in addition to an embryo of knowledge, it gives the taste to develop it. It is so, for example, with reading, of which it is most of the time an incomparable promoter. Contrary to too many received ideas, competition is very rare between the small screen and the book, if only because their respective clienteles are different. Those who like to read do not sacrifice this unpunished vice to the uniformity of the usual television spectacles. On the contrary, after every literary show, the sales figures of the books mentioned or having inspired the show always fill publishers with delight.
db6d98ea-ce1f-4752-bbe2-f4b7ceceeba2.question_fr: Que soutient l’auteur de ce texte concernant la télévision ?
db6d98ea-ce1f-4752-bbe2-f4b7ceceeba2.question_en: What does the author of this text maintain regarding television?

options.text: C’est un vecteur de diffusion des œuvres littéraires.
options.text_en: It is a vehicle for the dissemination of literary works.
options.explanation: The text explicitly calls television an 'incomparable promoter' of reading and notes that book sales increase after literary programs.

options.text: C’est une source de connaissances sûre et fiable.
options.text_en: It is a sure and reliable source of knowledge.
options.explanation: The text actually suggests the opposite in the first sentence, stating TV is criticized for distributing information that is 'a bit fuzzy' (un peu floues).

options.text: L’audience des émissions culturelles est en hausse.
options.text_en: The audience for cultural shows is rising.
options.explanation: The text discusses the increase in book sales figures ('chiffres de la vente des livres'), not the audience ratings for the TV shows themselves.

options.text: La concurrence qu’elle mène à la lecture est acharnée.
options.text_en: The competition it leads against reading is fierce.
options.explanation: The text explicitly contradicts this, stating that 'competition is very rare' ('la concurrence est très rare') between the small screen and books.

db6d98ea-ce1f-4752-bbe2-f4b7ceceeba2.key_line_fr: Il en est ainsi par exemple de la lecture, dont elle est la plupart du temps un incomparable promoteur.
db6d98ea-ce1f-4752-bbe2-f4b7ceceeba2.key_line_en: It is so, for example, with reading, of which it is most of the time an incomparable promoter.
db6d98ea-ce1f-4752-bbe2-f4b7ceceeba2.explanation: The author argues that instead of competing with books, television acts as a powerful promoter for reading, as evidenced by increased book sales following literary broadcasts.
db6d98ea-ce1f-4752-bbe2-f4b7ceceeba2.breakdown:
1.  The text acknowledges TV is criticized for vague information but argues it sparks interest.
2.  It specifically cites reading, stating TV is an 'incomparable promoter' (incomparable promoteur) of it.
3.  It refutes the idea of competition between TV and books.
4.  It concludes that book sales increase after literary TV shows.
5.  Therefore, the author supports that TV helps promote/distribute literary works.

2facbd9f-6110-468f-82a6-9582af2f22f1.text:
« DRÔLE ET TRÈS BEAU ! »
« DES ACTEURS MAGNIFIQUES ! »
« À VOIR ABSOLUMENT ! »
2facbd9f-6110-468f-82a6-9582af2f22f1.text_en:
“FUNNY AND VERY BEAUTIFUL!”
“MAGNIFICENT ACTORS!”
“ABSOLUTELY A MUST-SEE!”

options.explanation: A concert typically features musicians or singers, not actors.
A film features actors and is a visual medium described as something 'to see'.
A book is something 'to read' (à lire), and while it has characters, it does not feature actors performing.
A painting is a static visual art form and does not involve actors.

2facbd9f-6110-468f-82a6-9582af2f22f1.explanation: The text mentions 'actors' and says it is 'to see' (à voir), which are characteristic descriptions of a movie.
2facbd9f-6110-468f-82a6-9582af2f22f1.breakdown:
1. Identify the keywords in the text: 'DRÔLE' (funny), 'BEAU' (beautiful), 'ACTEURS' (actors), 'À VOIR' (to see).
2. Analyze the keyword 'ACTEURS': This word specifically refers to people performing roles, which immediately links to movies or theater.
3. Evaluate the options against 'ACTEURS':
   - Concerts involve musicians.
   - Books involve authors/characters (and are read, not seen).
   - Paintings do not have actors.
   - Movies have actors and are visual media ('à voir').
4. Conclusion: The presence of 'actors' and the recommendation 'to see' confirms it is a movie review.

f55509cc-ed35-4330-be0d-67cf26d0fe29.text:
ASSOCIATION En route pour l’école
Pour 92 euros, aidez des enfants à aller à l’école !
Pour beaucoup d’entre eux, le collège est très loin : ils se lèvent très tôt et rentrent tard.
Avec une bicyclette, ils pourraient y aller plus facilement.
Faites un don à notre association pour leur offrir une bicyclette !
f55509cc-ed35-4330-be0d-67cf26d0fe29.text_en:
ASSOCIATION On the way to school
For 92 euros, help children go to school!
For many of them, middle school is very far: they get up very early and come home late.
With a bicycle, they could go there more easily.
Make a donation to our association to offer them a bicycle!
f55509cc-ed35-4330-be0d-67cf26d0fe29.question_fr: Qu’est-ce que cette association voudrait faire ?
f55509cc-ed35-4330-be0d-67cf26d0fe29.question_en: What would this association like to do?

options.explanation: This is too vague. While providing transport helps families, the specific stated goal is providing bicycles, not general aid.

options.text: Donner un vélo à des élèves.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states the goal is to 'offer a bicycle' ('offrir une bicyclette'). 'Vélo' is a synonym for 'bicyclette'.
The text mentions that the school is far ('loin'), but does not suggest building new ones.
The text talks about offering bicycles ('offrir'), not repairing ('réparer') old ones.

f55509cc-ed35-4330-be0d-67cf26d0fe29.key_line_fr: Faites un don à notre association pour leur offrir une bicyclette !
f55509cc-ed35-4330-be0d-67cf26d0fe29.key_line_en: Make a donation to our association to offer them a bicycle!
f55509cc-ed35-4330-be0d-67cf26d0fe29.explanation: The association asks for donations specifically to give bicycles ('offrir une bicyclette') to children who live far from school.
f55509cc-ed35-4330-be0d-67cf26d0fe29.breakdown:
1. The text describes a problem: middle school is very far for many children ('le collège est très loin').
2. It proposes a solution: using a bicycle ('Avec une bicyclette').
3. It explicitly asks for donations to provide these bicycles: 'offrir une bicyclette' (offer a bicycle).
4. Option B says 'Donner un vélo' (Give a bike). 'Vélo' is a common synonym for 'bicyclette', and 'offrir' (to offer/give) matches the association's goal.

c8857769-b9f7-41d0-a269-66b6a398e289.text:
Chers locataires,
La société « Ville propre » nous demande de faire plus attention quand on jette nos déchets.
Il faut séparer le plastique et le carton et les mettre dans les poubelles jaunes.
Vous pouvez jeter les autres déchets dans les poubelles grises.
Merci,
Votre gardien
c8857769-b9f7-41d0-a269-66b6a398e289.text_en: Dear tenants, The company 'Clean City' asks us to pay more attention when throwing away our waste. You must separate plastic and cardboard and put them in the yellow bins. You can throw other waste in the grey bins. Thank you, Your caretaker
c8857769-b9f7-41d0-a269-66b6a398e289.question_fr: Pourquoi est-ce que le concierge écrit aux locataires ?
c8857769-b9f7-41d0-a269-66b6a398e289.question_en: Why is the caretaker writing to the tenants?

options.text: Pour annoncer un changement de couleur des poubelles.
options.text_en: To announce a change in the color of the bins.
options.explanation: The text mentions specific colors (yellow and grey) for specific waste, but does not announce that these colors are changing.

options.text: Pour informer de l’ouverture du nouveau local poubelle.
options.text_en: To inform about the opening of the new trash room.
options.explanation: There is no mention of a new location or room ('local') being opened.

options.text: Pour présenter l’entreprise de tri des poubelles.
options.text_en: To introduce the waste sorting company.
options.explanation: The company 'Ville propre' is mentioned as the source of the request, but the purpose of the note is not to introduce or present the company itself.

options.text: Pour rappeler l’utilisation correcte des poubelles.
options.text_en: To remind about the correct use of the bins.
options.explanation: The note explains exactly how to sort waste into the correct bins, matching the purpose of reminding tenants about correct usage.

c8857769-b9f7-41d0-a269-66b6a398e289.key_line_fr: Il faut séparer le plastique et le carton et les mettre dans les poubelles jaunes.
c8857769-b9f7-41d0-a269-66b6a398e289.key_line_en: You must separate plastic and cardboard and put them in the yellow bins.
c8857769-b9f7-41d0-a269-66b6a398e289.explanation: The text provides specific rules on sorting waste into yellow or grey bins, which serves to remind tenants how to use them correctly.
c8857769-b9f7-41d0-a269-66b6a398e289.breakdown: The text is a message from the caretaker ('gardien') to the tenants ('locataires'). The core message is a request from a company to pay attention to waste disposal ('faire plus attention quand on jette nos déchets'). Specifically, it gives instructions on separating plastic and cardboard for the yellow bins ('poubelles jaunes') versus other waste for the grey bins ('poubelles grises'). This constitutes a reminder or instruction on how to use the bins correctly.

63c4fcc7-1d32-4d45-bf65-016cc1dfc3e3.text:
Votre bibliothèque vous invite à venir écouter une sélection de CD à l’occasion du festival de musique.
« Le printemps du Jazz »

Une page se tourne ou plutôt ne se tournera plus pour les députés.
Des tablettes numériques remplacent désormais les épaisses liasses de papier.
Depuis leur arrivée en juin, beaucoup de nouveaux députés se sont émus de la quantité de papier utilisée pendant l’examen des textes, avec des amendements systématiquement imprimés.
Avec environ 52 000 paquets utilisés chaque année, l’Assemblée est gourmande en feuilles, même si ce chiffre a déjà énormément diminué depuis cinq ans avec la dématérialisation de certains travaux.
21e64a09-f959-4440-b5bb-e9934855b2f0.text_en: A page turns, or rather will no longer turn for the deputies. Digital tablets now replace thick bundles of paper. Since their arrival in June, many new deputies were moved by the quantity of paper used during the examination of texts, with amendments systematically printed. With about 52,000 packages used each year, the Assembly is greedy for sheets, even if this figure has already decreased enormously over five years with the dematerialization of certain works.

3fb1dd3c-c052-45a6-8296-38878699de33.text:
Lors des premiers pas de l’art urbain (connu aussi sous le nom de street art), il y a plus de cinquante ans, personne ne portait vraiment intérêt à cette expression artistique éphémère.
Les tags étaient destinés à disparaître, mais avec le temps, cela a changé : désormais on va jusqu’à découper les murs pour les vendre aux enchères et en garder une trace, car la conservation des œuvres d’art urbain dans l’espace public pose de sérieux défis.
Il faut les protéger des agressions du temps, de la température, des dégradations humaines.
On peut mettre une protection en plexiglas, mais un jour le mur finira aussi peut-être par tomber.
3fb1dd3c-c052-45a6-8296-38878699de33.text_en: During the early steps of urban art (also known as street art), more than fifty years ago, no one really cared about this ephemeral artistic expression. Tags were destined to disappear, but over time, this changed: now people go as far as cutting out walls to sell them at auction and keep a trace of them, because preserving urban art works in public spaces poses serious challenges. They must be protected from the ravages of time, temperature, and human degradation. One can put up Plexiglas protection, but one day the wall might also eventually fall.
3fb1dd3c-c052-45a6-8296-38878699de33.question_fr: Qu’explique l’auteur à propos des œuvres d’art urbain ?
3fb1dd3c-c052-45a6-8296-38878699de33.question_en: What does the author explain about urban art works?

options.explanation: The text mentions auctions (enchères), but never mentions museums being ready to welcome the works.

options.text_en: The market sees its value rising.
options.explanation: While auctions are mentioned, the text focuses on the effort to 'keep a trace' and the challenges of 'conservation' rather than analyzing the market value or rising prices.
The text discusses the art works themselves, not the fame or status of the artists.

options.text_en: People want to preserve them permanently.
options.explanation: The text emphasizes 'keeping a trace', 'conservation', and 'protecting' the works from time, which means the goal is to preserve them durably.

3fb1dd3c-c052-45a6-8296-38878699de33.key_line_fr: désormais on va jusqu’à découper les murs pour les vendre aux enchères et en garder une trace, car la conservation des œuvres d’art urbain dans l’espace public pose de sérieux défis.
3fb1dd3c-c052-45a6-8296-38878699de33.key_line_en: now people go as far as cutting out walls to sell them at auction and keep a trace of them, because preserving urban art works in public spaces poses serious challenges.
3fb1dd3c-c052-45a6-8296-38878699de33.explanation: The passage explains that street art, once considered temporary, is now the subject of significant efforts to protect and preserve it against time and degradation.
3fb1dd3c-c052-45a6-8296-38878699de33.breakdown: The text contrasts the initial view of street art as 'ephemeral' (destined to disappear) with the modern attitude where people go to great lengths to 'keep a trace' (en garder une trace) of it. It explicitly mentions the challenges of 'conservation' and the need to 'protect' these works from time and degradation. This aligns perfectly with the idea of wanting to preserve them for the long term.

7eaa1d27-e82b-4e6d-a06d-6d26264bc357.text:
SOCIÉTÉ
Plus que jamais peut-être, des lycéens, étudiants, jeunes travailleurs sont nombreux à consacrer une partie de leur activité, souvent bénévolement, aux plus âgés.
Tout au long de la semaine, ils passent faire un brin de causette, histoire de tenir compagnie à ces personnes isolées, délaissées par leur famille.
Rencontrer des jeunes n’est-il pas le plus sûr moyen de conserver un semblant de vie sociale ?
7eaa1d27-e82b-4e6d-a06d-6d26264bc357.text_en: Perhaps more than ever, many high schoolers, students, and young workers devote part of their activity, often voluntarily, to the elderly. Throughout the week, they drop by for a chat, just to keep these isolated people, abandoned by their families, company. Isn't meeting young people the surest way to maintain a semblance of social life?
7eaa1d27-e82b-4e6d-a06d-6d26264bc357.question_fr: Pourquoi certains jeunes consacrent-ils du temps aux personnes âgées ?
7eaa1d27-e82b-4e6d-a06d-6d26264bc357.question_en: Why do some young people devote time to the elderly?

options.explanation: The passage describes a social exchange between 'jeunes' (youth) and 'plus âgés' (older people), which establishes a bond between generations.
Although 'étudiants' (students) are mentioned, the text does not state they are doing this for school credit.
The text explicitly says the work is done 'bénévolement', meaning voluntarily or for free.

options.text: Parce qu’ils ne veulent plus être seuls.
options.text_en: Because they don't want to be alone anymore.
options.explanation: The text identifies the elderly as the 'personnes isolées' (isolated people), not the young volunteers.

3d10612b-9b99-45e5-942d-f4e1cc4e571c.text:
Hier soir, lors du dernier concert du Festival de Jazz organisé par la ville de Nancy, une chanteuse lorraine, Mell, a enthousiasmé le public lors de la première partie.
À tel point que le groupe prévu ensuite a dû décaler son horaire.
En effet, lorsque la chanteuse a quitté la scène, la salle, noire de monde, s’est mise à hurler afin de l’empêcher de partir.
3d10612b-9b99-45e5-942d-f4e1cc4e571c.text_en: Last night, during the last concert of the Jazz Festival organized by the city of Nancy, a singer from Lorraine, Mell, enthused the audience during the first part. To such an extent that the group scheduled next had to shift its schedule. Indeed, when the singer left the stage, the room, packed with people, started screaming to stop her from leaving.
3d10612b-9b99-45e5-942d-f4e1cc4e571c.question_fr: Comment le public a-t-il réagi lors du concert de Mell ?
3d10612b-9b99-45e5-942d-f4e1cc4e571c.question_en: How did the audience react during Mell's concert?

options.text: Il a acclamé de toutes ses forces la chanteuse.
options.text_en: It acclaimed the singer with all its might.
options.explanation: The audience screamed to keep her on stage, which signifies intense acclaim and enthusiasm.

options.text: Il a demandé l’annulation du concert.
options.text_en: It asked for the cancellation of the concert.
options.explanation: The audience was enthusiastic ('enthousiasmé'), so they did not want to cancel the concert.

options.text: Il a invité le groupe suivant à partir.
options.text_en: It invited the following group to leave.
options.explanation: The next group was delayed due to the first act's success, but the audience did not ask the next group to leave.

options.text: Il l’a retenue prisonnière toute la nuit.
options.text_en: It held her prisoner all night.
options.explanation: This is a literal misinterpretation. Preventing a singer from leaving the stage means demanding an encore, not kidnapping.

3d10612b-9b99-45e5-942d-f4e1cc4e571c.key_line_fr: En effet, lorsque la chanteuse a quitté la scène, la salle, noire de monde, s’est mise à hurler afin de l’empêcher de partir.
3d10612b-9b99-45e5-942d-f4e1cc4e571c.key_line_en: Indeed, when the singer left the stage, the room, packed with people, started screaming to stop her from leaving.
3d10612b-9b99-45e5-942d-f4e1cc4e571c.explanation: The text describes an enthusiastic crowd screaming to prevent the singer from leaving, which corresponds to cheering and acclaiming her, not hostility or kidnapping.
3d10612b-9b99-45e5-942d-f4e1cc4e571c.breakdown:
1.  **Analyze the context**: The text states Mell 'enthousiasmé le public' (enthused the audience).
2.  **Identify the specific action**: When she left, the crowd 's’est mise à hurler afin de l’empêcher de partir' (started screaming to stop her from leaving).
3.  **Evaluate Option A**: 'Acclamé de toutes ses forces' (acclaimed with all its might) aligns perfectly with a crowd screaming for an artist to stay for an encore.
4.  **Evaluate Option B**: The context is positive enthusiasm, not a request for cancellation.
5.  **Evaluate Option C**: The next group was delayed ('décaler'), but the audience did not ask them to leave; they just wanted more of Mell.
6.  **Evaluate Option D**: 'Retenue prisonnière' (held prisoner) is a literal and incorrect interpretation of wanting an artist to stay on stage.

b52e96f4-d0bf-47b6-889f-2416daf6a5ae.text:
Comment recruter la bonne personne, baby-sitter ou collaborateur ?
Si le bouche-à-oreille ou les tests constituent des méthodes largement répandues, difficile pour autant d’être sûr à 100% que la personne choisie soit vraiment la bonne.
C’est pourquoi, pour une somme modique, une entreprise californienne, Predictim, promet une analyse complète de la personnalité des candidats via les réseaux sociaux : grâce à un algorithme, toutes leurs publications sont étudiées en seulement quelques secondes.
Cependant, l’usage de l’intelligence artificielle pour la sélection de candidats a rapidement montré ses limites.
L’entreprise Amazon, par exemple, a dû renoncer à son logiciel de recrutement, car celui-ci avait tendance à privilégier les hommes.
b52e96f4-d0bf-47b6-889f-2416daf6a5ae.text_en: How to recruit the right person, baby-sitter or employee? While word of mouth or tests constitute widely widespread methods, it is difficult however to be 100% sure that the chosen person is really the right one. That is why, for a modest sum, a Californian company, Predictim, promises a complete analysis of the candidates' personality via social networks: thanks to an algorithm, all their publications are studied in only a few seconds. However, the use of artificial intelligence for the selection of candidates has quickly shown its limits. The company Amazon, for example, had to give up its recruitment software, because it tended to favor men.
b52e96f4-d0bf-47b6-889f-2416daf6a5ae.question_fr: Que devrait permettre l’intelligence artificielle dans le monde professionnel ?
b52e96f4-d0bf-47b6-889f-2416daf6a5ae.question_en: What is artificial intelligence supposed to allow in the professional world?
