options.text: De vérifier le profil des postulants.
options.explanation: The text states the AI analyzes candidates' personalities and studies their social media publications, which constitutes verifying their profiles.
There is no mention of AI being used to create new jobs.
While this might be a general goal of AI, the text explicitly states that Amazon's AI 'tended to favor men,' proving it failed to avoid discrimination in that instance.

b52e96f4-d0bf-47b6-889f-2416daf6a5ae.key_line_fr: C’est pourquoi, pour une somme modique, une entreprise californienne, Predictim, promet une analyse complète de la personnalité des candidats via les réseaux sociaux : grâce à un algorithme, toutes leurs publications sont étudiées en seulement quelques secondes.
b52e96f4-d0bf-47b6-889f-2416daf6a5ae.key_line_en: That is why, for a modest sum, a Californian company, Predictim, promises a complete analysis of the candidates' personality via social networks: thanks to an algorithm, all their publications are studied in only a few seconds.
b52e96f4-d0bf-47b6-889f-2416daf6a5ae.explanation: The text describes an AI tool designed to analyze candidate personalities through social media, which is a method of verifying applicant profiles.
b52e96f4-d0bf-47b6-889f-2416daf6a5ae.breakdown: The text introduces the challenge of recruitment and presents an AI solution offered by the company Predictim. The specific function described for this AI is to perform a 'complete analysis of the personality of candidates via social networks' by studying their posts. This aligns directly with Option B (verifying the profile of applicants). The text later mentions that Amazon's AI failed by favoring men, which contradicts Option D (avoiding discrimination). Options A and C are not mentioned.

d73cd32e-e434-4f92-a260-c64599756d3e.text:
Elle écrivait récemment sa dernière chronique, lancée comme un appel à la résistance : « Je m’en vais et je pense que vous devriez me rejoindre. ».
La journaliste Kelly H. annonçait trois choses : qu’elle démissionnait après une longue carrière dans un prestigieux quotidien, qu’elle devenait professeure de mathématiques et qu’elle créait une fondation pour encourager d’anciens entrepreneurs à devenir enseignants.
« Vous avez eu une carrière à succès. Maintenant, faites quelque chose de plus important ! Enseignez ! ».
En tant que journaliste, elle avait effectué des enquêtes sur la vie des cadres supérieurs, en ridiculisant le plus souvent l’engouement pour les concepts managériaux en vogue et en soulignant les crises existentielles des cadres.
d73cd32e-e434-4f92-a260-c64599756d3e.text_en: She recently wrote her last column, launched as a call to resistance: 'I am leaving and I think you should join me.' Journalist Kelly H. announced three things: that she was resigning after a long career in a prestigious daily newspaper, that she was becoming a mathematics professor, and that she was creating a foundation to encourage former entrepreneurs to become teachers. 'You have had a successful career. Now, do something more important! Teach!'. As a journalist, she had conducted investigations into the lives of senior executives, often ridiculing the craze for management concepts in vogue and highlighting the existential crises of executives.
d73cd32e-e434-4f92-a260-c64599756d3e.question_fr: Quelle est la nouvelle priorité de Kelly H. ?
d73cd32e-e434-4f92-a260-c64599756d3e.question_en: What is Kelly H.'s new priority?

options.text: Changer la façon de gérer des équipes.
options.text_en: Changing the way teams are managed.
options.explanation: This relates to the topics she covered in her past career as a journalist, not her new priority.

options.text_en: Compensating for the lack of trainers.
options.explanation: The text mentions encouraging others to become teachers because it is 'important,' not explicitly to fill a shortage of trainers.
She is leaving a successful career in a company, indicating this is no longer her priority.
She has become a teacher and urges others to teach. Teaching is the act of transmitting knowledge.

d73cd32e-e434-4f92-a260-c64599756d3e.key_line_fr: Maintenant, faites quelque chose de plus important ! Enseignez !
d73cd32e-e434-4f92-a260-c64599756d3e.key_line_en: Now, do something more important! Teach!
d73cd32e-e434-4f92-a260-c64599756d3e.explanation: Kelly H. leaves her journalism career to become a math teacher and urges others to teach, making the transmission of knowledge her new priority.
d73cd32e-e434-4f92-a260-c64599756d3e.breakdown:
1. Identify Kelly H.'s actions: She is resigning to become a math teacher ('devenait professeure de mathématiques').
2. Identify her message: She tells others to 'Teach!' ('Enseignez !').
3. Analyze the options against these facts.
4. Option A refers to her past work criticizing management, not her new goal.
5. Option B suggests filling a labor shortage ('manque'), which is not explicitly stated as the motivation; the motivation is doing something 'more important'.
6. Option C refers to the career success she is leaving behind.
7. Option D ('Transmitting knowledge') perfectly describes the act of teaching ('Enseignez') and becoming a professor.

46581d37-83bd-4dee-aeda-18f717096ec9.text:
Vincent Van Gogh (1853-1890), un fou génial et sans le sou, s’est coupé l’oreille ; il n’a pas été reconnu de son vivant.
Voilà à peu près l’image qu’on se fait du célèbre peintre néerlandais, du moins à en croire les livres, les films et les anecdotes dont il est le héros.
Un mythe difficile à effacer s’est construit autour du peintre à partir d’une histoire romancée.
Or, une étude approfondie de l’ensemble de la correspondance de Vincent Van Gogh - échangée essentiellement avec son frère Théo, mais aussi avec Gauguin - donne une impression beaucoup plus nuancée.
Van Gogh n’était pas si pauvre, il n’était pas si fou et il a bénéficié d’une certaine notoriété de son vivant, même si ce n’était pas auprès du grand public.
Forte personnalité, dans ses lettres il savait raconter merveilleusement et de façon captivante ce qui l’occupait et pourquoi il peignait un sujet de telle ou telle manière.
46581d37-83bd-4dee-aeda-18f717096ec9.text_en: Vincent Van Gogh (1853-1890), a mad genius and penniless, cut off his ear; he was not recognized during his lifetime. That is roughly the image people have of the famous Dutch painter, at least according to books, films, and anecdotes of which he is the hero. A myth difficult to erase has been built around the painter based on a romanticized story. However, a thorough study of the entire correspondence of Vincent Van Gogh - exchanged essentially with his brother Théo, but also with Gauguin - gives a much more nuanced impression. Van Gogh was not that poor, he was not that crazy, and he enjoyed a certain notoriety during his lifetime, even if it was not with the general public. A strong personality, in his letters he knew how to recount wonderfully and captivatingly what occupied him and why he painted a subject in such and such a way.
46581d37-83bd-4dee-aeda-18f717096ec9.question_fr: Qu’explique ce texte sur Vincent Van Gogh ?
46581d37-83bd-4dee-aeda-18f717096ec9.question_en: What does this text explain about Vincent Van Gogh?

options.text: Que sa biographie aide à mieux comprendre ses tableaux.
options.text_en: That his biography helps to better understand his paintings.
options.explanation: The text mentions that he explained his art in letters, but the primary purpose of the text is to correct the misconceptions about his life and personality, not specifically to use biography to analyze paintings.

options.text: Que sa correspondance avec ses proches a influencé sa peinture.
options.text_en: That his correspondence with his loved ones influenced his painting.
options.explanation: The text states that he wrote about his painting, not that the act of corresponding influenced the painting itself.

options.text: Que ses écrits permettent de mieux cerner qu’il était.
options.text_en: That his writings allow us to better identify who he was.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states that studying his correspondence provides a 'much more nuanced impression' of him, correcting the myths regarding his poverty and madness.

options.text: Que ses textes confortent l’image que l’on avait de lui.
options.text_en: That his texts confirm the image we had of him.
options.explanation: The text argues the opposite: the letters contradict the popular image (myth) rather than reinforcing (confortent) it.

46581d37-83bd-4dee-aeda-18f717096ec9.key_line_fr: Or, une étude approfondie de l’ensemble de la correspondance de Vincent Van Gogh - échangée essentiellement avec son frère Théo, mais aussi avec Gauguin - donne une impression beaucoup plus nuancée.
46581d37-83bd-4dee-aeda-18f717096ec9.key_line_en: However, a thorough study of the entire correspondence of Vincent Van Gogh - exchanged essentially with his brother Théo, but also with Gauguin - gives a much more nuanced impression.
46581d37-83bd-4dee-aeda-18f717096ec9.explanation: The text contrasts the 'myth' of Van Gogh with the reality revealed in his letters, showing that his writings help us understand his true personality.
46581d37-83bd-4dee-aeda-18f717096ec9.breakdown: The text begins by describing the popular stereotype of Van Gogh as a 'mad genius' and 'penniless'. It then uses the pivotal connector 'Or' (However) to introduce a counter-argument: a detailed study of his correspondence reveals a 'much more nuanced impression'. The text explains that his letters show he wasn't as poor or crazy as the myth suggests. Therefore, the writings allow us to better understand the reality of who he was, supporting Option C.

94a14dfc-aeeb-47de-a37b-2eb10eed150d.text:
Les chaînes d’information en continu nous montrent la vie en temps réel, comme si nous y étions.
Les informations y sont plus vraies que nature, elles palpitent et nous prennent aux tripes, analyse le journaliste Hubert Huertas.
Avec le direct, nous pouvons imaginer qu’il peut toujours se passer quelque chose.
C’est plus fort que le différé et plus fort que la fiction : nous sommes dans le concret, en contact avec le monde, et cela devient addictif, ajoute Virginie Spies, spécialiste des médias.
À cela s’ajoute une impression d’insécurité.
Le direct présente dans ces moments un côté hypnotique et tient le téléspectateur en haleine.
94a14dfc-aeeb-47de-a37b-2eb10eed150d.text_en: Continuous news channels show us life in real time, as if we were there. The information is truer than life; it palpitates and grabs us by the guts, analyzes journalist Hubert Huertas. With live broadcasting, we can imagine that something can always happen. It is stronger than recorded broadcasts and stronger than fiction: we are in the concrete, in contact with the world, and it becomes addictive, adds Virginie Spies, a media specialist. To this is added a feeling of insecurity. Live broadcasting presents a hypnotic side in these moments and keeps the viewer in suspense.
94a14dfc-aeeb-47de-a37b-2eb10eed150d.question_fr: Qu’explique cet article à propos des chaînes d’informations en continu ?
94a14dfc-aeeb-47de-a37b-2eb10eed150d.question_en: What does this article explain about continuous news channels?

options.explanation: The text states that 'live' coverage (immediacy) keeps the viewer in suspense and is addictive, effectively captivating the audience through the immediate moment.

options.text: Elles exigent un sens du discernement.
options.text_en: They require a sense of discernment.
options.explanation: The text describes the viewer's state as 'hypnotic' and passive, rather than one requiring active critical judgment or discernment.

options.text: Elles modifient le rapport au temps.
options.text_en: They modify the relationship to time.
options.explanation: Although 'real time' vs 'delayed' is discussed, the primary point is the emotional grip (addiction), not a structural change in the relationship with time.
The text associates the viewership with addiction and insecurity, which are distinct from the concept of feeding a healthy or budding curiosity.

94a14dfc-aeeb-47de-a37b-2eb10eed150d.key_line_fr: Le direct présente dans ces moments un côté hypnotique et tient le téléspectateur en haleine.
94a14dfc-aeeb-47de-a37b-2eb10eed150d.key_line_en: Live broadcasting presents a hypnotic side in these moments and keeps the viewer in suspense.

vocabulary.gloss: grab us by the guts / deeply affect us

94a14dfc-aeeb-47de-a37b-2eb10eed150d.explanation: The article argues that the 'live' and 'real-time' nature of continuous news creates a hypnotic and addictive effect that captures the viewer's attention.
94a14dfc-aeeb-47de-a37b-2eb10eed150d.breakdown:
The text analyzes the psychological impact of 24-hour news channels. It emphasizes keywords like 'temps réel' (real time) and 'le direct' (live broadcast), describing them as 'addictif' (addictive), 'hypnotique' (hypnotic), and capable of keeping the viewer 'en haleine' (in suspense). This indicates that the channel's power lies in the 'now' or the immediate nature of the content. 

Option A ('Elles captivent l’instantanéité') aligns with this, suggesting that these channels enthrall or hold attention through the quality of immediacy. Option B is incorrect because the text suggests viewers are hypnotized rather than using discernment. Option C is a distractor; while 'time' is mentioned, the focus is on emotional engagement, not a philosophical shift in time perception. Option D is incorrect because the text links the viewing habit to 'insécurité' and 'addiction' rather than positive 'curiosity'.

e1361eb6-f5e7-4403-98e1-b39e28a15c8c.text:
Le désintérêt pour la lecture chez un grand nombre d'enfants peut être expliqué par plusieurs facteurs.
Tout d'abord, beaucoup d'enfants abandonnent la lecture lorsqu'ils réalisent que d'autres élèves sont plus avancés qu'eux.
De plus, lorsqu'on demande à l'enfant non seulement de lire, mais aussi de comprendre, il peut perdre son intérêt. En général, l'absence de compréhension est associée à un manque de plaisir.
Cependant, la culture générale s'acquiert justement en lisant. Cela crée un cercle vicieux difficile à briser. Pour sortir de ce cercle vicieux, les psychologues recommandent de mettre à la disposition des enfants des livres adaptés à leur niveau de compréhension et à leurs centres d'intérêt.
De plus, il est important de proposer des méthodes d'enseignement de la lecture qui encouragent l'interaction entre les élèves.
Enfin, il est important que les parents et les enseignants encouragent la lecture chez les enfants en leur offrant des livres adaptés à leur âge et à leur niveau de compréhension.
e1361eb6-f5e7-4403-98e1-b39e28a15c8c.text_en: The lack of interest in reading among a large number of children can be explained by several factors. First, many children give up reading when they realize that other students are more advanced than them. Moreover, when asking the child not only to read but also to understand, they may lose interest. In general, the absence of understanding is associated with a lack of pleasure. However, general culture is acquired precisely by reading. This creates a vicious circle that is difficult to break. To get out of this vicious circle, psychologists recommend making books available to children that are adapted to their level of understanding and their interests. Additionally, it is important to propose reading teaching methods that encourage interaction between students. Finally, it is important for parents and teachers to encourage reading in children by offering them books adapted to their age and level of understanding.
e1361eb6-f5e7-4403-98e1-b39e28a15c8c.question_fr: Selon ce texte, quelle est l’une des raisons qui découragent les enfants de lire ?
e1361eb6-f5e7-4403-98e1-b39e28a15c8c.question_en: According to this text, what is one of the reasons that discourage children from reading?

options.explanation: The text links the loss of interest to the demand for comprehension ('comprendre'). 'Accéder au sens' (accessing meaning) is synonymous with understanding.

options.text: La pression exercée par la famille
options.explanation: The text mentions parents in the context of a solution (encouragement), not as a source of negative pressure causing disinterest.
The text suggests proposing better teaching methods as a solution, but it does not cite the methods themselves as the direct cause of discouragement in the list of factors.
The text mentions children comparing themselves to more advanced peers, but it does not mention mockery ('moqueries') or bullying.

e1361eb6-f5e7-4403-98e1-b39e28a15c8c.key_line_fr: En général, l'absence de compréhension est associée à un manque de plaisir.
e1361eb6-f5e7-4403-98e1-b39e28a15c8c.key_line_en: In general, the absence of understanding is associated with a lack of pleasure.
e1361eb6-f5e7-4403-98e1-b39e28a15c8c.explanation: The text explicitly states that children lose interest when they are required to understand what they read, linking a lack of comprehension to a lack of pleasure.
e1361eb6-f5e7-4403-98e1-b39e28a15c8c.breakdown: The question asks for a reason why children are discouraged from reading. Scanning the text for causes of 'désintérêt' (lack of interest), we find two main points: social comparison and the requirement to understand. The text states: 'when asking the child not only to read but also to understand, they may lose interest' and 'lack of understanding is associated with a lack of pleasure.' Option A mentions 'difficulty accessing meaning,' which is a synonym for 'difficulty understanding' or 'lack of comprehension.'

a872edff-e0bc-4c56-8923-4a6cf7f64433.text:
Ça pourrait être une tragédie, avec les meilleurs ingrédients du genre : rencontres hasardeuses de personnages abîmés par un lourd passé, malheurs successifs et révélations inattendues.
Sauf qu’entre le jeune pompier Roméo et l’infirmière Juliette victime de la cruauté de son compagnon, le chemin tracé par Agnès Ledig dans son roman Pars avec lui est plein de pudeur, riche de personnages ordinaires, mais surprenants, vrais, mais imprévisibles, dans une France provinciale qu’on décrit trop peu.
Il y a chez eux une envie de dire, d’avouer ce qui fut trop longtemps caché.
Ainsi, l’histoire se fait-elle peu à peu libération et rédemption.
Avec un art direct et familier de conteuse, l’auteure offre à ses personnages un espoir, un bonheur encore possible.
a872edff-e0bc-4c56-8923-4a6cf7f64433.text_en: It could be a tragedy, with the best ingredients of the genre: chance encounters of characters damaged by a heavy past, successive misfortunes and unexpected revelations. Except that between the young firefighter Romeo and the nurse Juliette, victim of her partner's cruelty, the path traced by Agnès Ledig in her novel 'Pars avec lui' is full of modesty, rich in ordinary but surprising characters, true but unpredictable, in a provincial France that is described too little. There is in them a desire to say, to confess what was hidden too long. Thus, the story gradually becomes liberation and redemption. With a direct and familiar storytelling art, the author offers her characters hope, a happiness still possible.
a872edff-e0bc-4c56-8923-4a6cf7f64433.question_fr: D’après la critique, quel est l’atout principal du roman d’Agnès Ledig ?
a872edff-e0bc-4c56-8923-4a6cf7f64433.question_en: According to the critique, what is the main asset of Agnès Ledig's novel?

options.text: L’alternance entre le comique et le drame.
options.text_en: The alternation between comedy and drama.
options.explanation: The text mentions 'tragedy' and 'happiness', but does not mention 'comedy' or an alternation between the two.
While the characters have a 'heavy past', the atmosphere is described as 'full of modesty' and offering 'hope', rather than being enigmatic or disturbing.
The text mentions 'provincial France', but this is the setting, not the primary asset highlighted by the critic, which is the characters' evolution.

options.text: L’émancipation des héros au cours du récit.
options.text_en: The emancipation of the heroes during the story.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states the story becomes 'liberation and redemption', which is synonymous with the 'emancipation' of the heroes.

a872edff-e0bc-4c56-8923-4a6cf7f64433.key_line_fr: Ainsi, l’histoire se fait-elle peu à peu libération et rédemption.
a872edff-e0bc-4c56-8923-4a6cf7f64433.key_line_en: Thus, the story gradually becomes liberation and redemption.
a872edff-e0bc-4c56-8923-4a6cf7f64433.explanation: The text describes the story as moving towards 'liberation and redemption' for the characters, which aligns perfectly with 'emancipation'.
a872edff-e0bc-4c56-8923-4a6cf7f64433.breakdown:
1. The text begins by describing the genre elements (tragedy, damaged characters), but quickly pivots using 'Sauf que' (Except that). 
2. It describes the characters' journey: they have a desire to confess hidden things. 
3. The crucial sentence states: 'l’histoire se fait-elle peu à peu libération et rédemption' (the story gradually becomes liberation and redemption). 
4. This idea of 'liberation' and 'redemption' leading to 'hope' directly matches Option D (Emancipation of the heroes). 
5. Option A is incorrect because comedy is not mentioned. Option B is incorrect because the outcome is positive (hope), not disturbing. Option C mentions the setting (provincial France) but the critique focuses on the characters' internal journey.

2351014c-0ef4-4a1e-ac9b-fe0866f8d7e1.text:
La révolution numérique aura, selon le philosophe Michel Serres, des effets au moins aussi considérables qu’en leur temps l’invention de l’écriture, puis celle de l’imprimerie.
Les notions de temps et d’espace en sont transformées et les façons d’accéder à la connaissance profondément modifiées.
À cet égard, chaque grande rupture dans l’histoire de l’humanité conduit à priver l’homme de facultés (« il perd »), mais chaque révolution lui en apporte de nouvelles (« il gagne »).
Pour chaque perte d’une part de mémoire et de capacité de traitement de l’information liée à la diffusion des technologies numériques, l’homme gagne une possibilité nouvelle de mise en relation (entre les individus et entre les savoirs) ainsi qu’une faculté décuplée d’invention et de création.
2351014c-0ef4-4a1e-ac9b-fe0866f8d7e1.text_en: According to philosopher Michel Serres, the digital revolution will have effects at least as considerable as the invention of writing and then printing in their time. The notions of time and space are transformed by it, and the ways of accessing knowledge deeply modified. In this regard, every major rupture in the history of humanity leads to depriving man of faculties ('he loses'), but every revolution brings him new ones ('he gains'). For every loss of a part of memory and information processing capacity linked to the spread of digital technologies, man gains a new possibility of connection (between individuals and between fields of knowledge) as well as a tenfold faculty of invention and creation.
2351014c-0ef4-4a1e-ac9b-fe0866f8d7e1.question_fr: Sur quoi Michel Serres attire-t-il l’attention ?
2351014c-0ef4-4a1e-ac9b-fe0866f8d7e1.question_en: What does Michel Serres draw attention to?

options.explanation: The text explicitly discusses the loss and gain of human 'faculties' (memory vs. invention/creation). This process of losing old abilities and gaining new ones constitutes an 'evolution of mental aptitudes'.

options.text: La mondialisation de la recherche scientifique.
options.explanation: The text mentions connecting individuals and knowledge, but it does not discuss the 'globalization of scientific research'.

The text mentions that 'ways of accessing knowledge' are modified, but the primary focus of the argument is on the faculties of the human mind (memory, invention), not the transformation of the knowledge itself.
There is no reference to preserving or maintaining cultural heritage in the text.

2351014c-0ef4-4a1e-ac9b-fe0866f8d7e1.key_line_fr: À cet égard, chaque grande rupture dans l’histoire de l’humanité conduit à priver l’homme de facultés (« il perd »), mais chaque révolution lui en apporte de nouvelles (« il gagne »).
2351014c-0ef4-4a1e-ac9b-fe0866f8d7e1.key_line_en: In this regard, every major rupture in the history of humanity leads to depriving man of faculties ('he loses'), but every revolution brings him new ones ('he gains').
2351014c-0ef4-4a1e-ac9b-fe0866f8d7e1.explanation: Michel Serres argues that the digital revolution changes human cognitive abilities, causing us to lose some faculties like memory while gaining others like creativity, which fits the description of evolving mental aptitudes.
2351014c-0ef4-4a1e-ac9b-fe0866f8d7e1.breakdown: The text outlines Michel Serres's view that the digital revolution acts as a major historical rupture similar to writing or printing. The core argument is presented in the second half of the text: humans lose certain 'faculties' (memory, information processing) but gain new ones (connection, invention, creation). The terms 'faculties', 'memory', 'capacity', and 'invention' all refer to the mind's abilities. Therefore, the text focuses on how these mental abilities are changing (evolving). Option A captures this shift accurately.

400d708b-12a9-4e85-86e1-5b793852437d.text:
Bonjour Madame Grange,
Je vous confirme notre rendez-vous de demain. Je viendrai vous chercher à l’aéroport. Nous irons ensuite manger au restaurant. Enfin, nous rencontrerons les responsables de l’entreprise à 14h pour signer le contrat.

Madame Dire

Finally, we will meet the managers of the company at 2 PM to sign the contract. See you tomorrow, Madame Dire

400d708b-12a9-4e85-86e1-5b793852437d.question_en: Why is Madame Dire writing to Madame Grange?

400d708b-12a9-4e85-86e1-5b793852437d.key_line_fr: Je vous confirme notre rendez-vous de demain. Je viendrai vous chercher à l’aéroport. Nous irons ensuite manger au restaurant. Enfin, nous rencontrerons les responsables...
400d708b-12a9-4e85-86e1-5b793852437d.key_line_en: I am confirming our appointment for tomorrow. I will come to pick you up at the airport. We will then go to eat at a restaurant. Finally, we will meet the managers...
400d708b-12a9-4e85-86e1-5b793852437d.explanation: The sender lists a schedule of events (airport, lunch, meeting) for tomorrow, effectively organizing the professional agenda for the day.

By listing these sequential activities, Madame Dire is establishing the plan for their time together. Therefore, the purpose is to organize the schedule for their working day.

de09a630-b4f6-49ff-9225-1f85621c9f52.text:
Production franco-canadienne.
Comédie.
Durée : 1 h 56 min
Année de production : 2004. Sortie : mercredi 6 juillet.
Public : à partir de 8 ans.
Résumé : Que peut-on offrir à un ami qui a tout ? Rien ! C’est l’histoire d’une amitié extraordinaire entre deux garçons : l’un, très pauvre, et l’autre, très riche. Une amitié racontée avec tendresse, humour, et un brin de philosophie.
de09a630-b4f6-49ff-9225-1f85621c9f52.text_en:

Il nous est tous arrivé de parler à voix haute alors que nous sommes seuls.
Mais pourquoi nous mettons-nous à nous exprimer ainsi et ne nous contentons-nous pas de penser silencieusement dans notre tête ?
À l’oral, tout ne peut pas être dit en même temps, contrairement à ce qui se passe dans la tête, où les pensées viennent simultanément et peuvent s’exclure les unes les autres.
À l’oral, il faut choisir les mots, énoncer les choses dans l’ordre, les mettre à plat pour organiser notre réflexion, comme l’explique le psychologue Sébastien Dupont.
73c7b1d4-c519-4bb3-becd-38c3d5639f1b.text_en: It has happened to all of us to speak out loud when we are alone. But why do we start expressing ourselves this way and not just content ourselves with thinking silently in our heads? When speaking, everything cannot be said at the same time, unlike what happens in the head, where thoughts come simultaneously and can exclude one another. When speaking, one must choose words, state things in order, lay them out to organize our reflection, as explained by psychologist Sébastien Dupont.

Si des animés japonais étaient diffusés avant Dragon Ball, c’est cette saga qui a popularisé le manga en France.
Le personnage principal, Goku, est d’abord un enfant simple et très joyeux.
Avec l’âge et l’expérience, il mûrit et assume les responsabilités liées au développement de ses supers pouvoirs.
Cette évolution du protagoniste, parallèle à celle de ses lecteurs, leur a permis de s’identifier à lui.
Ce procédé narratif, qui consiste à faire grandir le personnage au fil du temps, était sans précédent et surtout en opposition claire avec les comics américains dont les personnages ne vieillissent jamais.
4b652b34-b623-4c7d-a4a8-2edfb34bbbdb.text_en: While Japanese anime were broadcast before Dragon Ball, it is this saga that popularized manga in France. The main character, Goku, is initially a simple and very cheerful child. With age and experience, he matures and assumes the responsibilities linked to the development of his superpowers. This evolution of the protagonist, parallel to that of his readers, allowed them to identify with him. This narrative process, which consists of making the character grow up over time, was unprecedented and especially in clear opposition to American comics whose characters never age.
