d471f206-28f8-4a07-b8cc-ac0ed361db60.text:
C’est un fait majeur dans l’histoire du français : la France est devenue minoritaire en nombre de locuteurs dans le monde francophone.
Ce qui vaut mieux que de faire partie des 2 000 langues qui, par les hasards de l’histoire et des rapports de force, risquent d’avoir disparu d’ici à la fin du siècle.
En revanche, nous allons devoir abandonner certaines de nos postures traditionnelles.
Et ce pour une raison simple : le français ne dépend pas seulement d’une élite intellectuelle, écrivains, enseignants ou académiciens, mais surtout de ses locuteurs.
Aussi la langue va-t-elle nécessairement s’ouvrir davantage.
Il semble acquis en tout cas que l’origine de la norme va se déplacer des rives de la Seine au vaste monde, sachant qu’il s’agit là d’un enrichissement et non d’une perte.
d471f206-28f8-4a07-b8cc-ac0ed361db60.text_en: It is a major fact in the history of French: France has become a minority in terms of the number of speakers in the French-speaking world. Which is better than being part of the 2,000 languages which, by the accidents of history and power struggles, risk disappearing by the end of the century. However, we will have to abandon some of our traditional postures. And this for a simple reason: French does not depend only on an intellectual elite, writers, teachers, or academicians, but above all on its speakers. Thus, the language will necessarily open up more. It seems certain in any case that the origin of the norm will move from the banks of the Seine to the vast world, knowing that this is an enrichment and not a loss.
d471f206-28f8-4a07-b8cc-ac0ed361db60.question_fr: Comment l’auteur voit-il l’évolution du français ?
d471f206-28f8-4a07-b8cc-ac0ed361db60.question_en: How does the author see the evolution of French?

options.text: Elle est dépendante de décisions politiques.
options.text_en: It is dependent on political decisions.
options.explanation: The text mentions 'rapports de force' (power struggles) regarding other languages, but does not state that the evolution of French depends on specific political decisions.

options.text: Elle est limitée par les intellectuels.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states that the language does *not* depend solely on the intellectual elite and is opening up, contradicting the idea that it is limited by them.

options.text: Elle est menacée par l’essor d’autres langues.
options.text_en: It is threatened by the rise of other languages.
options.explanation: The text contrasts French with languages that risk disappearing, implying French is safe. It calls the global expansion an 'enrichissement' (enrichment), not a threat.

options.text: Elle est modelée par ses locuteurs.
options.text_en: It is shaped by its speakers.
options.explanation: The text asserts that the language depends 'surtout de ses locuteurs' (above all on its speakers), meaning they are the primary force driving its evolution.

d471f206-28f8-4a07-b8cc-ac0ed361db60.key_line_fr: le français ne dépend pas seulement d’une élite intellectuelle, écrivains, enseignants ou académiciens, mais surtout de ses locuteurs.
d471f206-28f8-4a07-b8cc-ac0ed361db60.key_line_en: French does not depend only on an intellectual elite, writers, teachers, or academicians, but above all on its speakers.
d471f206-28f8-4a07-b8cc-ac0ed361db60.explanation: The author states that the future of French depends mainly on its speakers rather than elites, meaning the speakers are the ones shaping the language.
d471f206-28f8-4a07-b8cc-ac0ed361db60.breakdown: The text discusses the shifting dynamics of the French language. Specifically, it states that French no longer depends solely on an intellectual elite but 'surtout de ses locuteurs' (above all on its speakers). This directly supports the idea that the language is shaped or modeled by the people who speak it. The author views this shift as an 'enrichissement' (enrichment) rather than a threat or a limitation.

32dd80dc-d77a-41f4-8514-bbcdf8d8a194.text:
Initiée dans les années 1960, la bataille contre les mauvaises herbes n’a jamais cessé.
Depuis, les sols, en plus d’être labourés à outrance, sont aspergés de pesticides qui se propagent sur les terres et dans les eaux voisines.
Claude Bourguignon, ingénieur agricole, milite depuis plus de vingt ans pour tenter de convaincre les agriculteurs que le labourage intensif et les pesticides causent la perte de la matière organique terrestre.
Présente sur la couche supérieure de la terre, elle est composée de microbes, d’insectes et de champignons, et elle fournit des nutriments qui sont essentiels pour les sols.
32dd80dc-d77a-41f4-8514-bbcdf8d8a194.text_en: Initiated in the 1960s, the battle against weeds has never ceased. Since then, soils, in addition to being excessively ploughed, are sprayed with pesticides that spread onto the land and into neighboring waters. Claude Bourguignon, an agricultural engineer, has been campaigning for over twenty years to try to convince farmers that intensive ploughing and pesticides cause the loss of terrestrial organic matter. Present on the upper layer of the earth, it is composed of microbes, insects, and fungi, and it provides nutrients that are essential for soils.
32dd80dc-d77a-41f4-8514-bbcdf8d8a194.question_fr: Quel est l’objectif de Claude Bourguignon ?

options.text: Démontrer les dégâts des méthodes de culture intensive.
options.text_en: To demonstrate the damage of intensive farming methods.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states that he tries to convince farmers that intensive ploughing and pesticides cause the loss of organic matter. This equates to demonstrating the damage of intensive farming.

options.text: Prouver l’efficacité des insectes contre les parasites.
options.text_en: To prove the effectiveness of insects against parasites.
options.explanation: Insects are mentioned as a component of the soil's organic matter, not as a tool to fight parasites in this context.

options.text: Recommander des procédés de gestion durable de l’eau.
options.text_en: To recommend sustainable water management processes.
options.explanation: Although water contamination is mentioned in the background context, Bourguignon's specific stated goal is convincing farmers about the loss of soil organic matter.

options.text: Vulgariser des techniques de rendement des terres.
options.explanation: He is criticizing current intensive techniques that might focus on yield, rather than trying to popularize techniques for better yield.

32dd80dc-d77a-41f4-8514-bbcdf8d8a194.key_line_fr: Claude Bourguignon, ingénieur agricole, milite depuis plus de vingt ans pour tenter de convaincre les agriculteurs que le labourage intensif et les pesticides causent la perte de la matière organique terrestre.
32dd80dc-d77a-41f4-8514-bbcdf8d8a194.key_line_en: Claude Bourguignon, an agricultural engineer, has been campaigning for over twenty years to try to convince farmers that intensive ploughing and pesticides cause the loss of terrestrial organic matter.
32dd80dc-d77a-41f4-8514-bbcdf8d8a194.explanation: Claude Bourguignon's goal is to warn farmers that their intensive practices (ploughing and pesticides) are destroying the essential organic matter in the soil.
32dd80dc-d77a-41f4-8514-bbcdf8d8a194.breakdown:
1. Locate the sentence mentioning Claude Bourguignon: The text states he 'milite... pour tenter de convaincre les agriculteurs' (campaigns to try to convince farmers).
2. Identify the core message: He argues that 'le labourage intensif et les pesticides causent la perte de la matière organique terrestre' (intensive ploughing and pesticides cause the loss of terrestrial organic matter).
3. Compare with Option A: 'Démontrer les dégâts' (Demonstrate the damage) corresponds to 'convaincre... causent la perte' (convince... cause the loss). 'Méthodes de culture intensive' corresponds to 'labourage intensif et les pesticides'.

755d1cb6-e78a-4985-a96c-431a26effce7.text:
Dans les villes françaises, les arbres ont poussé tout l’hiver !
Insatiables capteurs de CO2, ils sont surtout de puissants climatiseurs.
Devant l’urgence, il faudrait en planter partout, dans les moindres interstices. Et vite.
Depuis des années, l’Organisation Mondiale de la Santé recommande un verdissement maximum des villes, insistant sur l’action de la nature quant à la réduction potentielle de l’exposition à la pollution de l’air, au bruit et à la chaleur excessive.
Mais sur le terrain, la mise en œuvre de tels programmes ne coule pas de source.
Le temps des politiques n’est pas le temps de l’arbre.
Pour qu’il rende pleinement les services qu’on attend de lui, il lui faut des dizaines d’années, un accès à l’eau, de l’espace, des congénères, un environnement écologique…
755d1cb6-e78a-4985-a96c-431a26effce7.text_en: In French cities, trees have been growing all winter! Insatiable CO2 sensors, they are above all powerful air conditioners. Faced with the emergency, we should plant them everywhere, in the smallest interstices. And quickly. For years, the World Health Organization has recommended maximum greening of cities, insisting on nature's action regarding the potential reduction of exposure to air pollution, noise, and excessive heat. But on the ground, the implementation of such programs is not self-evident. The time of politicians is not the time of the tree. For it to fully render the services expected of it, it needs decades, access to water, space, congeners, an ecological environment...
755d1cb6-e78a-4985-a96c-431a26effce7.question_fr: Que pense ce journaliste de l’arborisation des villes ?
755d1cb6-e78a-4985-a96c-431a26effce7.question_en: What does this journalist think about the greening of cities?

options.text: Elle a peu d’action sur le dérèglement climatique.
options.text_en: It has little effect on climate change.
options.explanation: Incorrect. The text explicitly states trees are 'insatiable CO2 sensors' and 'powerful air conditioners', acknowledging their positive impact.

options.text: Elle demande trop d’entretien aux petites villes.
options.text_en: It requires too much maintenance for small towns.
options.explanation: Incorrect. While the text mentions trees need water and space, it does not specifically mention 'small towns' or frame maintenance as the primary obstacle.

options.text: Elle doit figurer dans les programmes électoraux.
options.text_en: It must appear in electoral programs.
options.explanation: Incorrect. The journalist discusses the difficulty of implementation rather than making a specific demand for electoral programs.

options.text: Elle est incompatible avec les objectifs politiques.
options.text_en: It is incompatible with political objectives.
options.explanation: Correct. The text contrasts the long time trees need to grow (decades) with 'political time', implying that short-term political goals clash with the long-term requirements of urban forests.

755d1cb6-e78a-4985-a96c-431a26effce7.key_line_fr: Le temps des politiques n’est pas le temps de l’arbre.
755d1cb6-e78a-4985-a96c-431a26effce7.key_line_en: The time of politicians is not the time of the tree.

vocabulary.gloss: fellow trees / of the same kind

755d1cb6-e78a-4985-a96c-431a26effce7.explanation: The journalist argues that the decades required for trees to mature are incompatible with the short-term nature of political timelines.
755d1cb6-e78a-4985-a96c-431a26effce7.breakdown: The text begins by praising the benefits of trees and mentioning WHO recommendations for urban greening. However, the journalist introduces a contradiction with the word 'Mais' (But). The crucial sentence is 'Le temps des politiques n’est pas le temps de l’arbre' (The time of politicians is not the time of the tree). The text explains that trees need decades to become effective ('dizaines d’années'), whereas politicians operate on much shorter timelines. This creates a fundamental mismatch between the biological reality of trees and political schedules/objectives.

dc552241-c325-449d-8b8b-51526f2e5dce.text:
« Le programme de mobilité Erasmus n’est plus réservé aux étudiants », explique Sophie Roque, enseignante.
Peu répandu, le programme Erasmus+ pour les enseignants bénéficie depuis quelques années d’un grand appel d’air. La demande progresse, et l’offre de mobilité aussi. Le système éducatif finlandais et les formations en anglais attirent beaucoup.
Si le programme Erasmus+ pour les enseignants semble très apprécié de ceux qui y participent, il souffre néanmoins d’un vrai déficit de notoriété. On le découvre souvent par hasard ou à la faveur d’une rencontre.
Franck Le Cars, délégué académique, confirme que le bouche-à-oreille entre enseignants est le meilleur moyen de développer le dispositif. Il souligne également que ces mobilités à l’étranger restent complexes à mettre en œuvre car très chronophages.
dc552241-c325-449d-8b8b-51526f2e5dce.text_en: "The Erasmus mobility program is no longer reserved for students," explains Sophie Roque, a teacher. Little known, the Erasmus+ program for teachers has benefited from a breath of fresh air in recent years. Demand is growing, and the mobility offer is too. The Finnish education system and training in English attract many. If the Erasmus+ program for teachers seems very appreciated by those who participate in it, it nevertheless suffers from a real lack of fame. It is often discovered by chance or thanks to a meeting. Franck Le Cars, academic delegate, confirms that word-of-mouth between teachers is the best way to develop the scheme. He also emphasizes that these mobilities abroad remain complex to implement because they are very time-consuming.
dc552241-c325-449d-8b8b-51526f2e5dce.question_en: What do we learn about the Erasmus+ program?

options.text: Il est méconnu du public visé.
options.text_en: It is unknown to the target audience.
options.explanation: The text states the program suffers from a 'déficit de notoriété' (lack of fame), meaning it is little known ('méconnu') to the teachers.

options.text: Il est restreint à quelques pays
options.text_en: It is restricted to a few countries.
options.explanation: The text mentions the Finnish system attracts people, but does not state the program is restricted to only a few countries.
There is no mention in the text that the program favors specific establishments.

options.text_en: It suffers from a negative image.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states the program is 'très apprécié' (very appreciated) by participants, contradicting a negative image.

dc552241-c325-449d-8b8b-51526f2e5dce.key_line_fr: Si le programme Erasmus+ pour les enseignants semble très apprécié de ceux qui y participent, il souffre néanmoins d’un vrai déficit de notoriété.
dc552241-c325-449d-8b8b-51526f2e5dce.key_line_en: If the Erasmus+ program for teachers seems very appreciated by those who participate in it, it nevertheless suffers from a real lack of fame.

vocabulary.gloss: lack of fame / lack of awareness

dc552241-c325-449d-8b8b-51526f2e5dce.explanation: The text explicitly mentions that the program suffers from a 'déficit de notoriété' (lack of fame), which directly corresponds to option A being 'méconnu' (unknown/little known).
dc552241-c325-449d-8b8b-51526f2e5dce.breakdown:
1. Scan the text for the current status of the Erasmus+ program for teachers.
2. Locate the sentence: 'il souffre néanmoins d’un vrai déficit de notoriété' (it suffers from a real lack of fame/awareness).
3. Note the supporting detail: 'On le découvre souvent par hasard' (One often discovers it by chance).
4. Compare this with Option A: 'Il est méconnu du public visé' (It is unknown to the target audience). 'Méconnu' equates to 'déficit de notoriété'.
5. Eliminate Option D because the text says it is 'très apprécié' (very appreciated). Eliminate B and C as they are not mentioned in the text.

be1d0fd4-abad-45d4-b670-8c7239ef1af0.text:
Le trois-mâts d’exploration La Boudeuse va reprendre le large pour une nouvelle mission à caractère scientifique.
Le voilier va mettre le cap en septembre prochain sur l’Amérique du Sud et ses grands fleuves.
Il se consacrera aux études scientifiques et humaines concernant la biosphère, le réchauffement climatique et le développement durable, selon la « lettre de mission » adressée à son commandant, signée du ministre d’État aux Transports et à l’Écologie.
Cette lettre assigne à l’équipage un audacieux programme concernant la protection de l’environnement.
be1d0fd4-abad-45d4-b670-8c7239ef1af0.text_en: The exploration three-masted ship La Boudeuse is going to set sail again for a new mission of a scientific nature. The sailboat will set course next September for South America and its great rivers. It will devote itself to scientific and human studies concerning the biosphere, global warming, and sustainable development, according to the "mission letter" addressed to its commander, signed by the Minister of State for Transport and Ecology. This letter assigns the crew a bold program regarding environmental protection.
be1d0fd4-abad-45d4-b670-8c7239ef1af0.question_fr: Selon l’article, que va faire l’équipage du voilier La Boudeuse ?
be1d0fd4-abad-45d4-b670-8c7239ef1af0.question_en: According to the article, what will the crew of the sailboat La Boudeuse do?

options.text: Former des scientifiques à la prévention de risques écologiques.
options.text_en: Train scientists in the prevention of ecological risks.
options.explanation: The text mentions a scientific mission, but does not state that the crew will train other scientists in risk prevention.

options.text: Innover dans les moyens de lutte contre les pollutions fluviales.
options.text_en: Innovate in means of fighting river pollution.
options.explanation: While the mission concerns the environment, the text focuses on 'studies' regarding the biosphere and warming, not specifically on inventing new anti-pollution technologies.

options.text: Observer l’écosystème dans une région de grands fleuves.
options.text_en: Observe the ecosystem in a region of large rivers.
options.explanation: This matches the text's description of the destination (great rivers of South America) and the activity (scientific studies of the biosphere/ecosystem).

options.text: Représenter le gouvernement français lors d’une rencontre.
options.text_en: Represent the French government during a meeting.
options.explanation: A government minister signed the mission letter, but the crew's task is exploration and study, not attending a diplomatic meeting.

be1d0fd4-abad-45d4-b670-8c7239ef1af0.key_line_fr: Le voilier va mettre le cap en septembre prochain sur l’Amérique du Sud et ses grands fleuves. Il se consacrera aux études scientifiques et humaines concernant la biosphère...
be1d0fd4-abad-45d4-b670-8c7239ef1af0.key_line_en: The sailboat will set course next September for South America and its great rivers. It will devote itself to scientific and human studies concerning the biosphere...

vocabulary.gloss: set sail again / head back to sea

be1d0fd4-abad-45d4-b670-8c7239ef1af0.explanation: The article explicitly states the ship is going to South American rivers to conduct studies on the biosphere, which aligns with observing the ecosystem in a river region.
be1d0fd4-abad-45d4-b670-8c7239ef1af0.breakdown:
1. The text states the ship will head to 'South America and its great rivers' ('l’Amérique du Sud et ses grands fleuves').
2. It further explains the mission involves 'scientific studies... concerning the biosphere' ('études scientifiques... concernant la biosphère').
3. Option C combines these elements: observing the ecosystem (biosphere) in a region of large rivers.
4. Other options mention training, technical innovation, or diplomatic representation, which are not the primary focus described in the text.

b2253835-5b9e-4822-bc07-285d62bcfad1.text:
De plus en plus d’agriculteurs sont la cible d’accusations sévères de la part de leur voisinage ou d’organisations de défense des animaux.
La plupart reconnaissent que la critique est légitime et que leurs modes d’exploitation sont perfectibles.
Mais ils sont mis en cause de manière massive et généralisée, ce qui revient à contester en bloc leurs façons de travailler, leur utilité sociale et leur existence.
Les jeunes comme les vieux, les prospères comme les plus fragiles, ceux qui ont choisi l’agriculture biologique comme ceux qui sont restés en conventionnel : tous disent souffrir, à des degrés divers, de ce discrédit qui s’ajoute à leurs difficultés habituelles, financières notamment.
b2253835-5b9e-4822-bc07-285d62bcfad1.text_en: More and more farmers are the target of severe accusations from their neighbors or animal rights organizations. Most acknowledge that the criticism is legitimate and that their farming methods can be improved. But they are blamed in a massive and generalized way, which amounts to contesting their ways of working, their social utility, and their existence as a whole. Young and old, prosperous and fragile, those who chose organic farming and those who remained conventional: all say they suffer, to varying degrees, from this discredit which adds to their usual difficulties, particularly financial ones.
b2253835-5b9e-4822-bc07-285d62bcfad1.question_fr: Que répondent les agriculteurs face aux critiques ?
b2253835-5b9e-4822-bc07-285d62bcfad1.question_en: How do farmers respond to the criticisms?

options.explanation: The text states they admit their methods can be improved ('perfectibles'), rather than blindly defending traditions.

options.text: Ils éprouvent le sentiment d’être incompris.
options.explanation: They feel their social utility and existence are being unfairly contested 'en bloc' (as a whole), leading to suffering and a sense of being misunderstood.

options.text: Ils réfutent les reproches qui leur sont faits.
options.text_en: They refute the reproaches made against them.
options.explanation: The text explicitly says most acknowledge the criticism is legitimate ('reconnaissent que la critique est légitime').

options.text: Ils sont fiers de leurs apports à l’économie.
options.text_en: They are proud of their contributions to the economy.
options.explanation: The text focuses on their suffering and financial difficulties, not on pride regarding economic contributions.

b2253835-5b9e-4822-bc07-285d62bcfad1.key_line_fr: Les jeunes comme les vieux, les prospères comme les plus fragiles, ceux qui ont choisi l’agriculture biologique comme ceux qui sont restés en conventionnel : tous disent souffrir, à des degrés divers, de ce discrédit qui s’ajoute à leurs difficultés habituelles, financières notamment.
b2253835-5b9e-4822-bc07-285d62bcfad1.key_line_en: Young and old, prosperous and fragile, those who chose organic farming and those who remained conventional: all say they suffer, to varying degrees, from this discredit which adds to their usual difficulties, particularly financial ones.
b2253835-5b9e-4822-bc07-285d62bcfad1.explanation: Farmers accept some specific criticism but suffer because the public broadly attacks their entire existence and social value, making them feel misunderstood.
b2253835-5b9e-4822-bc07-285d62bcfad1.breakdown:
1. **Analyze the farmers' reaction:** The text states that farmers admit criticism is legitimate ('reconnaissent que la critique est légitime') but feel the attacks are too massive and generalized ('mis en cause de manière massive et généralisée').
2. **Evaluate Option C:** Since they acknowledge the legitimacy of the criticism, they do not refute the reproaches. This eliminates C.
3. **Evaluate Option A:** The text mentions both organic and conventional farmers suffer and admit improvements are needed ('modes d’exploitation sont perfectibles'). They are not simply defending tradition. This eliminates A.
4. **Evaluate Option D:** The text mentions 'financial difficulties' and suffering, not pride in economic contributions. This eliminates D.
5. **Confirm Option B:** The text emphasizes that farmers 'suffer' from 'discredit' that questions their 'social utility' and 'existence'. Feeling that one's fundamental value and existence are wrongly attacked despite admitting to specific faults aligns with the sentiment of being misunderstood ('incompris').

5d75282d-a6e0-4ac5-ac28-be6f5d3d522d.text:
Vous travaillez à la mairie de Rouen, vous êtes musicien et vous jouez d’un instrument depuis plusieurs années ?
Rejoignez l’orchestre des agents de la ville de Rouen !
Les répétitions reprennent en septembre (à la fin des congés d’été) et ont lieu les jeudis entre 12 h et 13 h 30 au conservatoire de la ville.
5d75282d-a6e0-4ac5-ac28-be6f5d3d522d.text_en: Do you work at the Rouen city hall, are you a musician and have you been playing an instrument for several years? Join the orchestra of Rouen city agents! Rehearsals resume in September (at the end of summer leave) and take place on Thursdays between 12:00 and 13:30 at the city conservatory.
5d75282d-a6e0-4ac5-ac28-be6f5d3d522d.question_fr: Qu’est-ce qui est proposé aux agents de la mairie ?
5d75282d-a6e0-4ac5-ac28-be6f5d3d522d.question_en: What is proposed to the city hall agents?

options.text: D’assister à un concert à Rouen.
options.text_en: To attend a concert in Rouen.
options.explanation: The text invites employees to play music, not to watch a performance.

options.text: De devenir membre de l’orchestre municipal.
options.text_en: To become a member of the municipal orchestra.
options.explanation: 'Rejoignez l’orchestre' (Join the orchestra) is synonymous with becoming a member.

options.text: De suivre des cours de musique à la rentrée.
options.text_en: To take music lessons at the start of the school year.
options.explanation: The text requires applicants to have played for several years ('jouez d’un instrument depuis plusieurs années'), implying they are not beginners seeking lessons.
The conservatory is mentioned only as the location for rehearsals, not as a place to visit for a tour.

5d75282d-a6e0-4ac5-ac28-be6f5d3d522d.key_line_fr: Rejoignez l’orchestre des agents de la ville de Rouen !
5d75282d-a6e0-4ac5-ac28-be6f5d3d522d.key_line_en: Join the orchestra of Rouen city agents!
5d75282d-a6e0-4ac5-ac28-be6f5d3d522d.explanation: The advertisement explicitly invites city hall employees who play instruments to join the city's orchestra.
5d75282d-a6e0-4ac5-ac28-be6f5d3d522d.breakdown:
1. The text addresses people working at the 'mairie de Rouen' (Rouen city hall).
2. It asks if they are musicians ('vous êtes musicien').
3. The imperative sentence 'Rejoignez l’orchestre des agents de la ville de Rouen !' explicitly invites them to join the group.
4. Option B translates to 'To become a member of the municipal orchestra', which matches the invitation to join.

f681739f-94c3-4749-a2cf-d567fab44382.text_en: INFORMATION During the international conference on the city, you can request a companion: He will help you with your travels, your research, for your meals, etc. For more information, ask at the reception.
f681739f-94c3-4749-a2cf-d567fab44382.question_en: What can you ask for at the reception?

ef7f6a51-b5e3-4408-bbfc-ac9deb6b3215.text:
Ah ! Le bel été !
Par trente-cinq degrés à l’ombre, les enfants réclament le goûter après la baignade, et coup de chance, le vendeur de beignets se profile à l’horizon.
Résultat : visite aux urgences, car les beignets à la crème avaient passé la journée au soleil.
Des histoires comme celle-là circulent dans toutes les associations de consommateurs.
La direction générale de la répression des fraudes dresse tout de même un bilan encourageant.
Peu d’endroits publics échappent aux vérifications et les escroqueries ont diminué.
Mais tout de même, en matière d’hygiène, le bon sens du consommateur doit prévaloir et lui permettre de prévenir tout incident.
ef7f6a51-b5e3-4408-bbfc-ac9deb6b3215.text_en:
Ah! Beautiful summer!
In 35-degree heat in the shade, children ask for a snack after swimming, and luckily, the donut seller appears on the horizon.
Result: visit to the emergency room, because the cream donuts had spent the day in the sun.
Stories like that circulate in all consumer associations.
The General Directorate for Fraud Control still draws up an encouraging balance sheet.
Few public places escape checks and scams have decreased.
But all the same, in terms of hygiene, consumer common sense must prevail and allow them to prevent any incident.
ef7f6a51-b5e3-4408-bbfc-ac9deb6b3215.question_fr: L’anecdote racontée dans cet article dénonce :
ef7f6a51-b5e3-4408-bbfc-ac9deb6b3215.question_en: The anecdote told in this article denounces:

options.text: Le grand nombre de vendeurs ambulants.
options.text_en: The large number of street vendors.
options.explanation: The text mentions a street vendor appearing, but it does not criticize the quantity or number of vendors.

options.text: Les dangers des aliments mal conservés.
options.text_en: The dangers of poorly preserved food.
options.explanation: The anecdote explicitly links the health incident (ER visit) to food left in the sun, highlighting the danger of improper food storage.

options.text: Les méfaits des collations après le bain.
options.text_en: The harmful effects of snacks after swimming.
options.explanation: The problem wasn't eating after swimming, but rather eating spoiled food (cream donuts left in the heat).
The children are described as simply asking for a snack; the text blames the hygiene of the food, not the children's behavior.

ef7f6a51-b5e3-4408-bbfc-ac9deb6b3215.key_line_fr: Résultat : visite aux urgences, car les beignets à la crème avaient passé la journée au soleil.
ef7f6a51-b5e3-4408-bbfc-ac9deb6b3215.key_line_en: Result: visit to the emergency room, because the cream donuts had spent the day in the sun.
ef7f6a51-b5e3-4408-bbfc-ac9deb6b3215.explanation: The story describes children getting sick from cream donuts left in the heat, which illustrates the danger of eating poorly preserved food.
ef7f6a51-b5e3-4408-bbfc-ac9deb6b3215.breakdown:
1. The question asks what the specific 'anecdote' (story) in the text denounces.
2. The anecdote describes children eating cream donuts sold on a hot beach (35 degrees).
3. The consequence is a 'visite aux urgences' (visit to the ER).
4. The stated cause is: 'car les beignets à la crème avaient passé la journée au soleil' (because the cream donuts had spent the day in the sun).
5. This clearly points to food safety issues due to heat exposure (poor preservation).
6. Therefore, option B matches the cause of the problem described in the story.

ddb3c0d2-d1b9-4c66-811f-b2571756b0f7.text:
En tournage dans le Vaucluse jusqu’en décembre, l’héroïne d’Une femme d’honneur, l’un des feuilletons stars de la première chaîne de télévision (TF1), a pris le temps de marquer une pause pour parler de la sécurité routière.
« Non pas avec le prisme de mon rôle de gendarme », dit-elle,
« mais en tant que mère et automobiliste choquée par le comportement de certains conducteurs. »
Corinne Touzet sait de quoi elle parle : chaque année, elle avale en monospace 25 000 kilomètres sur les routes de France.
ddb3c0d2-d1b9-4c66-811f-b2571756b0f7.text_en: Filming in the Vaucluse until December, the heroine of 'Une femme d'honneur', one of the star soap operas of the premier television channel (TF1), took the time to take a break to speak about road safety. "Not through the prism of my role as a gendarme," she says, "but as a mother and motorist shocked by the behavior of certain drivers." Corinne Touzet knows what she is talking about: every year, she devours 25,000 kilometers in a minivan on the roads of France.

options.explanation: The text mentions she is 'En tournage' (filming) and the 'héroïne' (heroine) of a TV series ('feuilleton'), defining her as an actress.

options.text: gendarme sur les routes de France.
options.text_en: a gendarme on the roads of France.
options.explanation: She explicitly refers to 'mon rôle de gendarme' (my role as a gendarme), indicating it is a fictional character she plays, not her real job.
While the text states she drives 25,000 km a year ('avale... 25 000 kilomètres'), it does not describe her as a competitive 'championne' (champion).
She works on a 'feuilleton' (soap opera/series), which is fictional content, not news reporting.

7 116 TONNES
C’est la quantité de médicaments non utilisés qui dorment dans les armoires des Français.
Pour les inciter à les ramener en pharmacie, l’Association santé environnement France (Asef) lance une grande opération.
Des tampons avec l’inscription « rapportez vos médicaments non utilisés à votre pharmacie » vont être remis aux 1 500 médecins et professionnels de santé adhérents de l’Asef.
Ces derniers pourront les appliquer sur les ordonnances pour sensibiliser les patients au gaspillage des médicaments.
93043183-46e6-4960-aae6-dce96b79ceb0.text_en: 7,116 TONNES. This is the quantity of unused medicines sleeping in the cupboards of the French. To encourage them to bring them back to the pharmacy, the French Environmental Health Association (Asef) is launching a major operation. Stamps with the inscription 'bring back your unused medicines to your pharmacy' will be given to the 1,500 doctors and health professionals who are members of ASEF. The latter will be able to apply them on prescriptions to raise patient awareness about medicine waste.

7403afd4-1074-4b2f-af2c-e7df0ef196be.text:
Minoritaires au sein des filières scientifiques universitaires et dans les écoles d’ingénieurs, les filles sont de plus en plus nombreuses à suivre des études de médecine.
Elles représentent désormais près de 70 % des inscrits en première année.
Attirance pour le secteur sanitaire et social, plus grande motivation et maturité sont des raisons invoquées pour expliquer cette forte féminisation de la profession.
Mais l’origine de l’élève en médecine a peu changé : 40 % de ces étudiants ont des parents cadres supérieurs ou exerçant une profession libérale, contre 30 % à l’université.
Des chiffres stables qui en font une des formations les plus clivées socialement, derrière les classes préparatoires aux grandes écoles.
7403afd4-1074-4b2f-af2c-e7df0ef196be.text_en: Minority in university science courses and engineering schools, girls are increasingly numerous in pursuing medical studies. They now represent nearly 70% of those enrolled in the first year. Attraction to the health and social sector, greater motivation and maturity are reasons cited to explain this strong feminization of the profession. But the origin of the medical student has changed little: 40% of these students have parents who are senior executives or practicing a liberal profession, against 30% at the university. Stable figures that make it one of the most socially divided training courses, behind the preparatory classes for the grandes écoles.
7403afd4-1074-4b2f-af2c-e7df0ef196be.question_fr: Que constate le journaliste à propos des études de médecine ?
7403afd4-1074-4b2f-af2c-e7df0ef196be.question_en: What does the journalist observe about medical studies?

options.text: Elles ont moins de succès que les cursus scientifiques.
options.text_en: They are less successful than scientific courses.
options.explanation: The text mentions women are minorities in science courses but does not claim medicine is less successful than them.

options.text: Elles représentent inégalement les milieux sociaux.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states that the course is 'socially divided' (clivées socialement) with a high concentration of students from wealthy backgrounds.

options.text: Elles séduisent des étudiants aux profils variés.
options.text_en: They attract students with varied profiles.
options.explanation: The text states the origin of students has 'changed little' and remains concentrated in specific upper classes, implying a lack of variety.

options.text: Elles sont source de discrimination envers les femmes.
options.text_en: They are a source of discrimination against women.
options.explanation: The text states that women make up nearly 70% of students, indicating they are not discriminated against in terms of access.

7403afd4-1074-4b2f-af2c-e7df0ef196be.key_line_fr: Des chiffres stables qui en font une des formations les plus clivées socialement, derrière les classes préparatoires aux grandes écoles.
7403afd4-1074-4b2f-af2c-e7df0ef196be.key_line_en: Stable figures that make it one of the most socially divided training courses, behind the preparatory classes for the grandes écoles.
7403afd4-1074-4b2f-af2c-e7df0ef196be.explanation: The journalist points out that medical studies are socially stratified ('clivées'), meaning students predominantly come from specific, higher social classes rather than a diverse mix.
7403afd4-1074-4b2f-af2c-e7df0ef196be.breakdown: The text is divided into two parts. The first part discusses the high number of women in medicine (70%). The second part, introduced by 'Mais' (But), shifts focus to social origins. It states that 40% of students have parents who are senior executives or professionals, making medicine one of the most 'clivées socialement' (socially divided) courses. This directly supports the statement that social backgrounds are unequally represented.

58905fe6-5386-4c17-9391-136acdc9dca6.text:
Selon une ancienne théorie sur la différence entre cerveau gauche et cerveau droit, les individus pourraient être classés selon leur dominance hémisphérique.
Les « plus à gauche » seraient ainsi plus logiques et analytiques, tandis que les « plus à droite » seraient créatifs et intuitifs.
S’il existe bel et bien une forme de dominance hémisphérique, elle dépend non pas de la personne, mais du type d’activité en cours.
Par exemple, chez 99 % des droitiers et plus de 70 % des gauchers, le langage fait appel le plus souvent à des neurones situés dans l’hémisphère gauche.
58905fe6-5386-4c17-9391-136acdc9dca6.text_en: According to an old theory on the difference between left brain and right brain, individuals could be classified according to their hemispheric dominance. The 'more left' would thus be more logical and analytical, while the 'more right' would be creative and intuitive. If a form of hemispheric dominance does indeed exist, it depends not on the person, but on the type of activity in progress. For example, in 99% of right-handers and more than 70% of left-handers, language appeals most often to neurons located in the left hemisphere.
58905fe6-5386-4c17-9391-136acdc9dca6.question_en: What do we learn about the brain?

options.text: Il est stimulé en phase d’apprentissage du langage.
options.text_en: It is stimulated during the language learning phase.
options.explanation: The text mentions language uses neurons in the left hemisphere, but does not specifically discuss the 'learning phase' or stimulation during learning.

options.text: À chaque activité correspond une région précise.
options.text_en: A specific region corresponds to each activity.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states that dominance depends on the 'type of activity in progress', illustrated by the example of language activity triggering the left hemisphere.

options.text: Les neurones sont concentrés dans quelques zones.
options.text_en: Neurons are concentrated in a few zones.
options.explanation: The text mentions neurons located in the left hemisphere for language, but does not claim that neurons are only concentrated in a few specific zones in general.

options.text: Son développement est lié au caractère d’un individu.
options.text_en: Its development is linked to an individual's character.
options.explanation: This refers to the 'old theory' mentioned in the first paragraph. The text refutes this by stating dominance depends on the activity, not the person/character.

58905fe6-5386-4c17-9391-136acdc9dca6.key_line_fr: S’il existe bel et bien une forme de dominance hémisphérique, elle dépend non pas de la personne, mais du type d’activité en cours.
58905fe6-5386-4c17-9391-136acdc9dca6.key_line_en: If a form of hemispheric dominance does indeed exist, it depends not on the person, but on the type of activity in progress.
58905fe6-5386-4c17-9391-136acdc9dca6.explanation: The passage clarifies that brain dominance is determined by the specific task being performed, such as language processing occurring in the left hemisphere, rather than an individual's personality.
58905fe6-5386-4c17-9391-136acdc9dca6.breakdown: The text contrasts an old theory (classifying people as left or right-brained) with a more accurate understanding. The crucial part of the text states that hemispheric dominance depends on the 'type of activity in progress' (type d’activité en cours), not on the person's character. It gives the example of language activity primarily using the left hemisphere. Therefore, the text teaches us that specific activities stimulate specific regions (dominance linked to activity), which matches Option B.

988c9d40-81a1-4d3f-b90e-61923e05db87.text:
L’histoire des sociétés humaines tourne autour de la recherche d’un monde plus juste.
Les idéologies religieuses et politiques ont toujours visé une certaine forme de justice et d’égalité.
Les êtres humains ont besoin de donner un sens à leur existence, notamment sociale : ils se soucient forcément de la vie des autres et veulent trouver une raison d’être à l’état de la société.
Aucune élite ne peut se contenter de posséder davantage d’argent ou de pouvoir que les autres de façon explicitement arbitraire.
De ce fait, l’organisation sociale est expliquée et justifiée par un discours sophistiqué.
Ce discours doit être un minimum plausible et repose souvent sur un mélange de sincérité et d’hypocrisie.
988c9d40-81a1-4d3f-b90e-61923e05db87.text_en: The history of human societies revolves around the search for a fairer world. Religious and political ideologies have always aimed for a certain form of justice and equality. Human beings need to give meaning to their existence, especially socially: they inevitably care about the lives of others and want to find a reason for the state of society. No elite can be content with possessing more money or power than others in an explicitly arbitrary way. As a result, social organization is explained and justified by a sophisticated discourse. This discourse must be at least somewhat plausible and often relies on a mixture of sincerity and hypocrisy.
988c9d40-81a1-4d3f-b90e-61923e05db87.question_fr: Qu’explique l’auteur sur les inégalités sociales ?
988c9d40-81a1-4d3f-b90e-61923e05db87.question_en: What does the author explain about social inequalities?

options.text: Elles diminuent dans toutes les organisations.
options.text_en: They are decreasing in all organizations.
options.explanation: The text mentions the *search* for a fairer world, but it does not state that inequalities are actually decreasing in all organizations.

options.text: Elles résultent du fonctionnement d’une société.
options.text_en: They result from the functioning of a society.
options.explanation: The text links the possession of power/money by elites to the 'social organization' which generates a discourse to legitimize this state, implying inequalities stem from how society functions.

options.text: Elles se combattent mieux avec de la sincérité.
options.text_en: They are better fought with sincerity.
options.explanation: Sincerity is mentioned as a component of the discourse used to *justify* the status quo, not as a means to fight inequalities.

options.text: Elles se justifient par des arguments fallacieux.
options.text_en: They are justified by fallacious arguments.
options.explanation: The text says the justifying discourse is a mix of 'sincerity and hypocrisy' and must be 'plausible.' Labeling it purely as 'fallacious' (deceptive/false) contradicts the mention of sincerity and plausibility.

988c9d40-81a1-4d3f-b90e-61923e05db87.key_line_fr: De ce fait, l’organisation sociale est expliquée et justifiée par un discours sophistiqué.
988c9d40-81a1-4d3f-b90e-61923e05db87.key_line_en: As a result, social organization is explained and justified by a sophisticated discourse.
988c9d40-81a1-4d3f-b90e-61923e05db87.explanation: The author argues that inequalities (elites having more) are structural to social organization and are rationalized by a narrative generated by the society itself.
988c9d40-81a1-4d3f-b90e-61923e05db87.breakdown: The text explores how human societies deal with inequality (elites having more money or power). It states that such inequalities cannot be arbitrary; they must be given meaning. Consequently, 'social organization is explained and justified by a sophisticated discourse.' This implies that inequalities are not just accidents but are embedded in the way society is organized and functions, requiring a constructed narrative to be accepted by its members. Therefore, they result from the functioning of the society.

8b5eb601-fd56-4256-bc8c-983e6f58cb1a.text:
Aux habitants de la résidence Les Lilas
Le gestionnaire de la résidence rappelle aux habitants que les travaux prévus dans le logement de Madame Bertrand commenceront le 15 avril.
Afin que les ouvriers de l’entreprise puissent travailler facilement, il vous est demandé de garer vos voitures sur l’aire de stationnement installée de l’autre côté de la rue pendant la durée des travaux.
Vous ne devez en aucun cas laisser vos véhicules devant l’entrée de la résidence.
Nous vous remercions de votre compréhension.
8b5eb601-fd56-4256-bc8c-983e6f58cb1a.text_en:
To the residents of Les Lilas residence
The residence manager reminds residents that the works planned in Mrs. Bertrand's apartment will begin on April 15.
In order for the company's workers to work easily, you are asked to park your cars on the parking area set up on the other side of the street for the duration of the works.
Under no circumstances should you leave your vehicles in front of the residence entrance.
We thank you for your understanding.
8b5eb601-fd56-4256-bc8c-983e6f58cb1a.question_fr: Qu’annonce ce courrier aux habitants de la résidence ?
8b5eb601-fd56-4256-bc8c-983e6f58cb1a.question_en: What does this mail announce to the residents of the residence?

options.text_en: The expansion of a parking lot.

The works are specific to a single apartment ('logement de Madame Bertrand'), not the modernization of the entire building structure.
The text announces 'travaux' (works) in a 'logement' (apartment), which matches 'transformation of an apartment'.

options.text_en: The moving out of a tenant.

8b5eb601-fd56-4256-bc8c-983e6f58cb1a.key_line_fr: les travaux prévus dans le logement de Madame Bertrand commenceront le 15 avril.
8b5eb601-fd56-4256-bc8c-983e6f58cb1a.key_line_en: the works planned in Mrs. Bertrand's apartment will begin on April 15.
8b5eb601-fd56-4256-bc8c-983e6f58cb1a.explanation: The notice informs residents about construction work (travaux) starting in a specific neighbor's apartment.
8b5eb601-fd56-4256-bc8c-983e6f58cb1a.breakdown: The text explicitly states that 'works planned in Mrs. Bertrand's apartment will begin'. The word 'travaux' (works/construction) in a 'logement' (apartment/housing unit) corresponds to the idea of transformation or renovation of that unit. It does not mention building a bigger parking lot, modernizing the entire building, or anyone moving out.

4a143117-5f6b-4cd0-8ae4-2175e4ff944a.text:
Vous pensez qu’il est un peu fou de partir en bateau avec des enfants ?
Clément, Marine et leurs deux filles de six et deux ans devraient vous inspirer.
Tous les quatre ou à plusieurs familles, ils maintiennent le rythme d’une croisière par an.
« Des vacances où on déconnecte à l’instant même où on pose le pied sur le pont », dit Clément.
« Une vie en contact permanent avec la nature, l’océan, les côtes sauvages, les dauphins…», rajoute Marine.
4a143117-5f6b-4cd0-8ae4-2175e4ff944a.text_en: Do you think it's a bit crazy to go on a boat trip with children? Clément, Marine and their two daughters aged six and two should inspire you. Just the four of them or with several families, they keep up the rhythm of one cruise per year. "Holidays where you disconnect the very moment you set foot on the deck," says Clément. "A life in constant contact with nature, the ocean, the wild coasts, the dolphins...", adds Marine.
4a143117-5f6b-4cd0-8ae4-2175e4ff944a.question_fr: Selon Marine et Clément, que permettent des vacances en bateau ?
4a143117-5f6b-4cd0-8ae4-2175e4ff944a.question_en: According to Marine and Clément, what do boat holidays allow?

options.text: De faire du sport et de rencontrer des personnes.
options.text_en: To do sports and meet people.
options.explanation: The text mentions traveling with several families, but does not explicitly mention doing sports or meeting new people as the primary purpose.

options.text: De nager régulièrement et de manger du poisson.
options.text_en: To swim regularly and eat fish.
options.explanation: Neither swimming regularly nor eating fish is mentioned in the text.

options.text: De se reposer et de découvrir le milieu marin.
options.text_en: To rest and discover the marine environment.
options.explanation: This matches the text exactly: 'déconnecte' relates to resting, and 'contact avec l'océan/les dauphins' relates to discovering the marine environment.

options.text: De vivre au calme et de se retrouver en famille.
options.text_en: To live in peace and quiet and meet up with family.
options.explanation: While they travel as a family, the specific quotes focus on disconnecting and nature, making Option C a more accurate summary of their statements than simply living in peace/quiet.

4a143117-5f6b-4cd0-8ae4-2175e4ff944a.key_line_fr: « Des vacances où on déconnecte à l’instant même où on pose le pied sur le pont », dit Clément. « Une vie en contact permanent avec la nature, l’océan, les côtes sauvages, les dauphins…», rajoute Marine.
4a143117-5f6b-4cd0-8ae4-2175e4ff944a.key_line_en: "Holidays where you disconnect the very moment you set foot on the deck," says Clément. "A life in constant contact with nature, the ocean, the wild coasts, the dolphins...", adds Marine.
4a143117-5f6b-4cd0-8ae4-2175e4ff944a.explanation: Clément talks about disconnecting (resting), and Marine talks about nature and the ocean (marine environment), which aligns perfectly with option C.
4a143117-5f6b-4cd0-8ae4-2175e4ff944a.breakdown:
The question asks what boat holidays allow according to the two speakers. 
1. Clément states: 'vacances où on déconnecte' (holidays where we disconnect). 'Déconnecter' (to disconnect) implies taking a break or resting, which matches 'Se reposer'.
2. Marine adds: 'contact permanent avec la nature, l’océan... les dauphins' (constant contact with nature, the ocean... dolphins). This corresponds to 'découvrir le milieu marin' (discovering the marine environment).
3. Option C combines both these elements perfectly.

79b33aaa-71f7-468f-beed-f77fd1217ba0.text:
C’est en France que se tient le salon du raisin biologique.
Avec 600 professionnels venus de quarante pays, c’est le salon bio le plus important en Europe.
Pourtant, si l’Europe produit la plus grande part de raisin bio, avec 88 % des surfaces biologiques dans le monde, la France n’est pas championne en la matière !
L’année dernière, l’agriculture biologique concernait seulement 4 % de la production française…
On parle toujours plus du bio qu’on ne le consomme.
79b33aaa-71f7-468f-beed-f77fd1217ba0.text_en: The organic grape fair is held in France. With 600 professionals from forty countries, it is the most important organic fair in Europe. However, while Europe produces the largest share of organic grapes, with 88% of organic surface areas in the world, France is not the champion in this matter! Last year, organic farming concerned only 4% of French production... We always talk more about organic than we consume it.
79b33aaa-71f7-468f-beed-f77fd1217ba0.question_fr: Quelle est la situation du marché français dans la culture du raisin biologique ?
79b33aaa-71f7-468f-beed-f77fd1217ba0.question_en: What is the situation of the French market in the cultivation of organic grapes?

options.text: La France compte de nombreux producteurs qui exportent peu.
options.text_en: France has many producers who export little.
options.explanation: The text mentions professionals coming to a fair in France, but it does not discuss the export habits of French producers.

options.text: La France demeure une petite productrice sur le plan européen.
options.text_en: France remains a small producer at the European level.
options.explanation: The text contrasts Europe's dominance with France's status ('not the champion'), and notes only 4% of French production is organic, indicating it is a minor player relative to the European whole.

options.text: La France fournit une part importante de la production mondiale.
options.text_en: France provides a significant share of world production.
options.explanation: The text attributes the 'large share' of world production to Europe as a whole, and explicitly states France is *not* the champion.

options.text: La France parvient tout juste à répondre à sa demande nationale.
options.text_en: France barely manages to meet its national demand.
options.explanation: The text states people talk about organic more than they consume it, but it does not provide data on whether production meets national demand.

79b33aaa-71f7-468f-beed-f77fd1217ba0.key_line_fr: Pourtant, si l’Europe produit la plus grande part de raisin bio, avec 88 % des surfaces biologiques dans le monde, la France n’est pas championne en la matière !
79b33aaa-71f7-468f-beed-f77fd1217ba0.key_line_en: However, while Europe produces the largest share of organic grapes, with 88% of organic surface areas in the world, France is not the champion in this matter!
79b33aaa-71f7-468f-beed-f77fd1217ba0.explanation: The text explains that while Europe is the global leader in organic grapes, France is 'not the champion,' indicating it remains a smaller producer within the European context.
79b33aaa-71f7-468f-beed-f77fd1217ba0.breakdown: The text establishes a contrast. First, it notes that Europe dominates the global organic grape market (88% of surfaces). However, it explicitly states that 'France is not the champion in this matter' and that organic farming only accounts for 4% of French production. This implies that despite being in Europe, France's specific contribution or status is relatively small compared to the European potential or leaders.

e4414eac-dbd3-4c40-8c17-4204652a353e.text:
RAPPEL
Pour un tri efficace des ordures, ne jetez dans les poubelles jaunes que les petits cartons tels que paquets de céréales ou de produits laitiers.
Les couvercles de ces poubelles ont un trou de la taille des cartons et ne peuvent pas être ouverts complètement, afin d’éviter le mélange des ordures.
Les gros cartons vont avec les ordures ménagères.
Les poubelles sont vidées tous les mardis.
e4414eac-dbd3-4c40-8c17-4204652a353e.text_en:
REMINDER
For effective waste sorting, throw only small cartons such as cereal or dairy product packets into the yellow bins.
The lids of these bins have a hole the size of the cartons and cannot be opened completely, in order to avoid mixing trash.
Large cartons go with household waste.
The bins are emptied every Tuesday.
e4414eac-dbd3-4c40-8c17-4204652a353e.question_fr: À quoi faut-il faire attention en triant les déchets ?
e4414eac-dbd3-4c40-8c17-4204652a353e.question_en: What must be paid attention to when sorting waste?

options.explanation: The bin itself is yellow, but the instruction does not ask to sort the waste based on the color of the waste items.
The text explicitly distinguishes between 'small cartons' (for the yellow bin) and 'large cartons' (for household waste), making dimension the deciding factor.
While cartons are a type of packaging, the distinction is not made between different types of packaging, but rather the size of the specific packaging (cartons).
There is no mention of the quantity or amount of waste allowed.

e4414eac-dbd3-4c40-8c17-4204652a353e.key_line_fr: Pour un tri efficace des ordures, ne jetez dans les poubelles jaunes que les petits cartons [...] Les gros cartons vont avec les ordures ménagères.
e4414eac-dbd3-4c40-8c17-4204652a353e.key_line_en: For effective waste sorting, throw only small cartons [...] into the yellow bins. [...] Large cartons go with household waste.
e4414eac-dbd3-4c40-8c17-4204652a353e.explanation: The text differentiates between 'small cartons' and 'large cartons', indicating that the size (dimension) determines where the waste goes.
e4414eac-dbd3-4c40-8c17-4204652a353e.breakdown: The text provides specific instructions on how to sort cartons based on their size. It states that only 'petits cartons' (small cartons) should go into the yellow bins, while 'gros cartons' (large cartons) must be placed with general household waste. Additionally, the bin lids have a hole specifically sized to enforce this dimension limit. Therefore, the primary factor to consider is the dimension of the waste.

0284d4b0-3ac4-4a92-b109-05b76b0d20c9.text:
Recherche de partenaire pour un projet collaboratif par Internet.
Pour inscrire votre classe à ce projet, communiquez directement avec la personne responsable ou suivez la consigne indiquée, selon le cas.
Titre : Comparaison des constellations entre les hémisphères nord et sud.
Personne responsable : Sandrine Grun.
Adresse électronique : sandrine.grun@collegerenoir.fr.
Pays d’origine : France.
Domaine concerné : astronomie/sciences de l’espace.
Description : un groupe d’élèves participant à un atelier d’astronomie avec leur professeur de sciences physiques souhaiterait comparer les constellations des hémisphères nord et sud et étudier leurs histoires.
Ces élèves recherchent un groupe d’élèves situé dans l’hémisphère sud, parlant français.
Ils voudraient commencer le projet entre élèves à la rentrée de septembre. Mais le travail entre professeurs pourrait commencer avant.
0284d4b0-3ac4-4a92-b109-05b76b0d20c9.text_en:
Partner search for a collaborative internet project.

Title: Comparison of constellations between the northern and southern hemispheres.
Responsible person: Sandrine Grun.
Email address: sandrine.grun@collegerenoir.fr.
Country of origin: France.
field concerned: astronomy/space sciences.

0284d4b0-3ac4-4a92-b109-05b76b0d20c9.question_fr: En quoi consiste le projet décrit dans cette annonce ?
0284d4b0-3ac4-4a92-b109-05b76b0d20c9.question_en: What does the project described in this ad consist of?

options.text: Réaliser une étude d’observation des astres.
options.text_en: Conduct a study of observing stars/celestial bodies.

options.text: Se joindre à une formation d’enseignants en sciences.

options.text: Suivre un cours de rattrapage en sciences physiques.

0284d4b0-3ac4-4a92-b109-05b76b0d20c9.key_line_fr: Description : un groupe d’élèves participant à un atelier d’astronomie avec leur professeur de sciences physiques souhaiterait comparer les constellations des hémisphères nord et sud et étudier leurs histoires.
0284d4b0-3ac4-4a92-b109-05b76b0d20c9.key_line_en: Description: a group of students participating in an astronomy workshop with their physics teacher would like to compare the constellations of the northern and southern hemispheres and study their histories.

0284d4b0-3ac4-4a92-b109-05b76b0d20c9.breakdown:
