2. The title of the project is 'Comparaison des constellations entre les hémisphères nord et sud' (Comparison of constellations between the northern and southern hemispheres).
3. The description states that students want to 'comparer les constellations' (compare constellations) and 'étudier leurs histoires' (study their histories).
4. Constellations are groups of stars ('astres').
5. Therefore, the project involves an observational study of celestial bodies (Option B).
6. Option A is incorrect because there is no mention of a contest ('concours'). Option C is incorrect because the main goal is student collaboration, not teacher training. Option D is incorrect because it is an astronomy workshop, not a remedial class.

c1a626eb-8483-43eb-a086-72891dd7696f.text:
La décision du gouvernement d’abattre 40 loups a fait grincer les dents d’un grand nombre d’organisations non gouvernementales.
L’espèce est en effet sur la liste rouge des animaux en voie d’extinction de l’Office National de la Chasse et de la Faune Sauvage.
Selon une étude scientifique récente, la disparition du loup dans le parc de Yellowstone aux États-Unis a perturbé tout un écosystème.
Certaines espèces consommatrices d’arbres et d’arbustes que le canidé chassait ont proliféré au point de menacer la végétation.
De surcroît, le loup aurait d’autres bienfaits : prédateur opportuniste, il cible les proies les plus fragiles ou en mauvaise santé, favorisant ainsi la vigueur des espèces qu’il traque.
c1a626eb-8483-43eb-a086-72891dd7696f.text_en: The government's decision to cull 40 wolves set many non-governmental organizations on edge. Indeed, the species is on the red list of animals facing extinction of the National Office for Hunting and Wildlife. According to a recent scientific study, the disappearance of the wolf in Yellowstone Park in the United States disrupted an entire ecosystem. Certain tree- and shrub-eating species that the canid hunted proliferated to the point of threatening vegetation. Moreover, the wolf supposedly has other benefits: an opportunistic predator, it targets the most fragile or unhealthy prey, thus promoting the vigor of the species it tracks.
c1a626eb-8483-43eb-a086-72891dd7696f.question_en: What do we learn about wolves?

options.text: Ils ont de moins en moins d’espace naturel.
options.text_en: They have less and less natural space.
options.explanation: The text mentions they are on an extinction list, but it does not explicitly state that their natural space is shrinking.

options.text: Ils permettent de protéger la biodiversité.
options.explanation: The text illustrates how wolves maintain the ecosystem by controlling prey populations and protecting vegetation, which equals protecting biodiversity.
The text focuses on the benefits of wolves, not on whether the danger they pose is exaggerated.

options.text: Ils sont décimés par la maladie.
options.explanation: The text states wolves target prey that are in poor health ('en mauvaise santé'), not that the wolves themselves are sick.

c1a626eb-8483-43eb-a086-72891dd7696f.key_line_fr: Selon une étude scientifique récente, la disparition du loup dans le parc de Yellowstone aux États-Unis a perturbé tout un écosystème.
c1a626eb-8483-43eb-a086-72891dd7696f.key_line_en: According to a recent scientific study, the disappearance of the wolf in Yellowstone Park in the United States disrupted an entire ecosystem.
c1a626eb-8483-43eb-a086-72891dd7696f.explanation: The passage describes how the presence of wolves regulates other species and preserves vegetation, showing they are essential for ecosystem balance.
c1a626eb-8483-43eb-a086-72891dd7696f.breakdown: The text discusses the negative impact of the wolf's disappearance, citing a study on Yellowstone Park where the ecosystem was disrupted without them. It explains that without wolves, plant-eating species multiplied and threatened vegetation. It also mentions that wolves kill sick prey, improving the overall health of prey species. These points collectively illustrate the wolf's role in maintaining ecological balance.

91d3caaf-d24f-4f1e-9243-de5e23f261bd.text:
Le ministère de l’Éducation nationale prépare une campagne promotionnelle afin de revaloriser le métier d’enseignant.
En effet, s’il a supprimé des milliers de postes ces dernières années, il peine cependant à embaucher des professeurs.
La présidente de la première organisation syndicale enseignante du pays ne décolère pas.
« Le ministère prend le problème à l’envers. Ce n’est pas en faisant de la communication que nous rendrons le métier d’enseignant attractif », proteste la syndicaliste.
« Comment donner envie aux étudiants de devenir enseignant quand on leur supprime leur formation ? »
Pour elle, l’attractivité du métier passe aussi par une revalorisation de la paie.
Or, le gouvernement a annoncé un gel des salaires dans la Fonction publique.
91d3caaf-d24f-4f1e-9243-de5e23f261bd.text_en: The Ministry of National Education is preparing a promotional campaign to revalue the teaching profession. Indeed, while it has cut thousands of jobs in recent years, it nevertheless struggles to hire teachers. The president of the country's leading teachers' union is furious. "The ministry is tackling the problem backwards. It is not through communication that we will make the teaching profession attractive," protests the trade unionist. "How can we make students want to become teachers when their training is being cut?" For her, the attractiveness of the profession also depends on a revaluation of pay. However, the government has announced a wage freeze in the Civil Service.
91d3caaf-d24f-4f1e-9243-de5e23f261bd.question_fr: Comment rendre le métier d’enseignant plus attirant ?
91d3caaf-d24f-4f1e-9243-de5e23f261bd.question_en: How to make the teaching profession more attractive?

options.text: En limitant la part de l’apprentissage pratique.
options.text_en: By limiting the share of practical learning.
options.explanation: The text mentions that training is being cut ('on leur supprime leur formation'), which is presented as a problem, not a solution involving limiting practical learning.

options.text: En rendant compréhensibles les décisions politiques.
options.explanation: The text criticizes the ministry for focusing on communication rather than substantive issues; it does not suggest that explaining decisions is the solution.
There is no mention of career evolution or promotion perspectives in the text.

options.text: En révisant les conditions de rémunération.
options.explanation: The text explicitly links attractiveness to a 'revalorisation de la paie' (pay raise), which corresponds to revising remuneration conditions.

91d3caaf-d24f-4f1e-9243-de5e23f261bd.key_line_fr: Pour elle, l’attractivité du métier passe aussi par une revalorisation de la paie.
91d3caaf-d24f-4f1e-9243-de5e23f261bd.key_line_en: For her, the attractiveness of the profession also depends on a revaluation of pay.
91d3caaf-d24f-4f1e-9243-de5e23f261bd.explanation: The union president argues that better pay is essential for making the job attractive, which aligns with the option about revising remuneration.
91d3caaf-d24f-4f1e-9243-de5e23f261bd.breakdown:
1. **Identify the core question**: The question asks how to make the teaching profession more attractive ('plus attirant').
2. **Locate relevant opinions**: The text centers on the union president's critique. She argues that communication campaigns are insufficient.
3. **Find the specific suggestion**: She explicitly states, 'l’attractivité du métier passe aussi par une revalorisation de la paie' (the attractiveness of the profession also depends on a revaluation of pay).
4. **Match with options**: Option D, 'En révisant les conditions de rémunération' (By revising remuneration conditions), is a direct paraphrase of revaluing pay.

94ff96e3-446e-4d16-a43b-e2033b92d922.text:
- En tant que philosophe, que répondez-vous à ceux qui s’inquiètent de voir évoluer les jeunes dans l’univers virtuel des nouvelles technologies ?
- Rendez-vous compte que la culture est à la portée de chacun !
Quel progrès !
On sait que les nouvelles technologies n’activent pas les mêmes régions du cerveau que les livres.
Cet organe évolue, de la même façon qu’il avait déjà révélé des capacités nouvelles lorsqu’on est passé de l’oral à l’écrit.
Que faisaient nos neurones avant l’invention de l’écriture ?
Les facultés cognitives ne sont pas stables chez l’homme, c’est très intéressant.
C’est ma réponse aux vieux grognons qui accusent les jeunes de ne plus avoir de mémoire.
Ils jugent avec les facultés cognitives qui sont les leurs, sans admettre que le cerveau évolue.
94ff96e3-446e-4d16-a43b-e2033b92d922.text_en:
- As a philosopher, what do you say to those worried about seeing young people evolve in the virtual universe of new technologies?
- Realize that culture is within everyone's reach! What progress! It is known that new technologies do not activate the same regions of the brain as books. This organ evolves, in the same way that it had already revealed new capacities when we moved from oral to written. What were our neurons doing before the invention of writing? Cognitive faculties are not stable in humans, it is very interesting. That is my answer to the old grumps who accuse young people of no longer having memory. They judge with the cognitive faculties that are theirs, without admitting that the brain evolves.
94ff96e3-446e-4d16-a43b-e2033b92d922.question_fr: Quel est l’avis de ce philosophe concernant les nouvelles technologies ?
94ff96e3-446e-4d16-a43b-e2033b92d922.question_en: What is this philosopher's opinion regarding new technologies?

options.text: Elles détruisent les cellules du cerveau.
options.explanation: The text says the brain evolves and activates different regions, not that cells are destroyed.

options.text: Elles développent la mémoire à court terme.
options.explanation: The text mentions memory only to say that critics accuse youth of lacking it; it does not claim tech develops short-term memory.
The text states that cognitive faculties are not stable and the brain evolves, activating different regions. This means cognitive processes are modified.

options.text: Elles provoquent la disparition de l’écriture.
options.text_en: They cause the disappearance of writing.
options.explanation: The text uses the invention of writing as a historical comparison for brain evolution, not to say writing is disappearing today.

94ff96e3-446e-4d16-a43b-e2033b92d922.key_line_fr: Les facultés cognitives ne sont pas stables chez l’homme, c’est très intéressant.
94ff96e3-446e-4d16-a43b-e2033b92d922.key_line_en: Cognitive faculties are not stable in humans, it is very interesting.
94ff96e3-446e-4d16-a43b-e2033b92d922.explanation: The philosopher explains that the brain evolves and changes how it works (cognitive faculties) in response to new technologies, just as it did with the invention of writing.
94ff96e3-446e-4d16-a43b-e2033b92d922.breakdown: The philosopher argues that the brain is an organ that evolves. He explicitly states that new technologies do not activate the same brain regions as books and compares this shift to the transition from oral to written history. He concludes that 'cognitive faculties are not stable in humans.' This directly supports the idea that technologies modify how our cognitive processes function, rather than destroying them or specifically targeting short-term memory.

44b9778b-10e9-4fbb-8466-df1dbaa9d9b6.text:
Certains économistes spécialisés dans la politique en matière de mobilité estiment que la gratuité des transports en commun n'est pas souhaitable. Pour eux, la question de savoir qui va les financer est un peu simpliste: « La gratuité existe déjà dans notre pays. Il y a une quinzaine de réseaux en dehors de l'île-de-France qui le font déjà totalement. Le problème actuel est celui des ressources. En effet, les réseaux des grandes métropoles ne sont pas formatés pour pouvoir absorber ce supplément de fréquentation.
Et donc de ce point de vue, il n'est pas possible de se poser la question de la gratuité, avant de savoir quelle offre sera proposée aux usagers qui voyagent sur le réseau. »
44b9778b-10e9-4fbb-8466-df1dbaa9d9b6.text_en: Some economists specializing in mobility policy believe that free public transport is not desirable. For them, the question of who will finance them is a bit simplistic: "Free transport already exists in our country. There are about fifteen networks outside of Ile-de-France that already do it completely. The current problem is that of resources. Indeed, the networks of large metropolises are not configured to be able to absorb this increase in ridership. And so from this point of view, it is not possible to ask the question of free access, before knowing what offer will be proposed to users who travel on the network."
44b9778b-10e9-4fbb-8466-df1dbaa9d9b6.question_fr: D'après ces spécialistes, quel est le fond du problème de la gratuité des transports ?
44b9778b-10e9-4fbb-8466-df1dbaa9d9b6.question_en: According to these specialists, what is the fundamental problem with free transport?

options.text: L’absence de modèle comparatif de mobilité.
options.text_en: The lack of a comparative mobility model.
options.explanation: The text actually mentions that free transport already exists in other networks, so models do exist, but this is not the cited problem.

options.text_en: The lack of responsibility of users.
options.explanation: The text does not discuss the behavior or responsibility of the users, only the system capacity.

options.text: Le déficit provoqué par son financement.
options.text_en: The deficit caused by its funding.
options.explanation: The text explicitly calls the financing question 'simplistic' and shifts focus to the physical capacity of the networks.

options.text: Le risque de saturation des réseaux.
options.explanation: The text states networks cannot 'absorb this increase in ridership,' which is synonymous with becoming saturated.

44b9778b-10e9-4fbb-8466-df1dbaa9d9b6.key_line_fr: En effet, les réseaux des grandes métropoles ne sont pas formatés pour pouvoir absorber ce supplément de fréquentation.
44b9778b-10e9-4fbb-8466-df1dbaa9d9b6.key_line_en: Indeed, the networks of large metropolises are not configured to be able to absorb this increase in ridership.
44b9778b-10e9-4fbb-8466-df1dbaa9d9b6.explanation: The economists argue that current transport networks in big cities are not designed to handle the increase in passenger numbers that free access would generate, leading to saturation.
44b9778b-10e9-4fbb-8466-df1dbaa9d9b6.breakdown:
1. Scan the text for the economists' main argument regarding the 'problem' (le problème).
2. The text states: 'Le problème actuel est celui des ressources' (The current problem is resources). 
3. It clarifies this by saying: 'les réseaux... ne sont pas formatés pour pouvoir absorber ce supplément de fréquentation' (networks are not configured to absorb this increase in ridership).
4. 'Absorbing extra ridership' refers to the physical capacity of the system.
5. Compare with options: Option D mentions 'saturation', which corresponds exactly to the inability to absorb extra ridership. Option C (financing) is dismissed in the text as 'simplistic'.

8b75c6a8-74b0-4aa2-9091-8bb8613fe0d2.text:
La génération Y, ce sont les 20-30 ans qui ont grandi avec les nouvelles technologies.
Phénomène de société, ils sont ultra-connectés et surfent sur les réseaux sociaux, disposant de compétences que ne détenaient pas leurs aînés.
Une autre caractéristique les rassemble, la précarité au travail : 25 % des jeunes sont au chômage, d’autres ont des emplois temporaires.
Conséquence : on les présente comme sans illusions, peu impliqués au travail, individualistes et réfractaires à l’autorité.
Pourtant, cette précarité aurait du bon : elle pousserait la génération Y à se prendre en charge plus que ses aînés, en créant ses propres entreprises.
Cependant, des sociologues ont montré qu’il est très difficile de distinguer l’effet d’âge de l’effet période économique sur les attitudes au travail.
8b75c6a8-74b0-4aa2-9091-8bb8613fe0d2.text_en: Generation Y consists of 20-30-year-olds who grew up with new technologies. A social phenomenon, they are ultra-connected and surf social networks, possessing skills that their elders did not hold. Another characteristic unites them, job precariousness: 25% of young people are unemployed, others have temporary jobs. Consequence: they are presented as disillusioned, little involved in work, individualistic, and resistant to authority. However, this precariousness might have a good side: it pushes Generation Y to take charge of themselves more than their elders, by creating their own businesses. However, sociologists have shown that it is very difficult to distinguish the age effect from the economic period effect on attitudes toward work.
8b75c6a8-74b0-4aa2-9091-8bb8613fe0d2.question_fr: D’après ce texte, de quelle qualité serait dotée la génération Y ?
8b75c6a8-74b0-4aa2-9091-8bb8613fe0d2.question_en: According to this text, with which quality would Generation Y be endowed?

options.text: Un esprit créatif dans le secteur des technologies Internet.
options.text_en: A creative spirit in the internet technology sector.
options.explanation: The text mentions they possess tech skills ('compétences'), but the specific quality highlighted as a positive outcome of their situation is their independence, not specifically 'creativity' within the tech sector.

options.text: Une grande autonomie dans le domaine professionnel.
options.text_en: Great autonomy in the professional field.
options.explanation: The phrase 'se prendre en charge' (take charge of oneself) and the mention of creating their own businesses directly correspond to having great autonomy in the professional field.

options.text: Une aptitude étonnante à savoir se mettre en avant.
options.text_en: An astonishing aptitude for knowing how to promote themselves.
options.explanation: The text does not mention an ability to 'se mettre en avant' (put themselves forward/show off). It implies they are independent, which is different from self-promotion.

options.text: Un esprit de solidarité avec les personnes sans emploi.
options.text_en: A spirit of solidarity with unemployed people.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states they are presented as 'individualistes' (individualistic), which contradicts the idea of solidarity.

8b75c6a8-74b0-4aa2-9091-8bb8613fe0d2.key_line_fr: Pourtant, cette précarité aurait du bon : elle pousserait la génération Y à se prendre en charge plus que ses aînés, en créant ses propres entreprises.
8b75c6a8-74b0-4aa2-9091-8bb8613fe0d2.key_line_en: However, this precariousness might have a good side: it pushes Generation Y to take charge of themselves more than their elders, by creating their own businesses.
8b75c6a8-74b0-4aa2-9091-8bb8613fe0d2.explanation: The text explicitly states that economic insecurity pushes this generation to 'take charge of themselves' and start their own businesses, which defines professional autonomy.
8b75c6a8-74b0-4aa2-9091-8bb8613fe0d2.breakdown:
1. The question asks for a specific quality attributed to Generation Y in the text.
2. The text describes Generation Y as tech-savvy but facing job precariousness.
3. While they are negatively perceived as individualistic and resistant to authority, the text introduces a positive counterpoint starting with 'Pourtant' (However).
4. It states that precariousness pushes them to 'se prendre en charge' (take charge of themselves) and 'créant ses propres entreprises' (creating their own businesses).
5. Taking charge of oneself and starting a business are direct indicators of professional autonomy, matching Option B.

60206a22-6a40-44e3-bbf6-13e2ba451c94.text:
Les économistes ne sont pas tous d’accord sur les effets du vieillissement de la population sur la consommation.
Certains annoncent une chute possible, dans les années à venir, de la consommation des baby-boomers (la génération de ceux qui sont nés dans les années 50 et 60).
Cette réflexion s’appuie sur le fait que les baby-boomers n’ont pas assez épargné pour leur retraite.
Par ailleurs, des baisses significatives des pensions de retraite sont probables d’ici quelques années puisque les pays industrialisés sont en train de réformer leurs systèmes de retraite.
S’ils prennent conscience de l’ampleur des effets de ces réformes sur leur futur niveau de vie, les baby-boomers pourraient limiter leur consommation pour se constituer une épargne pour leurs vieux jours.
60206a22-6a40-44e3-bbf6-13e2ba451c94.text_en: Economists do not all agree on the effects of population aging on consumption. Some predict a possible drop, in the coming years, in the consumption of baby boomers (the generation of those born in the 50s and 60s). This reflection is based on the fact that baby boomers have not saved enough for their retirement. Furthermore, significant drops in retirement pensions are probable within a few years since industrialized countries are in the process of reforming their pension systems. If they become aware of the scale of the effects of these reforms on their future standard of living, baby boomers could limit their consumption to build up savings for their old age.
60206a22-6a40-44e3-bbf6-13e2ba451c94.question_en: What does the author explain about baby boomers?

options.text: Ils font preuve de solidarité économique avec les autres générations.
options.text_en: They show economic solidarity with other generations.
options.explanation: The text does not mention intergenerational solidarity.

options.text: Ils sont à l’origine d’une part significative de l’épargne des banques.
options.text_en: They are the source of a significant share of bank savings.
options.explanation: The text actually states the opposite: they 'have not saved enough' ('n’ont pas assez épargné').

options.text: La réforme des retraites influencera leurs comportements.
options.text_en: Pension reform will influence their behaviors.
options.explanation: The text explicitly links the awareness of pension reforms to a decision to limit consumption (a behavior).

options.text: Leur pouvoir d’achat est garanti dans les pays industrialisés.
options.text_en: Their purchasing power is guaranteed in industrialized countries.
options.explanation: The text predicts 'significant drops in retirement pensions' ('baisses significatives'), meaning their purchasing power is at risk, not guaranteed.

60206a22-6a40-44e3-bbf6-13e2ba451c94.key_line_fr: S’ils prennent conscience de l’ampleur des effets de ces réformes sur leur futur niveau de vie, les baby-boomers pourraient limiter leur consommation pour se constituer une épargne pour leurs vieux jours.
60206a22-6a40-44e3-bbf6-13e2ba451c94.key_line_en: If they become aware of the scale of the effects of these reforms on their future standard of living, baby boomers could limit their consumption to build up savings for their old age.
60206a22-6a40-44e3-bbf6-13e2ba451c94.explanation: The author argues that impending pension reforms will likely cause baby boomers to save more and consume less, thereby influencing their economic behavior.
60206a22-6a40-44e3-bbf6-13e2ba451c94.breakdown:
1. **Analyze the Text**: The text discusses the potential economic behavior of 'baby-boomers' in response to aging and pension issues.
2. **Locate Key Information**: The text states that baby-boomers haven't saved enough and that pension systems are being reformed ('réformer leurs systèmes de retraite').
3. **Connect to Consequence**: The final sentence says that if they realize the impact of these reforms, they 'could limit their consumption' ('pourraient limiter leur consommation').
4. **Match with Options**: 'Limiting consumption' is a change in behavior. Therefore, the pension reform influences their behavior, which matches Option C.

ae5349d3-34ab-436d-9849-8c80f105ead6.text:
M. Khalifa, responsable du patrimoine, a accidentellement découvert une douzaine de sculptures, certaines endommagées par l’érosion ou des actes de vandalisme, qui dateraient d’environ 2000 ans.
« En me rendant sur la zone, j’ai en fait découvert que des chameaux étaient sculptés dans les affleurements de la montagne.
C’est vraiment unique », raconte-t-il.
Le mystère reste entier sur les sculptures et les outils utilisés.
Pour trouver des réponses à toutes les questions concernant les sculptures de chameaux, un important travail de terrain est encore nécessaire.
ae5349d3-34ab-436d-9849-8c80f105ead6.text_en: Mr. Khalifa, heritage manager, accidentally discovered a dozen sculptures, some damaged by erosion or acts of vandalism, which likely date back about 2000 years. 'Going to the area, I actually discovered that camels were carved into the mountain outcrops. It is truly unique,' he says. The mystery remains complete regarding the sculptures and the tools used. To find answers to all the questions concerning the camel sculptures, significant fieldwork is still necessary.
ae5349d3-34ab-436d-9849-8c80f105ead6.question_en: What do we learn about these sculptures?

options.text: Ce sont des reproductions de qualité.
options.explanation: The text describes them as unique ancient artifacts (2000 years old), not reproductions.
The text mentions that some are damaged by erosion or vandalism.

options.text: Leur transfert dans un musée est en cours.
options.text_en: Their transfer to a museum is underway.
options.explanation: There is no mention of moving the sculptures; they are carved into the mountain itself.

options.text: On ignore comment elles ont été réalisées.
options.text_en: It is unknown how they were made.
options.explanation: The text indicates that the tools used—and by extension the method of creation—remain a mystery.

ae5349d3-34ab-436d-9849-8c80f105ead6.key_line_fr: Le mystère reste entier sur les sculptures et les outils utilisés.
ae5349d3-34ab-436d-9849-8c80f105ead6.key_line_en: The mystery remains complete regarding the sculptures and the tools used.
ae5349d3-34ab-436d-9849-8c80f105ead6.explanation: The text clearly states that there is still a mystery surrounding the tools used to create the sculptures, meaning we do not know how they were made.
ae5349d3-34ab-436d-9849-8c80f105ead6.breakdown:
1. **Analyze Option A (Reproductions):** The text states they date back 2000 years and are 'unique', not reproductions. 
2. **Analyze Option B (Preservation):** The text explicitly states 'certaines endommagées par l’érosion ou des actes de vandalisme' (some damaged by erosion or vandalism). This contradicts 'perfectly preserved'.
3. **Analyze Option C (Museum transfer):** The text mentions they are carved into 'les affleurements de la montagne' (mountain outcrops), and there is no mention of moving them to a museum.
4. **Analyze Option D (Method unknown):** The text states 'Le mystère reste entier sur... les outils utilisés' (The mystery remains complete regarding... the tools used). Since the tools and methods are a mystery, we do not know how they were made.

67e0f63a-d5d7-4648-96f4-c332cc2ecdca.text:
Dans l'ensemble des espaces verts de la ville de Toulouse, les pelouses tondues régulièrement laissent place à 150 hectares de prairies urbaines, plus sauvages.
« En coupant l'herbe, on stoppe le cycle des végétaux. Or si on ne la coupe qu'une fois par an, c'est bon pour l'écosystème et ça permet l'intégration de nouvelles espèces », explique la conseillère municipale en charge des espaces verts.
Seul inconvénient, le résultat est nettement moins esthétique.
« Au début, c'était mal compris, car les gens pensaient que c'était sale, reconnaît l'élue. Mais aujourd'hui, on voit des petites fleurs réapparaître et je ne reçois plus de courriers. »
67e0f63a-d5d7-4648-96f4-c332cc2ecdca.text_en: Throughout the green spaces of the city of Toulouse, regularly mowed lawns are giving way to 150 hectares of urban meadows, which are wilder. 'By cutting the grass, we stop the plant cycle. However, if we only cut it once a year, it is good for the ecosystem and allows for the integration of new species,' explains the municipal councilor in charge of green spaces. The only downside is that the result is clearly less aesthetic. 'At first, it was misunderstood because people thought it was dirty,' admits the elected official. 'But today we see small flowers reappearing and I no longer receive letters.'
67e0f63a-d5d7-4648-96f4-c332cc2ecdca.question_fr: Quel est l’avantage principal de ne tondre l’herbe qu’une fois par an dans les espaces verts de la ville de Toulouse ?
67e0f63a-d5d7-4648-96f4-c332cc2ecdca.question_en: What is the main advantage of mowing grass only once a year in the green spaces of the city of Toulouse?

options.text: Cela réduit les coûts d’entretien des espaces verts.
options.text_en: It reduces maintenance costs for green spaces.
options.explanation: Not mentioned. While logical in real life, the text does not discuss cost reduction.

options.text: Cela favorise l’intégration de nouvelles espèces et est bon pour l’écosystème.
options.text_en: It promotes the integration of new species and is good for the ecosystem.
options.explanation: Directly supported by the text which states it is 'bon pour l’écosystème' and allows 'l’intégration de nouvelles espèces'.

options.text: C’est plus esthétique pour les visiteurs.
options.text_en: It is more aesthetic for visitors.
options.explanation: Contradicted by the text. The author states the result is 'nettement moins esthétique' (clearly less aesthetic).

options.text: Cela évite le bruit constant des tondeuses dans la ville.
options.text_en: It avoids the constant noise of lawnmowers in the city.
options.explanation: Not mentioned. The text focuses on biodiversity, not noise pollution.

67e0f63a-d5d7-4648-96f4-c332cc2ecdca.key_line_fr: Or si on ne la coupe qu’une fois par an, c’est bon pour l’écosystème et ça permet l’intégration de nouvelles espèces
67e0f63a-d5d7-4648-96f4-c332cc2ecdca.key_line_en: However, if we only cut it once a year, it is good for the ecosystem and allows for the integration of new species
67e0f63a-d5d7-4648-96f4-c332cc2ecdca.explanation: The text explicitly explains that limited mowing preserves the plant cycle, benefits the ecosystem, and helps new species integrate.
67e0f63a-d5d7-4648-96f4-c332cc2ecdca.breakdown:
1. **Identify the keyword in the question**: The question asks for the 'advantage principal' (main advantage) of mowing only once a year.
2. **Scan the text**: Look for the phrase regarding cutting grass once a year ('ne la coupe qu’une fois par an').
3. **Read the context**: The text immediately states, 'c’est bon pour l’écosystème et ça permet l’intégration de nouvelles espèces' (it is good for the ecosystem and allows the integration of new species).
4. **Evaluate options**: Option B matches this statement almost word-for-word. Option C is explicitly contradicted later ('moins esthétique'). Options A and D are not mentioned in the text.

f640e939-d87f-4823-99b4-0f17906e7436.text:
« C’est vrai qu’une forme d’intensité a marqué ma filmographie.
Je suis assez épuisée par le fait de jouer des drames.
Cela traverse le corps, le champ émotionnel, ça abîme.
C’est pour ça que j’essaie de ne pas faire plus d’un ou deux films par an.
Cette intensité est projetée sur moi, mais moi, j’aime aussi l’oisiveté, parfois la futilité et, avant tout, que ce soit vivant.
J’aime ce qui est fou.
Il y a une idée trop sage de ce que doit être une actrice qui circule et qui rend les actrices moins libres dans leur jeu que les acteurs. »
f640e939-d87f-4823-99b4-0f17906e7436.text_en: It is true that a form of intensity has marked my filmography. I am quite exhausted by the fact of playing dramas. It goes through the body, the emotional field, it damages. That is why I try not to do more than one or two films a year. This intensity is projected onto me, but I also like idleness, sometimes futility and, above all, that it be alive. I like what is crazy. There is an overly well-behaved idea of what an actress should be that circulates and makes actresses less free in their acting than actors.
f640e939-d87f-4823-99b4-0f17906e7436.question_fr: Qu’est-ce qui est difficile pour cette comédienne ?
f640e939-d87f-4823-99b4-0f17906e7436.question_en: What is difficult for this actress?

options.explanation: She mentions limiting the number of films she does per year, but never mentions that choosing the scripts is difficult.
She explicitly states that playing dramas exhausts her and damages her physically and emotionally.
There is no mention of directors or following their instructions in the text.

options.text: Respecter les textes au mot près.
options.text_en: Respecting the texts word for word.
options.explanation: The text discusses the intensity of roles and acting freedom, not the strict adherence to the script text.

f640e939-d87f-4823-99b4-0f17906e7436.key_line_fr: Je suis assez épuisée par le fait de jouer des drames.
f640e939-d87f-4823-99b4-0f17906e7436.key_line_en: I am quite exhausted by the fact of playing dramas.
f640e939-d87f-4823-99b4-0f17906e7436.explanation: The actress describes playing dramas as exhausting and damaging to her body and emotions, which corresponds to the difficulty of interpreting certain roles.
f640e939-d87f-4823-99b4-0f17906e7436.breakdown:
1. The question asks what is difficult for the actress.
2. In the text, she says: 'Je suis assez épuisée par le fait de jouer des drames' (I am quite exhausted by playing dramas).
3. She further explains: 'Cela traverse le corps... ça abîme' (It goes through the body... it damages).
4. This physical and emotional exhaustion related to 'playing dramas' aligns directly with option B ('Interpreting certain roles').
5. Other options regarding choosing scripts, obeying directors, or respecting text are not mentioned in the passage.

73b92b92-6980-40eb-a61c-3440ef963d43.text:
Là où leurs prédécesseurs rêvaient d’un contrat à durée indéterminée, les Milléniaux (génération née entre 1980 et 2000) sont en quête d’expériences diversifiées.
Beaucoup ont déjà connu le chômage et ont conscience de l’obsolescence de leurs compétences et de leur diplôme, d’où leur sentiment de n’avoir rien à perdre.
L’heure n’est plus à la relation de subordination, mais à la coopération.
Au quotidien, il y a de quoi déconcerter les managers.
Un Millénial accepte qu’on lui explique le sens du travail, mais pas la manière de le faire.
Face à ces collaborateurs qui font rimer le bien-être professionnel avec connexion, confiance, autonomie et flexibilité, il faut en finir avec le syndrome de la hiérarchie pyramidale.
73b92b92-6980-40eb-a61c-3440ef963d43.text_en: Where their predecessors dreamed of a permanent contract, Millennials (generation born between 1980 and 2000) are in search of diversified experiences. Many have already known unemployment and are aware of the obsolescence of their skills and diploma, hence their feeling of having nothing to lose. The time is no longer for the relationship of subordination, but for cooperation. On a daily basis, there is enough to disconcert managers. A Millennial accepts being explained the meaning of work, but not the way to do it. Facing these collaborators who rhyme professional well-being with connection, trust, autonomy and flexibility, we must finish with the syndrome of the pyramidal hierarchy.
73b92b92-6980-40eb-a61c-3440ef963d43.question_fr: Qu’apprend-on sur les Milléniaux dans le monde du travail ?
73b92b92-6980-40eb-a61c-3440ef963d43.question_en: What do we learn about Millennials in the world of work?

options.explanation: The text states that relationships based on subordination are being replaced by cooperation and calls for an end to pyramidal hierarchy. This indicates a disruption of traditional authority.

options.text: Ils évitent les postes à responsabilité.
options.explanation: The text mentions they value autonomy and meaning, but nowhere does it say they avoid responsibility.

options.text: Ils sont moins motivés que leurs ainés.
options.text_en: They are less motivated than their elders.
options.explanation: The text discusses different motivations (meaning, autonomy) but does not suggest they are less motivated than previous generations.

options.text: Ils tiennent à la stabilité de l’emploi.
options.explanation: The text explicitly contrasts them with predecessors who dreamed of permanent contracts (stability), stating Millennials seek 'diversified experiences' instead.

73b92b92-6980-40eb-a61c-3440ef963d43.key_line_fr: L’heure n’est plus à la relation de subordination, mais à la coopération.
73b92b92-6980-40eb-a61c-3440ef963d43.key_line_en: The time is no longer for the relationship of subordination, but for cooperation.
73b92b92-6980-40eb-a61c-3440ef963d43.explanation: Millennials reject traditional subordination and pyramidal hierarchies in favor of cooperation and autonomy, thereby changing how authority works in the workplace.
73b92b92-6980-40eb-a61c-3440ef963d43.breakdown:
1. The text contrasts Millennials with their predecessors: predecessors wanted stability ('contrat à durée indéterminée'), while Millennials want 'expériences diversifiées' (diverse experiences). This eliminates Option D.
2. It states 'L’heure n’est plus à la relation de subordination, mais à la coopération' (The time is no longer for subordination, but for cooperation). This suggests a shift in how authority works.
3. It mentions that managers are 'déconcertés' (disconcerted) and that we must end the 'hiérarchie pyramidale' (pyramidal hierarchy).
4. These points collectively show that Millennials are changing or disrupting traditional authority structures, which aligns perfectly with Option A.

2cb69330-6460-4670-98e1-ae74699c955a.text:
C’est un étonnant phénomène, appelé couronne de timidité : le feuillage de certains arbres n’entre jamais en contact avec celui des autres, créant des frontières entre les feuilles et des chemins de lumière.
Dans certaines forêts, en observant les cimes des arbres, un labyrinthe de lumière se dessine entre les feuillages, comme si les arbres laissaient volontairement une barrière polie d’une trentaine de centimètres pour éviter d’entrer en contact.
Cet espace laisserait filtrer la lumière, essentielle à la photosynthèse et à la survie des sous-bois, et permettrait également d’éviter des contagions, qu’il s’agisse de maladies ou d’insectes non volants.
Une même espèce d’arbres s’entend donc pour créer un environnement propice à la survie du groupe dans son ensemble.
2cb69330-6460-4670-98e1-ae74699c955a.text_en: It is an astonishing phenomenon, called crown shyness: the foliage of certain trees never comes into contact with that of others, creating borders between the leaves and paths of light. In certain forests, observing the tree tops, a labyrinth of light takes shape between the foliage, as if the trees voluntarily left a polite barrier of about thirty centimeters to avoid coming into contact. This space is said to let light filter through, essential for photosynthesis and the survival of the undergrowth, and would also prevent contagions, whether from diseases or non-flying insects. The same species of trees therefore agrees to create an environment favorable to the survival of the group as a whole.
2cb69330-6460-4670-98e1-ae74699c955a.question_fr: Que constate l’auteur du texte à propos des arbres ?
2cb69330-6460-4670-98e1-ae74699c955a.question_en: What does the author observe about trees?

options.text: Ils sont aptes à coloniser un territoire vierge.
options.text_en: They are apt to colonize a virgin territory.
options.explanation: The text discusses the behavior of trees in existing forests ('Dans certaines forêts'), not the colonization of new or virgin territories.

options.text: Ils sont capables de communiquer entre eux.
options.text_en: They are capable of communicating with each other.
options.explanation: The phrase 's'entend pour créer' (agrees/coordinates to create) suggests that trees have a way of communicating or coordinating to act for the benefit of the group.

options.text: Ils sont en compétition pour leur croissance.
options.text_en: They are in competition for their growth.
options.explanation: The text describes a cooperative behavior for the 'survival of the group,' explicitly avoiding contact, rather than competing for space.

options.text: Ils sont susceptibles de ressentir des émotions.
options.text_en: They are likely to feel emotions.
options.explanation: While the phenomenon is metaphorically called 'timidity,' the text explains it through biological needs (light, disease prevention), not actual emotional capacity.

2cb69330-6460-4670-98e1-ae74699c955a.key_line_fr: Une même espèce d’arbres s’entend donc pour créer un environnement propice à la survie du groupe dans son ensemble.
2cb69330-6460-4670-98e1-ae74699c955a.key_line_en: The same species of trees therefore agrees to create an environment favorable to the survival of the group as a whole.
2cb69330-6460-4670-98e1-ae74699c955a.explanation: The author concludes that trees 'agree' (s'entendent) to leave space for the group's survival, implying a form of communication or coordination.
2cb69330-6460-4670-98e1-ae74699c955a.breakdown: The text describes a phenomenon where trees avoid touching each other to allow light through and prevent disease spread. The crucial part is the conclusion: 'Une même espèce d’arbres s’entend donc pour créer un environnement propice...' (The same species of trees therefore agrees to create an environment favorable...). The verb 's'entendre' (to get along/agree) implies a form of coordination or communication to achieve a collective result, supporting option B.

dc39a093-348a-47cb-b4fb-1dcbbed41d8e.text:
SUR LE CHEMIN DE LA BIO-CONSTRUCTION
Depuis quelque temps, la conscience écologique s’est considérablement aiguisée.
Les particuliers ont même une idée précise de ce qu’ils veulent comme habitat.
En conséquence, les projets de logement 100 % écologiques deviennent l’obsession de tous les cabinets d’architectes : construction basse consommation, rénovation énergétique, maison passive.
Il s’agit maintenant d’adapter l’offre du marché et d’élargir les domaines de compétences des professionnels, notamment au sein des entreprises de construction.
D’autant plus que, selon un grand nombre de spécialistes, la construction bio - quand elle est mise en œuvre - représente un gain pour tout le monde, pour le promoteur comme pour l’acheteur.
dc39a093-348a-47cb-b4fb-1dcbbed41d8e.text_en:
ON THE PATH TO BIO-CONSTRUCTION
For some time now, ecological conscience has sharpened considerably.
Individuals even have a precise idea of what they want in terms of housing.
Consequently, 100% ecological housing projects are becoming the obsession of all architectural firms: low-consumption construction, energy renovation, passive houses.
It is now a matter of adapting the market offer and expanding the fields of competence of professionals, particularly within construction companies.
Especially since, according to a large number of specialists, bio-construction - when implemented - represents a gain for everyone, for the developer as well as for the buyer.
dc39a093-348a-47cb-b4fb-1dcbbed41d8e.question_fr: Selon l’auteur, quel est le défi de la bioconstruction ?
dc39a093-348a-47cb-b4fb-1dcbbed41d8e.question_en: According to the author, what is the challenge of bio-construction?

options.explanation: The text indicates that public ecological awareness is already 'considerably sharpened' and they have 'precise ideas', so they do not need convincing.
The text explicitly calls for 'expanding the fields of competence of professionals', which corresponds to training specialists.
The text argues that bio-construction already 'represents a gain for everyone', presenting profitability as a benefit rather than a challenge to be solved.
While 'energy renovation' is mentioned as a type of project, the specific challenge identified by the author concerns the skills of the workforce, not the act of restoration itself.

dc39a093-348a-47cb-b4fb-1dcbbed41d8e.key_line_fr: Il s’agit maintenant d’adapter l’offre du marché et d’élargir les domaines de compétences des professionnels, notamment au sein des entreprises de construction.
dc39a093-348a-47cb-b4fb-1dcbbed41d8e.key_line_en: It is now a matter of adapting the market offer and expanding the fields of competence of professionals, particularly within construction companies.
dc39a093-348a-47cb-b4fb-1dcbbed41d8e.explanation: The author identifies the need to expand the skills ('domaines de compétences') of construction professionals, which means training specialists in the sector.
dc39a093-348a-47cb-b4fb-1dcbbed41d8e.breakdown:
1. The text states that customers already have a sharp ecological conscience and know what they want (eliminating Option A).
2. It mentions that eco-projects are already an 'obsession' for architects and represent a 'gain for everyone' (eliminating Option C as profitability is established, not the main obstacle).
3. The text explicitly identifies the current task ('Il s’agit maintenant...') as adapting the market offer and 'expanding the fields of competence of professionals' within construction companies.
4. 'Expanding fields of competence' is synonymous with training or educating specialists, making Option B the correct answer.

4dd0d9e7-4a3d-4973-9008-3b1a5979b2e8.text:
Les champs de mise en œuvre des robots sont légion : production, services, gestion des données, vie urbaine, sécurité, loisirs, domotique.
Leur arrivée donne lieu à des transformations inédites et à des problématiques nouvelles, souvent mythifiées.
Un univers professionnel où tout serait régi par des robots ? Voilà qui est encore loin de la réalité.
Si l’automatisation a fait disparaître des emplois, elle en a aussi créé d’autres.
Surtout, elle a bouleversé le fonctionnement de l’entreprise, faisant peser une forte pression sur les salariés, tenus de maintenir la continuité de la production dans des processus toujours plus complexes.
4dd0d9e7-4a3d-4973-9008-3b1a5979b2e8.text_en: The fields of application for robots are legion: production, services, data management, urban life, security, leisure, home automation. Their arrival gives rise to unprecedented transformations and new issues, often mythologized. A professional universe where everything is governed by robots? That is still far from reality. If automation has eliminated jobs, it has also created others. Above all, it disrupted the functioning of the company, placing strong pressure on employees, who are required to maintain production continuity in increasingly complex processes.
4dd0d9e7-4a3d-4973-9008-3b1a5979b2e8.question_fr: Quelle est la conséquence de la robotisation dans le monde professionnel ?
4dd0d9e7-4a3d-4973-9008-3b1a5979b2e8.question_en: What is the consequence of robotization in the professional world?

options.text: Elle a accru la compétitivité industrielle.
options.explanation: The text lists fields of application (production, services, etc.) but does not explicitly state that it increased industrial competitiveness.

options.text: Elle a amélioré les conditions de travail.
options.explanation: The text states that automation places 'strong pressure on employees', which implies conditions became more difficult, not improved.

options.text: Elle a enrayé la hausse du chômage.
options.text_en: It halted the rise in unemployment.
options.explanation: The text says automation 'eliminated jobs' and 'created others', but it does not claim that it stopped (halted) the overall rise in unemployment.

options.text: Elle a modifié l’organisation du travail.
options.text_en: It modified the organization of work.
options.explanation: The phrase 'bouleversé le fonctionnement de l’entreprise' (disrupted the functioning of the company) confirms that the organization of work has been modified.

4dd0d9e7-4a3d-4973-9008-3b1a5979b2e8.key_line_fr: Surtout, elle a bouleversé le fonctionnement de l’entreprise
4dd0d9e7-4a3d-4973-9008-3b1a5979b2e8.key_line_en: Above all, it disrupted the functioning of the company
4dd0d9e7-4a3d-4973-9008-3b1a5979b2e8.explanation: The text explicitly states that automation 'disrupted the functioning of the company,' which means it changed how work is organized.
4dd0d9e7-4a3d-4973-9008-3b1a5979b2e8.breakdown:
1. The question asks for the consequence of robotization in the professional world based on the text.
2. Scan the text for the impact on companies or work.
3. The text states: 'Surtout, elle a bouleversé le fonctionnement de l’entreprise' (Above all, it disrupted the functioning of the company).
4. It also mentions it places 'strong pressure on employees' and involves 'increasingly complex processes'.
5. Compare this with Option D: 'It modified the organization of work.'
6. 'Bouleversé le fonctionnement' (disrupted the functioning) is a direct synonym for modifying the organization. Therefore, D is correct.

fca32f0b-d98e-4a9e-9e83-10dd8002cfe4.text:
L’expression « management des savoirs » peut paraître paradoxale.
Tout d’abord, les savoirs, comparativement aux ressources matérielles, semblent moins contrôlables parce que plus évanescents.
Comment en effet parvenir à gérer une chose aussi insaisissable que le savoir ?
Ensuite, le management évoque des règles et procédés organisationnels alors que les savoirs sont plutôt en position de force et, en tout état de cause, refuseraient d’être dirigés et contraints dans des règles standard.
Pourtant, il est de plus en plus communément admis que les savoirs doivent être gérés comme les ressources matérielles : c’est même là que réside désormais la clé de la compétitivité des entreprises.
fca32f0b-d98e-4a9e-9e83-10dd8002cfe4.text_en: The expression 'knowledge management' may seem paradoxical. First of all, knowledge, compared to material resources, seems less controllable because it is more evanescent. How indeed can one manage something as elusive as knowledge? Next, management evokes organizational rules and procedures whereas knowledge is rather in a position of strength and, in any case, would refuse to be directed and constrained within standard rules. However, it is increasingly commonly accepted that knowledge must be managed like material resources: this is even where the key to the competitiveness of companies now lies.
fca32f0b-d98e-4a9e-9e83-10dd8002cfe4.question_fr: Quelle est la particularité de l’expression « management des savoirs » ?
fca32f0b-d98e-4a9e-9e83-10dd8002cfe4.question_en: What is the peculiarity of the expression 'knowledge management'?

options.text: Elle évoque la facilité de contrôle des savoirs comparativement aux ressources matérielles.
options.text_en: It evokes the ease of controlling knowledge compared to material resources.
options.explanation: The text states the opposite: knowledge seems 'less controllable' compared to material resources.

options.text: Elle suggère que les savoirs peuvent être facilement dirigés et contraints dans des règles standard.
options.text_en: It suggests that knowledge can be easily directed and constrained within standard rules.
options.explanation: The text suggests knowledge would 'refuse to be directed and constrained' by standard rules, rather than being easily directed.

options.text: Elle souligne la complexité de gérer une chose aussi insaisissable que le savoir tout en reconnaissant son importance pour la compétitivité des entreprises.
options.text_en: It underscores the complexity of managing something as elusive as knowledge while recognizing its importance for company competitiveness.
options.explanation: This summarizes the text's main point: the expression is paradoxical because knowledge is 'elusive' (hard to manage), yet managing it is the 'key to competitiveness'.

options.text: Elle affirme que les savoirs sont moins importants pour la compétitivité des entreprises que les ressources matérielles.
options.text_en: It asserts that knowledge is less important for company competitiveness than material resources.
options.explanation: The text states that knowledge is the 'key to competitiveness,' implying it is extremely important, not less important.

fca32f0b-d98e-4a9e-9e83-10dd8002cfe4.key_line_fr: Pourtant, il est de plus en plus communément admis que les savoirs doivent être gérés comme les ressources matérielles : c’est même là que réside désormais la clé de la compétitivité des entreprises.
fca32f0b-d98e-4a9e-9e83-10dd8002cfe4.key_line_en: However, it is increasingly commonly accepted that knowledge must be managed like material resources: this is even where the key to the competitiveness of companies now lies.
fca32f0b-d98e-4a9e-9e83-10dd8002cfe4.explanation: The text describes knowledge management as paradoxical because knowledge is hard to control ('elusive'), yet essential for business success ('competitiveness'). Option C reflects this contradiction.
fca32f0b-d98e-4a9e-9e83-10dd8002cfe4.breakdown: The text opens by stating the expression 'knowledge management' seems paradoxical. It explains that knowledge is 'evanescent' and 'elusive' (insaisissable), making it hard to control, unlike material resources. However, the final sentence asserts that despite this difficulty, managing knowledge is now the 'key to competitiveness'. Option C perfectly captures this duality: the complexity (due to elusiveness) and the necessity (for competitiveness).

49c7aecf-138b-4d46-94e6-86fa7fa5c7db.text_en: For summer, here are some simple steps if it is very hot: • Drink 1.5 liters of water a day; • Limit physical exertion; • Eat fruits and vegetables; • Keep your home cool.

49c7aecf-138b-4d46-94e6-86fa7fa5c7db.question_en: What is the goal of this announcement?

The text mentions the condition 'if it is hot' but does not provide a weather report or forecast.
While it lists actions, 'Limiter les efforts' (limiting efforts) is not a leisure activity being presented.
It suggests eating fruits and vegetables as a health tip, not as a structured meal plan or restaurant menu.

49c7aecf-138b-4d46-94e6-86fa7fa5c7db.key_line_fr: Pour l’été, voici quelques gestes simples s’il fait très chaud
49c7aecf-138b-4d46-94e6-86fa7fa5c7db.key_line_en: For summer, here are some simple steps if it is very hot
49c7aecf-138b-4d46-94e6-86fa7fa5c7db.explanation: The text lists recommendations to stay healthy during hot weather, which is the definition of giving advice.
49c7aecf-138b-4d46-94e6-86fa7fa5c7db.breakdown:
1.  **Analyze the document**: The text begins with 'voici quelques gestes simples s’il fait très chaud' (here are some simple steps if it is very hot).
2.  **Examine the list**: The bullet points provide instructions: drink water, limit physical effort, eat fruits/vegetables, keep the house cool.

Option C is incorrect as limiting effort is not a leisure activity. Option D is incorrect because mentioning specific food types does not constitute a full menu.

options.explanation: The text asks to 'Remplissez le dossier' (fill out the file), which means completing the necessary documents.
The text mentions registrations, not asking for a specific program.
There is no mention of scheduling a meeting or appointment ('rendez-vous').
Parents can go to the town hall to pick up forms, but the main task is not to visit the school or establishment itself.

1d0c21c8-3a83-49f3-a99c-e2014a1b0e7f.key_line_fr: Remplissez le dossier sur le site de la ville www.ville-de-vernon.fr ou retirez-le à la mairie et renvoyez-le avec toutes les informations avant le 17 mars.
1d0c21c8-3a83-49f3-a99c-e2014a1b0e7f.key_line_en: Fill out the file on the city's website www.ville-de-vernon.fr or pick it up at the town hall and send it back with all the information before March 17th.
1d0c21c8-3a83-49f3-a99c-e2014a1b0e7f.explanation: The instruction 'Remplissez le dossier' (fill out the file) directly corresponds to option A, 'Compléter des documents'.
1d0c21c8-3a83-49f3-a99c-e2014a1b0e7f.breakdown: The text announces that registrations are open. It specifically instructs parents to 'Remplissez le dossier' (Fill out the file/folder). 0ceab122-0570-4d56-8151-2a824a504a71.text: À Chamonix, à 10 minutes à pied des pistes de ski, grand 3 pièces de 65 m², tout équipé, confortable et calme. Proche de nombreux commerces et d’une garderie. 620 euros la semaine en été, 1050 euros en hiver.
0ceab122-0570-4d56-8151-2a824a504a71.text_en: In Chamonix, 10 minutes walk from the ski slopes, large 3-room apartment of 65 m², fully equipped, comfortable and quiet. Close to many shops and a daycare. 620 euros per week in summer, 1050 euros in winter.

It mentions 'pistes de ski' (ski slopes) to locate the apartment, but does not rent out equipment.
There is no mention of employment or salary.

0ceab122-0570-4d56-8151-2a824a504a71.key_line_fr: 620 euros la semaine en été, 1050 euros en hiver.

d3cbb2d2-6519-4cf3-9570-1cf2f75579f2.text_en: The Association « Bon appétit ! » proposes you eat better. It comes to your home with tasty little dishes every day of the week. All our menus are prepared with seasonal vegetables! Choose your menu on our site www.bonappetit.fr !

3bb27ed8-5113-49b4-898f-229b681a71f3.text:
Salut Lucie,
Je t’écris de l’île d’Yeu où je passe une semaine formidable : plage, mer, soleil et surtout beaucoup de calme et de repos. J’espère que tu vas bien, à bientôt.
Je t’embrasse,
Agathe.
3bb27ed8-5113-49b4-898f-229b681a71f3.text_en: Hi Lucie, I am writing to you from the Ile d'Yeu where I am spending a wonderful week: beach, sea, sun and above all lots of calm and rest. I hope you are doing well, see you soon. Hugs, Agathe.

options.explanation: She is spending a week ('une semaine') on vacation, not permanently moving house ('déménagement').
