51a78eae-38ad-4b41-a8f2-d08e0ee9136a.explanation: The association is creating a center where people can borrow books (a library) to make reading accessible to everyone.
51a78eae-38ad-4b41-a8f2-d08e0ee9136a.breakdown: The text explicitly states that the association is setting up ('mettant sur pied') a 'centre de livres d'occasion à emprunter' (center for second-hand books to borrow). A place where one can borrow books is the definition of a library ('bibliothèque'). Furthermore, the text concludes by saying this project aims to make reading 'accessible à tous' (accessible to all), which perfectly matches option C: 'Ouvrir une bibliothèque pour tous' (Open a library for everyone).

a22b16e1-f952-4c23-874a-7a1a6cf00273.text:
Depuis des siècles, les gestes sont les mêmes. La précision obligatoire.
Et le temps nécessaire. Pourtant, avant les défilés des collections automne-hiver, la fièvre règne dans les ganteries de Saint-Junien, principale ville gantière de France.
Industrie saisonnière, pour que les gants soient livrés en automne, les cadences maximales de fabrication se situent avant, entre le printemps et l'été. Avec un handicap majeur : l'impossibilité d'embaucher en renfort des artisans gantiers supplémentaires, pour la simple raison qu'il n'en existe pas.
L'apprentissage de ces métiers s'effectue forcément en interne puisque la dernière école de ganterie a mis la clé sous la porte.
a22b16e1-f952-4c23-874a-7a1a6cf00273.text_en: For centuries, the gestures have been the same. The precision required. And the time necessary. Yet, before the autumn-winter collection shows, fever reigns in the glove factories of Saint-Junien, the main glove-making city in France. A seasonal industry, so that gloves are delivered in autumn, maximum production rates occur before then, between spring and summer. With a major handicap: the impossibility of hiring additional glove-making artisans as reinforcement, for the simple reason that they do not exist. Learning these trades is necessarily done internally since the last glove-making school closed its doors.
a22b16e1-f952-4c23-874a-7a1a6cf00273.question_fr: Quel est le principal problème que rencontre l'industrie du gant ?
a22b16e1-f952-4c23-874a-7a1a6cf00273.question_en: What is the main problem facing the glove industry?

options.text: La réactivité aux changements de la mode.
options.explanation: The text mentions fashion shows ('défilés') to set the timeline, but does not imply the industry struggles to react to style changes.
The text explicitly defines the 'major handicap' as the impossibility of hiring ('embaucher') extra artisans because they simply don't exist.

The text says the school closed ('mis la clé sous la porte'), forcing internal training. It does not claim the training itself is 'ill-suited' (inadaptée), just that external candidates are unavailable.
While the text mentions gestures have been the same for centuries, this highlights the requirement for precision and time, not that the techniques are obsolete or problematic.

a22b16e1-f952-4c23-874a-7a1a6cf00273.key_line_fr: Avec un handicap majeur : l'impossibilité d'embaucher en renfort des artisans gantiers supplémentaires, pour la simple raison qu'il n'en existe pas.
a22b16e1-f952-4c23-874a-7a1a6cf00273.key_line_en: With a major handicap: the impossibility of hiring additional glove-making artisans as reinforcement, for the simple reason that they do not exist.

vocabulary.term: mis la clé sous la porte
vocabulary.gloss: closed down / went out of business

a22b16e1-f952-4c23-874a-7a1a6cf00273.explanation: The passage explicitly states the main handicap is the inability to hire extra staff during peak season because no qualified artisans exist.
a22b16e1-f952-4c23-874a-7a1a6cf00273.breakdown:
1. Scan the text for keywords indicating a problem ('handicap', 'problème', 'difficulté').
2. Locate the sentence: 'Avec un handicap majeur : l'impossibilité d'embaucher en renfort des artisans gantiers supplémentaires...' (With a major handicap: the impossibility of hiring additional glove artisans...).
3. Analyze the cause: The text states these artisans do not exist because the schools have closed.
4. Match with options: 'Embaucher' (to hire) corresponds directly to 'Recrutement' (Recruitment) in Option B. The lack of existing artisans confirms the difficulty in finding 'personnels qualifiés' (qualified personnel).

acd7c251-af8b-4162-8b51-ca0a7d7d72b0.text:
Les séances de matinée, au cinéma, me comblaient. Elles me donnaient le courage d'affronter la curiosité des uns et des autres. Elles ne m'éloignaient pas longtemps de mes enfants. Je m'asseyais à ma place, avec de moins en moins de gêne, au fil des mois. Le cinéma, quel dérivatif puissant à l'angoisse ! Films intellectuels, à thèse, films sentimentaux, films policiers, films drôles, films à suspense furent mes compagnons. Je puisais en eux des leçons de grandeur, de courage et de persévérance. Ils approfondissaient et élargissaient ma vision du monde, grâce à leur apport culturel. J'oubliais mes tourments en partageant ceux d'autrui. Le cinéma, distraction peu onéreuse, peut donc procurer une joie saine.
Mariama Bâ, Une si longue lettre
acd7c251-af8b-4162-8b51-ca0a7d7d72b0.text_en: Morning cinema sessions filled me with satisfaction. They gave me the courage to face the curiosity of others. They didn't keep me away from my children for long. I would sit in my seat, with less and less embarrassment, as the months went by. Cinema, what a powerful diversion from anguish! Intellectual films, thesis films, romantic films, detective films, funny films, suspense films were my companions. I drew lessons of greatness, courage, and perseverance from them. They deepened and broadened my vision of the world, thanks to their cultural contribution. I forgot my torments by sharing those of others. Cinema, an inexpensive distraction, can therefore provide healthy joy.
acd7c251-af8b-4162-8b51-ca0a7d7d72b0.question_fr: Que ressent cette personne quand elle va au cinéma ?
acd7c251-af8b-4162-8b51-ca0a7d7d72b0.question_en: What does this person feel when she goes to the cinema?

options.text_en: She feels a sense of invulnerability.
options.explanation: The text says cinema gave her courage, but 'invulnerability' is an exaggeration not supported by the text.

options.text: Elle s’imagine vivre une vie meilleure.
options.text_en: She imagines living a better life.
options.explanation: She mentions broadening her vision of the world, not fantasizing about living a better life herself.

options.text: Elle savoure le bonheur d’avoir une famille.
options.text_en: She savors the happiness of having a family.
options.explanation: The text implies she goes to the cinema alone as an escape; she mentions her children only to say she isn't away from them for too long.

options.text: Elle s’abstrait un temps de ses soucis.
options.text_en: She detaches herself from her worries for a while.
options.explanation: This matches the text's description of cinema as a diversion from anguish where she forgets her torments.

acd7c251-af8b-4162-8b51-ca0a7d7d72b0.key_line_fr: J'oubliais mes tourments en partageant ceux d'autrui.
acd7c251-af8b-4162-8b51-ca0a7d7d72b0.key_line_en: I forgot my torments by sharing those of others.
acd7c251-af8b-4162-8b51-ca0a7d7d72b0.explanation: The narrator explicitly states that she forgets her torments and finds a diversion from her anguish at the cinema, which matches the idea of detaching from worries.
acd7c251-af8b-4162-8b51-ca0a7d7d72b0.breakdown:
1. The question asks what the narrator feels or experiences when going to the cinema.
2. In the text, the narrator describes the cinema as a 'dérivatif puissant à l'angoisse' (powerful diversion from anguish).
3. Later, she explicitly states: 'J'oubliais mes tourments' (I forgot my torments/troubles).
4. Option D ('She detaches herself from her worries for a while') is a synonym for forgetting torments and using cinema as a diversion from anguish.
5. Option A is incorrect because gaining 'courage' to face others is not the same as total 'invulnerability'.
6. Option B is not supported; she learns lessons but doesn't explicitly fantasize about a different life.
7. Option C is incorrect; she mentions not being away from her children for long, but the cinema is an escape *from* daily life, not a moment to savor family happiness.

d882edc4-a71d-4b93-8b70-32798e355cb6.text:
Histoires d’école
Bernard Martin
Longtemps, l'auteur de ce livre fut un objet de stupeur pour sa famille : incapable d'apprendre l'alphabet, détestant les majuscules, les noms propres et les listes de vocabulaire à retenir.
« D'où venait mon ânerie ? », se demande-t-il dans cet ouvrage qui en réconfortera plus d'un. Car ce romancier jubilatoire fut un mauvais élève, terrassé par l'école. Il fut aussi professeur de français, histoire de contredire le destin.
Ce récit est à la fois un manuel de pédagogie et un recueil de souvenirs. Un beau témoignage à offrir à tous ceux qui n'ont pas la science infuse. À tout le monde, donc.
d882edc4-a71d-4b93-8b70-32798e355cb6.text_en: For a long time, the author of this book was an object of stupor for his family: incapable of learning the alphabet, hating capital letters, proper names, and vocabulary lists to memorize. 'Where did my stupidity come from?' he asks himself in this work which will comfort more than one person. For this jubilant novelist was a bad student, crushed by school. He was also a French teacher, just to contradict destiny. This narrative is both a pedagogy manual and a collection of memories. A beautiful testimony to offer to all those who think they have innate knowledge. To everyone, therefore.

dc98319d-477e-4a65-a0b1-056e6c4c3aa0.text:
Dans leur nouvelle collection, les éditions Nil invitent des auteurs à se livrer à un exercice épistolaire intime en écrivant une lettre pour dire l'indicible. Le modèle est celle que Kafka rédigea à l'intention de son père et qu'il préféra dans un tiroir tant l'accusation portée était peu amène.
Avec L'Autre fille, missive adressée à sa sœur aînée, morte avant sa naissance, Annie Ernaux inaugure brillamment le concept, fidèle à son écriture tranchante et analytique. Rejetant le terme d'autofiction, l'écrivain se dit fascinée par la réalité, partant à la recherche d'une vérité sur une mort que ses parents lui ont toujours cachée.
En demandant à des auteurs de se libérer d'un vieux tourment, la collection souhaite réhabiliter un genre littéraire oublié.
dc98319d-477e-4a65-a0b1-056e6c4c3aa0.text_en:
In their new collection, Nil editions invite authors to engage in an intimate epistolary exercise by writing a letter to say the unspeakable. The model is the one Kafka drafted for his father and which he preferred to leave in a drawer, so unkind was the accusation it carried.
With 'L'Autre fille' (The Other Daughter), a missive addressed to her older sister, who died before her birth, Annie Ernaux brilliantly inaugurates the concept, faithful to her sharp and analytical writing. Rejecting the term autofiction, the writer claims to be fascinated by reality, setting out in search of a truth about a death that her parents always hid from her.
By asking authors to free themselves from an old torment, the collection wishes to rehabilitate a forgotten literary genre.

21ee5daf-3d08-48f0-9ae8-857d40bc178c.text:
Qu'est-ce que la « banquise » ? Un amas de glace flottante, un peu comme un glaçon géant. D'ailleurs, ce mot nous fait spontanément penser à un banc de glace. On parle bien de banquette, alors pourquoi pas de banquise ? Hélas, l'origine du mot est tout autre.
En fait, on devrait plutôt dire « panquise », puisque le mot provient d'une vieille langue scandinave, le norois, dans laquelle un « pakkis » est un bloc de glace. Le début du mot appartiendrait à la famille de « paquet » et le « -is » final signifie « glace » dans de nombreuses langues du Nord. Alors bien sûr, c'est la proximité du mot français « banc » qui a prêté à confusion.
21ee5daf-3d08-48f0-9ae8-857d40bc178c.text_en: What is "banquise"? A mass of floating ice, a bit like a giant ice cube. Moreover, this word spontaneously makes us think of a "banc de glace" (ice bank). We speak of "banquette" (bench/seat), so why not "banquise"? Alas, the origin of the word is quite different. In fact, we should rather say "panquise", since the word comes from an old Scandinavian language, Old Norse, in which a "pakkis" is a block of ice. The beginning of the word supposedly belongs to the family of "paquet" (packet/pack) and the final "-is" means "ice" in many Northern languages. So of course, it is the proximity of the French word "banc" that lent itself to confusion.

options.explanation: The text demonstrates how the similarity between "banquise" and "banc" leads people to believe they are related, while the true origin is completely different ("pakkis"). This shows how easily one can be mistaken about a word's origin.

21ee5daf-3d08-48f0-9ae8-857d40bc178c.key_line_en: So of course, it is the proximity of the French word "banc" that lent itself to confusion.
21ee5daf-3d08-48f0-9ae8-857d40bc178c.explanation: The article explains that people wrongly associate "banquise" with "banc" because they sound similar, whereas it actually comes from "pakkis," showing how easy it is to believe a false etymology.

0492959e-1892-4b87-9379-6722d8d8f9ff.text:
Les technologies de l'information et de la communication (TIC) ont révolutionné presque tous les aspects de la vie privée et professionnelle.
Si les élèves ne sont pas capables de naviguer dans un environnement numérique complexe, ils ne pourront pas participer pleinement à la vie économique, sociale et culturelle du monde qui les entoure.
Les systèmes d'éducation doivent fournir aux professionnels de l'éducation des environnements d'apprentissage.
Ceux-ci permettront de développer les pédagogies du XXIᵉ siècle et de doter les élèves des compétences dont ils auront besoin pour réussir dans le monde de demain.
La technologie est le seul moyen d'élargir au maximum l'accès à la connaissance ; elle peut être utilisée au service des nouvelles pédagogies en plaçant les apprenants au cœur d'un apprentissage actif.
0492959e-1892-4b87-9379-6722d8d8f9ff.text_en: Information and communication technologies (ICT) have revolutionized almost all aspects of private and professional life. If students are not able to navigate a complex digital environment, they will not be able to fully participate in the economic, social, and cultural life of the world around them. Education systems must provide education professionals with learning environments. These will allow for the development of 21st-century pedagogies and equip students with the skills they will need to succeed in the world of tomorrow. Technology is the only way to maximize access to knowledge; it can be used in the service of new pedagogies by placing learners at the heart of active learning.

de2b2e55-f9d3-400e-b02b-ed44438d7f23.text_en: Whether they are students or employees, many young people face housing problems. Meanwhile, retirees live in houses that have become too large for them, often alone. Bringing these generations together is the goal of the Lien association, which looks for retirees who have a room in their home to host a young person between 18 and 25 years old. In return, the young person can perform…
de2b2e55-f9d3-400e-b02b-ed44438d7f23.question_fr: Quel est l’objectif de l’association Lien ?
de2b2e55-f9d3-400e-b02b-ed44438d7f23.question_en: What is the goal of the Lien association?

options.text: Centraliser les demandes de location des retraités
options.explanation: The text discusses finding specific retirees willing to host, not acting as a central agency for general rental requests.

options.text: Favoriser la cohabitation entre les générations.
options.explanation: The text explicitly mentions the goal is to "make these generations meet" by having a young person live in a retiree's home.

options.text: Loger des jeunes en difficulté dans un studio.
options.text_en: House young people in difficulty in a studio.
options.explanation: The text specifies the accommodation is "une chambre" (a room) inside the retiree's home, not an independent "studio."

options.text: Offrir une assistance médicale aux personnes âgées.
options.text_en: Offer medical assistance to the elderly.
options.explanation: Medical assistance is not mentioned. The text suggests an exchange of services or presence, but medical care is a specific professional service not implied here.

de2b2e55-f9d3-400e-b02b-ed44438d7f23.key_line_fr: Faire se rencontrer ces générations, c’est l’objectif de l’association Lien qui recherche des retraités qui ont chez eux une chambre pour accueillir un jeune entre 18 et 25 ans.
de2b2e55-f9d3-400e-b02b-ed44438d7f23.key_line_en: Bringing these generations together is the goal of the Lien association, which looks for retirees who have a room in their home to host a young person between 18 and 25 years old.
de2b2e55-f9d3-400e-b02b-ed44438d7f23.explanation: The text explicitly states the goal is to make generations meet by housing young people with retirees, which matches Option B.
de2b2e55-f9d3-400e-b02b-ed44438d7f23.breakdown: The text identifies two groups: young people with housing issues and retirees living alone in large houses. It then explicitly states: "Faire se rencontrer ces générations, c’est l’objectif de l’association Lien" (Bringing these generations together is the goal of the Lien association). This concept of bringing distinct age groups to live together is synonymous with "promoting cohabitation between generations."

b3c1b579-3852-4dfc-ae1b-6b4cb75b033b.text:
Parce que c’est important de rendre curieux et de faire rire, le théâtre Aktéon met en place toute l’année des séances scolaires sur demande.
Au jour et à l’heure que vous souhaitez, vous pouvez assister avec votre classe à un spectacle privé dans votre établissement ! De nombreux collégiens et lycéens en ont profité l’an dernier.
Après le spectacle, l’équipe artistique propose d’échanger sur la pièce avec les élèves. Des rencontres toujours enrichissantes, parfois drôles !
Source : brochure
b3c1b579-3852-4dfc-ae1b-6b4cb75b033b.text_en: Because it is important to spark curiosity and make people laugh, the Aktéon theater organizes school sessions on request all year round. On the day and time you wish, you can attend a private show with your class in your establishment! Many middle and high school students took advantage of this last year. After the show, the artistic team offers to discuss the play with the students. Meetings that are always enriching, sometimes funny!

options.explanation: The text mentions a private show 'dans votre établissement' (in your establishment), which means welcoming the theater troupe into the school.
The text mentions watching a play and discussing it, but never mentions teaching the history of theater.
While the artistic team discusses the play, there is no mention of presenting specific theater professions (lighting, costumes, etc.).
The offer is for a 'spectacle' (show), not for 'cours' (classes/lessons) for the students to learn how to act.

b3c1b579-3852-4dfc-ae1b-6b4cb75b033b.key_line_fr: Au jour et à l’heure que vous souhaitez, vous pouvez assister avec votre classe à un spectacle privé dans votre établissement !
b3c1b579-3852-4dfc-ae1b-6b4cb75b033b.key_line_en: On the day and time you wish, you can attend a private show with your class in your establishment!
b3c1b579-3852-4dfc-ae1b-6b4cb75b033b.explanation: The brochure invites teachers to book private performances that take place directly inside their own schools ('dans votre établissement').
b3c1b579-3852-4dfc-ae1b-6b4cb75b033b.breakdown: The text states that the theater organizes sessions 'sur demande' (on request). Crucially, it says: 'vous pouvez assister avec votre classe à un spectacle privé dans votre établissement' (you can attend a private show with your class in your establishment). 'Dans votre établissement' in the context of a class implies bringing the performance directly to the school.

aed777a6-b7c1-414b-be1b-6d972c5a378d.text:
Chère Sarah,
Je suis de retour à la montagne. Les vacances étaient géniales : cette année, nous avons pris le train jusqu’à La Rochelle, puis nous avons pris un bateau jusqu’à l’île de Ré. Nous y avons passé toute la semaine.
On s’est déplacé à vélo, on a pêché et ramassé des coquillages. C’était magnifique.
Je t’embrasse,
Pamela.
aed777a6-b7c1-414b-be1b-6d972c5a378d.text_en: Dear Sarah, I am back in the mountains. The vacation was great: this year, we took the train to La Rochelle, then we took a boat to the Île de Ré. We spent the whole week there. We got around by bike, we fished and gathered seashells. It was magnificent. Love, Pamela.
aed777a6-b7c1-414b-be1b-6d972c5a378d.question_fr: Où est-ce que Pamela a passé ses vacances ?
aed777a6-b7c1-414b-be1b-6d972c5a378d.question_en: Where did Pamela spend her vacation?

options.explanation: She is 'back' (de retour) in the mountains, meaning that is where she lives/returned to, not where she went for the holiday.
La Rochelle was a transit point where she took the train before taking the boat.
She took a boat (sur un bateau) to get to her destination, but she did not spend the vacation living on the boat.
She spent the week on 'l’île de Ré'. The word 'île' means island.

aed777a6-b7c1-414b-be1b-6d972c5a378d.key_line_fr: puis nous avons pris un bateau jusqu’à l’île de Ré. Nous y avons passé toute la semaine.
aed777a6-b7c1-414b-be1b-6d972c5a378d.key_line_en: then we took a boat to the Île de Ré. We spent the whole week there.
aed777a6-b7c1-414b-be1b-6d972c5a378d.explanation: Pamela explicitly states she went to 'l’île de Ré' and spent the week there. 'Île' translates to 'island'.
aed777a6-b7c1-414b-be1b-6d972c5a378d.breakdown:
1. The text asks where Pamela spent her vacation.
2. Pamela says: 'Je suis de retour à la montagne' (I am back in the mountains), which implies she lives there and the vacation is over, ruling out Option A.
3. She explains the journey: 'train jusqu’à La Rochelle' (train to La Rochelle) then 'bateau jusqu’à l’île de Ré' (boat to the Île de Ré).
4. Crucially, she adds: 'Nous y avons passé toute la semaine' (We spent the whole week there). The 'y' refers to the last mentioned place, 'l’île de Ré'.
5. Since 'l’île de Ré' contains the word 'île' (island), Option D is the correct answer.

661d8f44-8558-4d04-93d3-6a7264c523b9.text:
Situé au cœur d’un jardin tropical et en bordure d’une grande plage de sable fin, le Coralia est un hôtel-club de dernière génération, confortable et convivial.
Complet et bien équipé, il satisfera les familles comme les sportifs.
Vous pourrez pratiquer tous les sports nautiques et vous détendre dans nos salles de musculation et de fitness.
Son magnifique restaurant vous accueillera jusque très tard dans la nuit.
L’un des rares hôtels de la région à proposer une animation 100 % francophone.
661d8f44-8558-4d04-93d3-6a7264c523b9.text_en: Located in the heart of a tropical garden and bordering a large fine sand beach, the Coralia is a latest-generation hotel-club, comfortable and friendly. Complete and well-equipped, it will satisfy families as well as sports enthusiasts. You will be able to practice all water sports and relax in our weight training and fitness rooms. Its magnificent restaurant will welcome you until very late at night. One of the rare hotels in the region to offer 100% French-speaking entertainment.

options.text: Un club pour les jeunes enfants.
options.explanation: The text says the hotel satisfies 'families', but does not explicitly mention a specific 'club' for children.

options.text: Un espace de remise en forme.
options.explanation: The phrase 'salles de musculation et de fitness' (weight training and fitness rooms) confirms the existence of a fitness area ('espace de remise en forme').
The text mentions a restaurant, but does not specify the pricing model or board type (e.g., full board).
The text mentions a 'magnificent restaurant' that stays open late, but does not specifically describe the variety of the food offer.

661d8f44-8558-4d04-93d3-6a7264c523b9.key_line_fr: Vous pourrez pratiquer tous les sports nautiques et vous détendre dans nos salles de musculation et de fitness.
661d8f44-8558-4d04-93d3-6a7264c523b9.key_line_en: You will be able to practice all water sports and relax in our weight training and fitness rooms.
661d8f44-8558-4d04-93d3-6a7264c523b9.explanation: The passage lists 'weight training and fitness rooms' among the amenities, which corresponds exactly to a 'fitness area'.
661d8f44-8558-4d04-93d3-6a7264c523b9.breakdown: The text explicitly mentions facilities for physical activity and relaxation. Specifically, it states users can relax in 'salles de musculation et de fitness' (weight training and fitness rooms). The term 'espace de remise en forme' is a direct synonym for fitness facilities. The other options (kids' club, full board, specific catering details) are not mentioned in the text.

1ebbdac4-605d-4574-87f2-d5907e421ce6.text:
La ville de Montreuil impose de nouvelles règles aux projets immobiliers du centre-ville pour promouvoir l’installation de commerces et d’ateliers d’artistes sur les axes centraux de la ville.
Cette solution favorise la mixité des usages. En effet, la construction de logements est plus rentable que celle de locaux commerciaux ou artistiques, ce qui incite les promoteurs à ne construire que ce type de biens.
Refusant de créer une ville-dortoir et décidée à préserver l’identité artistique de la ville, la municipalité entend soutenir l’installation de ces activités en rez-de-chaussée.
1ebbdac4-605d-4574-87f2-d5907e421ce6.text_en: The city of Montreuil is imposing new rules on real estate projects in the city center to promote the installation of shops and artist workshops on the city's central axes. This solution fosters mixed-use. Indeed, the construction of housing is more profitable than that of commercial or artistic premises, which encourages developers to build only this type of property. Refusing to create a dormitory town and determined to preserve the city's artistic identity, the municipality intends to support the installation of these activities on the ground floor.
1ebbdac4-605d-4574-87f2-d5907e421ce6.question_fr: Quel est l’objectif de la politique urbaine de Montreuil ?
1ebbdac4-605d-4574-87f2-d5907e421ce6.question_en: What is the objective of Montreuil's urban policy?

options.text: Développer la mixité sociale dans les quartiers.
options.explanation: The text discusses 'mixité des usages' (different types of buildings/activities), not 'mixité sociale' (integration of different social classes).

options.text_en: Diversify activities in the city center.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states the goal is to promote shops and artist workshops to ensure mixed usage, which means diversifying activities in the city center.

options.text: Encourager la croissance du secteur immobilier.
options.text_en: Encourage growth in the real estate sector.
options.explanation: The city is imposing restrictions on developers, not specifically trying to grow the sector; in fact, it is curbing the trend of building only profitable housing.

options.text_en: Stabilize the number of housing units.
options.explanation: The text does not mention a goal of stabilizing the specific number of housing units, but rather ensuring they are not the only thing built.

1ebbdac4-605d-4574-87f2-d5907e421ce6.key_line_fr: La ville de Montreuil impose de nouvelles règles aux projets immobiliers du centre-ville pour promouvoir l’installation de commerces et d’ateliers d’artistes sur les axes centraux de la ville.
1ebbdac4-605d-4574-87f2-d5907e421ce6.key_line_en: The city of Montreuil is imposing new rules on real estate projects in the city center to promote the installation of shops and artist workshops on the city's central axes.
1ebbdac4-605d-4574-87f2-d5907e421ce6.explanation: The city wants to avoid becoming a 'dormitory town' (just housing) by forcing developers to include shops and artist studios, thereby diversifying the activities available in the center.
1ebbdac4-605d-4574-87f2-d5907e421ce6.breakdown:
1. The text states that Montreuil imposes new rules to promote 'l’installation de commerces et d’ateliers d’artistes' (the installation of shops and artist workshops).
2. It explicitly mentions that this solution favors 'la mixité des usages' (mixed-use development) and avoids creating a 'ville-dortoir' (dormitory town) consisting only of housing.
3. Option A mentions 'social mix' (mixité sociale), which refers to people, whereas the text talks about 'usage mix' (activities/buildings).
4. Option B, 'Diversify activities', perfectly matches the goal of adding shops and workshops alongside housing.
5. Option C is incorrect because the city is regulating developers who are already motivated by profit, not necessarily encouraging growth itself.
6. Option D is irrelevant; the focus is on adding other types of spaces, not stabilizing housing numbers.

72f39d30-25bf-4306-8d52-1aa56ac0ef43.text:
Chaque année, le 10 août, les habitants de l’île de la Guadeloupe se retrouvent à Pointe-à-Pitre pour célébrer Saint Laurent, leur patron.
Après une grande messe donnée à l’église de Saint Laurent, une procession de cuisinières vêtues de leurs plus beaux madras sillonne la ville avant de convier la population à un grand festin composé des meilleurs plats créoles.
Située dans le village du Gosier, à proximité de Pointe-à-Pitre, l’Auberge de la Vieille Tour, construite autour d’un moulin à vent du XVIIIe siècle, sera un lieu de séjour idéal pour assister à cette manifestation haute en couleur et pour goûter au vrai parfum des Antilles.
72f39d30-25bf-4306-8d52-1aa56ac0ef43.text_en: Every year, on August 10th, the inhabitants of the island of Guadeloupe meet in Pointe-à-Pitre to celebrate Saint Laurent, their patron saint. After a high mass given at the church of Saint Laurent, a procession of cooks dressed in their finest madras traverses the city before inviting the population to a grand feast composed of the best Creole dishes. Located in the village of Gosier, near Pointe-à-Pitre, the Auberge de la Vieille Tour, built around an 18th-century windmill, will be an ideal place to stay to attend this colorful event and to taste the true flavor of the Antilles.
72f39d30-25bf-4306-8d52-1aa56ac0ef43.question_fr: La célébration de Saint Laurent à Pointe-à-Pitre…
72f39d30-25bf-4306-8d52-1aa56ac0ef43.question_en: The celebration of Saint Laurent in Pointe-à-Pitre...

options.text: consiste en un grand évènement religieux.
options.text_en: consists of a major religious event.
options.explanation: While it starts with a mass, the text emphasizes the cultural and culinary aspects (procession of cooks, feast) rather than defining it solely as a religious event.

options.text: permet de découvre les saveurs antillaises.
options.explanation: The text explicitly mentions a 'grand feast composed of the best Creole dishes,' which corresponds to discovering Antillean flavors.

options.text: se réduit à une manifestation pour touristes.
options.text_en: is reduced to an event for tourists.
options.explanation: The text states that 'the inhabitants... meet up,' indicating it is a local tradition for residents, not just a show for tourists.

options.text: se déroule dans un ancien monument restauré.
options.text_en: takes place in an old restored monument.
options.explanation: The 'old restored monument' (windmill) describes the Auberge de la Vieille Tour (a hotel), which is a place to stay, not where the celebration takes place.

72f39d30-25bf-4306-8d52-1aa56ac0ef43.key_line_fr: une procession de cuisinières vêtues de leurs plus beaux madras sillonne la ville avant de convier la population à un grand festin composé des meilleurs plats créoles.
72f39d30-25bf-4306-8d52-1aa56ac0ef43.key_line_en: a procession of cooks dressed in their finest madras traverses the city before inviting the population to a grand feast composed of the best Creole dishes.
72f39d30-25bf-4306-8d52-1aa56ac0ef43.explanation: The passage highlights a feast with 'the best Creole dishes,' which directly supports the option about discovering Antillean flavors.
72f39d30-25bf-4306-8d52-1aa56ac0ef43.breakdown:
1. The text describes the celebration of Saint Laurent on August 10th.
2. It details a 'procession of cooks' (procession de cuisinières) and a 'grand feast composed of the best Creole dishes' (grand festin composé des meilleurs plats créoles).
3. Option B suggests the event allows discovering Antillean flavors. Since 'Creole dishes' represent the flavors of the Antilles, this matches the text.
4. Option A is insufficient because, although there is a mass, the text emphasizes the cooks and the feast.
5. Option C is incorrect because 'inhabitants' (habitants) participate, not just tourists.
6. Option D is incorrect because the 'old restored monument' refers to a nearby hotel, not the event location.

b307c6b5-c33c-4146-bfda-f4e343c075c0.text:
À Julien, qui nous interroge sur l’emploi du franglais dans notre magazine,
nous pouvons assurer que nous cherchons à éviter les anglicismes, sans toutefois pouvoir les éradiquer.
Les réactions de nos lecteurs nous confortent dans notre vigilance,
mais nous considérons aussi qu’il est important de s’exprimer dans un langage commun.
Or, dans ce langage commun, des mots étrangers ont trouvé leur place.
Pour être compris de tous,
il est parfois plus logique de parler de check-list que d’une liste d’actions à cocher…
Et, en comparaison à bien d’autres publications,
la présence de si peu d’anglicismes dans nos colonnes devrait réjouir ???
b307c6b5-c33c-4146-bfda-f4e343c075c0.text_en: To Julien, who questions us on the use of Franglais in our magazine, we can assure that we seek to avoid Anglicisms, without however being able to eradicate them. The reactions of our readers reinforce our vigilance, but we also consider that it is important to express oneself in a common language. However, in this common language, foreign words have found their place. To be understood by all, it is sometimes more logical to speak of a check-list than a list of actions to check off... And, in comparison to many other publications, the presence of so few Anglicisms in our columns should rejoice ???
b307c6b5-c33c-4146-bfda-f4e343c075c0.question_fr: Quel est le point de vue de l’équipe de rédaction du magazine ?
b307c6b5-c33c-4146-bfda-f4e343c075c0.question_en: What is the point of view of the magazine's editorial team?

options.text: Il faut accepter l’évolution d’une langue.
options.text_en: One must accept the evolution of a language.
options.explanation: The text states that foreign words have found their place in the common language and are necessary for clear communication, implying an acceptance of how the language has evolved.

options.text: Il faut bannir les termes anglais.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states they cannot 'eradicate' (éradiquer) these terms and sometimes find them 'more logical' to use, contradicting the idea of a total ban.

options.text: Il faut plaire à l’ensemble des lecteurs.
options.explanation: While they mention reader reactions, the primary argument is about communication efficiency ('to be understood by all'), not simply trying to please everyone.

options.text: Il faut utiliser des mots basiques.
options.explanation: The text focuses on the origin of words (Anglicisms vs. French) and their usage in common language, not on whether the words are 'basic' or complex.

b307c6b5-c33c-4146-bfda-f4e343c075c0.key_line_fr: Or, dans ce langage commun, des mots étrangers ont trouvé leur place.
b307c6b5-c33c-4146-bfda-f4e343c075c0.key_line_en: However, in this common language, foreign words have found their place.
b307c6b5-c33c-4146-bfda-f4e343c075c0.explanation: The editors argue that foreign words are part of the common language and aid understanding, showing they accept the natural evolution of the language.
b307c6b5-c33c-4146-bfda-f4e343c075c0.breakdown: The editorial team explains that while they try to avoid Anglicisms, they recognize that it is impossible to eliminate them completely. They argue that it is important to use a 'common language' (langage commun) where 'foreign words have found their place' (des mots étrangers ont trouvé leur place). They give the example that using 'check-list' is more logical for being understood by everyone than the French equivalent. This reasoning supports the idea that language changes and incorporates new terms, meaning one must accept this evolution.

eca28e2c-8bee-43ab-bf7a-c3d9df8a2777.text:
Sophie,

eca28e2c-8bee-43ab-bf7a-c3d9df8a2777.question_en: Why is Robert writing to Sophie?

eca28e2c-8bee-43ab-bf7a-c3d9df8a2777.explanation: Robert explicitly uses the imperative 'Marions-nous !' (Let's get married), which corresponds to asking Sophie to become his wife.

9ef758fc-c1bd-46f3-9871-0db57de55cd7.text:
Ne jetez pas vos vieux jouets, livres, ou vêtements d'enfants !

9ef758fc-c1bd-46f3-9871-0db57de55cd7.text_en: Do not throw away your old toys, books, or children's clothes! The association 'Un Noël pour tous' offers them as gifts to children for the end-of-year holidays. You can bring them every Wednesday morning to the town hall.

9ef758fc-c1bd-46f3-9871-0db57de55cd7.key_line_fr: L'association « Un Noël pour tous » les offre en cadeau à des enfants pour les fêtes de fin d'année.
9ef758fc-c1bd-46f3-9871-0db57de55cd7.key_line_en: The association 'Un Noël pour tous' offers them as gifts to children for the end-of-year holidays.
9ef758fc-c1bd-46f3-9871-0db57de55cd7.explanation: The association collects used items to give them as gifts to children, which matches Option B.
9ef758fc-c1bd-46f3-9871-0db57de55cd7.breakdown:

0761f35d-c546-4ab0-9f5f-d5fc52c46a72.text: Vous n'avez pas pu voyager pendant la grève ? Vous pouvez demander le remboursement de votre billet de train sur notre site Internet à l'adresse : « www.montrain.fr ». Vous recevrez un virement sur votre compte en banque. Pour un remboursement en espèces, allez à un guichet dans une gare. Il n'y aura pas de remboursement par chèques ou par carte bancaire.

b55c5871-e0c6-4052-8186-4191954ff0bf.text: La troisième édition du Grand Culturo aura lieu le premier dimanche de mai. Le Grand Culturo c'est l'échange entre particuliers de livres, de bandes dessinées, de disques, de DVD, de petits objets design, de jeux vidéo, d'affiches, de tableaux ou d'instruments de musique... Les échanges se font sans intermédiaire et sans argent. Un rendez-vous culturel ouvert à tous et entièrement gratuit.
b55c5871-e0c6-4052-8186-4191954ff0bf.text_en: The third edition of the Grand Culturo will take place on the first Sunday of May. The Grand Culturo is the exchange between individuals of books, comic books, records, DVDs, small design objects, video games, posters, paintings or musical instruments... The exchanges are done without intermediaries and without money. A cultural meeting open to all and entirely free.
b55c5871-e0c6-4052-8186-4191954ff0bf.question_fr: Que peut-on faire à cet événement ?
b55c5871-e0c6-4052-8186-4191954ff0bf.question_en: What can one do at this event?

options.explanation: The text states the exchanges are done 'sans argent' (without money), so you cannot buy anything.
The purpose of the event is 'l'échange' (exchange), not just admiring collections, and the text does not mention that the items are 'rares'.
The text lists many different items (books, DVDs, instruments, etc.) that are exchanged, meaning participants can obtain varied articles.
The text specifies the exchange is 'entre particuliers' (between individuals), not with 'artisans d’art' (art artisans).

b55c5871-e0c6-4052-8186-4191954ff0bf.key_line_fr: Le Grand Culturo c'est l'échange entre particuliers de livres, de bandes dessinées, de disques, de DVD, de petits objets design, de jeux vidéo, d'affiches, de tableaux ou d'instruments de musique...
b55c5871-e0c6-4052-8186-4191954ff0bf.key_line_en: The Grand Culturo is the exchange between individuals of books, comic books, records, DVDs, small design objects, video games, posters, paintings or musical instruments...
b55c5871-e0c6-4052-8186-4191954ff0bf.explanation: The event is defined as an exchange of various cultural goods between individuals without money, fitting the description of obtaining varied articles.
b55c5871-e0c6-4052-8186-4191954ff0bf.breakdown: The text describes an event based on 'l'échange' (exchange) of a wide variety of items like books, comics, records, etc. Since the text explicitly states 'sans argent' (without money), option A is incorrect. The focus is on exchanging goods, not just looking at them (Option B) or meeting professionals (Option D, contradicted by 'entre particuliers'). Therefore, 'Obtenir des articles variés' (Obtaining varied articles) through exchange is the correct answer.

08c52f3d-c1bb-4343-bde9-51d417c4ebef.text: La ville de Clermont-Ferrand fait maintenant partie des « villes apprenantes » de l’UNESCO. Cette organisation apporte son aide aux projets pour une éducation de qualité tout au long de la vie. Clermont-Ferrand devient ainsi la première cité française de cette association mondiale réunissant 177 autres villes, situées dans 41 pays, qui partagent leur expérience sur ce type d’apprentissage.
08c52f3d-c1bb-4343-bde9-51d417c4ebef.text_en: The city of Clermont-Ferrand is now part of UNESCO's "learning cities". This organization provides assistance to projects for quality education throughout life. Clermont-Ferrand thus becomes the first French city in this global association bringing together 177 other cities, located in 41 countries, which share their experience on this type of learning.
08c52f3d-c1bb-4343-bde9-51d417c4ebef.question_fr: Quel est le but des « villes apprenantes » ?
08c52f3d-c1bb-4343-bde9-51d417c4ebef.question_en: What is the goal of "learning cities"?

options.explanation: The text mentions sharing experiences about learning, but does not specifically mention creating physical places for cultural exchange.
The text states the goal is 'education throughout life', which matches the definition of 'formation continue' (continuing education).
There is no mention of moving jobs or professional mobility in the text.
The text mentions cities sharing experiences, not standardizing their school programs.

08c52f3d-c1bb-4343-bde9-51d417c4ebef.key_line_fr: Cette organisation apporte son aide aux projets pour une éducation de qualité tout au long de la vie.
08c52f3d-c1bb-4343-bde9-51d417c4ebef.key_line_en: This organization provides assistance to projects for quality education throughout life.

08c52f3d-c1bb-4343-bde9-51d417c4ebef.explanation: The text defines the goal as supporting 'education throughout life', which directly corresponds to 'continuing education' (formation continue).
08c52f3d-c1bb-4343-bde9-51d417c4ebef.breakdown: The text explicitly defines the mission of the organization. It states that it supports projects for 'une éducation de qualité tout au long de la vie' (quality education throughout life). In French educational terminology, 'éducation tout au long de la vie' is synonymous with 'formation continue' (continuing education). Therefore, Option B is the correct paraphrase of the text.

1c0ff7b9-2b20-4467-9351-666d7956e1a6.text: Faire des horaires à rallonge, venir travailler même malade… Depuis quelques années, le présentéisme - une présence excessive au travail - s'étend dans les entreprises. En cause : une idée typiquement française selon laquelle la valeur de son travail dépend du nombre d'heures qu'on y passe. Favorisé par la crainte de perdre son emploi, le présentéisme est un phénomène difficile à repérer, mais qui représente un vrai danger pour les salariés et les entreprises. Contrairement à ce que l'on croit souvent, un salarié trop présent risque d'être moins efficace, car il s'épuisera avec des horaires trop importants, perdra sa concentration et sera démotivé.
1c0ff7b9-2b20-4467-9351-666d7956e1a6.text_en: Working extended hours, coming to work even when sick... For some years now, presenteeism - excessive presence at work - has been spreading in companies. The cause: a typically French idea that the value of one's work depends on the number of hours spent there. Favored by the fear of losing one's job, presenteeism is a phenomenon difficult to spot, but represents a real danger for employees and companies. Contrary to what is often believed, an overly present employee risks being less effective, because they will exhaust themselves with excessive hours, lose concentration and become demotivated.
1c0ff7b9-2b20-4467-9351-666d7956e1a6.question_en: What do we learn about presenteeism?

options.explanation: The text mentions it stems from a 'typically French idea' ('idée typiquement française'), not that it is a global phenomenon.

options.text: Il influence la productivité des salariés
options.explanation: The text explicitly says an overly present employee risks being 'less effective' ('moins efficace'), which links directly to productivity.
The text states the opposite: it is a phenomenon that is 'difficult to spot' ('difficile à repérer').

options.text: Ses effets sont néfastes pour l’emploi
options.text_en: Its effects are harmful to employment
options.explanation: The text says presenteeism is favored by the fear of losing one's job ('crainte de perdre son emploi'), but focuses its harmful effects on the individual's health and company efficiency, not on the job market itself.

1c0ff7b9-2b20-4467-9351-666d7956e1a6.key_line_fr: Contrairement à ce que l'on croit souvent, un salarié trop présent risque d'être moins efficace
1c0ff7b9-2b20-4467-9351-666d7956e1a6.key_line_en: Contrary to what is often believed, an overly present employee risks being less effective
1c0ff7b9-2b20-4467-9351-666d7956e1a6.explanation: The passage argues that staying at work too long makes employees exhausted and less effective, which means it negatively impacts their productivity.
1c0ff7b9-2b20-4467-9351-666d7956e1a6.breakdown: The text defines presenteeism and discusses its causes and consequences. Specifically, the last sentence states that an employee who is too present risks being 'less effective' (moins efficace) because they get exhausted and lose concentration. Being 'less effective' is directly related to productivity. Therefore, presenteeism influences employee productivity.

8b7cafbe-5d99-49a3-b82d-6c08f514aa3d.text: En dix ans le nombre de sources lumineuses sur la voie publique - panneaux publicitaires, lampadaires - a progressé en France de 30%. Première conséquence de cette consommation électrique : 50% de la population ne peut plus voir les étoiles. Seconde conséquence : la disparition des papillons, moustiques et autres insectes, qui tournent jusqu'à épuisement la nuit sous les lampadaires ou meurent grillés.
8b7cafbe-5d99-49a3-b82d-6c08f514aa3d.text_en: In ten years the number of light sources on public roads - advertising billboards, streetlamps - has increased in France by 30%. First consequence of this electricity consumption: 50% of the population can no longer see the stars. Second consequence: the disappearance of butterflies, mosquitoes and other insects, which circle until exhaustion at night under streetlamps or die roasted.
8b7cafbe-5d99-49a3-b82d-6c08f514aa3d.question_en: What does the author of the text deplore?

options.explanation: The text states the number of light sources 'has increased' (a progressé) by 30%. This increase is the root cause of the negative effects mentioned.
The text mentions the 'disappearance' (disparition) of insects, not their proliferation.
The text lists advertising billboards (panneaux publicitaires) as sources that have increased, not been removed (suppression).

options.text: Le montant élevé des frais d’électricité
options.text_en: The high amount of electricity costs
options.explanation: While 'electricity consumption' is mentioned, the text focuses on ecological and visual consequences (stars, insects), not the financial cost.

8b7cafbe-5d99-49a3-b82d-6c08f514aa3d.key_line_fr: En dix ans le nombre de sources lumineuses sur la voie publique - panneaux publicitaires, lampadaires - a progressé en France de 30%.
8b7cafbe-5d99-49a3-b82d-6c08f514aa3d.key_line_en: In ten years the number of light sources on public roads - advertising billboards, streetlamps - has increased in France by 30%.
8b7cafbe-5d99-49a3-b82d-6c08f514aa3d.explanation: The author describes a 30% increase in light sources and lists its negative environmental impacts, indicating regret regarding this multiplication of lights.
8b7cafbe-5d99-49a3-b82d-6c08f514aa3d.breakdown: The text begins by stating a fact: the number of light sources on public roads has increased by 30% in ten years. It then lists negative consequences of this increase (inability to see stars, death of insects). The verb 'déplorer' means to find something unfortunate or regrettable. Since the author links the increase in lights to negative outcomes, they are deploring this increase (multiplication).

cb4c517c-83cc-479b-a723-4ce87138672e.text: C'est le défi quotidien du consommateur soucieux de son alimentation. Comment déchiffrer ce qui se cache derrière les sigles et les obscurs tableaux des étiquettes ? En France, l'État a bien décidé la mise en place d'un affichage simple, le Nutri-score, qui, avec une lettre et une couleur, informe le consommateur sur la qualité nutritionnelle d'un produit. Mais vous le verrez peu dans les rayons : son utilisation facultative est basée sur le volontariat de l'industrie agroalimentaire.
cb4c517c-83cc-479b-a723-4ce87138672e.text_en: It is the daily challenge of the consumer concerned about their diet. How to decipher what lies behind the acronyms and obscure tables of labels? In France, the State has indeed decided on the implementation of a simple display, the Nutri-score, which, with a letter and a color, informs the consumer about the nutritional quality of a product. But you will see it little on the shelves: its optional use is based on the volunteering of the agri-food industry.
cb4c517c-83cc-479b-a723-4ce87138672e.question_en: What do we learn about the Nutri-Score display?

options.text: Il est obligatoire sur les produits
options.explanation: The text states its use is 'optional' (facultative), not mandatory.

options.text: Il facilite la lecture des étiquettes
options.explanation: The text describes it as a 'simple display' designed to help 'decipher' obscure labels, meaning it facilitates reading.

options.text: II répond à une décision des fabricants
options.text_en: It responds to a decision by manufacturers
options.explanation: The text says 'the State decided' (l'État a décidé) on its implementation, not the manufacturers.

options.text_en: It transforms the organization of the shelves
options.explanation: The text mentions it is rarely seen on shelves ('you will see it little'), but does not suggest it changes how shelves are organized.

cb4c517c-83cc-479b-a723-4ce87138672e.key_line_fr: En France, l'État a bien décidé la mise en place d'un affichage simple, le Nutri-score, qui, avec une lettre et une couleur, informe le consommateur sur la qualité nutritionnelle d'un produit.
cb4c517c-83cc-479b-a723-4ce87138672e.key_line_en: In France, the State has indeed decided on the implementation of a simple display, the Nutri-score, which, with a letter and a color, informs the consumer about the nutritional quality of a product.
cb4c517c-83cc-479b-a723-4ce87138672e.explanation: The text describes the Nutri-score as a 'simple display' meant to help consumers decipher complex label information, thus making labels easier to read.
cb4c517c-83cc-479b-a723-4ce87138672e.breakdown:
1. The text introduces the difficulty of reading food labels ('obscure tables', 'acronyms').
2. It presents the Nutri-score as a solution implemented by the State: a 'simple display' using a letter and a color.
3. This contrast implies that the Nutri-score makes understanding (reading) the nutritional quality easier compared to the complex standard labels.
4. Therefore, it facilitates the reading of labels (Option B).
5. Option A is incorrect because the text explicitly states its use is 'optional' (facultative).
6. Option C is incorrect because the text states 'the State decided the implementation', not the manufacturers (even if usage is voluntary).
7. Option D is incorrect as there is no mention of reorganizing shelves; it actually says you will see it 'little' on shelves.

05a6065f-8f86-4548-b4c5-36c4be97a3cb.text: Le son aigu des petites voix résonne au rythme des couverts. Chaque midi, les enfants de l'école maternelle Rochechouart à Paris s'asseyent autour des tables du restaurant scolaire avec une nouvelle habitude : trier leurs déchets à l'issue du déjeuner. Pour instaurer ce nouveau geste, les enfants ont appris ce qu'étaient les biodéchets. Ils deviennent ainsi des ambassadeurs du tri. Les parents risquent désormais de se faire rappeler à l'ordre s'ils ne trient pas leurs déchets à la maison. Plus on vieillit, plus il est difficile de changer ses habitudes, d'où l'intérêt de commencer dès le plus jeune âge.
05a6065f-8f86-4548-b4c5-36c4be97a3cb.text_en: The high-pitched sound of small voices resonates to the rhythm of cutlery. Every noon, the children of the Rochechouart kindergarten in Paris sit around the tables of the school cafeteria with a new habit: sorting their waste at the end of lunch. To establish this new gesture, the children learned what bio-waste was. They thus become ambassadors of sorting. Parents now risk being called to order if they do not sort their waste at home. The older we get, the harder it is to change habits, hence the interest in starting from a very young age.

5d195df7-73bb-4fe3-8ff4-04536c795c42.text:
LE PARTAGE, UN NOUVEAU MODE DE CONSOMMATION
La consommation collaborative, basée sur l'échange, le partage, la location plutôt que la possession, n'est plus l'apanage de pionniers engagés. « Nous faisons face à un mouvement de fond, analyse le sociologue Erwan Lecoeur. Partager n'est pas nouveau. Mais cet acte, longtemps le fait d'une minorité, est récupéré par des acteurs intermédiaires : entreprises, grandes associations, institutions. Par exemple, les parkings-relais se multiplient pour favoriser le covoiturage. De telles initiatives légitiment ces pratiques. » Faut-il y voir un effet de la crise ?
« Non, répond cet observateur, la consommation collaborative vient juste conforter une nouvelle façon d'appréhender la consommation. »
D'après lemonde.fr
5d195df7-73bb-4fe3-8ff4-04536c795c42.text_en: Collaborative consumption, based on exchange, sharing, and renting rather than ownership, is no longer the exclusive domain of committed pioneers. 'We are facing a groundswell,' analyzes sociologist Erwan Lecoeur. 'Sharing is not new. But this act, for a long time done by a minority, is being recovered by intermediate actors: companies, large associations, institutions. For example, park-and-ride facilities are multiplying to encourage carpooling. Such initiatives legitimize these practices.' Should we see an effect of the crisis in this? 'No,' replies this observer, 'collaborative consumption just reinforces a new way of understanding consumption.'

LES REQUINS N’ONT PAS FINI DE NOUS SURPRENDRE !
Tapis dans les fonds océaniques d'Amérique du Nord, les requins-houle possèdent une peau marron ou grisâtre à deux tons, l'un foncé et l'autre clair. Une équipe de chercheurs américains a découvert une molécule fabriquée exclusivement dans les zones claires de leur peau : elle absorbe la lumière bleue à la seule à subsister à une telle profondeur - pour émettre du vert. Les requins se parent alors, dans le noir des profondeurs, de motifs vert fluorescent auxquels ils sont particulièrement sensibles. « Comme leur vision se limite précisément aux couleurs bleu et vert, ce phénomène pourrait aider les individus à s'identifier », présume Jason Crawford, de l'université de Yale.
f2495207-c688-469b-a91e-d42fa0bd03ad.text_en: Lying on the ocean floors of North America, swell sharks possess a brown or greyish two-toned skin, one dark and the other light. A team of American researchers has discovered a molecule made exclusively in the light areas of their skin: it absorbs blue light—the only light to remain at such depth—to emit green. The sharks then adorn themselves, in the darkness of the depths, with fluorescent green patterns to which they are particularly sensitive. « As their vision is strictly limited to blue and green colors, this phenomenon could help individuals to identify each other », presumes Jason Crawford, of Yale University.

Mon souci a toujours été d'inciter mes étudiants à ne pas s'enfermer dans une seule vision du monde.
Parce que finalement chacun vit dans sa prison.
C'est à la fin de mon livre : «Il faut parler deux langues au moins pour savoir qu'on en parle une, que c'est Une langue que lon parle ».
J'ai toujours dit à mes étudiants que le monde ne se limitait pas à notre manière de vivre.
Accepter de n'exister qu'avec une langue, qu'avec une culture, c'est se priver de liberté.
En choisissant d'étudier une autre langue, on se donne une chance inouïe : tout d'un coup, on voit apparaitre cette prison dans laquelle on vivait sans forcément s'en rendre compte.
fd9e0e4e-d7af-485b-80ea-0530dc75a391.text_en: My concern has always been to encourage my students not to lock themselves into a single view of the world. Because ultimately everyone lives in their own prison. It is at the end of my book: "You have to speak at least two languages to know that you speak one, that it is One language that you speak". I have always told my students that the world was not limited to our way of living. Accepting to exist with only one language, only with one culture, is depriving oneself of freedom. By choosing to study another language, one gives oneself an incredible chance: suddenly, one sees this prison appear in which one was living without necessarily realizing it.

De nombreuses théories du complot circulent sur Internet. Plutôt que de purement les contredire, la première saison de « Mécaniques du complotisme » - nouveau podcast de France Culture - en décortique l'origine et les ramifications.
Le présentateur, Roman Bornstein, nous explique : « Nous avons voulu autopsier un délire collectif et montrer qu'il ne s'agissait pas simplement de délires d'adolescents passionnés d'informatique dans une cave. Le complotisme n'est jamais innocent et son histoire explique beaucoup de notre époque ».
En s'appuyant sur un site Internet de surveillance des théories du complot, il raconte leur propagation, dans un discours efficace, mené à la manière d'un roman d'espionnage.
2749b1e8-6b1c-40de-8438-fbfc594c35fe.text_en: Many conspiracy theories circulate on the Internet. Rather than purely contradicting them, the first season of 'Mécaniques du complotisme' - a new podcast from France Culture - dissects their origin and ramifications. The presenter, Roman Bornstein, explains to us: 'We wanted to autopsy a collective delusion and show that it was not simply the delusions of computer-passionate teenagers in a basement. Conspiracism is never innocent and its history explains much about our era'. Relying on a conspiracy theory monitoring website, he recounts their propagation, in an effective discourse, conducted in the manner of a spy novel.
