29c36f10-3023-4e56-ba3d-a74513f73375.text:
Un salarié qui avale un sandwich devant l'écran en guise de pause déjeuner offre à son employeur 128 heures de travail non rémunéré, soit seize jours pleins, ont calculé des chercheurs britanniques.
Interrogés sur leurs motivations, ces salariés expliquent se sentir trop coupables de s'arrêter de travailler. En ces temps de compétition exacerbée entre les salariés, ce serait interprété comme un manque d'efficacité. Un médecin rappelle pourtant que « faire des pauses régulières, se lever et marcher aide à s'aérer l'esprit » pendant sa journée de travail. « Prendre une pause déjeuner prépare à une après-midi productive », poursuit-il.
D'après lexpress.fr
29c36f10-3023-4e56-ba3d-a74513f73375.text_en: A salaried employee who swallows a sandwich in front of the screen as a lunch break gifts their employer 128 hours of unpaid work, or sixteen full days, British researchers have calculated. Questioned about their motivations, these employees explain feeling too guilty to stop working. In these times of exacerbated competition between employees, it would be interpreted as a lack of efficiency. However, a doctor reminds us that 'taking regular breaks, getting up and walking helps clear the mind' during one's workday. 'Taking a lunch break prepares for a productive afternoon,' he continues.
29c36f10-3023-4e56-ba3d-a74513f73375.question_fr: D'après cet article, pourquoi certains salariés travaillent-ils pendant la pause déjeuner ?
29c36f10-3023-4e56-ba3d-a74513f73375.question_en: According to this article, why do some employees work during their lunch break?

options.explanation: The text explicitly states this is 'unpaid work' (travail non rémunéré), so they are not doing it for financial gain.

options.text: Pour donner une bonne image d’eux.
options.text_en: To give a good image of themselves.
options.explanation: The text states that taking a break would be viewed as a 'lack of efficiency' amidst fierce competition. Therefore, they work to avoid this negative perception and maintain a good professional reputation.

options.text: Pour exécuter les ordres de la direction.
options.explanation: The text describes the employees' internal motivations (guilt, fear of judgment), not external orders from management.

options.text: Pour quitter leur entreprise plus tôt.
options.explanation: The text mentions giving extra hours to the employer, not leaving early. There is no reference to shortening the workday.

29c36f10-3023-4e56-ba3d-a74513f73375.key_line_fr: En ces temps de compétition exacerbée entre les salariés, ce serait interprété comme un manque d'efficacité.
29c36f10-3023-4e56-ba3d-a74513f73375.key_line_en: In these times of exacerbated competition between employees, it would be interpreted as a lack of efficiency.
29c36f10-3023-4e56-ba3d-a74513f73375.explanation: Employees fear that taking a break will make them look inefficient in a competitive environment, so they work to maintain a good image.
29c36f10-3023-4e56-ba3d-a74513f73375.breakdown: The text investigates why employees work during lunch. It explicitly mentions that employees explain they feel 'too guilty' to stop working. It further explains that in times of 'exacerbated competition', taking a break would be 'interpreted as a lack of efficiency' (interprété comme un manque d'efficacité). By avoiding this negative interpretation, they are trying to maintain a positive professional image. Therefore, they work to project a good image of themselves (efficiency/dedication).

91291faf-0423-4688-a4c4-628994899589.text:
Le syndrome d'épuisement professionnel est-il uniquement lié au monde du travail ? Si l'on considère la sphère privée, certains médecins préfèrent utiliser le terme de surcharge mentale. Pour le docteur Marie-Pierre Guilho-Bailly, médecin-psychiatre spécialisée en pathologie professionnelle, il est indispensable de ne pas étendre le concept de ce syndrome à toutes les situations d'épuisement engendrées par la vie personnelle, familiale ou sociale.
À son sens, le seul syndrome d'épuisement professionnel qui puisse être retenu concernant le milieu familial renvoie au travail des aidants familiaux. Toutefois, des études tendent à montrer que les symptômes peuvent survenir également dans la vie personnelle, notamment chez certains parents particulièrement épuisés.
91291faf-0423-4688-a4c4-628994899589.text_en: Is professional burnout syndrome linked only to the world of work? If we consider the private sphere, some doctors prefer to use the term mental overload. For Dr. Marie-Pierre Guilho-Bailly, a psychiatrist specializing in occupational pathology, it is essential not to extend the concept of this syndrome to all situations of exhaustion generated by personal, family, or social life. In her view, the only professional burnout syndrome that can be retained regarding the family environment refers to the work of family caregivers. However, studies tend to show that symptoms can also occur in personal life, notably among certain particularly exhausted parents.
91291faf-0423-4688-a4c4-628994899589.question_fr: Qu'apprend-on à propos du syndrome d'épuisement professionnel ?
91291faf-0423-4688-a4c4-628994899589.question_en: What do we learn about professional burnout syndrome?

options.text: Il demande une prise charge médicale.
options.explanation: The text mentions doctors and psychiatrists to discuss the definition of the syndrome, not to emphasize the necessity of medical treatment.

options.text: Il peut s’étendre au domaine personnel.
options.text_en: It can extend to the personal domain.
options.explanation: The final sentence explicitly states that studies show symptoms can occur in personal life ('vie personnelle').

options.text: Il suscite un consensus parmi les spécialistes.
options.explanation: The text suggests a debate rather than consensus: some doctors prefer 'mental overload,' while others set strict limits on the concept.
The text mentions 'aidants familiaux' (family caregivers), not 'aides-soignants' (nursing assistants).

91291faf-0423-4688-a4c4-628994899589.key_line_fr: Toutefois, des études tendent à montrer que les symptômes peuvent survenir également dans la vie personnelle, notamment chez certains parents particulièrement épuisés.
91291faf-0423-4688-a4c4-628994899589.key_line_en: However, studies tend to show that symptoms can also occur in personal life, notably among certain particularly exhausted parents.
91291faf-0423-4688-a4c4-628994899589.explanation: The passage concludes that, despite debates on terminology, studies indicate that burnout symptoms can extend to the personal sphere.
91291faf-0423-4688-a4c4-628994899589.breakdown: The text discusses whether 'professional burnout' applies outside the workplace. While one doctor argues against extending the term to personal life generally (except for family caregivers), the text concludes with a counterpoint introduced by 'Toutefois' (However). This final sentence states that studies show symptoms can indeed occur in personal life, specifically mentioning exhausted parents. Therefore, option B is the correct inference.

5b3ecd8c-dc21-45b5-8079-42b73cd8e9f0.text:
Quand on choisit une voiture, on compare les prix et les performances avant de faire son choix. Mais quand il s'agit d'une prothèse de hanche ou de sein, on prend ce que le spécialiste impose. On ne se sent souvent ni le droit, ni le courage, ni la capacité de vérifier si le matériel proposé est le plus adapté ou si le médecin est sous influence des fabricants. Ce qui explique cette confiance totale accordée au médecin. Cet abandon du patient à son médecin ou à l'hôpital exigent donc en retour une éthique et un professionnalisme sans faille de l'univers médical qui doit notamment se protéger du marketing très agressif des fabricants du matériel.
D'après Le Soir
5b3ecd8c-dc21-45b5-8079-42b73cd8e9f0.text_en: When choosing a car, one compares prices and performance before making a choice. But when it comes to a hip or breast prosthesis, one takes what the specialist imposes. One often feels neither the right, nor the courage, nor the capacity to verify if the proposed equipment is the most suitable or if the doctor is under the influence of manufacturers. Which explains this total trust granted to the doctor. This surrender of the patient to their doctor or to the hospital therefore requires in return flawless ethics and professionalism from the medical world which must notably protect itself from the very aggressive marketing of equipment manufacturers.
5b3ecd8c-dc21-45b5-8079-42b73cd8e9f0.question_fr: Que souligne l'article au sujet des prothèses ?
5b3ecd8c-dc21-45b5-8079-42b73cd8e9f0.question_en: What does the article highlight regarding prostheses?

options.text: Le coût des dispositifs pose un problème d’éthique.
options.text_en: The cost of devices poses an ethical problem.
options.explanation: The text mentions comparing prices for *cars*, not prostheses. The ethical issue discussed is the potential influence of manufacturers on doctors, not the cost itself.

options.text: Le respect de la déontologie médicale est primordial.
options.text_en: Respect for medical ethics is primordial.
options.explanation: The text concludes that because patients blindly trust doctors, the medical world must maintain 'flawless ethics and professionalism', which corresponds to medical deontology being primordial.

options.text: Les fabricants d’implants doivent signer une charte
options.text_en: Implant manufacturers must sign a charter.
options.explanation: The text mentions 'aggressive marketing' from manufacturers, but never mentions a requirement for them to sign a charter.

options.text: Les patients ont le devoir de s’informer davantage.
options.text_en: Patients have a duty to inform themselves more.
options.explanation: The text states that patients *do not* feel capable or brave enough to verify information, placing the burden of responsibility on the doctor's ethics rather than on the patient's duty to inform themselves.

5b3ecd8c-dc21-45b5-8079-42b73cd8e9f0.key_line_fr: Cet abandon du patient à son médecin ou à l'hôpital exigent donc en retour une éthique et un professionnalisme sans faille de l'univers médical
5b3ecd8c-dc21-45b5-8079-42b73cd8e9f0.key_line_en: This surrender of the patient to their doctor or to the hospital therefore requires in return flawless ethics and professionalism from the medical world
5b3ecd8c-dc21-45b5-8079-42b73cd8e9f0.explanation: Since patients cannot judge medical devices themselves and blindly trust specialists, the text argues that strict medical ethics are essential to prevent commercial influence.
5b3ecd8c-dc21-45b5-8079-42b73cd8e9f0.breakdown: The text contrasts the consumer behavior of buying a car (active comparison) with receiving a medical prosthesis (passive acceptance/trust). It states that because patients feel unable to verify the suitability of the device or the independence of the doctor, they surrender themselves ('abandon') to the medical system. The text concludes that this situation demands 'une éthique et un professionnalisme sans faille' (flawless ethics and professionalism) from doctors. This aligns perfectly with Option B.

9bb7270c-1e82-4be4-965a-0630e84c2c57.text:
Est-on plus heureux
quand on est riche?
quand on croit en Dieu?
quand on vit en couple?
Depuis quelques décennies, de nombreuses recherches concernant le bien-être sont menées sur les facteurs sociaux et psychologiques quil favorisent ou non le bonheur. On pourrait penser que le bien- être est un phénomène subjectif, inaccessible donc à l'investigation scientifique et à la mesure. Or, grâce à des instruments divers mis en place depuis plus de trente ans pour mesurer le niveau de satisfaction de vie des individus et des populations, des méthodologies diverses ont été mises au point pour permettre de mesurer la qualité de vie telle qu'elle est perçue.
9bb7270c-1e82-4be4-965a-0630e84c2c57.text_en: Are we happier when we are rich? When we believe in God? When we live as a couple? For a few decades, numerous studies concerning well-being have been conducted on the social and psychological factors that favor happiness or not. One might think that well-being is a subjective phenomenon, therefore inaccessible to scientific investigation and measurement. However, thanks to various instruments put in place for more than thirty years to measure the level of life satisfaction of individuals and populations, diverse methodologies have been developed to allow measuring the quality of life as it is perceived.
9bb7270c-1e82-4be4-965a-0630e84c2c57.question_fr: Qu'apprend-on sur le bien-être dans cet article ?
9bb7270c-1e82-4be4-965a-0630e84c2c57.question_en: What do we learn about well-being in this article?

options.text: C’est un état difficile à évaluer chez une personne.
options.text_en: It is a state difficult to evaluate in a person.
options.explanation: The text mentions this is what 'one might think' (On pourrait penser), but the rest of the paragraph refutes this by explaining that measurements are possible via new methodologies.

options.text: Des outils ont été élaborés pour en estimer l’intensité.
options.text_en: Tools have been developed to estimate its intensity.
options.explanation: This is a paraphrase of the final sentence, which states that 'instruments' and 'methodologies' have been developed to 'measure' well-being.

options.text: Les enquêtes dont c’est le sujet sont innombrables.
options.text_en: The surveys on this subject are innumerable.
options.explanation: The text says research is 'numerous' (nombreuses), not 'innumerable' (innombrables). The focus is on measurement methods, not the count of surveys.

options.text: Malgré des études sérieuses, l’analyse est impossible.
options.text_en: Despite serious studies, analysis is impossible.
options.explanation: This contradicts the text, which concludes that measuring quality of life is now possible thanks to specific instruments.

9bb7270c-1e82-4be4-965a-0630e84c2c57.key_line_fr: Or, grâce à des instruments divers mis en place depuis plus de trente ans [...] des méthodologies diverses ont été mises au point pour permettre de mesurer la qualité de vie telle qu'elle est perçue.
9bb7270c-1e82-4be4-965a-0630e84c2c57.key_line_en: However, thanks to various instruments put in place for more than thirty years [...] diverse methodologies have been developed to allow measuring the quality of life as it is perceived.
9bb7270c-1e82-4be4-965a-0630e84c2c57.explanation: The passage argues that despite well-being seeming subjective, specific tools and methods have been created to measure it.
9bb7270c-1e82-4be4-965a-0630e84c2c57.breakdown: The text begins by acknowledging that one might think well-being is too subjective to measure. However, the connector 'Or' (However/Now) introduces the main point: thanks to instruments established over 30 years, methodologies have been developed ('mises au point') to measure ('mesurer') the quality of life. This directly supports the idea that tools exist to estimate its intensity.

fc859066-da6d-4b6b-85cc-212e5b3edaa1.text:
Quelques astuces pour optimiser les révisions.
Lors des révisions pour un examen, l'acquisition des connaissances s'opère plus facilement en jonglant avec la mémoire visuelle et la mémoire auditive. Comme la part des deux peut varier d'une personne à l'autre, c'est à chacun de mesurer la méthode qui lui paraît la plus efficace. Il est inutile d'intégrer des notions par cœur: mieux vaut se détacher des termes employés, pour s'approprier les connaissances et les exprimer différemment. Enfin, une bonne hygiène de vie et des activités variéesl constituent un gage de réussite et permettent de limiter le stress : il est indispensable de s'aérer l'esprit et de faire des pauses.
fc859066-da6d-4b6b-85cc-212e5b3edaa1.text_en: Some tips to optimize revisions. During revisions for an exam, the acquisition of knowledge occurs more easily by juggling visual memory and auditory memory. As the share of the two can vary from one person to another, it is up to everyone to measure the method that seems most effective to them. It is useless to integrate notions by heart: it is better to detach oneself from the terms used, to appropriate the knowledge and express it differently. Finally, a healthy lifestyle and varied activities constitute a guarantee of success and allow limiting stress: it is indispensable to clear one's mind and take breaks.
fc859066-da6d-4b6b-85cc-212e5b3edaa1.question_fr: D'après cette personne, que faut-il éviter de faire lorsque l'on révise ?
fc859066-da6d-4b6b-85cc-212e5b3edaa1.question_en: According to this person, what should one avoid doing when revising?

options.text: Mémoriser des concepts sans les comprendre.
options.explanation: The text explicitly states that learning 'by heart' (par cœur) is useless and suggests appropriating the knowledge instead, which implies understanding.
The text encourages juggling visual and auditory memory, implying that using different methods is helpful.
The text states it is 'indispensable' to take breaks, so this should not be avoided.

options.text: Se disperser dans de nombreuses activités
options.explanation: The text mentions that 'varied activities' are a guarantee of success to limit stress, so engaging in activities is encouraged.

fc859066-da6d-4b6b-85cc-212e5b3edaa1.key_line_fr: Il est inutile d'intégrer des notions par cœur: mieux vaut se détacher des termes employés, pour s'approprier les connaissances et les exprimer différemment.
fc859066-da6d-4b6b-85cc-212e5b3edaa1.key_line_en: It is useless to integrate notions by heart: it is better to detach oneself from the terms used, to appropriate the knowledge and express it differently.
fc859066-da6d-4b6b-85cc-212e5b3edaa1.explanation: The text advises against learning by heart ('par cœur'), which corresponds to memorizing concepts without understanding them.
fc859066-da6d-4b6b-85cc-212e5b3edaa1.breakdown: The question asks what one should avoid doing. Scanning the text for negative advice, we find the phrase 'Il est inutile d'intégrer des notions par cœur' (It is useless to integrate notions by heart). The text suggests that instead of rote learning, one should 's'approprier les connaissances' (make knowledge one's own) and express it differently. This aligns with Option A, which describes memorizing without understanding. Options B, C, and D describe actions (using multiple methods, taking breaks, doing varied activities) that the text actually promotes as beneficial.

1b63d913-9e43-42c1-84bf-9a007f416d8c.text: La loi interdit de mettre à disposition des mineurs des appareils de bronzage. Nous avons envoyé trois jeunes filles, âgées de quinze ans, dans vingt-cinq solariums (centres de bronzage). Elles disaient qu'elles souhaitaient faire des séances de bronzage. Le bilan de leurs visites est affligeant : un seul centre a refusé en expliquant que les bancs solaires sont interdits aux mineurs. Vingt-deux n’ont même pas demandé l’âge de ces jeunes filles et étaient prêts à les accepter. Deux se sont renseignés sur leur âge, ajoutant que si leurs mères étaient d'accord, il n'y avait pas de problème. Or l'interdiction est totale, même en cas d'accord parental.
1b63d913-9e43-42c1-84bf-9a007f416d8c.text_en: The law prohibits making tanning devices available to minors. We sent three fifteen-year-old girls to twenty-five solariums (tanning centers). They said they wished to have tanning sessions. The result of their visits is appalling: only one center refused, explaining that sunbeds are forbidden to minors. Twenty-two did not even ask for the age of these young girls and were ready to accept them. Two inquired about their age, adding that if their mothers agreed, there was no problem. Yet the ban is total, even in cases of parental agreement.
1b63d913-9e43-42c1-84bf-9a007f416d8c.question_fr: L'auteur de cet article tire de son enquête un bilan négatif parce que :
1b63d913-9e43-42c1-84bf-9a007f416d8c.question_en: The author of this article draws a negative conclusion from his investigation because:

options.text: Certains solariums font une discrimination anti-jeunes.
options.text_en: Certain solariums discriminate against young people.
options.explanation: The salons are not refusing the youth (discrimination); they are illegally accepting them.

options.text: La majorité des solariums ne respecte pas du tout la loi.
options.text_en: The majority of solariums do not respect the law at all.
options.explanation: 22 out of 25 salons ignored the age restriction entirely, and 2 others applied it incorrectly, meaning the vast majority violated the law.

options.text: La plupart des jeunes filles ignorent l’interdiction légale.
options.text_en: Most young girls are unaware of the legal ban.
options.explanation: The text focuses on the professional responsibility of the salon owners, not the girls' knowledge of the law.

options.text: La plupart des parents ignorent les dangers des solariums.
options.text_en: Most parents are unaware of the dangers of solariums.
options.explanation: The text mentions parental consent only as an invalid excuse used by the salons; the focus remains on the salons' failure to enforce the ban.

1b63d913-9e43-42c1-84bf-9a007f416d8c.key_line_fr: Vingt-deux n’ont même pas demandé l’âge de ces jeunes filles et étaient prêts à les accepter.
1b63d913-9e43-42c1-84bf-9a007f416d8c.key_line_en: Twenty-two did not even ask for the age of these young girls and were ready to accept them.
1b63d913-9e43-42c1-84bf-9a007f416d8c.explanation: The investigation revealed that 24 out of 25 tanning salons were willing to allow minors to use tanning beds despite a total legal ban.
1b63d913-9e43-42c1-84bf-9a007f416d8c.breakdown:
1. **Identify the Main Topic**: The text discusses a legal ban on tanning beds for minors and an undercover investigation to test compliance.
2. **Analyze the Data**: Out of 25 salons visited by 15-year-old girls, only **one** refused service based on the law. 
3. **Evaluate the Violations**: 22 salons didn't even ask for age, and 2 allowed it with parental consent (which the text states is still illegal).
4. **Determine the Author's View**: The author calls the result 'affligeant' (appalling) because almost all centers failed to follow the law.
5. **Match with Options**: Option B states that the majority do not respect the law, which aligns perfectly with the statistic (24 out of 25 failed).

5591cf5e-6d14-4e50-8b3c-8c69858477a6.text:
Chers collègues,
Nous vous invitons à une rencontre sur le thème « Organisation et conduite deconférences internationales » les 3 et 4 mai prochains. De nombreux spécialistes interviendront lors d’ateliers en petits, groupes. Ce stage n’est pas obligatoire mais il est fortement recommandé aux collègues du service des relations internationales.
Vous obtiendrez le programme sur simple demande auprès de Madame Dupré.
Cordialement,
La direction.
5591cf5e-6d14-4e50-8b3c-8c69858477a6.text_en: Dear colleagues, We invite you to a gathering on the theme 'Organization and conduct of international conferences' on next May 3rd and 4th. Many specialists will speak during small group workshops. This training course is not mandatory but is highly recommended for colleagues in the international relations department. You can obtain the program upon request from Madame Dupré. Sincerely, The Management.
5591cf5e-6d14-4e50-8b3c-8c69858477a6.question_fr: Qu'est-ce qui est proposé aux employés ?
5591cf5e-6d14-4e50-8b3c-8c69858477a6.question_en: What is proposed to the employees?

options.explanation: While the text uses the word 'rencontre', the event is explicitly defined later as a 'stage' (training) lasting two days with workshops, which distinguishes it from a standard administrative 'réunion'.
There is no mention of travel, only the topic of 'international' conferences.
The text uses the word 'stage' (training course) and mentions 'ateliers' (workshops), which are characteristic of professional training ('formation').
The training is about organizing international conferences, not about the employees moving to work abroad.

5591cf5e-6d14-4e50-8b3c-8c69858477a6.key_line_fr: Ce stage n’est pas obligatoire mais il est fortement recommandé aux collègues du service des relations internationales.
5591cf5e-6d14-4e50-8b3c-8c69858477a6.key_line_en: This training course is not mandatory but is highly recommended for colleagues in the international relations department.
5591cf5e-6d14-4e50-8b3c-8c69858477a6.explanation: The document explicitly calls the event a 'stage' (training course) and mentions learning workshops, which corresponds to 'une formation'.
5591cf5e-6d14-4e50-8b3c-8c69858477a6.breakdown:
1. The text invites employees to a 'rencontre' (gathering) over two days (May 3rd and 4th). 
2. It mentions that specialists will intervene during 'ateliers' (workshops). 
3. Crucially, the text explicitly refers to the event as 'Ce stage' (This training course). 
4. In a professional context, a 'stage' involving workshops corresponds to 'une formation' (training). 
5. While 'rencontre' suggests a meeting, the duration and the use of 'stage' make 'formation' the specific and correct category.

c9545122-358e-4ca2-9f5f-b98c65bc87e1.text:
NATURE+
Vous êtes-vous déjà promené en forêt après le coucher du soleil ? C'est un moyen unique de redécouvrir la forêt autrement, d'écouter les oiseaux et le bruit des animaux, de reconnaîtrerles arbres et les plantes par le toucher. Vous serez accompagné d’un guide spécialiste de la région. Nature+ vous propose une promenade à pied ou à cheval. Il faut prévoir un vêtement chaud et une lampe de poche. Vous pouvez réserver en ligne dès à présent.
c9545122-358e-4ca2-9f5f-b98c65bc87e1.text_en: Have you ever walked in the forest after sunset? It is a unique way to rediscover the forest differently, to listen to the birds and the sound of animals, to recognize trees and plants by touch. You will be accompanied by a regional specialist guide. Nature+ offers a walk on foot or on horseback. You need to bring warm clothes and a flashlight. You can book online right now.

options.text_en: To sleep in a natural setting.
options.explanation: The text mentions a walk ('promenade') after sunset, not sleeping or camping overnight.
The text describes the activity as a 'unique way' to discover the forest 'differently' (by night, using touch and hearing), which defines an original visit.

options.text: De participer à un stage aventure.
options.text_en: To participate in an adventure course.
options.explanation: The text offers a 'promenade' (walk/stroll), which is a leisure activity, not a 'stage' (training course/internship) for adventure.

options.text: De passer la nuit dans un zoo.
options.text_en: To spend the night in a zoo.
options.explanation: The setting is a 'forêt' (forest), not a 'zoo'.

c9545122-358e-4ca2-9f5f-b98c65bc87e1.key_line_fr: C'est un moyen unique de redécouvrir la forêt autrement
c9545122-358e-4ca2-9f5f-b98c65bc87e1.key_line_en: It is a unique way to rediscover the forest differently
c9545122-358e-4ca2-9f5f-b98c65bc87e1.explanation: The ad promotes a unique night walk to experience the forest differently, which corresponds to an original visit rather than sleeping there or training.
c9545122-358e-4ca2-9f5f-b98c65bc87e1.breakdown: The text describes a walk in the forest after sunset. It explicitly states, 'C'est un moyen unique de redécouvrir la forêt autrement' (It is a unique way to rediscover the forest differently). This implies an unconventional or original experience involving senses like hearing and touch. Therefore, it is an 'original visit'. The other options (sleeping, adventure course, zoo) are not mentioned or contradict the text which focuses on a 'promenade' (walk) in a 'forêt' (forest).

6914f057-48a7-4313-a292-5968258784e3.text: Le projet de tunnel sous l'Atlantique "Transatlantic" faisait croire à un train fantôme dans un faux tunnel, mais une vraie campagne de communication. Tout le monde en a parlé : des affiches partout en France présentaient ce projet de tunnel qui mettrait New York à 8 heures de train de Paris. La plaisanterie a bien fonctionné. Mais qui se cachait donc derrière ce projet ? Aujourd'hui, le publicitaire et son client, la SNCF, avouent tout en révélant qu'« on ne peut pas aller partout en train ». C'est pourquoi "voyages SNCF" vend aussi "de l'avion et des séjours", à New York notamment. En attendant, les deux plaisantins en ont fait rêver plus d'un.
6914f057-48a7-4313-a292-5968258784e3.text_en: The "Transatlantic" tunnel project under the Atlantic made people believe in a phantom train in a fake tunnel, but a real communication campaign. Everyone talked about it: posters everywhere in France presented this tunnel project that would put New York 8 hours by train from Paris. The joke worked well. But who was hiding behind this project? Today, the advertiser and his client, the SNCF, confess everything by revealing that "one cannot go everywhere by train". That is why "voyages SNCF" also sells "flights and stays", specifically in New York. Meanwhile, the two jokers made more than one person dream.
6914f057-48a7-4313-a292-5968258784e3.question_fr: Quel était le but de la SNCF en lançant cette campagne publicitaire ?
6914f057-48a7-4313-a292-5968258784e3.question_en: What was the goal of the SNCF in launching this advertising campaign?

options.text: Annoncer le lancement d’une nouvelle ligne ferroviaire.
options.text_en: To announce the launch of a new railway line.
options.explanation: The text explicitly calls it a 'fake tunnel' and a 'joke', so no real line was being launched.

options.text: Faire patienter les usagers de la SNCF pendant leur trajet.
options.text_en: To make SNCF users wait patiently during their journey.
options.explanation: There is no mention of entertaining passengers during delays or travel time.

options.text: Promouvoir d’autres offres commerciales de la SNCF.
options.text_en: To promote other commercial offers of the SNCF.
options.explanation: The text explains that because trains can't go everywhere, SNCF sells other products like flights and stays.

options.text: Rappeler que le train permet de rallier toutes les villes.
options.text_en: To remind that the train allows connecting all cities.
options.explanation: The text states the opposite: 'one cannot go everywhere by train'.

6914f057-48a7-4313-a292-5968258784e3.key_line_fr: C'est pourquoi "voyages SNCF" vend aussi "de l'avion et des séjours", à New York notamment.
6914f057-48a7-4313-a292-5968258784e3.key_line_en: That is why "voyages SNCF" also sells "flights and stays", specifically in New York.
6914f057-48a7-4313-a292-5968258784e3.explanation: The campaign used a fake train tunnel to highlight that trains cannot reach everywhere, thereby promoting SNCF's other services like flight bookings.
6914f057-48a7-4313-a292-5968258784e3.breakdown:
1. The text states the 'Transatlantic' tunnel project was a 'faux tunnel' (fake tunnel) and a 'plaisanterie' (joke/prank).
2. The SNCF admits the truth: 'on ne peut pas aller partout en train' (one cannot go everywhere by train).
3. The text concludes: 'C'est pourquoi "voyages SNCF" vend aussi "de l'avion et des séjours"' (That is why 'voyages SNCF' also sells flights and stays).
4. This indicates the goal was to advertise services other than train travel (flights, vacation packages).
5. Option C matches this by mentioning 'promoting other commercial offers'.

843785b5-d259-401f-bdd5-bfeaab5c6492.text:
Parents mode d’emploi
Série télévisée-Du lundi au vendredi à 20 h 40
Nous découvrons le quotidien de Gaby et Isa, les personnages principaux, quadragénaires d'aujourd'hui, qui cherchent un mode d'emploi pour être de bons parents ! Ils essaient de contrôler la situation et seraient même prêts à nous donner des conseils mais comme tous les parents, ils font de grosses erreurs… ce qui nous amuse et nous fait rire, pour notre plus grand plaisir !
D'après www.elephant-groupe.com
843785b5-d259-401f-bdd5-bfeaab5c6492.text_en:
TV Series - Monday to Friday at 8:40 PM
We discover the daily life of Gaby and Isa, the main characters, 40-year-olds of today, who are looking for a user manual to be good parents! They try to control the situation and would even be ready to give us advice but like all parents, they make big mistakes... which amuses us and makes us laugh, for our greatest pleasure!
According to www.elephant-groupe.com
843785b5-d259-401f-bdd5-bfeaab5c6492.question_fr: Quel est l'objectif de cette série télévisée ?
843785b5-d259-401f-bdd5-bfeaab5c6492.question_en: What is the objective of this TV series?

options.text: 1. Informer sur de nouvelles méthodes éducatives.
options.text_en: To inform about new educational methods.
options.explanation: The text states the parents make 'big mistakes' and amuse the audience, rather than successfully teaching valid educational methods.

options.text: Montrer la vie de tous les jours d’un jeune couple.
options.text_en: To show the daily life of a young couple.
options.explanation: The couple is described as 'quadragénaires' (people in their 40s), so they are not considered a 'young couple' in this context.

options.text: Présenter les relations familiales avec humour.
options.text_en: To present family relationships with humor.
options.explanation: The text explicitly mentions that the parents' behavior 'makes us laugh' (nous fait rire), which aligns with presenting family life with humor.

options.text: Proposer de solutions a des situations de crise.
options.text_en: To propose solutions to crisis situations.
options.explanation: While they seek solutions, the text highlights that they fail ('make big mistakes') for comic effect, rather than providing actual solutions to crises.

843785b5-d259-401f-bdd5-bfeaab5c6492.key_line_fr: ...ils font de grosses erreurs… ce qui nous amuse et nous fait rire, pour notre plus grand plaisir !
843785b5-d259-401f-bdd5-bfeaab5c6492.key_line_en: ...they make big mistakes... which amuses us and makes us laugh, for our greatest pleasure!
843785b5-d259-401f-bdd5-bfeaab5c6492.explanation: The passage states that the parents' mistakes make the audience laugh ('nous fait rire'), indicating the goal is entertainment through humor.
843785b5-d259-401f-bdd5-bfeaab5c6492.breakdown:
1. The text describes a TV series featuring parents who try to be perfect but make 'grosses erreurs' (big mistakes).
2. The outcome of these mistakes is described as 'ce qui nous amuse et nous fait rire' (which amuses us and makes us laugh).
3. Option A and D imply a serious or educational purpose, which contradicts the fact that they make mistakes and the show is for pleasure.
4. Option B is incorrect because the characters are 'quadragénaires' (in their 40s), not a 'young couple', and it misses the key element of humor.
5. Option C fits perfectly as it links the family context ('relations familiales') with the reaction described in the text ('rire' -> 'humour').

3638b9ce-07d2-435e-afd5-6e1431ed384a.text:
Le festival Étonnants Voyageurs de Saint-Malo ouvrira ses portes vendredi 27 mai.
Comme chaque année, ce rendez-vous soutenu par de nombreux sponsors réunit des écrivains du voyage.
En revanche, la thématique qui, jusqu'à présent, était de rigueur, a été abandonnée cette année.
Pas de pays à l’honneur, mais le monde, car si l’identité propre à tout groupe humain n'est pas contestée, les frontières posent problème.
Quelle légitimité y a-t-il en effet à mettre en valeur un pays, alors que l’une des revendications de ces écrivains qui ont fondé le collectif « Rour-une littérature voyageuse » est d’être citoyen du monde ?
C’est donc le rapport à la route qui est questionné cette année, sans souci de localisation précise.
3638b9ce-07d2-435e-afd5-6e1431ed384a.text_en: The Étonnants Voyageurs festival in Saint-Malo will open its doors on Friday, May 27th. Like every year, this meeting, supported by numerous sponsors, brings together travel writers. However, the theme that had been customary until now has been abandoned this year. No country of honor, but the world, because while the identity specific to any human group is not contested, borders pose a problem. Indeed, what legitimacy is there in highlighting a country, when one of the claims of these writers... is to be a citizen of the world? It is therefore the relationship to the road that is questioned this year, without concern for precise localization.
3638b9ce-07d2-435e-afd5-6e1431ed384a.question_fr: Pourquoi le festival Etonnants Voyageurs a-t-il cessé de mettre un pays à l'honneur?
3638b9ce-07d2-435e-afd5-6e1431ed384a.question_en: Why has the Etonnants Voyageurs festival stopped honoring a specific country?

options.text: Parce que la majorité des pays invités en a fait la demande.
options.text_en: Because the majority of invited countries requested it.
options.explanation: The text does not mention any requests made by the invited countries.

options.text: Parce que la manifestation s’est centrée sur la région de Saint-Malo.
options.text_en: Because the event centered on the Saint-Malo region.
options.explanation: Saint-Malo is the location of the festival, but the text explicitly states the theme is about 'the world' without precise localization, not centered specifically on the Saint-Malo region as a topic.

options.text: Parce que les partenaires ont réduit leurs subventions.
options.text_en: Because the partners reduced their subsidies.
options.explanation: The text mentions the event is 'supported by numerous sponsors' ('soutenu par de nombreux sponsors'), implying continued support rather than a reduction in subsidies.

options.text: Parce que l’événement s’inscrit dans un principe d’universalité.
options.text_en: Because the event subscribes to a principle of universality.
options.explanation: The text emphasizes 'the world' over specific countries and mentions the writers' claim to be 'citizens of the world,' which aligns with the principle of universality.

3638b9ce-07d2-435e-afd5-6e1431ed384a.key_line_fr: Quelle légitimité y a-t-il en effet à mettre en valeur un pays, alors que l’une des revendications de ces écrivains... est d’être citoyen du monde ?
3638b9ce-07d2-435e-afd5-6e1431ed384a.key_line_en: Indeed, what legitimacy is there in highlighting a country, when one of the claims of these writers... is to be a citizen of the world?
3638b9ce-07d2-435e-afd5-6e1431ed384a.explanation: The festival stopped honoring specific countries because the participating writers identify as 'citizens of the world,' preferring a universal theme over national borders.
3638b9ce-07d2-435e-afd5-6e1431ed384a.breakdown: The text explains that the festival abandoned the tradition of honoring a specific country ('Pas de pays à l’honneur'). Instead, it focuses on 'the world' ('mais le monde'). The text justifies this by stating that the writers involved claim to be 'citizens of the world' ('citoyen du monde') and find borders problematic. This alignment with a global perspective and rejection of specific national boundaries corresponds directly to the 'principle of universality' mentioned in Option D.

e36fa837-983e-4c52-ba64-cb1e3973039a.text: Le lieu de travail doit-il être un espace où il faut en permanence être souriant et heureux ? L'idée qu'il est essentiel de constamment se présenter sous son meilleur jour est depuis longtemps ancrée dans les mentalités. Pour cette raison, les employeurs cherchent souvent comment faire pour stimuler le moral de leurs employés. II vient pourtant d'être prouvé que cela était contre- productif : s'autoriser à ne pas toujours être aimable peut mener les employés à faire moins d'erreurs et à améliorer leurs capacités de communication.
e36fa837-983e-4c52-ba64-cb1e3973039a.text_en: Should the workplace be a space where one must permanently be smiling and happy? The idea that it is essential to constantly present oneself in one's best light has long been anchored in mentalities. For this reason, employers often seek how to stimulate the morale of their employees. However, it has just been proven that this was counter-productive: allowing oneself not to be always amiable can lead employees to make fewer errors and improve their communication skills.
e36fa837-983e-4c52-ba64-cb1e3973039a.question_fr: Quelle idée est remise en questionpar cet auteur ?
e36fa837-983e-4c52-ba64-cb1e3973039a.question_en: What idea is questioned by this author?

options.text: L’esprit d’équipe est la clé de la réussite professionnelle.
options.text_en: Team spirit is the key to professional success.
options.explanation: The text focuses on individual mood and emotional expression, not on team spirit or collaboration.

options.text: La bonne humeur garantit de meilleures performances.
options.explanation: The text argues against the idea that one must always be happy to work well, stating instead that not being amiable can improve accuracy (reduce errors).

options.text: Le cadre de l’entreprise influe sur le moral des salariés.
options.text_en: The corporate setting influences the morale of employees.
options.explanation: While the text implies employers try to influence morale, the main argument is about the *consequences* of forced happiness, not the environment itself.

options.text: Les primes contribuent à la motivation du personnel.
options.explanation: There is no mention of bonuses, salaries, or financial incentives in the passage.

e36fa837-983e-4c52-ba64-cb1e3973039a.key_line_fr: II vient pourtant d'être prouvé que cela était contre- productif : s'autoriser à ne pas toujours être aimable peut mener les employés à faire moins d'erreurs et à améliorer leurs capacités de communication.
e36fa837-983e-4c52-ba64-cb1e3973039a.key_line_en: However, it has just been proven that this was counter-productive: allowing oneself not to be always amiable can lead employees to make fewer errors and improve their communication skills.
e36fa837-983e-4c52-ba64-cb1e3973039a.explanation: The author refutes the traditional belief that employees must always be happy to be productive, showing that negative moods can actually lead to fewer mistakes.
e36fa837-983e-4c52-ba64-cb1e3973039a.breakdown:
1. **Analyze the text**: The text starts by describing a common belief: the workplace should be a place where people are always smiling and happy (presenting their best side). 
2. **Identify the pivot**: The phrase 'Il vient pourtant d'être prouvé que cela était contre-productif' (However, it has just been proven that this was counter-productive) signals that the author is challenging the previous statement.
3. **Analyze the conclusion**: The text states that allowing oneself *not* to be amiable leads to fewer errors and better communication (better performance).
4. **Match with options**: Option B claims 'Good mood guarantees better performance.' The author explicitly refutes this by saying constant happiness is counter-productive and negative moods can actually reduce errors. Therefore, Option B is the idea being challenged.

ebb190b3-8a54-4b52-8b22-03370e0fb65b.text:
Serge Ravet est catégorique: « Demain, on étudiera dans un autre monde, un monde virtuel », affirme le directeur de l'Institut européen du e-learning, convaincu que les nouvelles technologies vont « révolutionner la manière d'apprendre et d'enseigner ».
Avec l'e-learning (ou formation en ligne), l’étudiant devient effectivement acteur de sa formation. Grâce aux outils de communication - messagerie instantanée, tchat, visioconférence – et de collaboration – wikis, forums -, il peut entretenir une relation nouvelle avec ses professeurs. « Curieusement, la distance physique peut être un avantage car la technologie facilite les interactions, signale Serge Ravet. Il est souvent moins intimidant d’interpeller un prof derrière son écran qu'en amphithéâtre ! »
ebb190b3-8a54-4b52-8b22-03370e0fb65b.text_en:
Serge Ravet is categorical: "Tomorrow, we will study in another world, a virtual world," affirms the director of the European Institute of E-learning, convinced that new technologies will "revolutionize the way of learning and teaching".
With e-learning (or online training), the student effectively becomes an active participant in their training. Thanks to communication tools - instant messaging, chat, video conferencing - and collaboration tools - wikis, forums -, he can maintain a new relationship with his professors. "Curiously, physical distance can be an advantage because technology facilitates interactions, points out Serge Ravet. It is often less intimidating to call out to a professor behind one's screen than in a lecture hall!"
ebb190b3-8a54-4b52-8b22-03370e0fb65b.question_fr: Qu'apprend-on sur les étudiants qui pratiquent l'e-learning ?
ebb190b3-8a54-4b52-8b22-03370e0fb65b.question_en: What do we learn about students who practice e-learning?

options.text: Ils améliorent leurs résultats dans toutes les matières.
options.text_en: They improve their results in all subjects.
options.explanation: The text discusses the method of learning, not specific academic results or grades.

options.text: Ils regrettent le manque de possibilités d’échanges.
options.text_en: They regret the lack of possibilities for exchange.
options.explanation: The text states the opposite: technology "facilitates interactions" through chat, video, etc.

options.text: Ils s’impliquent de façon responsable dans les cours.
options.text_en: They get involved in a responsible way in the courses.
options.explanation: The phrase "acteur de sa formation" indicates active participation and responsibility, which aligns with getting involved responsibly.

options.text: Ils sont de plus en plus nombreux à choisir ce système.
options.text_en: They are increasingly numerous in choosing this system.
options.explanation: The text predicts a future revolution but does not provide current statistics on the growing number of students.

ebb190b3-8a54-4b52-8b22-03370e0fb65b.key_line_fr: Avec l'e-learning (ou formation en ligne), l’étudiant devient effectivement acteur de sa formation.
ebb190b3-8a54-4b52-8b22-03370e0fb65b.key_line_en: With e-learning (or online training), the student effectively becomes an active participant in their training.

vocabulary.gloss: to call out to / to question

ebb190b3-8a54-4b52-8b22-03370e0fb65b.explanation: The text explicitly states that the student becomes an "actor" of their training, which means they take an active and responsible role in their learning process.
ebb190b3-8a54-4b52-8b22-03370e0fb65b.breakdown:

dd282a25-2710-4fc7-8223-8e9ad565f088.text:
Chère Madame,
Je vous remercie de votre commande mais votre règlement ne couvre pas totalement le montant de votre achat. Plutôt que de vous faire supporter des frais supplémentaires, je vous expédie votre colis dès aujourd'hui et je vous demande de me faire parvenir un chèque de 20 euros, à réception.
Ben sincèrement.
dd282a25-2710-4fc7-8223-8e9ad565f088.text_en: Dear Madam, I thank you for your order but your payment does not fully cover the amount of your purchase. Rather than making you bear additional costs, I am shipping your package today and I ask you to send me a check for 20 euros, upon receipt. Sincerely.
dd282a25-2710-4fc7-8223-8e9ad565f088.question_fr: Quel est l'objet de cette lettre ?

options.text: Prévenir une cliente que sa commande sera livrée en retard.
options.text_en: To warn a client that her order will be delivered late.
options.explanation: The text states the package is being shipped 'today' (dès aujourd'hui), so there is no delay.

options.text: Confirmer à une cliente que sa commande a bien été expédiée.
options.text_en: To confirm to a client that her order has been shipped.
options.explanation: While the letter mentions shipping the package, this is secondary to the main issue, which is requesting the unpaid balance.

options.text: Prévenir une cliente qu’elle devra payer 20 euros de frais d’envoi.
options.text_en: To warn a client that she will have to pay 20 euros in shipping fees.
options.explanation: The 20 euros is part of the purchase amount, not shipping fees. The author explicitly states they are avoiding extra costs for the client.

dd282a25-2710-4fc7-8223-8e9ad565f088.key_line_fr: votre règlement ne couvre pas totalement le montant de votre achat... je vous demande de me faire parvenir un chèque de 20 euros
dd282a25-2710-4fc7-8223-8e9ad565f088.key_line_en: your payment does not fully cover the amount of your purchase... I ask you to send me a check for 20 euros
dd282a25-2710-4fc7-8223-8e9ad565f088.explanation: The client's payment was insufficient, so the seller is asking for the remaining 20 euros to complete the full payment of the order.
dd282a25-2710-4fc7-8223-8e9ad565f088.breakdown: The letter addresses a payment discrepancy. The sender notes that the customer's payment is insufficient ('ne couvre pas totalement le montant') and requests the remaining balance of 20 euros ('je vous demande de me faire parvenir un chèque de 20 euros'). While the letter mentions the item is being shipped (Option C), the primary purpose of writing is to resolve the payment issue and request the missing funds to complete the purchase price. Option B is incorrect because the package is being sent 'today' (not late). Option D is incorrect because the text explicitly avoids charging extra fees ('frais supplémentaires'), and the 20 euros represents the missing purchase amount, not shipping fees.

313ddb57-c001-43c0-bdf7-5030cb5fe845.text:
Par une erreur d'inattention en réservant leurs billets via Internet, trois touristes étrangers ont découvert la campagne verdoyante de Rodez, en France, au lieu des plages ensoleillées de Rhodes, en Grèce.
Ils ont en effet confondu les deux destinations. Ils ont donc pris l'avion pour se rendre sur l'ile grecque et c'est avec surprise qu'ils ont atterri dans l'Aveyron.
C'est joli aussi, mais il n'y a pas la mer !
Selon l'aéroport, une dizaine de touristes vivent ce type d'aventure chaque année.
313ddb57-c001-43c0-bdf7-5030cb5fe845.text_en: Due to a careless mistake while booking their tickets via the Internet, three foreign tourists discovered the green countryside of Rodez, in France, instead of the sunny beaches of Rhodes, in Greece. Indeed, they confused the two destinations. So they took the plane to go to the Greek island and it was with surprise that they landed in Aveyron. It's pretty too, but there is no sea! According to the airport, about ten tourists experience this type of adventure every year.

313ddb57-c001-43c0-bdf7-5030cb5fe845.key_line_en: Due to a careless mistake while booking their tickets via the Internet, three foreign tourists discovered the green countryside of Rodez, in France, instead of the sunny beaches of Rhodes, in Greece.

4623c128-febc-4a74-82d5-1c06fb205dfe.text:
Le télétravail peut être bénéfique dans la mesure où le télétravailleur développe des compétences de planification et d'autogestion.
Toutefois, pour qu'il soit vraiment profitable, il faut que ses modalités soient clairement définies par l'entreprise. Sinon, un climat de méfiance entre collègues, voire de rejet, risque de s'installer et d'inciter les télétravailleurs à s'investir plus intensément que nécessaire. Par ailleurs, le télétravail rend la frontière entre domaine familial et univers professionnel plus floue, il est difficile de déconnecter de l'un ou de l'autre. Sur ce point, les chercheurs observent une différence entre les télétravailleurs qui ont beaucoup de responsabilités familiales, et ceux qui en ont moins : les premiers connaissent plus de conflits en télétravail que les seconds.
4623c128-febc-4a74-82d5-1c06fb205dfe.text_en: Telework can be beneficial insofar as the teleworker develops planning and self-management skills. However, for it to be truly profitable, its terms must be clearly defined by the company. Otherwise, a climate of mistrust between colleagues, or even rejection, risks settling in and inciting teleworkers to invest themselves more intensely than necessary. Furthermore, telework makes the boundary between the family domain and the professional universe more blurred; it is difficult to disconnect from one or the other. On this point, researchers observe a difference between teleworkers who have many family responsibilities and those who have fewer: the former experience more conflicts in telework than the latter.
4623c128-febc-4a74-82d5-1c06fb205dfe.question_fr: Que constate l'auteur de l'article à propos des télétravailleurs ?
4623c128-febc-4a74-82d5-1c06fb205dfe.question_en: What does the author of the article observe about teleworkers?

options.explanation: The text mentions a risk of "mistrust" or "rejection" from colleagues, not specifically "isolation."

options.explanation: The text suggests a potential "climate of mistrust," not an intensification of exchanges.

options.explanation: The text explicitly mentions that the boundary between family and work becomes "blurred" and hard to disconnect from, which means they must juggle both.

4623c128-febc-4a74-82d5-1c06fb205dfe.key_line_fr: Par ailleurs, le télétravail rend la frontière entre domaine familial et univers professionnel plus floue, il est difficile de déconnecter de l'un ou de l'autre.
4623c128-febc-4a74-82d5-1c06fb205dfe.key_line_en: Furthermore, telework makes the boundary between the family domain and the professional universe more blurred; it is difficult to disconnect from one or the other.
4623c128-febc-4a74-82d5-1c06fb205dfe.explanation: The text explicitly states that telework blurs the boundary between the family and professional domains, making it difficult to separate the two.
4623c128-febc-4a74-82d5-1c06fb205dfe.breakdown:

a9292f43-8d65-4181-8852-b6ae8bb17231.text:
« Suggéré par la France, le Label du patrimoine européen met l'accent sur l'histoire des pays et sur la contribution des lieux à l'unité de l'Europe.
Il est décerné par l'Union européenne à des sites choisis pour leur valeur symbolique et leur rôle historique. Ainsi, le quartier européen de Strasbourg a-t-il reçu ce label. Cette initiative a pour objectif d'aider les citoyens européens à mieux comprendre les idéaux de l'Europe, à mieux connaître leur patrimoine culturel commun, à mieux cerner les valeurs démocratiques qui sous-tendent le processus d'intégration européenne.
Elle a également vocation à sensibiliser les citoyens, notamment les jeunes, aux droits de l'homme et à renforcer le dialogue interculturel par l'éducation artistique et civilisationnelle.»
a9292f43-8d65-4181-8852-b6ae8bb17231.text_en: Suggested by France, the European Heritage Label emphasizes the history of countries and the contribution of sites to the unity of Europe. It is awarded by the European Union to sites chosen for their symbolic value and their historical role. Thus, the European quarter of Strasbourg received this label. This initiative aims to help European citizens better understand the ideals of Europe, better know their common cultural heritage, better grasp the democratic values that underpin the process of European integration. It also intends to raise awareness among citizens, especially young people, about human rights and to strengthen intercultural dialogue through artistic and civilizational education.
a9292f43-8d65-4181-8852-b6ae8bb17231.question_fr: Quel est l'intérêt de ce label ?
a9292f43-8d65-4181-8852-b6ae8bb17231.question_en: What is the interest of this label?

options.explanation: The text explicitly mentions 'unity of Europe' and 'common cultural heritage,' which equates to developing a common identity.

options.text_en: To reward the most beautiful sites.
options.explanation: The text states sites are chosen for 'symbolic value' and 'historical role,' not for being the 'most beautiful.'
The label is 'European' and awarded by the 'European Union,' not limited to safeguarding only 'French' heritage.

options.text_en: To valorize the diversity of languages.
options.explanation: The text discusses history, values, and intercultural dialogue, but does not mention the 'diversity of languages' as a goal.

a9292f43-8d65-4181-8852-b6ae8bb17231.key_line_fr: Cette initiative a pour objectif d'aider les citoyens européens à mieux comprendre les idéaux de l'Europe, à mieux connaître leur patrimoine culturel commun...
a9292f43-8d65-4181-8852-b6ae8bb17231.key_line_en: This initiative aims to help European citizens better understand the ideals of Europe, better know their common cultural heritage...
a9292f43-8d65-4181-8852-b6ae8bb17231.explanation: The text focuses on 'common cultural heritage,' 'unity,' and 'integration,' which aligns with the goal of developing a shared European identity.
a9292f43-8d65-4181-8852-b6ae8bb17231.breakdown:
The text defines the purpose of the label in several places. It mentions emphasizing the 'contribution of sites to the unity of Europe' and aims to help citizens know their 'common cultural heritage' and understand 'democratic values' underpinning 'European integration.' These elements—unity, common heritage, and integration—collectively point towards building a shared sense of belonging, or a common identity (Option A).

Option B is incorrect because the text specifies sites are chosen for 'symbolic value and their historical role,' not beauty. Option C is incorrect because while suggested by France, it is a 'European' label awarded by the EU, not focused solely on French heritage. Option D is incorrect because the text mentions intercultural dialogue and history, but does not specifically mention linguistic diversity.

b686d6bf-a142-4ea9-8237-9f84ec73a20a.text:
Une étude récente alerte sur les risques que la révolution digitale fait peser sur les emplois: quatre postes sur dix risqueraient d'être robotisés d'ici vingt ans.
Trois millions d'emplois pourraient être détruits. Qu'en est-il en réalité ?
À n'en pas douter, la révolution numérique a déjà conduit à la suppression de nombreux emplois.
Mais elle en a créé de nouveaux aussi.
Le paysage de l'emploi sera certainement impacté par une nouvelle génération de machines.
Cependant, la vérité est que personne ne peut anticiper l'avenir technologique à l'horizon de dix ou vingt ans et encore moins mesurer ses conséquences sur l'emploi.
b686d6bf-a142-4ea9-8237-9f84ec73a20a.text_en: A recent study warns of the risks that the digital revolution poses to jobs: four out of ten positions risk being robotized within twenty years. Three million jobs could be destroyed. What is the reality? Undoubtedly, the digital revolution has already led to the elimination of many jobs. But it has created new ones too. The employment landscape will certainly be impacted by a new generation of machines. However, the truth is that no one can anticipate the technological future on a horizon of ten or twenty years, let alone measure its consequences on employment.
b686d6bf-a142-4ea9-8237-9f84ec73a20a.question_fr: Quelle est la position de l'auteur au sujetde cette étude ?
b686d6bf-a142-4ea9-8237-9f84ec73a20a.question_en: What is the author's position regarding this study?

options.explanation: The text discusses the study's conclusions, not the technical methods used to reach them.

options.text: Il discute la pertinence des exemples.
options.text_en: He discusses the relevance of the examples.
options.explanation: The text does not provide or debate specific examples of jobs or industries.
The author balances the negative prediction (job destruction) with positive factors (job creation) and skepticism about predicting the future, thus 'nuancing' the alarmist view.

options.text: Il confirme les résultats de l’étude.
options.text_en: He confirms the results of the study.
options.explanation: The author explicitly states that the future consequences cannot be measured, which contradicts confirming the study's specific numbers.

b686d6bf-a142-4ea9-8237-9f84ec73a20a.key_line_fr: Cependant, la vérité est que personne ne peut anticiper l'avenir technologique à l'horizon de dix ou vingt ans et encore moins mesurer ses conséquences sur l'emploi.
b686d6bf-a142-4ea9-8237-9f84ec73a20a.key_line_en: However, the truth is that no one can anticipate the technological future on a horizon of ten or twenty years, let alone measure its consequences on employment.
b686d6bf-a142-4ea9-8237-9f84ec73a20a.explanation: The author argues that while jobs are lost, new ones are created and the future is unpredictable, thereby softening the study's scary predictions.
b686d6bf-a142-4ea9-8237-9f84ec73a20a.breakdown: The text begins by presenting the study's alarming prediction: 'Three million jobs could be destroyed.' The author then pivots with the question 'Qu'en est-il en réalité ?' (What is the reality?). They acknowledge job losses but immediately counter with 'Mais elle en a créé de nouveaux aussi' (But it has created new ones too). Finally, the author concludes that 'personne ne peut anticiper l'avenir' (no one can anticipate the future). This effectively creates a nuance or qualification to the study's extreme (alarmist) predictions rather than rejecting them entirely or accepting them blindly.

49d4905e-22ba-4053-90bb-c9cd79ee9622.text:
Les Gaulois étaient un peuple celte qui vivait sur le territoire aujourd'hui appelé France. Que sait-on d'eux ?
« C'étaient d'excellents forgerons qui savaient fabriquer des armes solides, explique Joseph Le Gall, archéologue.
Mais ce n'était pas qu'un peuple de valeureux guerriers, c'étaient des paysans qui pratiquaient l'élevage, cultivaient la terre : une activitéu humaine, pacifique par nature.
S'ils sont cultivateurs, les Gaulois sont aussi habiles commerçants.
Ils sont encore excellents artisans : les outils, poteries ou bijoux retrouvés lors de fouilles archéologiques révèlent un peuple qui aime les belles choses. »
Qu'en est-il alors de cette réputation de bagarreurs qu'on leur prête facilement ?
« Il y a des conflits au temps des Gaulois, dit Joseph Le Gall,d comme à toutes les époques. »
49d4905e-22ba-4053-90bb-c9cd79ee9622.text_en: The Gauls were a Celtic people who lived on the territory today called France. What do we know about them? "They were excellent blacksmiths who knew how to make solid weapons," explains Joseph Le Gall, archaeologist. But they were not just a people of valiant warriors, they were peasants who practiced animal husbandry, cultivated the land: a human activity, peaceful by nature. If they are farmers, the Gauls are also skilled traders. They are also excellent artisans: the tools, pottery or jewelry found during archaeological excavations reveal a people who love beautiful things. What about this reputation as brawlers that is easily attributed to them? "There are conflicts in the time of the Gauls," says Joseph Le Gall, "as in all eras."
49d4905e-22ba-4053-90bb-c9cd79ee9622.question_fr: Que remet en cause cet article à propos des Gaulois ?
49d4905e-22ba-4053-90bb-c9cd79ee9622.question_en: What does this article call into question regarding the Gauls?

options.explanation: The text mentions they were 'habiles commerçants' (skilled traders), which implies negotiation skills, but it does not challenge this ability; it affirms it.
The text challenges the idea that they were solely 'bagarreurs' (brawlers) or warriors, emphasizing their peaceful nature as farmers and artisans instead.
The text affirms they 'aime les belles choses' (love beautiful things), supporting their sense of aesthetics rather than questioning it.
The text explicitly states they were 'paysans' (peasants) who cultivated the land, confirming their talent as farmers.

49d4905e-22ba-4053-90bb-c9cd79ee9622.key_line_fr: Mais ce n'était pas qu'un peuple de valeureux guerriers, c'étaient des paysans qui pratiquaient l'élevage, cultivaient la terre : une activité humaine, pacifique par nature.
49d4905e-22ba-4053-90bb-c9cd79ee9622.key_line_en: But they were not just a people of valiant warriors, they were peasants who practiced animal husbandry, cultivated the land: a human activity, peaceful by nature.
49d4905e-22ba-4053-90bb-c9cd79ee9622.explanation: The text argues that the Gauls were not just warriors but primarily peaceful farmers and artisans, thus challenging their reputation as purely warlike people.
49d4905e-22ba-4053-90bb-c9cd79ee9622.breakdown:
The question asks what the article challenges (remet en cause) regarding the Gauls. 
1. The text starts by acknowledging they were smiths and warriors.
2. Crucially, it introduces a contrast with 'Mais' (But): 'ce n'était pas qu'un peuple de valeureux guerriers' (they were not just a people of valiant warriors).
3. It emphasizes they were 'paysans' (farmers) engaged in a 'pacifique' (peaceful) activity.
4. It explicitly mentions the 'réputation de bagarreurs' (reputation as brawlers) and clarifies that while conflicts existed, they were also skilled artisans and traders.
5. Therefore, the article challenges the reductionist view of their warlike nature (esprit belliqueux).

bf48b3a7-b924-4f2c-9f49-c3416fa6b287.text:
Les plateformes Internet, presque en temps réel, ajustent ce qui est offert à nos attentes. Or, une attente, c'est quelque chose qui ne vient pas tout de suite.
Là, il y a un court-circuit: avant même que je puisse attendre quelque chose, une proposition vient à moi, en fonction de ce que des machines ont calculé de ce qui devrait être mon attente !
On tape quelques lettres et le moteur de recherche nous dit déjà ce qu'on veut savoir.
L'un des dangers est de conditionner nos attentes pour qu'elles soient alignées sur les intérêts commerciaux plutôt que suscitées par notre curiosité.
La curiosité consiste justement à essayer de dépasser ses attentes. Aller vers le bizarre, l'étonnant, le non-aligné.
bf48b3a7-b924-4f2c-9f49-c3416fa6b287.text_en: Internet platforms, almost in real time, adjust what is offered to our expectations. However, an expectation is something that does not come immediately. Here, there is a short-circuit: even before I can expect something, a proposal comes to me, based on what machines have calculated my expectation should be! We type a few letters and the search engine already tells us what we want to know. One of the dangers is to condition our expectations so that they align with commercial interests rather than being aroused by our curiosity. Curiosity consists precisely in trying to go beyond one's expectations. Going towards the bizarre, the astonishing, the non-aligned.
bf48b3a7-b924-4f2c-9f49-c3416fa6b287.question_fr: Que dénonce la personne interviewée à propos des moteurs de recherche Internet ?
bf48b3a7-b924-4f2c-9f49-c3416fa6b287.question_en: What does the interviewee denounce regarding Internet search engines?

options.explanation: The text describes how algorithms anticipate and condition our desires, preventing genuine curiosity and independent choice, which amounts to stifling free will.
The text discusses how results are selected (based on prediction/commerce), not their accuracy or truthfulness.
The text focuses on the speed and anticipation of results ('almost in real time'), not on the quantity of results provided.
While 'commercial interests' are mentioned as the driving force behind the algorithms, the main criticism is the psychological conditioning of the user, not the visual clutter of advertisements.

bf48b3a7-b924-4f2c-9f49-c3416fa6b287.key_line_fr: L'un des dangers est de conditionner nos attentes pour qu'elles soient alignées sur les intérêts commerciaux plutôt que suscitées par notre curiosité.
bf48b3a7-b924-4f2c-9f49-c3416fa6b287.key_line_en: One of the dangers is to condition our expectations so that they align with commercial interests rather than being aroused by our curiosity.
bf48b3a7-b924-4f2c-9f49-c3416fa6b287.explanation: The author criticizes search engines for predicting our needs and shaping our expectations to fit commercial goals, thereby removing the element of surprise and our ability to choose freely (free will).
bf48b3a7-b924-4f2c-9f49-c3416fa6b287.breakdown: The text explains that internet platforms anticipate our needs using algorithms ('machines have calculated'), often presenting options before we even form a conscious desire. This creates a 'short-circuit' where our expectations are conditioned to fit commercial interests rather than arising from genuine curiosity. By pre-empting our requests and steering us toward calculated outcomes, these engines reduce our ability to explore the unexpected or make independent choices, effectively stifling free will.

80a48b18-79be-4d0f-af53-5e6598200c14.text:
« La rhétorique de préservation de la planète est désormais omniprésente dans le discours public, elle capte l'attention des électeurs et des consommateurs. Parfois, elle relève d'une pratique qui consiste à utiliser l'argument écologique dans le seul but d'améliorer son image et qui ne date pas d'hier, si l'on pense au principe très répandu de coller un logo en forme de petite fleur ou d'ours polaire, sur un emballage vert ou brun pour rassurer quant à l'origine du produit.
Le bon sens et l'instinct permettent quasi toujours de déjouer les cas les plus flagrants, mais d'autres messages sont plus ambigus. Dans ce contexte, une poignée de journalistes économiques et scientifiques ont élaboré un manuel permettant de déceler de tels cas d'écoblanchiment. »
80a48b18-79be-4d0f-af53-5e6598200c14.text_en: The rhetoric of preserving the planet is now omnipresent in public discourse; it captures the attention of voters and consumers. Sometimes, it stems from a practice consisting of using the ecological argument for the sole purpose of improving one's image and which is not new, if one considers the very widespread principle of sticking a logo in the shape of a small flower or polar bear on green or brown packaging to reassure regarding the origin of the product. Common sense and instinct almost always allow one to thwart the most flagrant cases, but other messages are more ambiguous. In this context, a handful of economic and scientific journalists have developed a manual allowing one to detect such cases of greenwashing.

options.explanation: The text mentions consumers but does not discuss changes in dietary habits.
There is no mention of waste reduction measures in the text.
The text describes voluntary deceptive practices by companies, not regulations imposed upon them.
The text critiques 'greenwashing' (écoblanchiment) and using ecological arguments to improve image, which are deceptive communication strategies.

80a48b18-79be-4d0f-af53-5e6598200c14.key_line_fr: Parfois, elle relève d'une pratique qui consiste à utiliser l'argument écologique dans le seul but d'améliorer son image...
80a48b18-79be-4d0f-af53-5e6598200c14.key_line_en: Sometimes, it stems from a practice consisting of using the ecological argument for the sole purpose of improving one's image...
80a48b18-79be-4d0f-af53-5e6598200c14.explanation: The article discusses 'greenwashing' (écoblanchiment), where companies use ecological arguments and packaging to improve their image without substance, which is a criticism of communication strategies.
80a48b18-79be-4d0f-af53-5e6598200c14.breakdown:
1.  **Identify the main topic**: The text discusses the 'rhetoric of preserving the planet' in public discourse.
2.  **Analyze the criticism**: The author notes that this rhetoric is often used solely to 'improve one's image' (améliorer son image) through packaging tricks (logos, colors) rather than genuine action. 
3.  **Identify the specific term**: The text ends by mentioning a manual to detect 'écoblanchiment' (greenwashing).
4.  **Match with options**: Greenwashing and using ecological arguments for image enhancement are marketing and **communication strategies**. The text does not discuss diets (A), waste (B), or imposed legal norms (C).

b1314cd7-e6b8-4758-b0ba-39fb793945c7.text:
« Né sous la plume de Georges Simenon il y a 90 ans, le commissaire Maigret a été le héros de 75 romans et de 28 nouvelles. Sa silhouette massive aura hanté les couloirs du 36, quai des Orfèvres de 1931 à 1972.
Armé de sa pipe et d'une intuition affûtée, le commissaire Jules Maigret continue de séduire lecteurs et spectateurs quatre-vingt-dix ans après sa naissance.
Jacques Santamaria, scénariste et adaptateur de plusieurs enquêtes de Maigret, confie:
"Simenon décrit quelqu'un qui ressemble à un monolithe immobile, alors que son héros est intellectuellement toujours en mouvement, son esprit est un rouage infini, il enregistre, réfléchit, analyse sans cesse." »
b1314cd7-e6b8-4758-b0ba-39fb793945c7.text_en:
Born from the pen of Georges Simenon 90 years ago, Commissioner Maigret was the hero of 75 novels and 28 short stories. His massive silhouette haunted the hallways of 36, Quai des Orfèvres from 1931 to 1972.
Armed with his pipe and a sharpened intuition, Commissioner Jules Maigret continues to seduce readers and viewers ninety years after his birth.
Jacques Santamaria, screenwriter and adapter of several Maigret investigations, confides:
"Simenon describes someone who resembles an immovable monolith, whereas his hero is intellectually always in motion, his mind is an infinite mechanism, he records, reflects, analyzes ceaselessly."
b1314cd7-e6b8-4758-b0ba-39fb793945c7.question_fr: Que souligne Jacques Santamariachez ce héros ?
b1314cd7-e6b8-4758-b0ba-39fb793945c7.question_en: What does Jacques Santamaria highlight about this hero?

options.explanation: The introduction mentions the quantity of his adventures (75 novels), but Santamaria's quote focuses on the character's internal method, not the variety of cases.
Santamaria describes Maigret's mind as a mechanism that 'records, reflects, analyzes ceaselessly,' which directly corresponds to the 'finesse of his reasoning.'
The text's introduction mentions his 90th anniversary and career span (1931-1972), but Santamaria's specific quote discusses Maigret's mental state, not his longevity.
Santamaria explicitly states Maigret resembles an 'immovable monolith' (monolithe immobile). The 'motion' mentioned is purely intellectual, not physical.

b1314cd7-e6b8-4758-b0ba-39fb793945c7.key_line_fr: son héros est intellectuellement toujours en mouvement, son esprit est un rouage infini, il enregistre, réfléchit, analyse sans cesse.
b1314cd7-e6b8-4758-b0ba-39fb793945c7.key_line_en: his hero is intellectually always in motion, his mind is an infinite mechanism, he records, reflects, analyzes ceaselessly.

vocabulary.gloss: monolith (a large single upright block of stone)

b1314cd7-e6b8-4758-b0ba-39fb793945c7.explanation: Santamaria contrasts Maigret's physical stillness with his constant mental activity, emphasizing his continuous analysis and reflection.
b1314cd7-e6b8-4758-b0ba-39fb793945c7.breakdown: The question asks specifically what Jacques Santamaria highlights. You must look at the section of the text quoting him directly. Santamaria states that while Maigret looks like an 'immovable monolith' physically, he is 'intellectually always in motion' and that he 'records, reflects, analyzes ceaselessly.' These actions (reflecting, analyzing) refer to his mental processes and reasoning. Therefore, he highlights the sharpness/subtlety of his reasoning, not his physical movement or the duration of his career.
